question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umugore w'imyaka mirongo ine n’itandatu, yaje akorora, ahinda umuriro, ndetse ababara n'umutwe. Namupimye umuriro agira mirongo itatu n’umunani n’ibice bitatu. Mpimye tederi mpimye amaraso yiwe nsanga amaraso ye nta malariya arimo. Tederi iba negatifu. Kuko yakororaga cyane, namubajije igihe amaze akorora ambwira ko amaze ibyumweru bitatu n'iminsi ibiri. Namuganirije ku ngaruka z'inkorora itinze kuvurwa, mubwira ko yamuviramo inkora y'igikatu, cyangwa se igituntu. Mugira inama yo kujya kwa muganga ngo bamupime ko nta gituntu yaba arwaye, babashe no kumuha imiti yamurinda kuba yarwara inkorora y'igikatu. Yabinyemereye mfata igitabo cya taransiferi ndamwandika ndetse muha taransiferi ajya kwa muganga. Nabazaga nimba nta bundi bufasha namuha, cyangwa indi nama namugira. Murakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugore w'imyaka 46, arakorora, afite umuriro wa 38.3, tederi yabaye negatifu. Inama wamuhaye zirahagije, igisigaye ni ukumushishikariza kuzikurikiza vuba cyane kugira ngo banamuhe imiti imufasha. Waba umwigishije kugabanya umuriro mu buryo bwa gakondo bwo gushyira igitambaro gitose ku gahanga.
question_english: I have received a forty-six-year-old woman who has come in coughing, with a fever and a headache. I have measured her temperature, and it has been thirty-eight point three. I have tested her blood and found that she does not have malaria; the test has been negative. Since she has been coughing a lot, I have asked her how long she has been coughing, and she has told me it has been three weeks and two days. I have talked to her about the consequences of prolonged coughing, telling her that it could lead to severe coughing or tuberculosis. I have advised her to go to the hospital to be tested for tuberculosis and to receive medication to prevent severe coughing. She has agreed, and I have taken the transfer book, written her a transfer, and sent her to the hospital. I have asked if there is any other help I could offer her or any other advice I could give. Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Nasuye umugore wabyaye, afite imyaka makumya n'umunani. Afite ibiro mirongo itanu na bitanu. Mwigisha uko bonsa mubwira ko agomba konsa uko umwana ashatse konka byibura inshuro umunani ku munsi. Musobanura ko amashereka y'umuhondo arimo urukingo rurinda indwara, ambwira ko izo nshuro zose atazibonera umwanya. Mungire inama yicyo namusobanurira?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Mubwire ko umwanya agomba kuwushaka kuko na we agomba gukunda umwana we, akamufasha no kumurinda akiri muto. Ndumva wakomeza ukajya ujya kumusura, kuko uko umwigisha ibyiza byo konsa umwna azageraho abyumve, ntucike intege kwigisha ni uguhozaho.
question_english: I have visited a woman who has given birth; she is twenty-eight years old and weighs fifty-five kilograms. I have taught her how to breastfeed, telling her that she should breastfeed whenever the baby wants, at least eight times a day. I have explained to her that the yellow breast milk contains a vaccine that protects against diseases, and she has told me that she won't have time for all those times. Advise me on what I should explain to her?

question_kinyarwanda: Umugore w'imyaka mirongo itatu, afite ibiro mirongo itandatu, uburwaye afite; ikibazo cyo kuribwa mu nda, gucika intege no kuruka ibyo ariye. Namubajije ubundi burwayi asanganywe ambwira ko ntabwo usibye ko aboneza urubyaro akoresheje ibinini, namugiriye inama yo kurya imbuto imboga n'ibikomoka ku matungo, mwamfasha iki? Ni izihe nama nagira uyu murwayi?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze kubaza iki ikibazo cy,uyu mugore w,imyaka mirongo itatu,afite ibiro mirongo itandatu,uburwayi afite,ikibazo cyo kuribwa mu nda,gucika intege no kuruka ibyo ariye.umubajije niba hari ubundi burwayi afite,akubwira ko ntabwo usibye ko aboneza urubyaro akoresheje ibinini, wamugiriye inama yo kurya imbuto n,imboga,n,ibikomoka ku matunga. Ukaba ubaza icyo twagufasha n,inama wagira umugore. Mbashimiye inama nziza mwagiriye uyu mugore yo kurya imbuto,imboga,n,ibikomoka ku matungo,Kuko ibi nibyiza k,umuntu wese cyane cyane umugore utwite,umugore wonsa,uboneza urubyaro nabandi.Ariko uyu mugore yanakubwiye ibindi bimenyetso bitakagombye kugirwa n,umuntu uboneza urubyaro akoresheje ibinini nkuko yabikubwiye,Kuko iyo umugore uboneza agize ibindi bimenyetso bidasanzwe nk,ibi yakubwiye harimo kuribwa mu nda,gucika intege no kuruka ibyo ariye,birajyana kubimenyetso by,umugore utwite. Niyo mpamvu tugomba kumubaza niba atarishe amasaha yafatiragaho ibinini,niba ataragiye yibagirwa kubinywa,noneho agafatirwa ibizamini by,inkari kugirango turebe niba adatwite,Kuko biba bishoboka cyane,kabone nubwo twasanga yarubahirije gahunda,Kuko gusama biba bishoboka gake gashoboka. Uyu mubyeyi muhe taransiferi imujyana ku kigo Nderabuzima bamusuzume barebe ko adatwite,cyangwa bamuvure ubundi burwayi bwamuteye ibibazo afite. Murakoze.
question_english: A 30-year-old woman, weighing 60 kg, came with complaints of abdominal pain, fatigue, and vomiting after eating. I asked her if she had any other health issues, and she mentioned that she was using contraceptive tablets. I advised her to eat fruits, vegetables, and animal-based foods. How can I assist her further? What other advice should I give this patient?

question_kinyarwanda: Mwaramutse! Umubyeyi anzaniye umwana w'imyaka itatu ambwira ko yaraye ari guhitwa mpaka mu gitondo. Mubajije inshuro yitumye ambwira ko zirenze ziri hejuru y’icumi, mubajije nimba nta bundi burwayi yarasanzwe agira ambwira ko ari ntabwo. None umubyeyi namufashe iki? Murakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Muhe zinc kubera uko guhitwa, hanyuma umuhe na ORS ayishyire muri litiro y'amazi ajye amuha buri uko ashatse kunywa, hanyuma umubwire ko abonye bidahagaze, yakwihutira kumugeza kwa muganga agahabwa ubufasha bwisumbuye.
question_english: Good morning! A parent brought their three-year-old child, telling me that the child had diarrhea throughout the night until morning. When I asked how many times the child had passed stool, they said it was more than ten times. I inquired if the child had any pre-existing conditions, and they said no. How can I assist the parent? Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umwana w'umuhungu w'imyaka ibiri, afite ibiro cumi na bibiri magana ane, afite ikizigira cy'akaboko muwaka cumi na gatanu n'igice, yaje arwaye ahinda umuriro yaje afite uduheri ku mubiri, yaje yatukuye amaso ndetse ahinda umuriro mwinshi cyane nawupimye igipimo cy'umuriro nsanga afite mirongo itatu n'icyenda n'igice. Narebye ku ruhu rwe nsanga uduheri hatangiye guturukamo amazi nagiriye inama umubyeyi we kumujyana kwa muganga mwandikira taransiferi ndamubwira nawe aranyumva ajyana umwana kwa muganga. Nabazaga nimba nta bundi bufasha namuha murakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umwana w’umuhungu w’imyaka 2 upima ibiro 12, afite MUAC ya 15.5cm yaje afite umuriro mwinshi cyane (39.5°C), ibishishi ku mubiri, amaso atukura kandi ibishishi byari byatangiye gusohora amazi. • Ni byiza ko boherejwe ku bitaro. Ibi bishobora kuba impiswi y'iseru, indwara ya Kawasaki n'ibindi. Bityo rero ku bitaro bazasuzuma, kandi niba basanze ari iseru bazavura bakoresheje amavuta ya tetracycline ku maso kubera conjunctivitis, Vitamine A, kandi niba hari ubwandu bwa bagiteri bwiyongereye bazavura bakoresheje antibiyotike zikwiye.
question_english: I received a two-year-old boy, weighing twelve kilograms and four hundred grams, with an arm circumference of fifteen and a half centimeters. He came in sick with a fever, had rashes on his body, red eyes, and a very high fever, which I measured to be thirty-nine and a half degrees. I examined his skin and found that the rashes had started oozing fluid. I advised his parent to take him to the hospital, wrote a transfer note, and explained it to them. The mother understood and took the child to the hospital. I inquired if there was any other assistance I could provide. Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Umugabo ufite imyaka makumyabiri n'itanu, afite ibiro mirongo itandatu, arababara umutwe yacitse intege, abimaranye iminsi ibiri, nta bundi burwayi asanzwe afite mufatiye tederi(TDR) iba positifu(positif). Namuha iyihe ngano y'umuti?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Uyu ni umugabo w'imyaka 25 upima ibiro 60, umaze iminsi 2 ababara umutwe afite n'intege nke, kandi tederi yagaragaje ko ari positive. Uyu murwayi afite malariya, rero ugomba kumuha kwariteme sisi fuwa katere yo kunywa, bisobanura ibinini 4 kabiri ku munsi, mu minsi 2. Ushobora kandi kumuha imiti igabanya ibimenyetso niba ibimenyetso bikomeye, nko kumuha paracetamol (1 gram) igabanya kuribwa umutwe. Mwigishe uburyo yakwirinda malariya, umwigishe ku bimenyetso mpuruza nko guta ubwenge, kuruka, imyitwarire idasanzwe, kandi umwigishe ku bijyanye n'igihe agomba gusubira kwa muganga.
question_english: A twenty-five-year-old man weighing sixty pounds, has a debilitating headache, has been suffering for two days, has no other medical conditions, and his tdr test is positive. What can i give you of the medicine? A twenty-five-year-old man weighing sixty kilograms has been experiencing a headache and weakness for two days. He has no other existing health conditions, and his Rapid Diagnostic Test (RDT) is positive. What dosage of medication should I give him

question_kinyarwanda: Umudamu ufite imyaka makumyabiri n'umwe, amaze iminsi irindwi abyaye ariko ngo afite ikibazo cyo kutagira amashereka. Aje angisha inama y'icyo yakora kugira ngo abone amashereka, njyewe mugira inama yo kujya kwa muganga kugirango ngo bamufashe, kugira ngo arengere ubuzima bw'uruhinja. None inama namugiriye hari izindi nama nari kumuha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Uwo mudamu wakiriye ufite imyaka 21 akaba amaze iminsi irindwi abyaye, kandi ntamashereka afite. Inama ni uko uwo mudamu agomba kunywa amazi menshi cyane, ndetse agafata n'ibiribwa bihagije cyane, yirinda kurya ibiryo bikomeye cyane mu gihe ikibazo gikomeje, ni ngombwa kugana abaganga bakamusuzuma byimbitse bakareba ikibazo gihari bakamufasha.
question_english: A 21-year-old woman, who gave birth seven days ago, is experiencing a lack of breast milk. She came seeking advice on what to do to produce milk. I advised her to go to the hospital for assistance to ensure the baby’s health. Is there any other advice I could have given her?

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'umuhungu ufite imyaka itatu,ibiro cumi na bitatu magana atanu, aje yituma inshuro eshanu ku munsi by'uruzi,aruka arababara n'umutwe nta bundi burwayi yari asanganywe. Namuha ubuhe bufasha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Urakoze kubaza ikibazo cy’umwana w’umuhungu w’imyaka itatu, ufite ibiro cumi na bitatu, waje ahitwa inshuro eshanu ku munsi, akituma iby’uruzi, akanaruka, akababara umutwe, kandi nta bundi burwayi asanzwe agira. Uyu mwana rero akeneye gufashwa, birumvikana ko afite indwara y’impiswi. Uramuha ibinini bya Zenke (Zinc) mirigarama makumyabiri, azajya anywa ikinini kimwe ku munsi mu minsi icumi. Umuhe na ORS, azajya afata agashashi kamwe ka ORS akavanga muri litiro y’amazi meza, ubundi ajye aha umwana uko ahiswe. Uyu mubyeyi umwigishe cyane ku ndwara ziterwa n’umwanda. Umwigishe kugirira isuku y’ibyo kurya, cyane cyane ibigiye kugaburirwa umwana muto. Ajye anafasha umwana kwirinda kurya ibintu atoraguye, kuko abana b’imyaka itatu bashobora kurya ibyo babonye byose, harimo n’ibyanduye, bikabatera impiswi. Bisaba rero ko umubyeyi aba hafi y’umwana kugira ngo atagira ibyo arya byamutera impiswi. Murakoze!
question_english: A three-year-old boy, weighing 13.5 kilograms, presents with diarrhea occurring five times a day, vomiting, and a headache, with no other underlying conditions reported. What assistance can I provide him

question_kinyarwanda: Umubyeyi ufite umwana w'umuhungu; ufite umwaka umwe; ufite ibiro icumi n'ijana; ufite muwake ya cumi na kane magana atanu, ambwiye ko iyo yonse ahita aruka kandi afite umuriro mirongo itatu n'umunani. Mfashe tederi nsanga ni negatifu. None uyu mwana namufasha gute?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umwana ashobora kuba afite Gastroenteritis, iterwa n'umuriro, kuko arimo kuruka kandi afite umuriro. Ugomba kumuha paracetamol, kugira ngo umuriro ugabanuke. Kandi umuhe umuti wongera amazi mu mubiri (Oral rehydration solution) buri gihe arutse. Hanyuma umujyane ku kigo nderabuzima cya hafi, vuba bishoboka kugira ngo avurwe neza.
question_english: A parent has a one-year-old boy who weighs ten kilograms and has a temperature of thirty-eight degrees Celsius. She told me that whenever he sucks, he immediately vomits. I took TDR test and found it to be negative. So, how can I help this child?

question_kinyarwanda: Muraho, umwana w'umukobwa w'imyaka cumi nicyenda, ibiro mirongo itanu na bitandatu, angezeho ambwira ko ari kubabara mu nda afite n'umuriro, umutwe uri kumurya, mubajije igihe yafatiwe ambwira ko amaze iminsi ibiri. Mubajije igihe aherukira mu mihango ambwira ko ayirimo. Mubwiye ko yihangana ari bumere neza, muhaye taransiferi. Ese hari ubundi bufasha naha uyu mwana w'umukobwa?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Muraho, neza birashobokako uyu mwana w'umukobwa afite ibimenyetso birimo uburibwe mu nda, umuriro, ndetse n'umutwe, kuko ngo bimufashe mugihe cy'iminsi ibiri.  Iyo ari mu mihango, bishobora kuba ari bimwe mubimenyetso by'ibibazo bisanzwe bijyanye n'igihe cy'imihango, ariko hari n'ibibazo bindi bishobora kwiyongera. Uramutse ugize imbogamizi ko ashobora kuba afite ibimenyetso bikomeye, byaba byiza kumujyana kwa muganga cyangwa kugira ngo akorerwe igenzura rijyanye no gupimwa neza.  Ibi birashobora gufasha kumenya niba ari ikibazo cy'ibimenyetso by'imihango bisanzwe cyangwa niba hari ikindi kibazo gitera izo ngaruka. Ni ingenzi rero umwana iyo ataka cyane cyangwa afite ibimenyetso bishobora kwerekana ikibazo gikomeye, ni byiza kumufasha kugana kwa muganga kuko abana bakeneye kwitabwaho by'umwihariko.
question_english: Hello, a nineteen-year-old girl, fifty-six kilograms, she came to me and told me that she had a stomachache and a fever, suffering from headache. I asked her when it started and she told me that she had been sick for two days. I asked when she last had her period she told me she was in it. Tell her she's to be patient and it will be better. I give her a transfer. Is there any other help i can give to this girl?

question_kinyarwanda: Umugore w'imyaka mirongo itatu n'itandatu afite inda y'amezi atatu. Angezeho ambwira ko ari kuribwa mu kiziba cy'inda, ambwirako ari kuribwa n'umugongo. Mwohereje kwa muganga, ese hari ikindi namufasha? Murakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Uyu ni umugore w’imyaka 36 utwite inda ya gatatu, waje agaragaza ububabare mu nda no mu mugongo. * Ibi ni ibintu bisanzwe ku bagore batwite kugira ububabare mu nda no mu mugongo, keretse iyo ubwo bubabare bukabije. * Ashobora kandi kuba afite ubwandu mu nzira z’inkari (Urinary Tract Infection). Igikorwa giteganyijwe: Koherezwa ku kigo nderabuzima kugira ngo hakorwe isuzuma anabone ubundi buvuzi bukwiriye.
question_english: A 36-year-old woman, three months pregnant, came to me complaining of abdominal pain and back pain. I referred her to the hospital. Is there anything else I could do to assist her? Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Muraho, umwana w'umuhungu w'imyaka itanu, ibiro cumi n’umunani, azanwe n'umubyeyi we ambwiye ko umwana afite umuriro, inkorora, agacika intege. Mubajije igihe yafatiwe ambwira ko amaze umunsi umwe. Mufatiye tederi (TDR) na tayima metere nsanga ni negatifu. Muvuye umusonga; Umwana muhaye amoxi ibinini bine kabiri ku munsi mu minsi itanu. Nabazaga niba hari ubundi bufasha naha uyu mwana.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Muraho, umwana w'umuhungu w'imyaka itanu, ibiro cumi n’umunani, azanwe n'umubyeyi we. Ambwiye ko umwana afite umuriro, inkorora, agacika intege. TDR NEG. MWAKOZE cyane kubw'ubufasha mwatanze. Ariko mupime na SIDA, umuhe antipyretics. Umureke aruhuke, akomeze na amoxicillin. Aroroherwa. Nibyanga, umwohereze ajye gufatirwa igikororwa n'amaraso.
question_english: Hello, a 5-year-old boy weighing 18 kilograms was brought by his mother, who told me that the child has a fever, a cough, and weakness. When I asked how long he had been sick, she said it had been one day. I tested for malaria using a rapid diagnostic test (RDT) which resulted negative and performed Timer. I treated pneumonia by prescribing Amoxicillin, four tablets twice a day for five days. I was wondering if there is any additional support I can offer this child.

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umugabo w'imyaka mirongo itanu n'irindwi, ibiro mirongo itandatu n'umunani, afite umuriro wa mirongo itatu n’icyenda, ababara umutwe, amaso yahindutse umutuku, arababara mu muhogo, ahari umwenge hose haravamo amaraso. Namubajije igihe abimaranye ambwira ko abimaranye iminsi umunsi umwe. Namubajije ko nta bundi burwayi yagiraga ambwira ko ntabwo. Uyu murwayi mufasha iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: murakoze kwakira uyu murwayi -muhe umuti ugabanya umuriro -murinde kwegera abandi wasanga indwara yanduza -hamagara ambulance imutware kwa muganga byihuse -reba abandi bo mumuryango urebe ko ntakibazo bafite nabo ubiteho.
question_english: I've received a fifty-seven-year-old man, weighing sixty-eight kilograms, with a fever of thirty-nine degrees, complaining of a headache, red eyes, throat pain, and bleeding from every opening of the body. I've asked him how long he has been experiencing this, and he's told me it has been one day. I've asked him if he has had any other illnesses, and said no. What can I assist this patient?

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'umuhungu ufite amezi icyenda ibiro n'umunani magana atatu, yaje ari guhitwa inshuro eshanu ku munsi; muha imiti. None nagiye kumusura nsanga ari kunywa imiti akayiruka. Namuha ubuhe bufasha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Mwohereze ku kigonderabuzima bamufatire ibizami hanyuma bamuhe n'indi miti ihagarika kuruka.
question_english: A nine-month-old boy weighing eight kilograms and three hundred grams came with diarrhea five times a day; I gave him medication. I went to visit him and found that he takes the medication and vomits it. What help can I give him?

question_kinyarwanda: Mwiriwe! Nakiriye umwana w'umukobwa afite imyaka ine n'ibiro makumyabiri. Umubyeyi we amunzaniye amuteruye avuga ko ahanutse ku mukingo akaba atabasha guhagarara. Mbajije umubyeyi niba umwana nta bundi burwayi afite ambwira ko ntabwo. Mpamagaye ambulance imbwiye ko barahagera nyuma y'amasaha abiri. Nabazaga niba hari ubundi bufasha natanga mu gihe ambulance itarahagera. Murakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: uyu ni umwana w'umukobwa afite imyaka ine n'ibiro makumyabiri azanwe na mama we avuga ko yahanutse ku mukingo none ntabwo abafasha guhagarara. Ashobora kuba yavunitse ICYO WAKORA Niba ufite imiti igabanya ububabare umuhe paracetamol 15 mg ku kiro. Kumuhambiraho igitambaro kiza ugirango ni hari igufa ryacitse ridaKomeza kunyeganyega. U.komeze utegereze ambulance ize imujyane kwa muganga.
question_english: Good evening! I received a four-year-old girl weighing twenty kilograms. Her parent brought her in carrying her, saying that she fell from a slope and is unable to stand. When I asked the parent if the child has any other illness, they told me no. I called an ambulance, and they told me they would arrive in two hours. I was asking if there is any other help I can provide while waiting for the ambulance. Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'umuhungu w'imyaka makumyabiri n'itatu wibana, ampamagaye ambwira ko yumva afite umuriro mwinshi. Arakorora kandi avuye i kigali arasuherewe ahumekera hejuru afite iserereri afite n'isesemi ngo n'umutwe uri kumurya cyane. Mbaje kwegeranya ibikoresho by'ubwirinzi kuko nkeka ko ari icyorezo yaba afite, agapfukamunwa, ga, thermometre na TDR. Ngezeyo nsanga ari kubabara cyane ntinya kumwegera. Naketse ko yaba ari covid afite. Ese namwegera nkamusuzuma? Ese namutabariza muganga? Cyangwa mwohereze kwa muganga?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze kubaza iki kibazo cy’uyu mwana w’umuhungu w’imyaka makumyabiri n’itatu, wibana. Aguhamagaye akubwira ko yumva afite umuriro mwinshi, arakorora, kandi avuye i Kigali. Arasuherewe, ahumekera hejuru, afite isereri, afite n’isesemi, ndetse n’umutwe uri kumurya cyane. Ubanje kwegeranya ibikoresho by’ubwirinzi kuko ucyeka ko ari icyorezo. Yaba afite agapfukamunwa, ga, thermometer, na tederi. Ugezeyo, usanga ari kubabara cyane. Utinya kumwegera kuko waketse ko yaba ari COVID-19. Ukaba ubaza niba wamwegera ukamuzuma, niba wamutabariza kwa muganga, cyangwa se wamwohereza kwa muganga. Nibyo koko, iyo hari ibihe by’ibyorezo, umuntu utanga serivisi yo kwita ku bandi cyangwa ubuvuzi agomba kwirinda no kwiyitaho, kuko na we yahaburira ubuzima. Ni yo mpamvu, mu gihe waketse ko uyu muntu afite COVID-19 cyangwa ikindi cyorezo, ndetse ukaba wanagize ubwoba, ugomba guhamagara ubufasha kuri bagenzi bawe, ukabagisha inama. Ugomba kubanza kubaza ushinzwe abajyanama b’ubuzima mu kigo nderabuzima, ndetse n’abandi. Iyo utambaye imyenda yabigenewe, ntabwo uba wemewe kumwegera. Ahubwo ushobora kuguma aho, kugeza igihe abashinzwe gutwara abantu bacyekwaho ibyorezo bamutwaye. Uva aho ari uko bamujyanye. Murakoze.
question_english: A twenty-three-year-old male, living alone, called me saying he has a high fever. He is coughing and, after coming from Kigali, he feels weak, has difficulty breathing, a severe headache, and symptoms of nausea. I gathered protective equipment as I suspect he may have a contagious disease, including a face mask, gloves, thermometer, and rapid diagnostic test (RDT). When I arrived, I found him in significant pain and was hesitant to approach. I suspect he may have COVID-19. Should I approach him and perform the examination? Should I seek help from a doctor, or should I send him to the hospital?

question_kinyarwanda: Mwiriwe neza, umubyeyi w'imyaka mirongo itatu n'ibiri, abyariye mu nzira, muhaye ikinini cya misoprostol, mpamagara ambulance. Ni ubuhe bufasha bundi namuha? Murakoze
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umubyeyi w'imyaka 32 yabyaye mu nzira. Tanga ikinini cya misoprostal. Hamagara ambulance ako kanya. Niba ururenda rusohotse mbere y'uko ambulance ihagera, zirika umugozi neza hafi y'ururenda ariko ntuwuce. Pfuka umwana kugira ngo wirinde hypothermia.
question_english: Good evening, a 32-year-old mother has given birth on the way, I've given her a misoprostol tablet, and I've called an ambulance. What other assistance can I provide her? Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'umuhungu ufite umwaka n'igice afite ibiro cumi na bitatu, yavukanye ubwandu bwa SIDA, Afata imiti. Arahitwa. Namuhaye sureau na zinc byanze gukira. Ni iki nakora kugirango ngo mufashe mbere yo kumwohereza?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umwana wumuhungu ufite umwaka n'igice, ibiro 13, yavukanye ubwandu bwa SIDA, afata imiti, arahitwa. Amuhaye ORESI na zenkea byanze gukira. Aha mbere yo kumwohereza ibyo mwakoze birahagije, aha kuguhita uha umwana taransiferi akagana kwa muganga, agasuzumwa ndetse agahabwa ubufasha neza tugendeye kubizami akorerwa Ndetse tukamuha nama serumu yo mumutsi , bimurinda kuba yakama amazi mumubiri.
question_english: A 1.5-year-old boy weighing 13 kilograms was born with HIV and is on medication. He is experiencing weight loss. I gave him a supplement of sugar water and zinc, but his condition has not improved. What can I do to help him before transferring him?

question_kinyarwanda: Umurwayi ufite imyaka cumi n'icyenda ibiro mirongo itanu na bibiri ni umuhungu afite umuriro wa mirongo ine akababara umutwe akaba yari asanganywe uburwayi bw'imbasa. Mufatiye tederi nsanga ni pozitifu afite malariya. None ngomba kumuha sisi fuwa katere. None nayimuha afite n'imbasa?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze -Ntakibazo muhe iyo miti. -Muganirize na gahunda zo kwirinda malaria umwana, unamubwire akurikirane neza uburwayi bundi afite.
question_english: A 19-year-old patient weighing 52 kilograms is a boy with a fever of 40 degrees, a headache, and a history of polio. I conducted a TDR and found he is positive for malaria. Now I'm supposed to give him six times four. Can I give it to him even though he has polio?

question_kinyarwanda: Umugabo w'imyaka mirongo ine n'itanu n'ibiro mirongo irindwi, afite ikibazo cyuko ababara umugongo kandi ibingibi byamuteye kuba atakibasha gutera akabariro. Mbega muri make umugore we yamuca inyuma. Uyu mugabo namuha iyihe nama?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze! -Umugabo najye kwa muganga bamukorere ibizamini, bamuvure, akire n'ububabare bugende abashe kumererwa neza maze abashe kwegera umugore we. -Mubwire ko igihangayikishishe kurushaho ari uburwayi afite kurusha imibonano, nubwo na yo iba ikenewe kubera impamvu nyinshi niyivuze. -Egera umugore we na we umuganirize yihanganire umugabo kandi amufashe kwivuza, umuhe ikizere amube hafi. -Shishikariza umugabo kurya neza no kunywa, kureka inzoga, itabi n'imirimo ivunanye.
question_english: A 45-year-old man with a weight of 70 kg is experiencing back pain, which has led to him being unable to perform sexually. His wife may be cheating on him. What advice should I give to this man?

question_kinyarwanda: Umugabo ufite imyaka mirongo ine n'umunani, angeze imbere afite ikibazo cyo kumva ahora afite ubwoba bwinshi, yikanga ashi anashikagurika kandi agaragaza agahinda. Yibuka ibyamubayeho byamugiriye nabi. Abimaranye iminsi ine. Ese ni ubuhe bufasha bwahabwa uwo muntu?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Uyu mugabo w'imyaka mirongo ine n'umunani , yaje afite ubwoba bwinshi, atunguwe, afite impungenge n'agahinda. Uyu mugabo ashobora kuba afite indwara y'agahinda gakabije. Gahunda: Koherezwa ku bitaro kugira ngo asuzumwe n'umuganga w'ubuzima bwo mu mutwe.
question_english: A forty-eight-year-old man comes to me with a problem of constantly feeling very afraid, startled, and anxious, showing sadness. He remembers the bad things that happened to him. He has been experiencing this for four days. What kind of help can be given to this person?

question_kinyarwanda: Umugabo w'imyaka mirongo itandatu n'itanu, afite ibiro mirongo ine n'umunani. Afite inkorora irengeje ibyumweru bitatu nta burwayi yari asanganywe. Mugiriye inama yo kujya ku kigo nderabuzima ngo barebe impamvu itera iyo nkorora arabyanga. Nabazaga ngo mungire inama y'icyo namukorera.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugabo w' imyaka 65 apima ibiro 48kg afite inkorora imaze ibyumweru 3 nta bundi burwayi asanganywe banza umubaze ibimenyetso afite byiyongera kuri iyo nkorora musobanurire igituntu uko cyandura nuko wakirinda kwanduza abandi igihe ufite ibimenyetso mwohereze kwa muganga
question_english: A sixty-five-year-old man weighs forty-eight kilograms. He has had a cough lasting more than three weeks without any pre-existing illness. I advised him to go to the health center to determine the cause of the cough, but he refused. I was asking for advice on what I could do for him.

question_kinyarwanda: Nasuye umubyeyi ufite umwana w'amezi icyenda, nsanga aronka gusa, ntago aramuha imfashabere. Mugira inama yo guha umwana imfashabere, igizwe n'indyo yuzuye n'ibikombe bibiri by'amata yo mu nganda. Kuko umwana mu mashereka, aba akuramo mirongo irindwi na gatanu gusa, makumyabiri na gatanu akayikura mu imfashabere. Nabazaga niba ari ubundi bufasha namuha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Kugira ngo umubyeyi yita ku mwana w'amezi icyenda, ni ngombwa cyane ko umwana akomeza kubona amashereka, kuko niyo atuma umubiri we wubaka imbaraga, ndetse n’ubuzima bw’umwana bukarushaho kuba bwiza. Amashereka ya nyina niyo agomba kuba ikigero cy'ibanze mu mirire y’umwana, ariko mu gihe umubyeyi atabasha kubimwongerera cyangwa atabifite, imfashabere (nk’amata yo mu nganda) nayo ishobora kuba igisubizo. Gusa, iyo umwana afite amezi icyenda, ni byiza ko atangiye kugerageza ibiribwa bitandukanye bitari amashereka gusa, kugirango atangire kwiga kurya indyo yuzuye. Ibi biribwa biza kuba byunganira amazi y’amashereka, kandi bizamufasha gukura neza.
question_english: I have visited a parent with a nine-month-old child and found that the child is only breastfeeding and has not been given complementary food. I have advised them to give the child complementary food consisting of a balanced diet and two cups of formula milk. From breastfeeding, the child only gets seventy-five percent of the necessary nutrients, and twenty-five percent comes from complementary food. I am asking if there is any other support I can provide?

question_kinyarwanda: Umusore w'imyaka makumyabiri n'itanu n' ibiro mirongo itanu nabitandatu, ambwiye ko ari kubabara umutwe cyane, akaba afite n'umuriro mwinshi cyane; yacitse intege. Mubajije nimba nta bundi burwayi yari afite ambwira ko arwara umuvuduko w'amaraso namukoreye tederi nsanga ni negatifu. Namuha ubuhe bufasha bundi burenzeho?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugabo w'imyaka 25 ufite ibiro 56 afite umutwe ukabije, umuriro mwinshi n'intege nke. Afite umuvuduko w'amaraso mwinshi kandi ikizamini cya tederi cyagaragaje ko ari negatifu. Ni iki wamufasha? • Ushobora kumubaza niba asanzwe afata imiti igabanya umuvuduko w'amaraso, niba ari byo, umubwire ajye kwa muganga kugira ngo hakorwe ibindi bipimo kuko ikizamini cya malariya cyagaragaje ko ari negatifu kandi akeneye kumenya icyihishe inyuma y'umuriro mwinshi, umutwe n'intege nke. • Niba atayifata, umubwire ajye kwa muganga kugira ngo akorerwe isuzuma maze atangire gufata imiti igabanya umuvuduko w'amaraso ndetse anasuzumwe icyatera umuriro mwinshi.
question_english: A 25-year-old young man weighing 56 kilograms told me he has a severe headache, high fever, and weakness. When I asked if he had any other health issues, he said he has high blood pressure. I conducted a rapid diagnostic test (RDT), which came back negative. What additional assistance can I provide him?

question_kinyarwanda: Umugabo w'imyaka mirongo itanu n'itatu apima ibiro mirongo itandatu n'icyenda aje ataka cyane umutwe n'umugongo. Mufatiye umuriro agira mirongo itatu n'umunani n'ibice bitanu. Mufatiye tederi iba positif ariko afite ikibazo cy'ubuhumekero asima kandi mfite six fois quatre. Muhaye transiferi. Mumfashe, ubwo namuha imiti kandi afite ikibazo cya asima?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umurwayi w’imyaka 53 upima ibiro 69 agaragaza uburibwe bukabije bw’umutwe n’umugongo, afite umuriro wa 38.5°C, kandi TDR yagaragaje ko arwaye malaria, kandi asanzwe afite asima. Ibyo gukora: * Yego, ushobora kumuha imiti ya malaria nubwo afite asima. Nimuhite mumuha dose ya mbere mbere yo kumwohereza ku kigonderabuzima. * Mumufashe kubona umuti ugabanya umuriro n’uburibwe bw’umutwe, nka paracetamol. * Mumushishikarize kunywa amazi menshi. * Murebe neza ko afite imiti ye ya asima kandi ko ayifata neza uko bikwiye. * Mumwohereze ku ivuriro rimwegereye kugira ngo hakorwe isuzuma ryimbitse no kuvurwa uko bikwiye.
question_english: A 53-year-old man weighing 69 kilograms came in complaining of severe headaches and back pain. His temperature was 38.5°C. I conducted a rapid diagnostic test (RDT), which resulted positive, but he also has a respiratory issue (asthma) and I have 6*4 (prescribed medication). I gave him a transfer. I need your help—should I give him medication for malaria while he has asthma?

question_kinyarwanda: Naganiriye n'umuturage ku kibazo cy'imirire, ambaza aho imiti ivura inka n'imiti ivura abantu aho bihurira, kuko bababuza kunywa amata y'inka yatewe antibiotique. namusubiza iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Navuganye n’umuturage ku kibazo cy’imirire, ambaza uburyo imiti ivura inka n’imiti ivura abantu bifitanye isano kuko babwirwa kudakoresha amata y’inka yateweho imiti yica udukoko twanduza. Ni iki nakamushubije? Imiti yica udukoko twanduza iterwa mu nka, hari igihe igisigara mu mata, kandi kuyanywa bishobora gutera abantu kudakangwa n’iyo miti. Imiti iterwa mu nka isa n’iyo abantu bakoresha, itandukaniro riri mu bipimo.
question_english: I talked to a community member about the issue of nutrition, he asked me how the medicines that treat cows and the medicines that treat people are related because they are advised to take no milk from the cow which was injected with antibiotics. which answer should i give him?

question_kinyarwanda: Mwiriwe! Umwana w'umukobwa ufite umwaka, ufite ibiro umunani namupimye muwaka (MUAC) nsanga afite cumi na kane mubaza niba umwana arwaye ambwira ko atarwaye, mubwira ko agomba kumugaburira indyo yuzuye igizwe n'irinda indwara aribyo; imboga n'imbuto, ibitera imbaraga birimo ibirayi, amateke n' ibijumba byubaka umubiri inyama amata amagi n' indagara. Mubwira ko agomba no kumugirira isuku. Ambwira ko atabona umwanya wo kubikora kuko aba yagiye mu kazi. Mungire inama y'icyo nafasha uyu mubyeyi.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Uyu ni umwana w'umukobwa w'umwaka umwe upima ibiro umunani wapimwe akoresheje MUAC (Igipimo cy'Umukandara wo Hagati y'Ukuboko), basanga afite santimetero 14 kandi ari muzima.  Nyina yagiriwe inama yo kugaburira umwana indyo yuzuye no kwita ku isuku y'umwana. Yasubije ko adafite umwanya wo gukora ibyo byose kuko ahora mu kazi. Ugomba gusobanurira nyina ko nubwo umwana ari muzima ubu, ariko afite ibyago byo kugwa mu mirire mibi ishobora kumutera ingaruka zitandukanye zirimo gukura nabi no kudindira mu mikurire, ndetse ashobora kugira ikibazo cyo kutita ku bintu. Mwigishe ko agomba kubona umwanya wo kwita ku mwana niba ashaka ko akura neza kandi agatera imbere, cyangwa niba atabishoboye, nibura ashyireho umuntu ushobora gutegurira umwana amafunguro kugira ngo amurinde kugwa mu mirire mibi.
question_english: Good evening! A one-year-old girl weighing eight kilograms was measured using MUAC (Mid-Upper Arm Circumference), and it was found to be 14 cm. When I asked if the child was sick, the mother said she wasn’t. I advised her to feed the child a balanced diet, including body protecting foods, such as vegetables and fruits, energy-giving foods like potatoes, yams, and sweet potatoes, and body-building foods like meat, milk, eggs, and small fish (e.g., sardines). I also told her to ensure proper hygiene for the child. She replied that she doesn’t have time to do all this because she’s always at work. What advice can I give to help this mother?

question_kinyarwanda: Umusore w'imyaka makumyabiri n'ine yavuye mu mujyi wari urimo icyorezo cya mPox. Ageze iwabo mu cyaro, atangira kuramukanya no gusabana n'abo ahasanze. Wagira inama ki abo asanze?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umusore w'imyaka 24 y'amavuko yavuye mu mujyi wari urimo icyorezo cy'ubushita bw'inkende, ageze iwabo mu cyaro atangira gusuhuza no kuganira n’abo asanze. • Agomba gusobanurirwa ko ubushita bw'inkende ari indwara yandura cyane, bityo agomba kwishyira mu kato kugira ngo yirinde gukomeza gukwirakwiza iyo ndwara no gutegereza ko inzego z’ubuzima mu gace ke zifata ingamba zihuse zo kuyirwanya.
question_english: A twenty-four-year-old young man left a city that was experiencing an mpox outbreak. Upon arriving in his rural home, he began greeting and socializing with the local residents. What advice would you give to those who came into contact with him?

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana wimyaka cumi n'ikenda, ibiro mirongo itanu na bibiri, ni umuhungu. Afite umuriro, arababara mu mihogo, arahitwa cyane kandi kenshi. Yacitse intege ari kubabara no mu ngingo. Arigu yasheshe ibiheri ari kuva amaraso mu myenge y'umubiri, ntaburwayi yari asangwanywe. Nagiriye namugiriye inama yo kwiha akato, mugira n'inama yo kudakora ingendo arabyanga. Mungire inama y'icyo nakora.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: umwana ufite ibimenyetso byavuzwe birerekana ko afite ikibazo gikomeye gikeneye kwitabwaho byihutirwa. Umuriro, ububabare mu mihogo, guhitwa cyane, gucika intege, no kubona amaraso ava mu myenge y’umubiri, byose ni ibimenyetso by’ibibazo bikomeye mu mubiri. Nubwo nta burwayi busanzwe yari asanzwe afite ariko ibyo bimenyetso ibimenyetso bisaba kugana kwamuganga Agakorerwa isuzuma ryimbitse
question_english: A nineteen-year-old child, weighing fifty-two kilograms, is a boy. He has a fever, throat pain, a lot of diarrhea and frequently. He is weak, experiencing joint pain, and has developed rashes, bleeding from body holes, with no pre-existing conditions. I've advised him to isolate himself and not to travel, but he's refused. Please advise me on what to do.

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'imyaka ine ibiro cumi n'umunani aje azanwe na mukuru we ambwira ko uwo mwana afite ikibazo cyo kubabara umutwe akaba afite umuriro n'ibicurane. Tumubajije niba ntabundi burwayi afite ambwira ko ntabwo, tumufashe tederi nsanga ari negatifu. Muhaye transiferi. Ese hari ubundi bufasha nari guha uwo mwana?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umwana w’imyaka ine yageze kwa muganga ari kumwe na mukuru we, afite umutwe ubabara, umuriro, n’ibicurane, ariko TDR ya malariya yagaragaye ko ari negative. Icya mbere, hari uburwayi bwandura buri kuri uyu mwana, bushobora kuba malariya, umusonga, cyangwa indwara z’inkorora n’iz’ubuhumekero bwo hejuru mu gice cyo hejuru. Kandi kubera umuriro, uyu mwana afite ibyago byo kugagara. Icyo wakora: * Gutanga imiti igabanya umuriro: Paracetamol syrup 15mg/kg buri masaha 8. * Kumushishikariza kunywa amazi ahagije kugira ngo atagira umwuma. * Kumwohereza byihuse ku bitaro kugira ngo ahabwe ubuvuzi bukwiye. Ku bitaro bazafata amakuru arambuye y’uburwayi no kumukorera isuzuma ry’umubiri. * Gutanga imiti igabanya umuriro. * Gukora ibizamini byo kureba icyateye umuriro n’umutwe ubabara (septic workup). * Kumuvuza hakurikijwe icyateye uburwayi bwe.
question_english: A four-year-old boy presented with his older brother, who reported that the child has a headache, fever, and flu. When we asked him about having any other illnesses, the child stated that there were none; and when I took an RDT, it was negative. I gave him a transfer. Is there any additional assistance I could give to that child?

question_kinyarwanda: Umubyeyi ufite imyaka mirongo itatu, ibiro mirongo itandatu na bibiri, yaje angana, atwite kandi yituma kenshi. Mufatira umusarane nsanga nta kibazo, ndamwohereza. Ese hari ikindi kintu nari kumufasha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Uyu mubyeyi ufite imyaka mirongo itatu, ibiro mirongo itandatu na bibiri, utwite kandi yituma kenshi. Akeneye guhabwa ORS, zinc Ukamufata n'umuriro, niba ataruka Warangiza ukamwohereza kwa muganga bakamufasha.
question_english: A 30-year-old parent, weighing 62 kg, came to me. She is pregnant and defecates frequently. I took her stool and found no problem, so I sent her away. Is there something else I could have helped her with?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umugore w'imyaka mirongo itatu, afite ibiro mirongo ine na birindwi, afite umuriro wa mirongo itatu n'umunani n'ibice umunani. Afite umuvuduko w'amaraso kandi aratwite, nta bundi burwayi yari afite. Namukoreye tederi nsanga arwaye malariya. Nemerewe kumuha imiti ya malariya atwite?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugore w'imyaka mirongo itatu upima ibiro mirongo ine na birindwi, afite umuriro wa dogere mirongo itatu n'umunani n'ibice umunani.  Afite umuvuduko w'amaraso uri hejuru kandi atwite, nta zindi ndwara afite. Nakoze ikizamini cyihuse nsanga afite malariya. Ese nemerewe kumuha imiti ya malariya? Ugomba kumenya niba ari hejuru y'igihembwe cya mbere kuko niba ari mu gihembwe cya mbere ntiwemerewe. Ariko hejuru yaho urashobora kumuha Kandi ukohereza umurwayi ku bitaro kubera umuvuduko w'amaraso mu gihe cyo gutwita.
question_english: I have received a thirty-year-old woman weighing forty-seven kilograms, with a fever of thirty-eight point eight degrees. She has high blood pressure and is pregnant, with no other illnesses. I have performed a rapid diagnostic test and found that she has malaria. Am I allowed to give her malaria medication while pregnant?

question_kinyarwanda: Umubyeyi azanye umurwayi afite imyaka cumi n'itanu; afite ibiro mirongo itatu n'icyenda. Aje afite umuriro wa mirongo itatu n'numunani, mukoreye tederi(TDR) nsanga ni negatifu. Mbaza umurwayi nti nta bundi burwayi ufite ambwira ko afite indwara y'ibihaha. None uwo muntu namuha ubuhe bufasha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umurwayi w'imyaka cumi n'itanu upima ibiro mirongo itatu n'icyenda, afite umuriro wa dogere mirongo itatu n'umunani. Yakozweho ikizamini cyihuse (TDR) basanga ari negatifu ku ndwara y'ibihaha. Umuriro wa dogere 38 Celsius ugaragaza ko hashobora kuba hari ubwandu cyangwa ikibazo cy'uburibwe bw'imbere mu mubiri. Baza igihe indwara y'ibihaha yamenyekaniye n'imiti ari gufata niba hariho. Niba ufite imiti igabanya umuriro, uyimuhe. Tekereza kumwohereza byihutirwa ku kigo nderabuzima cya hafi kugira ngo hakorwe ibizamini birambuye no kumwitaho. Menya neza ko umurwayi akurikiranwa n'umukozi w'ubuzima kugira ngo harebwe uko ubuzima bwe buhagaze no guhindura imiti niba bikenewe.
question_english: A parent brought in a fifteen-year-old patient weighing thirty-nine kilograms. The patient has a fever of thirty-eight degrees. I performed a rapid test (TDR) and found it to be negative. When I asked the patient if they have any other illnesses, he told me that he has pulmonary disease. What help should I provide for this person?

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'umuhungu w'imyaka cumi n'icyenda ufite ibiro mirongo ine n’umunani aje angana,aje ababara umutwe cyane ndetse afite umuriro wa mirongo itatu n'icyenda, mufatiye tederi (TDR) iba negatifu,kandi asanzwe arwara indwara y'igituntu, ari no kumiti. Ubwo namufasha iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Twakongera tukamufatira ikizamini cya malaria ubundi tukamufatira nikizamini kigituntu . Tukanamuha imiti igabanya uwo muriro.
question_english: A 19-year-old boy weighing 48 kilograms came to me with severe headache and a fever of 39°C. I perform a rapid diagnostic test (RDT) and it comes back negative. He has a history of tuberculosis and is on treatment for it. How should I assist him?

question_kinyarwanda: Mwaramutse! Umubyeyi anzaniye umwana afite imyaka itatu, ambwira ko arwaye amaso. Mubajije niba nta bundi burwayi asanzwe agira ambwirako ntabwo. None uwo umubyeyi namufasha iki? Murakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'imyaka itatu, bambwira ko umwana afite ibibazo by'amaso. Igihe nabazaga niba umwana afite ibindi bibazo by'ubuzima, umubyeyi yavuze ko nta byo afite. Uyu murwayi akwiye kugana muganga w'amaso vuba bishoboka. Nuko mumwohereze ku bitaro by'akarere (DH) kugira ngo akomeze kwitabwaho.
question_english: Good morning! A parent brought me a three-year-old child, telling me that the child has ophthalmic conditions. When I asked if the child has any other health issues, the parent said no. How can I help this child? Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umugabo ufite imyaka mirongo itanu n'itanu, afite ibiro mirongo itandatu n'umunani, afite umuriro wa mirongo ine, mukoreye tederi (TDR) nsanga arwaye malariya. Nyuma y'iminsi itamuha umuti wa sisi fuwa kate(six fois quatre), nyuma y'iminsi itatu nsanga ntari gukira. Mwangira iyihe nama?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Urakoze, uhe umurwayi paracetamol hanyuma umwohereze kwa muganga kugira ngo akorerwe isuzuma n'ubuvuzi byimbitse.
question_english: I received a man in his fifties, weighing sixty-eight kilograms, with forty-four fever, who underwent a teter (tdr) and I found that he has had malaria. After three days without giving him the sis fuwa kate (six times four), after three days I've found out he has not been recovering. What advice would you give me?

question_kinyarwanda: Muraho! Umugore w'imyaka mirongo itanu; ibiro mirongo inani. Angezeho ari kuvuga ko afite imbeho nyinshi yumva yacitse intege. Mubajije igihe yafatiwe ambwira ko amaze iminsi ibiri. Mubajije ko ntabundi burwayi asanganwe ambwiye ko ari ntabwo. Mubwiye ko yihangana ari bumere neza; mushyizemo igipimo cy'ubushyuhe terimometere; musanzemo umuriro wa mirongo itatu n'umunani. mukoreye tederi(TDR) nsanze ari positiff. Muhaye sisifuwakatire ibinini bine kabiri ku munsi mu minsi itatu. Nabazaga niba hari ubundi bufasha naha uyu mugore.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umurwayi arwaye malariya, uretse coartem, muhe paracetamol ibinini 2, inshuro 3 ku munsi, kugira ngo agabanye umuriro, umutwe n'ububabare bw'umubiri niba biriho. Murakoze.
question_english: Hello! A fifty-year-old woman; eighty kilograms. She came to me saying she feels very cold and weak. When I asked how long she has been feeling this way, she told me it has been two days. When I asked if she has any other pre-existing illness, she told me she does not. I told her to be patient as she will feel better; I took her temperature with a thermometer and found it to be thirty-eight degrees. I performed a rapid diagnostic test (RDT) and found it to be positive. I gave her Coartem, four tablets twice a day for three days. I was asking if there is any other help I can provide to this woman.

question_kinyarwanda: Umukobwa ufite imyaka cumi n'itandatu, afite ibiro mirongo itanu, afite imihango amaranye iminsi itanu, ayimaze ababara mu nda yo hasi, anaruka, anahitwa. Nta bundi burwayi asanzwe afite. None uyu mukobwa namufasha nte?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Muhe ORESI nyuma y'uko agize impatwe buri gihe, ibinini bya Zenke kandi mumujyane ku bitaro kugira ngo akorerwe ibizamini birambuye no kuvurwa.
question_english: A sixteen-year-old girl, weighing fifty pounds, has five-day menstrual periods, during which she has pain in the lower abdomen, vomits, and has diarrhea. She has no other illnesses. How can I help this girl?

question_kinyarwanda: Umugabo w'imyaka mirongo itanu. Ibiro mirongo itanu na bibiri. Umuriro wa mirongo itatu na gatandatu n'igice. Twagiranye ikiganiro kundwara y'igituntu. Arambaza ati " kuki umuntu ashobora kurwara igituntu ntacyanduze abo babana mu rugo, ahubwo akarenga akacyanduza abo mu yindi miryango ni ukubera iki?" Namusobanuriye ko abantu badahuza ubudahangarwa bw'umubiri, akaba ariyo mpamvu abantu bamwe bashobora kwandura indwara abandi ntibazandure. Hari ikindi nari kongeraho?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Urugero, abantu bafite virusi itera SIDA bashobora kwandura igituntu byoroshye kubera ko ubudahangarwa bwabo buba bwananijwe.
question_english: A fifty-year-old man weighing fifty-two kilograms has a temperature of thirty-six and a half degrees. We have had a discussion about tuberculosis. He has asked me, 'Why can someone have tuberculosis without infecting those they live with at home, but instead infect others in different families? Why is that?' I have explained to him that people have different levels of immunity, which is why some people can contract diseases while others do not. Was there anything else I should have added?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umugore ufite imyaka mirongo itatu afite ibiro mirongo itanu n'umunani. Yabyariye mu rugo amaze iminota mirongo itatu abyaye. Namusuzumye nsanga nta wundi mwana usigaye mu nda. Namuhaye ibinini bitatu bya misoporositoro. Nyuma yaho yagize ingaruka zo kuruka. Mungire inama y'icyo namukorera.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze. -Mujyane kwa muganga none aha, -Mwigishe ibyiza byo kubyarira kwa muganga, -Muhamagarire imbangukiragutabara.
question_english: I have received a thirty-year-old woman weighing fifty-eight kilograms. She has given birth at home, and it has been thirty minutes since she gave birth. I have examined her and found no other baby left in the womb. I have given her three misoprostol tablets. Afterwards, she has experienced side effects of vomiting. Please advise me on what I can do for her.

question_kinyarwanda: Mwaramutse, nakiriye umusore w'imyaka makumyabiri n'itanu afite ibiro mirongotandatu na bibiri, ambwiye ko arimo kwihagarika akababa mu gitsina, mubajije igihe bimaze ambwira ko ari iminsi ibiri, mubajije niba nta bundi burwayi abana nabwo ambwira ko ntabwo mubajije niba yaba aheruka gukora imibonano mpuzabitsina idakingiye ambwira ko yayikoze mubwiye ko gukora imibonano idakingiye byamuviramo kwandura indwara zidakira harimo virusi itera SIDA, umwijima wo mu bwoko bwa hepatite vilarI b ndetse n'izindi ndwara: imitezi, mburugu n'izindi. Mwandikiye transferi, ndabaza niba hari ikindi namufasha, murakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Mwaramutse! Uko umusore avuga ko arimo kugira ikibazo cyo kwihagarika akababa mu gitsina nyuma yo gukora imibonano mpuzabitsina idakingiye, ni ikimenyetso cy'ingenzi. Birashoboka ko ibibazo by'uburwayi afite buturuka kuri iyo mibonano mpuzabitsina idakingiye,yakoze kandi ibyo byaba bifite ingaruka ku buzima bwe. Ubu buryo bwa transferi ni bwo buryo bwiza bwo kumusaba ko ajya kwa muganga kugira ngo abone ubufasha bwa muganga no gukora ibizamini byuzuye. Icyakora hari ibindi wakora kugira ngo umufashe mbere y'uko agera kwa muganga: 1. Kwihutira gutanga ibizamini by'amaraso aho bizamufasha bizamufasha kumenya niba hari indwara zishobora kuba zaramugezeho, cyane cyane virusi itera SIDA, hepatitis B cyangwa C, cyangwa izindi ndwara zifata urwungano rw'imyanya ndangagitsina. 2. kwirinda imibonano mpuzabitsina idakingiye Iyi niyo nzira yizewe yo kwirinda indwara zikwirakwira binyuze mu mibonano mpuzabitsina, harimo virusi itera SIDA, hepatitis n'izindi ndwara. Umusore ashobora gufashwa no kubona inyigisho ku buryo bwo gukoresha agakingirizo igihe cyose akeneye kubikora. 3. Kumenya neza ibindi bimenyetso bigaragara: Igihe umusore agaragaje ibindi bimenyetso birimo n'ububabare mu gitsina, ibisebe, kuzana amashyira mu gitsina cyangwa kwandura indwara ziterwa n'udukoko. Ibi bishobora gufasha kumenya niba hari indi ndwara yamuteye iyi ibi byose. 4. Kumugira ina kwihutira kugana kwa muganga: Mugihe uri kumufasha, kumusaba kugana kwa muganga vuba ni ngombwa kugira ngo asuzumwe neza. Ibi bizafasha kugenzura niba hari ikibazo cy'indwara zifata imyanya ndangagitsina cyangwa niba ikibazo cy'ubuzima cye cyaba gikomeye kurushaho. Inama yawe yo kumwohereza kwa muganga n'ingenzi cyane, kandi kumufasha kubona ubufasha bwihuse bizatuma amenya neza ikibazo afite, akamenya uburyo bwo kwirinda izindi ndwara, za ndurira mumibonano mpuzabitsina ndetse ningamba m'uburyo bwo gufata neza ubuzima bwe.
question_english: Good morning, I attended to a 25-year-old man weighing 62 kilograms who reported experiencing pain while urinating. When I asked how long this had been happening, he said it had been two days. I inquired if he had any other health conditions, and he said he did not. I also asked if he had recently engaged in unprotected sexual intercourse, and he confirmed that he had. I explained to him that unprotected sex could lead to contracting incurable diseases such as HIV, hepatitis B, and other infections like gonorrhea, syphilis, and others. I issued him a transfer. I am wondering if there is any additional assistance I can provide. Thank you!

question_kinyarwanda: Umubyeyi w'umugore w'imyaka mirongo itatu n'itanu yaje ambwira ko ashaka kuboneza urubyaro. Namubwiye ko mu mudugudu tudatangiza kuboneza urubyaro mwohereza kwa muganga.Mubwira ko nzamubonereza agarutse bwa kabiri. Mungire inama y'ikindi nari gukora?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umubyeyi ufiite imyaka 35 arashaka kuboneza urubyaro. Umushimire igitecyerezo n'umwanzuro byiza yahisemo byo kuboneza. Mubaze igihe aherukira mu mihango ubanze umupime inda urebe ko adatwite mbere yo kuboneza. Musobanurire ko yajya kwa muganga kuko bamusobanurira uburyo bwose bwo kuboneza urubyaro butandukanye , ubwijyihe kirekire,kigufi cyangwa ubwa burundu. Hari uburyo bukoresha imisemburo n'ubudakoresha imisemburo. Ko byaba byiza agiye agahitamo ubwo akoresha amaze kumva itandukaniro n'uburyo ikoramo agahitamo ubumunogeye.
question_english: A thirty-five-year-old woman came to me saying she wants to use contraceptive method. I told her that at village level, we don't give contraceptive method for the first time and that she should go to the hospital. I promised her that I will help her for the second time. What other advice or actions should I consider in this situation?

question_kinyarwanda: Umugore w'imyaka mirongo ine n'itanu ambajije niba umugabo ugira amahane yo kuba yakubita umuntu, ari ikimenyetso cy'uburwayi bwo mu mutwe?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: murakoze cyane kubaza icyo kibazo -uyu mugabo ubanza ukamenya ko atari kamere yifitiye ,niba bije vuba murebe n'icyabiteye -mubaze niba amukubita amuhoye koko ubusa ntacyo bapfuye maze bajye babanza babiganireho -niba akubita abanttu bose rero mubanze mumenye impamvu -ni ukuvuga ko birashoboka ko byaba uburwayi bwo mumutwe ,kamere cyangwa ari impamvu zindi
question_english: A forty-five-year-old woman has asked me if a man who is aggressive enough to hit someone is a sign of mental illness?

question_kinyarwanda: Mwaramutse, umubyeyi angejejeho umwana ufite amezi umunani, mubajije uburwayi bwe, ambwira ko yaraye ahinda umuriro anahitwa. Mubajije inshuro yituma ku munsi, ambwira ko ari eshatu. Mubajije nimba ari birebire, ambwira ko atari birebire cyane. Muha ibinini bya zenke(zinc), muha na ORS. Mubajije nimba nta bundi burwayi asanzwe agira, ambwira ko ari ntabwo. None umubyeyi namufasha iki? Murakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze kuri iki kibazo mubajije cy'umubyeyi ufite umwana w'amezi umunani waraye ahinda umuriro anahitwa, akaba ahitwa inshuro eshatu ku munsi ariko agahitwa ibitari birebire, kandi nta bundi burwayi asanzwe agira. Wakoze kumuha imiti ivura impiswi ya zenke na oweresi. Gusa akenshi nuha umubyeyi imiti, uge umusobanurira uko ayiha umwana. Zenke rero iyo umwana ari munsi y'amezi atandatu, bamuha mirigarama icumi ku munsi mu minsi icumi: ni ukuvuga, igice k'ikinini. N'aho iyo arengeje amezi atandatu, umuha mirigarama makumyabiri ku munsi, mu minsi icumi: ni ukuvuga ikinini kimwe ku munsi. Naho owersi yo, agashashi kamwe kajya muri litiro y'amazi meza, ukajya uha umwana buri uko ahiswe, akanywa; ukamenya ko umwana uri munsi y'imyaka ibiri anywa byibuze kuva kuri mirilitiro mirongo itanu kugeza ku ijana buri uko ahiswe, naho umwana urengeje imyaka ibiri anywa mirilitiro ijana kugeza kuri maganabiri buri uko ahiswe. Uyu mubyeyi rero, mubwire ko umwana we azajya amuha zenke makumyabiri inshuro imwe ku munsi kandi agategura oweresi agashashi kamwe ayivanga na litiro y'amazi meza, ubundi akajya aha umwana uko ahiswe, kandi akamuha byibuze mirilitiro mirongo itanu. Kandi wibuke no kumwigisha isuku no kurinda umwana kurya ibintu byanduye, kuko bimugiraho ingaruka mbi zo kurwara indwara ziterwa n'umwanda, kandi bikadindiza n'imikurire y'umwana. Murakoze!
question_english: Good morning, a parent brought their eight-month-old child to me. When I asked about the child's illness, the parent told me the child had a fever and vomited the night before. I also asked how many times the child passes stool in a day, and the parent said three times. When I asked if it was excessive, they said it wasn't too much. I gave the child zinc tablets and ORS. When I asked if the child has any other pre-existing conditions, the parent said no. What further assistance can I offer this child? Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Umurwayi afite imyaka makumyabiri, ibiro mirongo itanu na bitandatu ni umuhungu. Afite umuriro wa mirongo itatu n'icyenda akababara umutwe,akaba yarasanganywe uburwayi bw'igituntu. Mufatiye tederi(TDR) nsanga ni positifu afite malariya, none ngomba kumuha sisi fuwa katere(six fois Quatre). None nayimuha afite n'igituntu?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Uyu ni umugabo w'imyaka 20 ufite ibiro 56 wangejejweho afite umuriro mwinshi, umutwe, kandi TDR ye ya malariya yagaragaje ko ari nziza ku ndwara ya Tuberikilozi y'ibihaha. Uyu mugabo afite malariya na Tuberikilozi y'ibihaha, biremewe kumuha imiti ya malariya ku murwayi ufite Tuberikilozi y'ibihaha. Gahunda: -Mumuhe umuti wa malariya witwa Coartem ibinini 4 ku isaha ya 0h-8h hanyuma buri masaha 12 mu minsi 3 uhereye kuri dose y'itangiriro. -Mumwohereze ku kigo nderabuzima kugira ngo akomeze kwitabwaho, kuko malariya ishobora gukomera cyangwa ikaba malariya yo mu bwonko.
question_english: The patient is a 20-year-old male, weighing 56 kilograms. He has a fever of 39°C and a headache, and he has been diagnosed with tuberculosis. I performed a rapid diagnostic test (TDR) and found that he is positive for malaria. I plan to give him six doses of the antimalarial medication (six times four). Should I give him this treatment considering he also has tuberculosis?

question_kinyarwanda: Umugore w'imyaka mirongo irindwi n'itanu, yasuwe agirwa inama yo kwisuzumisha buri kwezi, kugira ngo amenye niba adafite zimwe mu ndwara zitandura, kuko ubushize twazivuzeho. Ati,:"yewe ni ibihe byayuma koko!" Hakorwa iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugore w'imyaka mirongo irindwi n'itanu yarasuwe agirwa inama yo kwigenzura buri kwezi kugira ngo arebe niba afite indwara zitandura, kuko twazivuzeho ubushize. asobanura ibyiza byo kwipimisha kugira ngo wirinde indwara zimwe na zimwe zidakira kandi, iyo zibonywe hakiri kare, zivurwe ku gihe. Umwemeze gukurikiza ubu buryo bwo kwipimisha buri kwezi kugira ngo yirinde ingaruka z'igihe kirekire.
question_english: A seventy-five-year-old woman has been visited and advised to self-examine every month to check if she has got any non-communicable diseases, because we talked about them last time. She said, "Oh, these are truly challenging times!" What should be done?

question_kinyarwanda: Umugore w'imyaka makumyabiri n'itandatu ambajije niba uburyo bwo kuboneza urubyaro hakoreshejwe urushinge umuntu ashobora kubusamiramo. None uyu mubyeyi namubwira gute?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugore w'imyaka 26 arabaza niba umugore ashobora gusama aboneza urubyaro akoresheje urushinge . Urushinge rwo kuboneza urubyaro rufite 99% by'ubushobozi bwo kurinda gusama ariko 1 mu 100 ashobora gusama. Bivuze ko bishoboka ariko ku kigero gito.
question_english: A twenty-six-year-old woman asked me if it is possible to conceive while using the injection method of family planning. So how should I respond to this woman?

question_kinyarwanda: Umusore w'imyaka makumyabiri n'itanu, ibiro ni mirongo itanu na bitandatu. Aje afite umuriro mwinshi, ababara mu nda n'umugongo. Mupimye umuriro nsanga ni mirongo itatu n'icyenda. Mupimye malariya nsanga ntayo afite. Mubajije niba nta bundi burwayi asanganywe, ambwira ko ntabwo. Namuha ubuhe bufasha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umusore w'imyaka 25, upima ibiro 56, yaje afite umuriro mwinshi, ububabare mu nda no mu mugongo. Napimye ubushyuhe bwe nsanga ari dogere 39 Celsius. Malaria ntiyagaragaye. Bisa n'uko ari gastroenteritis y'ubukana ifite umuriro mwinshi. Baza ibindi bimenyetso n'ibimenyetso by'indwara. Tanga imiti igabanya ububabare n'igabanya umuriro. Baza niba arimo kuruka niba bihari. Tanga ORS na zenk.
question_english: A 25-year-old young man, weighing 56 kilograms, comes in with a high fever, abdominal pain, and back pain. I measured his temperature and found it to be 39 degrees Celsius. I tested him for malaria and found he does not have it. When I asked if he has any other pre-existing conditions, he told me no. What assistance should I provide him?

question_kinyarwanda: Umukobwa w'imyaka cumi n'itanu ambajije ikibazo niba umuntu ashobora gusama atarabona imihango n'umunsi n'umwe. Uyu mukobwa namusubiza gute?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umukobwa ufite imyaka 15, ashobora gusama atarabona imihango n'umunsi n'umwe. Igizubizo wamuha: 1. Ntashobora gusama, kuko imihango niyo igaragaza ko umukobwa ari mugihe cyuburumbuke, kandi aribwo ashobora gusama 2. Nukumubwira ko yatinze kuyibona kumyaka ye, ariko bishoboka, agomba kugana umuganga winzobere yababyeyi (gynecologist) akamusuzuma akamenya impanvu ibitera, akamufasha byimbitse.
question_english: A 15-year-old girl asked me a question if a person can conceive without having seen menstruation even once. How should I answer this girl?

question_kinyarwanda: Umugore w'imyaka mirongo ine n'irindwi, angezeho ambwira ko ikibazo cyo mukanwa ambwira ko agira udusebe ambwira ko agira utubyimba ambwira ko ava amaraso mwishinya abyimba no kubabara ishinya anuka mu kanwa kugira ubushagarira cyane cyane iyo anyweye ibikonje cyangwa ibishyushye. Mwohereje kwa muganga. Ese hari ubundi bufasha namuha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugore w'imyaka 47 yaje afite ishinya zabyimbye, zibabaza kandi ziva amaraso, impumuro mbi mu kanwa, ibisebe mu kanwa no kumva uburibwe ku binyobwa bikonje cyangwa bishyushye. Uyu murwayi ashobora kuba afite gingivitisi. Mubwire kutanywa cyangwa kurya ibiryo cyangwa ibinyobwa bikonje cyane cyangwa bishyushye kandi agire isuku yo mu kanwa nk'ukoza amenyo nyuma yo kurya buri gihe no gukoresha umugozi woza amenyo, hanyuma akoreshe umuti w'amenyo urimo fluoride, hanyuma mumwohereze ku muganga w'amenyo kugira ngo amupime.  Nanone mubaze ku bijyanye n'ubuzima bwe bwa HIV kugira ngo harebwe niba nta kibazo cy'ubudahangarwa bw'umubiri.
question_english: A forty-seven-year-old woman came to me and told me about a problem in her mouth. She told me she has sores, swelling, bleeding gums, swollen and painful gums, bad breath, and sensitivity, especially when she drinks cold or hot things. I referred her to the doctor. Is there any other help I can offer her?

question_kinyarwanda: Umukobwa w'imyaka cumi n'irindwi tumusanganye n'umugabo w'imyaka mirongo itatu n'umwe mu nzu barimo basambana. Tubajije uwo mukobwa n'uwo mugabo, batubwira ko basambanye. Tubwiye uwo mwana w'umukobwa ngo tumujyane kwa muganga no kuri isange one stop center, umukobwa arabyanga ngo ntaho yajya kugira ngo tudafungisha uwo mugabo. Ese ni iki kindi twakora?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umukobwa w'imyaka 17 y'amavuko yabonetse ari kumwe n'umugabo w'imyaka 31 mu nzu aho bakoraga imibonano mpuzabitsina. Tumaze kubaza uwo mukobwa n'uwo mugabo, batubwiye ko bakoze imibonano mpuzabitsina. Murakoze cyane niba umukobwa atifuza kubwira Isange One Stop Center Ugomba kwicarana n'umukobwa ukamwigisha ingaruka mbi zituruka ku mibonano mpuzabitsina idakingiye, nk'indwara zidakira.
question_english: A 17-year-old girl has been found with a 31-year-old man in a house where they have been engaging in sexual activity. When we've asked the girl and the man, they've told us they have engaged in sexual activity. We've told the girl that we would take her to the hospital and to the Isange One Stop Center, but the girl has refused, saying she wouldn't go anywhere so that we wouldn't have the man arrested. What else can we do?

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'umuhungu ufite imyaka ine afite ibiro cumi na bitatu na muwake cumi na gatandatu arahitwa inshuro eshanu ku munsi. Abimaranye iminsi ibiri nta bundi burwayi asanzwe afite. Uyu mwana namuha iyihe ngano y'umuti?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umuhungu w'imyaka ine ufite ibiro cumi na bitatu na MUAC ya santimetero cumi n'esheshatu afite impiswi inshuro eshanu ku munsi. Yabimazemo iminsi ibiri kandi nta yindi ndwara yari asanzwe afite. Igisubizo Gastroenteritis. Kuma kw'umubiri. Kubura imyunyu ngugu ihagije. Gahunda Gukora isuzuma rya stool. Guha ORS 10ml/kg nyuma ya buri gihe cyo kwituma. Zinc 20mg rimwe ku munsi. Hari ibindi bimenyetso bifitanye isano no kuma kw'umubiri? Niba bihari, umwana agomba koherezwa kuvurwa byisumbuyeho.
question_english: A four-year-old boy who has thirteen kilograms and a MUAC of sixteen is having diarrhea five times a day. He has had it for two days and has no other pre-existing illness. What dose of medicine should I give to this child?

question_kinyarwanda: Mwriwe neza umugore w'imyaka mirongo ine n'irindwi, afite ibiro mirongo itandatu n'umunani aratwite. Namusuye iwabo mu rugo nsanga arikuribwa umutwe bikabije afite isereri, amaso no mu biganza arikwereruka, yabyimbye ibirenge, mubaza igihe abimaranye ambwiye ko abimaranye ibyumweru bibiri. Muhaye taransferi ngo ajyee ku kigo nderabuzima yanga kujyayo ngo bizikiza. None namufasha iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugore w'imyaka 47 utwite ufite umutwe, isereri, amaso n'intoki byerurutse hamwe n'ibirenge byabyimbye mu byumweru bibiri. Uyu murwayi afite indwara y'amaraso make itera umutwe n'isereri hamwe n'amaso yera. Umurwayi ashobora kuba afite ikibazo cyo kudasubiza amaraso neza kubera umubyimba uterwa n'inda. Hita wohereza umurwayi kwa muganga kugira ngo bapime urwego rw'amaraso. Kwa muganga, niba amaraso make, nyamuneka muhe ibinini bya feri kugira ngo azamure amaraso.
question_english: Good evening, a forty-seven-year-old woman, weighing sixty-eight kilograms, is pregnant. I visited her at her home and found her experiencing severe headaches, dizziness, and her eyes and hands are pale; her feet are swollen. I asked her how long she has had these symptoms, and she told me it has been two weeks. I gave her transport money to go to the health center, but she refused, saying it will heal on its own. So, what can I help her?

question_kinyarwanda: Umubyeyi w'umugabo w'imyaka mirongo ine n'icyenda aje ambwira ko afite umuriro, gucika intege, ababara umutwe aracibwamo, yabuze na apeti. Nanze kumukoraho kuko naketse yuko yaba afite nabonaga asa naho afite ibimenyetso by'icyorezo cya mabaga. Ntabwo nigeze mwegera, namubajije niba nta yindi miti afata ambwira ko ntayindi miti afata. Ese mpite mwohereza kwa muganga, ese musuzume cyangwa se muhururize?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugabo w'imyaka 49 yaje yitotombera umuriro, umunaniro, umutwe, impiswi no kubura appetit. Wirinze kumukoraho kuko waketse ko arwaye indwara y'icyorezo (Marburg). • Niba ukeka indwara yandura kandi yica nk'iyo, ugomba guhamagara imbangukiragutabara kugira ngo ijyane umurwayi kwa muganga aho bafite ibikoresho byihariye byo kwirinda (PPEs) kugira ngo bitondere umurwayi, bakore ibizamini bijyanye no gukomeza kumuvura cyangwa kugira ngo bemeze ko atarwaye Marburg.
question_english: A 49-year-old man came to me complaining of fever, fatigue, headache, diarrhea, and loss of appetite. I avoided physical contact with him because I suspected he might have symptoms of an epidemy named Murburg. I didn’t get close to him and asked if he was taking any other medication, to which he said no. Should I send him to the hospital, examine him myself, or call for emergency assistance?

question_kinyarwanda: Mwiriwe neza umugore w'imyaka mirongo ine nitanu ibiro mirongo irindwi, aje ambwira ko afite ikibazo cy'imihango idakama akaba arimo kubabara umutwe, akaba afite n'iserereri. Mubajije niba nta bundi burwayi asanganywe ambwira ko ntabwo mubaje igihe aherukira mu mihango, ambwira ko amaze ukwezi ayivuyemo. Mubwiye ko ari bumere neza muhaye transferi, nibazaga niba nta bundi bufasha namuha. Murakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Mwiriwe neza namwe! Nk'uko mwakiriye uyu mugore w'imyaka mirongo ine n'itanu, ufite ibiro mirongo irindwi, waje akubwira ko afite ikibazo cy'imihango idakama, akaba ari kubabara umutwe, akaba afite n'isereri. Wa mubaza ko ntabundi burwayi afite akakubwira ko ntabwo, wa mubaza igihe aherukira mu mihango, akakubwira ko amaze ukwezi ayivuyemo. Mwakoze cyane kuba mwa mwohereje ku ivuriro rimwegereye, nyuma yo kumva ikibazo cy'imihango idakama, kuribwa umutwe, no kuba afite isereri, kuko bishoboka ko ibyo yita imihango idakama atari yo, ahubwo ushobora gusanga ari inda iri kuvamo, cyangwa ari ibimenyetso bya kanseri y'inkondo y'umura, kandi ukanamusobanurira ko kuba ari kuribwa umutwe n'isereri ari bimwe mu bimenyetso bigirwa n'umuntu wagize ikibazo cyo kubura maraso. Ukamusobanurira neza ko nubwo umuhaye transferi imujyana kwa muganga, byaba byiza ko yakihutira kujyayo kandi agashaka undi muntu umuherekeza kugira ngo atagirira ikibazo mu nzira, yaba atamufite ukamuherekeza nk'umujyanama w'ubuzima. Akajya guhabwa ubufasha n'ubuvuzi bumukwiye. Murakoze!
question_english: Good afternoon, a 45-year-old woman weighing 70 kilograms came to me, reporting prolonged menstruation, headaches, and dizziness. When I asked if she had any other underlying conditions, she said no. I asked when she last had her period, and she told me it had been a month since it ended. I reassured her that she would be fine and gave her a referral. I was wondering if there is any other assistance I could offer her. Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Umugore ufite imyaka makumyabiri n'icyenda, yaje ambwira y'uko amaze iminsi ibiri ari kuva, ambwira y'uko ari no kubabara umutwe, ambwira ko asanzwe akoresha uburyo bwo kuboneza urubyaro, akoresheje ibinini by'imisemburo ibiri. Namugiriye inama yo kujya kwa muganga, ngo bakurikirane ikibazo afite. None nabazaga nimba uyu mubyeyi hari ubundi bufasha namuha mbere yuko ajya kwa muganga. Murakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze kubaza iki kibazo cy'uyu mugore ufite imyaka makumyabiri nicyenda waje akubwira ko amaze iminsi ibiri arimo kuva akubwira ko ari no kubabara umutwe akubwira ko asanzwe akoresha uburyo bwo kuboneza urubyaro akoresheje ibinini by'imisemburo ibiri. Wamugiriye inama yo kujya kwa muganga ngo akurikirane ikibazo afite none wabazaga niba uyu mubyeyi hari ubundi bufasha wamuha mbere yuko ajya kwa muganga. Nibyiza kuba mubajije icyi kibazo cy'uyu mugore umaze iminsi ibiri ava akaribwa umutwe kandi akaba asanzwe akoresha uburyo bwo kuboneza za urubyaro, ni byiza ko asuzumwa kuko afite ibimenyetso mpuruza ku mugore ukoresha uburyo bwo kuboneza urubyaro nko kuba ari kuva no kuribwa umutwe. Kandi kuba ari kuribwa umutwe aba agomba gusuzumwa hakarebwa icyatumye arwara umutwe niba atari umuvuduko w'amaraso wamurenze, niba atari ibibyimba arwaye . Kandi kuba ari kuva ntabwo twahita twemeza ko ari ibinini byabiteye, ahubwo uyu mubyeyi agomba gusuzumwa kanseri y'ikondo y'umura. Ubufasha wamuha ni ukamusobanurira ibi byose byavuzwe haruguru, ukamuha taransiferi imujyana ku kigo nderabuzima bakamusuzuma akavurwa neza. Murakoze.
question_english: A twenty-nine-year-old woman has come to me and has told me that she has been bleeding for two days. She has also mentioned that she has a headache and uses a hormonal contraceptive pill. I have advised her to go to the hospital so they can follow up on her issue. Now I was asking if there is any other assistance I can provide to this woman before she goes to the hospital. Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Umusaza w'imyaka mirongo itandatu n'umunani, afite ibiro mirongo itanu, yaje angana ambwira yuko Ari kubabara umutwe cyane. Mubajije ubundi burwayi asanganywe, ambwira yuko afite umuvuduko wamaraso. Namubajije niba imiti anywa yarayimaze, ambwira yuko yamunaniye atakiyinywa. Nafasha iki uyu umusaza?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umusaza ufite imyaka 68, ibiro 50, arababara umutwe cyane, asanzwe afite uburwayi bw'umuvuduko kandi yaretse imiti ngo yaramunaniye. Ubufasha: Uyu musaza ni ukumuganiriza ko kuba yararetse imiti byashobora kumuzanira ingaruka zitewe n'uyu muvuduko bikaba byamuzanira n'urupfu. Akabasha kumva ko agomba gusubira ku miti kandi akayinywa neza, Nyuma ugahita umuha transferi akajya kwa muganga, agasubizwa kumiti y'umuvuduko ndetse agakorerwa n'ibipimo bindi bakareba ko ntangaruka zamugezeho zatewe no kuba yararetse imiti, agahabwa ubufasha.
question_english: A 68-year-old man weighing 50 kilograms came to see me, complaining of severe headaches. When I asked about any pre-existing conditions, he told me he has high blood pressure. I also asked if he was still taking his medication, and he said he had stopped because it wasn’t working for him anymore. How can I help this man?

question_kinyarwanda: Nasuye umuryango ufite umwana w'umuhungu w'imyaka cumi n'umunani; afite ubumuga; ntiyifurizwa kujya ahagaragara ngo agire icyo yafashwa. Hakorwa iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umwana ufite ubumuga ubuzwa kujya hanze ngo agire icyo afashwa, bishobora kumuviramo nibindi bibazo byo mu mutwe, harimo; agahinda gakabije, kwiguga, kwitinya no kumvako we ntacyo yakora cyangwa ashoboye. Bishobora no kumuviramo intekerezo mbi zamugeza no kwiyahura. Kwigisha umuryango ko kuba umuntu afite ubumuga bidakuyeho ko haricyo yakora. Yakwiga, yasabana n'abandi, ndetse akanisanzura, bigatuma ubuzima bwe bugenda neza. Mukabasobanurira n'ingaruka zo guheza umwana ufite ubumuga, nkuko twabivuze haruguru.
question_english: I visited a family with an eighteen-year-old boy who has a disability; no one wishes him to go out in public so that he can receive any help. What can be done in this situation?

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'umuhungu w'imyaka makumyabiri ngo afite ikibazo cyo kubabara amenyo igihe yagize icyo ahekenya kandi ngo bibaho kenshi. Namugiriye inama yo kugana muganga ngo abe yavurwa, aranga, ati: "nzajya kwa masenge azampa umuti". Uwo mwana yafashwa iki?"
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze kubaza iki ikibazo cy'uyu mwana w'umuhungu w'imyaka makumyabiri, ufite ikibazo cyo kubabara amenyo igihe agize icyo ahekenya Kandi ngo bibaho kenshi. Wamugiriye inama yo kujya kwa muganga ngo abe yavurwa, aranga ngp azajya kwa nyirasenge amuhe imiti. Ukaba ubaza icyo wamufasha. Nibyo koko kuba uyu mwana w'umuhungu ufite ikibazo cyo kuribwa amenyo igihe agize icyo ahekenya, akumva ko akoresheje imiti ahawe na nyirasenge aribyo byamukiza, ni ikibazo cyo kudasobanukirwa uburwayi afite, no kutamenya ikibutera ni uko bwakirindwa. Kuko akenshi kuribwa amenyo, biba basobanuye ko ishinya yangiritse, amenyo yacukutse, bitewe no kutayagirira isuku, ngo ayoze uko amaze kurya n'umuti woza amenyo, kandi yibuke kuyoza cyane nyuma yo kurya agiye kuryama, kuko nijoro nibwo udukoko tuyangiza aba ari twinshi kuko umunwa uba ufunze bigatuma ogusijene itinjira neza, kandi iyo yinjiye ibasha kwica utwo dukoko. Rero uyu muhungu agomba kugirwa inama kugeza kurwego yumva ibi byose neza kandi akanasaba urirwa ko hari imiti ibivura bigakira, kandi agasobanurirwa ibibi byo gukoresha imiti y'ibyatsi kuko yangiza amenyo. Umuhe taransiferi imujyana ku ivuriro rimwegereye bamufashe. Murakoze.
question_english: A twenty-year-old boy , has a problem with toothache whenever he chews something, and it happens frequently. I advised him to visit a doctor for treatment, but he has refused, saying, "I will go to my aunt; she will give me medicine." What can be done to help this boy?

question_kinyarwanda: Umubyeyi w'imyaka mirongo itandatu, yaje kundeba, ambwira ko afite inkorora irengeje ibyumweru bibiri kandi acika intege cyane. Namugiriye inama yo kujya gutanga igikorwa, ambwira ko atagerayo. Ndamufasha iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umubyeyi ufite imyaka 60, afite inkorora irengeje ibyumweru bibiri, acika intege cyane, agomba gutanga igikororwa ariko nta mbaraga afite yo kugerayo; icyo tumukorera ni ukumuhamagarira imbangukiragutaba akagezwa ku kigonderabuzima akitabwaho. ageze ku kigonderabuzima baramukorera isuzumwa, bamupime igituntu, basanze afite koko igitumtu, agahabwa imiti yacyo ariyo : rhze amezi atandatu, kumuha umuti ugabanya umuriro ariwo: paracetamol 1g tds 5/7, gukurikiranwa kugeza abashije gukira neza.
question_english: A 60-year-old patient came to see me, reporting a cough lasting more than two weeks and severe fatigue. I advised her to get tested, but they said they couldn't make it to the facility. How can I assist her?

question_kinyarwanda: Umusore w'imyaka mirongo itatu afite ibiro mirongo itaratu na bitanu,yaje angana ambwira yuko afite inkorora imaze ibyumweru bitatu. Namubajije ubundi asanganywe ambwira ko ntabwo, namwandikiye taransiferi ajya kwa muganga avuyeyo basanga n’igituntu arwaye. Namugiriye inama yo kwirinda gusangira n'abandi bantu, akaza anywa wenyine kugira ngo atanduza abandi. None mwamfasha iki, ubundi bujyanama nagira uyu murwayi?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugabo w'imyaka 30 upima ibiro 65 yaje ansanga ambwira ko afite inkorora imaze ibyumweru bitatu. Igihe namubazaga niba afite izindi ndwara yari asanganywe, yarambwiye ati oya. Namwandikiye urupapuro rwo kujya kwa muganga, maze nyuma yo gusura kwa muganga, basanze afite igituntu. Namugiriye inama yo kwirinda gusangira n'abandi no kurya wenyine kugira ngo atanduza abandi. Ni gute nakomeza gufasha uyu murwayi, kandi ni izihe nama zindi namuha? Umurwayi wasanganywe igituntu agomba guhita atangira imiti y'igituntu (anti tibu) ako kanya, agashyirwa mu kato mu mezi abiri ya mbere y'ubuvuzi kuko icyo gihe aba yanduza cyane, gukurikiranwa neza mu mezi abiri ya mbere birakenewe, kwigisha umurwayi kurangiza imiti y'amezi atandatu y'igituntu, kurinda abandi kutandura adasangira ibikoresho n'abandi, no kwirinda kujya ahantu hateraniye abantu benshi.
question_english: A 30-year-old man weighing 65 kilograms came to me reporting a cough that has lasted for three weeks. When I asked if he had any pre-existing conditions, he said no. I wrote him a referral to go to the hospital, and after his visit, they found that he has tuberculosis. I advised him to avoid sharing with others and to eat alone to prevent spreading it. How else can you assist this patient, and what additional advice should I give him?

question_kinyarwanda: Muraho neza, umusore w'imyaka cumi n'icyenda ni umunyeshuri, yagize ikigare anywa ibiyobyabwenge none yifuza kubireka ariko yumva bimunanira, aragisha inama muganga niba hari imiti yamufasha.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Uyu ni umunyeshuri w'imyaka 19 wakoresheje ibiyobyabwenge kandi arashaka kubireka. Uyu mugabo arashaka kubireka. Gahunda: Agomba kuva mu itsinda yarimo. Kandi agabanya buhoro buhoro ingano y'ibyo yakoraga.
question_english: Hello, a 19-year-old student has been using drugs but now wants to quit, though he feels it's difficult for him. He is seeking advice from a doctor to know if there is any medication that can help him.

question_kinyarwanda: Mwaramutse, ngeze ku muhanda nsanga hari umuntu waguye hasi w'umusaza ufite imyaka mirongo ine n'itanu, nsanga abantu baramushungeye, mbasha kubakura kugira ngo ndebe ko yabona umwuka mubajije nimba hari ubundi uburwayi yari asanzwe afite ambwira ko yari asanzwe agira igicuri none mpamagaye ambilansi bambwira ko iri buhagere nyuma y'isaha none umurwayi namufasha iki? Murakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umusaza w’imyaka 55 yari aryamye hasi, abantu bamukikije. Nabasabye kwigira hirya ngo mbanze ndebe ko ahumeka. Namubajije niba hari uburwayi asanganwe, ambwira ko asanzwe afite indwara y'igicuri. * Rinda inzira z'ubuhumekero. Reka aruhuke gato. * Mugire inama yo gukuramo amatembabuzi mu kanwa. * Mubaze niba afite imiti igabanya umuriro. * Ushobora kumuha imiti ikwiye niba ayifite. * Rinda abantu kumukikiza kugira ngo atabura umwuka . * Azakira. * Ariko niba atoroherwa, ushobora guhamagara ubufasha.
question_english: Good morning, I arrived at the road and found an elderly man, 55 years old, lying on the ground surrounded by people. I managed to get them away to ensure he is breathing. When I asked if he had any existing health issues, he mentioned he had epilepsy. I called an ambulance and was told they would arrive in an hour. What else can I do to help this patient? Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Umugabo w'imyaka mirongo itatu nitanu, ufite ibiro mirongo irindwi na kimwe. Aje angana ambwira ko arwaye umutezi kandi amaze iminsi itanu, avuye kwa muganga bamuhaye imiti ariko bikaba bitari koroha. Mubajije igihe yafatiwe, ambwira ko yari amaze iminsi itatu nahise muha transferi. Ese hari ubundi bufasha mwamuha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: 1. Umugabo w’imyaka 35 ufite indwara y'imitezi amaze iminsi itatu afata imiti ariko nta mpinduka, mubwire kunywa amazi menshi no gukomeza gufata imiti nk'uko yayandikiwe. Mubwire kandi kugaruka kwa muganga ari kumwe n’uwo babana. Kwa muganga bapima bacyenera gupima uwo babana, iyo bombi basanze barwaye imitezi, baravurwa bombi. Niba umugore we adafite iyo ndwara, umugabo akomeza gufata imiti ye uko yagenwe.
question_english: A 35-year-old man weighing seventy-one kilograms came to me complaining of gonorrhea, which he has had for five days. He had already been to the hospital and received medication, but it has not been effective. When I asked when he started the treatment, he said it was three days ago. I immediately gave him a referral. Is there any other assistance I can offer him?

question_kinyarwanda: Umuhungu imyaka makumyabiri n'irindwi ibiro mirongo itandatu. Umuriro mirongo itatu n'icyenda. Aje afite intege nke umubiri washeshe ibiheri.
