Afite umuriro mwinshi. abimaranye iminsi itandatu, nta bundi burwayi afite. Mupimye nta malariya. Umuriro uri kwiyongera cyane, gucika intege. Gusesa ibiheri bimeze nk'ubushye ku mubiri. Afite ibimenyetso by'ubushita bw'inkende. Ni iki nakora kugira ngo mufashe mbere yo kumwohereza?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: murakoze -mubuze kwegera abandi -muhe ikinini kigabanya umuriro -mumwihutane kwa muganga bamufashe -ikindi tanga raporo bafashe ako gace kose
question_english: The boy is twenty-seven years old, weighing sixty kilograms. His temperature is thirty-nine degrees. He has come in weak, with his body covered in rashes. He has a high fever that he has had for six days, with no other illness. I have tested him, and he does not have malaria. The fever has been increasing significantly, and he is becoming weaker. The rashes look like burns on his body, and he shows symptoms of monkeypox. What can I do to help before referring him?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umugore w'imyaka mirongo ine nicyenda yaje ambwira ko umugabo amukubita cyane kandi akaba amufata ku ngufu. Bikaba bimaze gutuma agira ihahamuka cyane asigaye abona igitsina gabo akiruka. Namugiriye inama yo kubibwira abayobozi ambwira ko atajyayo amutinya. Nabazabaza niba uwo umugore yakorerwa ibihe bizamini cyangwa ya buhe buvuzi?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugore w'imyaka 49, umugabo aramukubita akanamufata ku ngufu, byamuteye ihungabana none asigaye abona igitsina gabo akiruka. Ntabwo yajya ku buyobozi kubera ko atinya umugabo we. Uyu mugore akorerwa ihohoterwa rishingiye ku gitsina n'iry'umubiri. Mwicaze umuganirize, umubwire ko ari ingenzi kubibwira abayobozi kandi ko umutekano we wizewe kuruta uko yamuhishira bikaba byamuviramo no kuba igihe kimwe yazamukubita akamwica. Umuhumurize, uti leta ifite uburyo bwihariye inyuzamo ibyo birego. Musuzume urebe ibice by'umubiri we wose niba nta bikomere afite, mubaze ko adatwite niba atabizi umenye igihe aherukira mu mihango. Byaba byiza kuva afite ubwoba bwo kujya kurega, umuherekeje ukamukorera ubuvugizi ku nzego zibishinzwe. Akajyanwa kwa muganga kugira ngo hakorwe ibizamini byimbitse barebe ko nta bikomere by'umubiri afite cyangwa indwara zandurira mu mibonano mpuzabitsina, n'ihungabana rijyanye n'imitekerereze afite. Afashwe bijyanye n'uko ameze.
question_english: I received a woman who is forty-nine years old. She told me that her husband beats her severely and also sexually assaults her. This has caused her post-traumatic stress disorder, and now, when she sees any male person, she runs away. I advised her to report this to the authorities, but she said she is afraid of her husband. I would like to ask if this woman should undergo any tests or what kind of treatment she should receive.

question_kinyarwanda: Umugabo w'imyaka mirongo itanu n'itandatu yaje avuga ko afite umururiro mwinshi, mubaje ko nta bundi burwayi asanganywe, avuga ko afite SIDA. Ese ubwo namupima malariya kandi afite sida? Mumfashe!
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze cyane. \- Nta kibazo rwose mupime malaria kuko izo ndwara zombi yazigira. \- Muhe umuti ugabanya umuriro. \- Malarira nuyibura ajye kwa muganga bamufashe.
question_english: A fifty-six-year-old man came saying he has a high fever, by asking him if he has no other pre-existing illness, he said he has AIDS. Should I test him for malaria even though he has AIDS? Help me!

question_kinyarwanda: Umukecuru w'imyaka mirongo itandatu, ibiro ni mirongo irindwi na kimwe, aje ababara umutwe no mu nda, afite n'umuriro. Mupimye umuriro nsanga ni mirongo itatu numunani, mupimye tederi nsanga nta malariya afite. Mubajije niba nta bundi burwayi asanganywe ambwira ko afite umuvuduko w'amaraso. Namuha ubuhe bufasha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Ubufasha wamuha, wamubwira gufata amazi akonje akanywa, ubundi ukamushyiraho igitambaro gitose, ukagishyira k'umutwe, ubundi ukamugeza kwa muganga kugira ngo bamufatire ibizamini byose, bamenye icyamuteye kugira umuriro no kuribwa mu nda. Hanyuma ukamubwira gukomeza imiti ye y'umuvuduko w'amaraso.
question_english: A woman in her sixties, whose weight is 71 kg, comes in with headache and abdominal pain. She has a fever and i tested her for fever and i found that she is thirty-eight. I tested TDR and got negative result. I asked if she had any other illnesses and she told me that she had a high blood pressure. What can i do for her?

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana ufite imyaka ibiri w'umuhungu, mama we yamuzanye afite ibiro icumi, arwaye guhitwa. Namusuzumye nsanga arituma inshuro zirenze enye ku munsi. Namuhaye zenke na osiro, nkomeza kumusuzuma mbona afite ibisebe mu kanwa. Twamufasha gute?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: murakoze kwakira uwo mwana -ari guhtwa cyane kandi afite ibisebe mukanwa,mukorere na TDR nusanga ari positifu umuhe imiti uko bisanzwe -baza nyina niba afata mebendazole uko bigenywa ningengabihe,nusanga ntabyo afata ubimuhe -reba ko yacitse intege cyane nusanga aribyo mwohereze kwa muganga bamufashe -ibyo bisebe bituma atarya,atanywa ,ababara?niba ari yego nimumujyane kwa muganga kuko aramutse atinjiza kandi ari guhitwa cyane yamererwa nabi kurushaho -gira inama umuryango kukwirinda imirire mibi,malaria,nizindi ndwara -namazra iminsi 2 ntagihinduka mujyane kwa muganga bamufashe -amwoze mukanwa akoresheje amazi ariko akunyu
question_english: A two-year-old boy, weighing 10 kilograms, was brought by his mother, suffering from diarrhea. I examined him and found that he defecates more than four times a day. I administered zinc and oral rehydration solution (ORS). Upon further examination, I noticed that he has sores in his mouth. How can we assist him?

question_kinyarwanda: Umugabo w'imyaka mirongo itandatu n'ibiri. Ibiro mirongo itanu n'umunani, yataye ubwenge ari kubabara umutwe, yacitse intege, ari guhumeka insigane, ari kureba ibikezikezi, nta burwayi yari asanganwe. Namubajije igihe ibyo bimenyetso abimaranye, ambwira ko abimaranye igihe kirekire, ko byagiye bitangira buke buke ariko uko iminsi igenda, bikagenda birushaho kwiyongera. Namugiriye inama yo kujya ku kigo nderabuzima ngo asuzumwe, apimwe, arebe ko yaba arwaye umuvuduko w'amaraso, arabyanga. Nabazaga ngo mungire inama y'icyo namukorera?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Mubaze niba afite indwara zidakira azwiho kandi mumugire inama yo gushaka inama kwa muganga kuko bishobora kuba ikibazo gikomeye cy’ubuzima nko kugira umuvuduko ukabije w’amaraso cyangwa diyabete...
question_english: A sixty-two-year-old man weighs fifty-eight kilograms and has lost consciousness while experiencing a headache. He has become weak, has been breathing heavily, and has been seeing blurry, with no prior medical conditions. I have asked him how long he has been experiencing these symptoms, and he has told me he has been dealing with them for a long time; they started gradually but have worsened over time. I have advised him to go to a health center for an examination and to check if he might have high blood pressure, but he has refused. I am asking for advice on what I should do for him?

question_kinyarwanda: Umukobwa w'imyaka makumyabiri nine, ibiro mirongo itandatu. Umuriro wa mirongo itatu na gatandatu. Aje afite ikibazo cyo gukora imibonano mpuzabitsina idakingiye, abimaranye iminsi itatu. Mubwiye ingaruka zirimo kwandura indwara nka SIDA, imitezi, mburugu no gusama inda atateganije. None kwifata byanze byamunaniye ni iki nakora kugira ngo mufashe mbere yo kumwohereza ku kigo gishinzwe urubyiruko ku bijyanye n'imyororokere?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze -Muhe undi mwanya muganire akubwire impamvu ze umwumve umufashe -Ese abikorana n'abantu benshi? Niba ari yego musabe ko yajya abasaba gukoresha agakingirizo mugihe kwifata bimunaniye. -Niba ari umwe bose bashyire hamwe ubaganirize niba biri bukunde. -Mubwire ibibi byabyo byose nk'ibyo wavuze harimo n'inda zitateguwe. -Ganiriza urubyiruko rwose rwaho kandi mukore ubukangurambaga bwimbitse.
question_english: A twenty-nine-year-old woman weighing sixty kilograms has a temperature of thirty-six degrees. She has come with a concern about having unprotected sexual intercourse, which she has been experiencing for three days. I have informed her of the risks, including contracting diseases such as HIV, gonorrhea, syphilis, and unintended pregnancy. Now that she has not been able to abstain, what can I do to help her before referring her to a youth center specializing in reproductive health?

question_kinyarwanda: umubyeyi w'imyaka mirongo ine n'ibiri, afite ubumuga bwo mu mutwe, afite umwana ufite amezi ane yamutaye mu nzira, kandi bakuru be bariga. Umwana turi kumwe mu nzira none nyina ari kumwanga. Ndamufasha iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Iki ni ikibazo gikomeye kandi gifite ingaruka ku buzima bw'umwana n'umubyeyi. Umubyeyi ufite ubumuga bwo mu mutwe, yataye umwana w'amezi ane mu nzira. Birasaba gufasha byihutirwa kugira ngo ubuzima bwabo bwiza butangire kubaho neza. Muri iki gihe, uri kumufasha gukora akazi keza mu gufasha uwo mwana. Dore zimwe mu nama nakugira: Gufata umwana mu maguru mashya, kujyana umwana n'umubyeyi kwa muganga, kugira uruhare mu gusubiza umwana ku muryango, ibiganiro n'abashinzwe kurengera uburenganzira bw'umwana no kuba hafi y'umubyeyi kubera ko umubyeyi afite ubumuga bwo mu mutwe. Ikindi wakora, ni ukugira neza ku mwana ukamwitaho kandi ugakora ibishoboka byose kugira ngo abone ubufasha bw’ibanze. Niba ubona ko byaba ngombwa ko umubyeyi asaba ubufasha mu buryo bwihariye, ashobora kwitabaza abashinzwe uburenganzira bw’umwana cyangwa imiryango ikabafasha.
question_english: A 42-year-old parent, who has a mental disability, has a four-month-old child and she has abandoned him on the road, and his older siblings are at school. The child is with me on the road, and now the mother is rejecting him. How can I help the child?

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'umukobwa w'imyaka itanu ufite ibiro makumyabiri na bine. Umubyeyi we ambwiye ko afite umuriro n'inkorora. Mubajije niba hari ubundi burwayi yari asanzwe afite ambwira ko ari ntabwo, mubajije igihe yafatiwe ambwira ko umuriro afite n'inkorora birenze iminsi cumi n'itandatu ariko kandi mukuru w'uwo mwana yigeze arwara igituntu. Mubwiye ko yihangana agakomera ko umwana azakira akamera neza. Muhaye taransiferi, nabazaga, ese hari ubundi bufasha naha uyu mwana?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Tanga paracetamol, wirinde guhura n'abandi bantu, muhe transiferi kandi uhumurize umuryango.
question_english: A five-year-old girl weighing 24 kilograms was brought by her parent, who reported that she has a fever and a cough. When I asked if she had any previous illnesses, the parent said no. I also asked how long she had been sick, and the parent said the fever and cough had lasted more than 16 days. However, the girl's older sibling had a history of tuberculosis. I reassured the parent that the child would recover and feel better. I gave a referral, but I am asking if there is any additional assistance I could provide to this child.

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umwana w'umuhungu w'imyaka icyenda, yari ari kuzamuka kuri sima aranyerera yikubita hasi ukuguru kurakomereka. Nabazaga muganga ni iki nafasha uwo mwana kugira abone imiti?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: urakoze kubaza ikibazo cy'umwana w'umuhungu w'imyaka icyenda wari arimo kuzamuka kuri sima akanyeyerera akikubita hasi akaguru kagakomereka none wabazaga icyo wamufasha uyu mwana yagize impanuka itunguranye kuba yikubise hasi agakomereka akaguru urareba neza aho yakomeretse nubona arimo kuva amaraso menshi ushake ukuntu wifashisha umwenda uhazirike hegerane ku buryo adakomeza kuva ubundi umufashe kugera kwa muganga kugirango ahabwe ubufasha bw'ibanze kandi bukwiye kuko iyo umuntu akomeretse ashobora gutakaza amaraso menshi ku buryo bishobora gutuma aremba akaba yatakaza n'ubwenge ariko iyo umufashije ku buryo atava amaraso menshi ukamugeza kwa muganga bareba ahakomeretse bakahadoda udutsi tuva bakadufunga ku buryo ahita ahabwa ubufasha agahabwa n'imiti yo kumugabanyiriza ububabare n'indi yo kumurinda kuba yagira infection aho yakomeretse uyu mwana rero mufashe agere kwa muganga urakoze
question_english: I received a 9-year-old boy who was climbing on cement and fell, injuring his leg. I am asking the doctor what I can do to help this child get medication.

question_kinyarwanda: Mwaramutse umubyeyi anzaniye umwana w'umukobwa ufite amezi atandatu abwiye ko arwaye impiswi mubajije inshuro yituma ku munsi ambwira ko ari eshatu muhaye asilo muha na zenke,mubaza niba ntabundi burwayi asanzwe agira mbere kandi ntabwo none umurwayi namufashe iki murakoze?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'umukobwa w'amezi 6 ufite impiswi, yituma inshuro eshatu ku munsi, wamuhaye umunyu wongerera umubiri amazi (ORS) na zinc. Nta bundi burwayi afite. Byiza, wakoze neza kumuha ORS na zinc, ugomba kwemeza ko anywa ORS kandi wigishe nyina uko ayimuha hamwe n'ibindi binyobwa byiyongera kuri ORS kugira ngo wirinde umwuma.  Ku bijyanye na zinc sulfate, ugomba kumwandikira 20 mg ku munsi nibura mu minsi 10 (zinc ifasha kugabanya ubukana n'ubusubiramo bw'impiswi) kandi ugomba gukurikirana uko ameze, niba nta mpinduka zigaragara, ugomba kumwohereza kwa muganga kugira ngo avurwe neza.
question_english: Good morning, a parent has brought me a 6-month-old baby girl, reporting that she has had diarrhea. When I have asked how many times she defecates in a day, the parent has said three times. I have given her Oral rehydration Salts and zinc. I have also asked if she has any other pre-existing conditions, and the parent has said no. What can I do that patient? Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Umubyeyi ufite umwana w'umuhungu w'imyaka itatu n'igice yaje angana ambwira ko umwana we afite umuriro ukabije amaranye iminsi ibiri. Mufata tederi i iba negatitifu. Mubajije ikindi kibazo yaba afite ambwira ko abona agenda ata ibiro bidasanzwe. Mwohereza kwa muganga. Nabazaga niba hari ubundi bufasha nari kumuha.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Wakoze kumwohereza ku kigo nderabuzima, kubera ko ikimenyetso cy'umuriro ari ikimenyetso cy'indwara nyinshi, biratuma babasha kumufatira ibindi bizamini, barebe niba nta yindi ndwara arwaye.
question_english: A parent with a three-and-a-half-year-old son came to me saying that her child has had a high fever for two days. I took a rapid test, and it was negative. When I asked if there were any other issues, she told me that she noticed he was losing weight unusually. I referred her to the hospital. I was asking if there was any other help I could provide.

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'umuhungu w'imyaka umunani. ibiro ni cumi nabibitandatu. Aje afite umuriro mwinshi. Mupimye umuriro nsanga ni mirongo itatu n'icyenda, mupimye malariya nsanga ntayo afite.Mubabajije niba nta bundi burwayi asanganywe ambwira ko ntabwo. Namuhaye ubuhe bufasha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Ni byiza kuba mubajije kino kibazo cy'uyu mwana w'umuhungu w'imyaka umunani, ibiro cumi na bitandatu, waje afite umuriro mwinshi, umupimye umuriro usanga ni mirongo itatu n'icyenda, umupimye malariya usanga ntayo afite, umubajije niba ntabundi burwayi asanganywe akubwira ko ntabwo, ukaba ubaza ubufasha wamuha. Mwakoze kwakira uyu mwana w'umuhungu w'imyaka umunani, waje afite umuriro mwinshi, kandi wamupima ugasanga nta malariya afite, kandi tuzi neza ko umuriro ari ikimenyetso kigaragaza indwara nyinshi harimo na malariya, kandi tuzi neza ko iyo umuntu afite umuriro agakorerwa tederi ikaba negatifu, aba agomba guhabwa taransiferi n'umujyanama w'ubuzima wamupimye, akoherezwa ku kigo Nderabuzima kimwegereye, bagasuzuma ubundi burwayi yaba afite, kandi agahabwa imiti igabanya umuriro nka paracetamol, kuko iyo umuriro ubaye mwinshi wangiza udutsi tujyana amaraso mu bwonko, akaba yagira ikindi ikibazo nko gutakaza ubwenge, kugagara n'ibindi. Niyo mpamvu iyo hari umwenda ubasha gufata amazi akonje ariko atavuye muri firigo nk'isume, urayitosa, ukayimushyira mu mutwe ukageza ku ijosi ahagana mu gituza kugira ngo ubushyuhe bw'umubiri busubire ku ikigero kiza. Mukwiye guhita mumuha taransiferi akagana ivuriro rimwegereye. Murakoze
question_english: An eight-year-old boy weighs sixteen kilograms. He came in with a high fever. I measured his temperature and found it to be thirty-nine degrees Celsius, and I tested for malaria, which came back negative. When I asked if he had any other illnesses, he said no. What assistance should I provide him?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umudamu w'imyaka mirongo itanu n'ibiri, afite ibiro mirongo ine na bitandatu, aje afite umuriro, namukoreye tederi (TDR) iba negatif. Mwamfasha iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Uyu ni umugore w'imyaka 52 ufite ibiro 46, ufite umuriro kandi tederi ye ni negative. Uwo murwayi ashobora kuba afite Malariya kuko turi mu gace karangwamo iyo ndwara, cyangwa indi ndwara y'ubwandu nko kwandura mu nzira y’inkari, umuriro wa typhoide. Icyo tugomba gukora bwa mbere ni ukumwohereza ku bitaro kugira ngo akorerwe ibizamini birambuye nyuma yo kumwandikira imiti igabanya umuriro (paracetamol 1g Po cyangwa IR). Ku bitaro, ikizamini cya malariya kizongera gukorwa kimwe n'ibindi bizamini bya laboratwari nko gupima inkari, FBC, gupima amase. Niba usanze afite malariya, azahita atangira gufata coartem r tabs BID iminsi 3, kimwe na paracetamol 1g inshuro eshatu ku munsi ku muriro, azigishwa uburyo bwo kwirinda malariya. Niba asanze afite indi ndwara y'ubwandu nko kwandura mu nzira y’inkari, azavurwa akoresheje antibiyotike zinyobwa nka metronidazole 500mg inshuro eshatu ku munsi mu minsi 7 cyangwa nitrofurantoin, kandi izindi ndwara zizavurwa hakurikijwe ibisubizo byavuye mu isuzumwa.
question_english: I received a 52-year-old woman, she weighs forty-six kilograms, she came with a fever, i performed TDR for her and it resulted negative. What can you help me?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umurwayi ufite imyaka makumyabiri n'umwe, ni umuhungu afite ibiro mirongo itanu n'icyenda. Yaje avuga ko afite umuriro, acitse intege. Mufashe umuriro nsanga afite mirongo itatu n'umunani. Mufashe tederi iba positifu muvura malariya. Coartem gatandatu kane, ibinini makumya na bine agafata ibinini bine kabiri ku munsi. None uyu murwayi hari undi bufasha bundi namuha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umurwayi ufite umuriro ndetse akaba afite ibiro bike (50 na magana akenda) aba afite ikibazo gikomeye mu gihe arwaye malariya. Nubwo yatangiye gufata imiti ya malariya (Coartem), hari ubufasha wamuha bw'ingenzi: Gukomeza gufata imiti neza: Ni ingenzi ko akomeza gufata imiti ya kwariteme nk’uko yabitegetswe (kuyifata neza kandi mu gihe cyagenwe). Agomba gukomeza gufata ibinini bine kabiri ku munsi kugeza igihe imiti izarangirira. Ntagomba gusiba cyangwa guhagarika imiti nubwo yaba yumva yorohewe, mpaka imiti ya malariya ayimaze Kwita ku mirire ni ingenzi, cyane cyane niba afite ibiro bike. Ni ingenzi gufungura cg se gufata ibiryo byoroshye ariko bikungahaye ku ntungamubiri (nk'amagi, umuceri, ibishyimbo, inyama zoroshye, imbuto, n'imboga) kugira ngo bimufashe kugira imbaraga zo gukomeza urugendo rwo gukira. Ku bantu bafite malariya, kwita ku mirire ni ingenzi kuko bashobora gutakaza intungamubiri cg bakajya mu mirire mibi. Kunywa amazi menshi ni ingirakamaro mu rwego rwo kwirinda ko yagira umwuma, cyane cyane igihe afite umuriro. Kunya amazi cyangwa esiro, bizamufasha kugarura ibyangiritse mu mubiri. Gukurikirana neza ibipimo by'umuriro: Buri gihe uge ukurikirana umuriro we. Niba umuriro utagabanuka cyangwa ukiyongera, ni byiza ko wahita umujyana kwa muganga cyangwa mu bitaro kugira ngo basuzume niba hari impinduka umubiri we wagize, ndetse barebe niba imiti iri gukora neza. Kuruhuka n'ingenzi: Umurwayi akwiye kuruhuka bihagije kugira ngo umubiri we ushobore kurwanya indwara neza. Ibi bizamufasha cyane ndetse bitume agarura imbaraga. Mu gihe acitse intege cg se agatakaza imbaraga, ni ngombwa ko ugisha muganga inama y'icyo wakora.
question_english: I've received a twenty-one years old patient boy, weighing fifty-nine kilograms. He has come saying he has had a fever and she's been feeling weak. I've taken his temperature and found it to be thirty-eight. I've conducted a rapid test, and it was positive and she's been treated for malaria. Coartem six-four, twenty-four tablets, taking four tablets twice a day. Now, is there any other assistance I can provide to this patient?

question_kinyarwanda: Muraho. Nasuye ingo nshinzwe nsangayo umugore w'imyaka mirongo itatu n'irindwi ufite ibiro mirongo itandatu n'umunani. Nsanga ari kota akazuba. Mubajije ambwira ko yacitse intege ari kuribwa mu ngingo zose, ambwira ko ari kubabara n'umutwe. Mubajije ko nta burwayi asanganywe, ambwira ko ntabwo. Mupimye umuriro, nsanga afite mirongo itatu n'icyenda temperaca. Mupimye malariya nsanga afite malariya. Mfite imiti sisi fuwa katire. Muhaye imiti arayanga ngo yivuzaga ibinyarwanda. Nababazaga niba hari ubundi bufasha naha uyu mugore?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugore w'imyaka mirongo itatu n'irindwi ufite ibiro mirongo itandatu n'umunani,yacitse intege ari kuribwa mu ngingo zose, ari kubabara n'umutwe, nta burwayi asanganywe,umuriro afite mirongo itatu n'icyenda temperaca. Malariya yabaye positifu, yanze kunywa imiti imiti kubera ko yivuzaga ibinyarwanda. Uyu mubyeyi uramusobanurira ko malariya ari indwara ikomeye kandi yica mu gihe gito ariko ko iyo umuntu avuriwe igihe kandi akanywa imiti yo kwa muganga neza akira vuba. Uramubwira ko malariya itavurwa n'imiti y'ibinyarwanda ahubwo ko iyo miti igira zimwe mu ngaruka mbi nko kwangiza umwijima. Uramugira inama yuko akeneye ubuvuzi bwihuse kandi ko nanywa coartem aramera neza. Umugire inama yo kugera ku ivuriro kugira ngo aganirizwe birushijeho ndetse akorerwe n'ibindi bizamini barebe ko gukoresha imiti y'ikinyarwanda cyane nta bundi burwayi byamuteye.
question_english: Hello. I have visited the households I am responsible for and found a thirty-seven-year-old woman weighing sixty-eight kilograms sitting in the sun. When I asked her, she told me she has been feeling weak and experiencing pain in all her joints, and she also mentioned having a headache. When I asked if she has any pre-existing conditions, she said no. I measured her temperature and found it to be thirty-nine degrees. I tested her for malaria and found that she has malaria. I have Coartem medication, but she has refused it, saying she prefers traditional remedies. I am asking if there is any other assistance I can provide to this woman?

question_kinyarwanda: Umukobwa w'imyakamyabiri afite ibiro mirongo ine na birindwi, yaje ambwira ko arya akaruka kandi afite isereri n'iseseme nyinshi. Mupimye tederi mbura malariya ariko ahita ambwira ko yanyweye coartem hashize iminsi itatu azinyweye ariko akaba atari koroherwa ariyo mpamvu yaraje. Mubaza ko hari indi miti yafashe ambwira ko ntayo. Twamufasha iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umukobwa w'imyaka 20 afite ibiro mirongo ine na birindwi, yaje ambwira ko arya akaruka kandi afite isereri n'iseseme nyinshi. TDR negatif ngo yafashe coarteme Mubaze niba mbere yogufata coartem bari bamupimye Mubaze niba umutwe umurya no gucika intege Niba aheruka gukora imibonano Umupime n'inda kuko ari mu kigero cy'uburumbuke Muhe ORS na zenke Abaye agarutse nyuma y'iminsi 3 uzongere usubiremo TDR
question_english: A twenty-year-old girl, weighing forty-seven kilograms, came to me saying that she eats and then vomits, and she also has dizziness and severe nausea. I tested her for malaria, but the result was negative. She then told me that she had taken Coartem three days ago but hadn't felt any better, which is why she came. I asked if she had taken any other medication, and she said no. How can we help her?

question_kinyarwanda: Mwaramutse umuntu anzaniye umwana w'umukobwa ufite imyaka cumi n'itanu, ambwira kori guhinda umuriro. Mufashe igipimo nsanga ari gupima mirongo itatu n'umunani n'ibice bitanu, mufashe tederi iba positifu, mubajije niba nta bundi burwayi asanzwe agira ambwiye ko asanzwe arwara igicuri. Muha ibinini bya sisi fuwa turuwa, musobanurira uburyo agomba kuzajya abiha umurwayi. None umurwayi namufasha iki? Murakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Mwaramutse neza ni byiza ko wahaye umwana ubufasha warufite ikibazo cyo kugira umuriro wa38.5 mugihe wafashe tdr ugasanga yabaye positifu ndetse akaba yahawe umuti wa malariya 6x4( Coartem),ukaba wamuhaye amabwiriza y'uko afata uwo muti kuko rero azanzwe afite indwara y'igicuri ni ngombwa gukomeza imiti y'ubwo burwayi gusa aramutse agize ibindi bibazo n'ingenzi kugana abaganga bakamufasha bamusuzuma. Murakoze.
question_english: Good morning, someone brought me a 15-year-old girl who was reported to have a fever. I took her temperature, and it was 38.5°C. I performed a malaria test, and the result was positive. When I asked if she had any pre-existing conditions, she mentioned that she has epilepsy. I gave her antimalarial tablets and explained how she should take the medication. How else can I assist this patient? Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Nasuye umubyeyi umaze iminsi itatu abyaye, yabuze amashereka kandi ngo ari kubabara imoko. Ndamufasha iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Turabashimira ubwitange mugira mu kwita ku barwayi. Icyo wafasha uwo mubyeyi ni ukumwigishe uko bonsa umwana neza, amushyira ku ibere inshuro nyinshi kuko bitumpa amashereka yiyongera. Umugire n'inama yo kurya imboga, urugero nk'isombe anywe n'igikoma. Nakomeza kuyabura ari no kubabara bikabije ajye ku kigo nderabuzima bamufashe.
question_english: I visited a mother who gave birth three days ago. She is experiencing a lack of breast milk and says she is having pain in her nipples. How can I assist her?

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'umuhungu ufite imyaka itanu ;afite ibiro cumi na bitanu; afite ikibazo cyo kuribwa mu nda cyane; yagagaye; yacitse intege; arituma inshuro imwe ku munsi. Namubajije ubundi burwayi asanganywe ambwira ko ari ntabwo. Namuhaye taransiferi ngo ajye kwa muganga. Mwamfasha iki ku bujyanama naha uyu murwayi.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umurwayi ashobora kuba afite indwara ziterwa n'udukoko twibasira amara, uburwayi bw'umuyoboro w'inkari cyangwa kwituma bikomeye. Ushobora kumuha umuti woroheje w'igabanya ububabare nka paracetamol (igice cy'ikinini) hanyuma ukamujyana ku kigo nderabuzima cya hafi kugira ngo akomeze kwitabwaho.
question_english: A five-year-old boy weighs fifteen kilograms and is experiencing severe abdominal pain; he is paralyzed, weak and defecates once a day. When I asked if he has any other underlying conditions, he said he does not. I gave him a referral to go to the hospital. What additional advice can I provide for this patient?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umwana w'umukobwa ufite imyaka makumyabiri, afite ibiro mirongo itaratu na bibiri. Ari kuva cyane amaze ibyumweru bibibiri. Afite agapira k'imyaka itatu nta bundi burwayi afite, musuzumye nsanga ari kwereruka ibiganza no mu maso, mugira inama yo kurya imboga n'imbuto. Nonone mwangira iyihe nama?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Mwakoze kwakira uwo mukobwa uri kuva, yerurutse kandi aringaniza urubyaro IBISHOBOKA AFITE -Ingaruka z'agapira -Inda iri kuvamo -Ubundi burwayi IBYO TWAKORA -Mumpime inda -Najye kwa muganga bamufashe bamupime amaraso kuko afite ibimenyetso mpuruza ko afite amaraso macye nibiba ngombwa yongererwe -Mirashoboka ko nako gapira bakamukuramo bakamuha ubundi buryo -Mube hafi umukurikirane.
question_english: I've received a 20-year-old girl weighing 62 kilograms. She has been experiencing heavy bleeding for two weeks. She has a three-year contraceptive implant and no other illnesses. Upon examination, I've found her to be pale in her hands and face, and I've advised her to eat vegetables and fruits. What advice would you give?

question_kinyarwanda: Umugabo w'imyaka mirongo icyenda, ibiro mirongo itanu, arwaye amavunja kandi ntagira umwitaho; nta burwayi yari asanganywe. Nagiriye inama abana be yo kumwitaho bakamuhadura; bakamukorera isuku umubiri no ku myambaro no mu rugo hose, kandi bagashaka n'umuntu wamuba hafi akajya amwitaho buri munsi. Abana be barabyanga ngo nta mwanya babibonera. Mungire inama y'icyo nabakorera.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Wakoze cyane kandi ntako utagize. Mumufashe, mubanze mumuhandure izo mvunja, munamukarabye, mumugaburire, mujye aho aba muhakore umuganda muhasukure, mumuhe amazi meza n'ibiryo, abanze yumve ko nawe ameze neza. Itabaze inzego zibanze zigufashe, bafatanye n'abandi babishinzwe, mwegere uwo muryango mubaganirize nabo bababwire imbogamizi n'impamvu badashaka kwita kuri uwo musaza. Mubwire inzego zishinzwe ubuzima nazo zishyireho ubuvugizi.
question_english: A ninety-year-old man weighing fifty kilograms is suffering from jiggers and is not taking care of himself; he has no underlying health conditions. I advised his children to take care of him by cleaning his body, clothes, and the entire house, and to find someone to look after him daily. However, his children refused, saying they don't have time. What should I do in this situation?

question_kinyarwanda: Muraho, umubyeyi yanzaniye umwana w’umuhungu ufite imyaka ibiri, ibiro cumi na bine, ambwira ko ari kubabara mu nda, arimo no guhitwa. Mubajije ko niba nta bundi burwayi asanganwe, ambwiye ko ari ntabwo. Mubwiye ko yihangana ari bumere neza. Muhaye zenke, ibinini bibiri ku munsi mu minsi icumi, sirop ikirahure uko umwana yitumye. Nabazaga nti niba hari ubundi bufasha naha uyu mwana.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'umuhungu w'imyaka ibiri, upima ibiro 14 ufite ububabare mu nda no kuruka. Uyu mwana ashobora kuba afite gastroenteritis ifitanye isano n'umuriro. Icyo wakora. Komeza kumuha zenke 20mg buri munsi hamwe na oresi yongera amazi mu mubiri igikombe kimwe igihe arangije kwituma. Hanyuma amujyane ku bitaro, kugira ngo bapime imyunyu ngugu ye, n'ibindi bipimo bishobora gufatwa.
question_english: Hello, a parent brought me a 2-year-old boy weighing 14 kilograms, who is complaining of abdominal pain and vomiting. I asked if he has any other underlying conditions, and the parent said no. I reassured them that he should improve with time. I gave him two Zinc tablets daily for 10 days and syrup glass as he defecate. Is there any other help I can offer to this child?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umwana w'umuhungu, afite imyaka itanu, uwo mwana umubyeyi we yamuzanye atavuga, ntahaguruka, ntagenda ntarira kandi uwo mwana asanzwe afite ubumuga bwo mu mutwe. Ubwo uwo mwana hari ibindi bizamini yatanga?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze, -Nonaha hamagara ambulance bamujyane kwa muganga kuko akeneye ibizamini byose no guca mu cyuma bakamufasha byihuse
question_english: I received a five-year-old boy, whose mother brought him, he is unable to speak, stand, walk, or cry. The child also has a known intellectual disability. Should this child undergo any other tests?

question_kinyarwanda: Mwaramutse neza, umugabo w'imyaka mirongo ine n'irindwi afite ibiro mirongo irindwi na kimwe. Afite ikibazo aribwa umutwe cyane, akavugishwa, akagwa hasi. Mubajije igihe abimaranye ambwiye ko abimaranye amezi abiri. Mwoje ku kigo nderabuzima ambwira ko atajyayo ntabwisungane mu kwivuza afite. Namufasha iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Mufatire ibimini bitandukanye, umubaze niba afite indwara zidakira hanyuma umugire inama yo gusaba ubufasha kugira ngo abone ubwisungane mu kwivuza kandi ahabwe ubufasha bwa muganga vuba bishoboka. Mushishikarize kujya ashaka ubwishingizi bw'ubuzima buri gihe.
question_english: Good morning, a forty-seven-year-old man weighs seventy-one kilograms. He has a problem of severe headache, talking incoherently, and collapsing. When I've asked how long he has had these symptoms, he's told me it has been two months. When I've suggested going to the health center, he's told me he doesn't go because he doesn't have health insurance. How can I help him?

question_kinyarwanda: umugabo w'imyaka mirongo itanu , mugezeho nsanga yasheshe ibiheri umubiri wose bimeze nk'ubushye. Nkurikiranye amakuru , nsanga ngo yahagaritse imiti igabanya ubukana. Ndamufasha iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Uyumugabo w'imyaka mirongo itanu, mugezeho nsanga yasheshe ibiheri umubiri wose bimeze nk'ubushye. Nkurikiranye amakuru, nsanga ngo yahagaritse imiti igabanya ubukana. Hari icyo uri bumufashe. Uramubaza ibindi bimenyetso nk'umuriro, gucika intege, gukorora no kuruka. Noneho umufate ikizami cy'umusonga, hanyuma umwohereze kwa muganga bajye gupima abasirikare b'umubiri babe bamuha imiti. Ariko umugire inama cyane yo gukomeza ubuvuzi.
question_english: A 50-year-old man came to me with a rash all over his body that looks like burns. Upon further investigation, I found out that he had stopped taking his antiretroviral medication. How can I help him?

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'umukobwa w'imyaka makumyabiri n'itatu wibana. Ampamagaye ambwira ko yumva afite umuriro mwinshi ari kumva,akorora, yagize isesemi , arumva yasuherewe, afite iserere ari guhumekera hejuru ngo n'umutwe uri kumurya. Ngiye musanga mfata ibikoresho by'ubwirinzi birimo agapfukamunwa na ga na terimometere, ngezeyo nsanga abantu benshi bamuhaye akato banze kumwegera, nanjye nanga kumusuzuma mbanza kureba ibimenyetso yaba afite ngo menye niba atari icyorezo cyamuteye. ese namukorera iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugore w'imyaka 23 uba wenyine, yampamagaye ambwira ko afite umuriro mwinshi, inkorora, isesemi, isereri, guhumeka bigoranye n'umutwe. Murakoze ku kazi mwakoze. Fata umwanya, ukore ikizamini cya SIDA, ukore ikizamini cy'uburumbuke, hanyuma wiyiteho. Hamagara imbangukiragutabara ujye kwa muganga, kugira ngo bapime ibipimo by'uburwayi bwo mu bihaha n'amaraso. Birashoboka gutangira gukoresha imiti yica udukoko twanduza.
question_english: A 23-year-old woman who lives alone called me, reporting that she had a high fever, coughing, nausea, dizziness, shortness of breath, and a headache. When I arrived, I put on protective equipment, including a face mask and gloves, before approaching her. Upon arrival, I found that many people had distanced themselves from her, refusing to go near her. I also hesitated to examine her at first, wanting to assess whether she might have an infectious disease. What should I do for her ?

question_kinyarwanda: Umubyeyi wo mudugudu wa gahondo, yanzaniye umwana ufite amezi mirongo itatu, apima ibiro cumi na bine, muac ya cumi na kane n'igice. Yaje ahumeka nabi, ataka cyane ndetse anakorora. Mufatiye umuriro nsanga afite mirongo itatu n'umunani. Mfashe tederi iba positive. Mbajije mama we ambwira yuko umwana yavukanye ikibazo cy'umutima kandi njye mfite amogisi. Muhaye taransiferi. Mumfashe, uyu mwana hari indi miti nari kumuha kandi afite ikindi kibazo?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umubyeyi yazanye umwana w’amezi 30 ufite ibiro 14, miwake ya 14.5cm, afite ikibazo cyo guhumeka, ararira kandi arakorora, afite umuriro wa 38°C kandi basuzumye malariya basanga ayirwaye, kandi nyina avuga ko umwana yavukanye ikibazo cy’umutima. • Uyu mwana agomba koherezwa byihutirwa ku bitaro kugira ngo avurwe neza malariya kandi nta nzitizi zo kuvura malariya ku bafite ibibazo by’umutima. Kuko uyu mwana afite ibimenyetso bya malariya ikomeye, nko guhumeka bigoranye, agomba koherezwa ku bitaro byihutirwa kugira ngo avurwe malariya ikomeye, avurwe umwuma ushobora guterwa n’umuriro mwinshi kandi avurwe umuriro hakoresheje paracetamol ya IV.
question_english: A parent from Gahondo village brought me a 30-month-old child weighing 14 kilograms, with a MUAC of 14.5 cm. The child came breathing with difficulty, crying a lot, and coughing. When I measured the temperature, it was 38°C. I performed a malaria test, and it was positive. When I asked the mother, she told me that the child was born with a heart condition, and I have amoxicillin. I gave a referral. Please help me: is there any other medication I could have given the child, when the child has another problem?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiye umwana w'umuhungu w'imyaka itatu, ibiro icyenda, yaje ababara mu nda, ari kwigorora. Namwohereje kwa muganga. Nyuma y'iminsi ine musuye nsanga aracyarwaye. Mukorere iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Uyu mwana w'imyaka itatu aracyarwaye nyuma y'iminsi ine, ndetse akaba akigaragaza ibimenyetso by'uburibwe, kwigorora, no kuba atorohewe, hari ikibazo kiri mu mubiri gikomeye cyane kandi gikeneye ubufasha bwihariye.mubyukuri rero icy'ingenzi wakora nukwegera muganga w'inzobere cyane cyane w'abana mugihe bashobora gukora ibizamini bagapima bakamenya impamvu y'uburwayi ndetse ndetse n'uburyo bwo kuvurwa. Ibimenyetso by'uburibwe bukabije, kwigorora, cyangwa kubura imbaraga bishobora guteza ikindi kibazo ni ngombwa kwihutira kumujyana kwa muganga kugirango uhabwe inama za muganga.
question_english: I received a three-year-old boy weighing 9 kg, who came in with abdominal pain and was writhing. I transferred him to the hospital. After four days, I visited him and found that he is still unwell. What should I do for him?

question_kinyarwanda: Umukobwa w'imyaka cumi nitanu yaje amubwira ko yahohotewe kandi agafatwa ku ngufu , adashobora kubibwira iwabo. Yavuye mu ishuri , ntasabana n'abandi ahora arira yigunze yataye ibiro byinshi. Namugiriye inama yo kujya kwa muganga. None mwamufasha iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umwana w’imyaka 15 yarahohotewe afatwa ku ngufu, ariko atinya kubibwira iwabo. Ubu ahora yigunze ndetse yataye ishuri. Icya mbere ni ukumuganiriza umwumvisha ko atari wenyine kandi ko afite uburenganzira bwo kwitabwaho. Uwo wamuhohoteye agomba kubiryozwa nk’uko amategeko abiteganya. Ugomba kumugira inama yo kujya kwa muganga hakorwa ibizamini kugira ngo barebe niba nta ndwara zandurira mu mibonano mpuzabitsina yaba yaranduye cyangwa niba ataratewe inda atateguye. Ibi bizatuma ahabwa ubufasha bukwiye bijyanye n’ibisubizo bizaboneka. Niba agaragaza ibimenyetso by’ihungabana, ni ngombwa guhita uhamagara abaganga b’inzobere mu by’imitekerereze bamuganirize kandi bamugire inama. Ugomba no kumufasha gusobanurira ababyeyi ikibazo yahuye na cyo, n’uburyo bashobora kumufasha mu gukomeza gukurikirana iki kibazo, kugira ngo atarushaho guhungabana. Niba ihohoterwa rimaze igihe gito, agomba guhabwa imiti ikumira gusama ndetse n’iyagenewe gukumira ibyago byo kwandura virusi itera SIDA (Post-Exposure Prophylaxis – PEP).
question_english: A 15-year-old girl told me she was assaulted and raped, and she can't tell her family. She dropped out of school, doesn't socialize with others, and is always crying and depressed. She has lost a lot of weight. I advised her to see a doctor. How can I help her?

question_kinyarwanda: Nasuye umugore w'imyaka mirongo itatu ufite ibiro mirongo itandatu n'umunani, yari yabyaye ari kumunsi wa gatatu, mwigisha ibimenyetso mpuruza. Nsanga ari kuribwa mu nda, yarasanganywe uburwayi bwa diyabete. Mugira inama yo kujya kwa muganga yanyeretse inzoga yo mu bwoko bw'amarikeli ambwira ko aribwo yinywera ko imuvura munda. Ni iki namubwira?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Uwo mubyeyi ni ukumugira inama yo guhagarika kunywa iyo nzoga kuko yamuteza ibibazo, ahubwo akihutira kujya kwa muganga kugira ngo ahabwe ubufasha. Inzoga si nziza ku muntu ufite ubwo burwayi, yewe no ku mubyeyi wabyaye kuko aba akeneye kunywa ibikoma kugira ngo abashe kubona n'amashereka yo Konsa umwana.
question_english: I visited a thirty-year-old woman weighing sixty-eight kilograms, who had given birth three days ago, teaching her warning signs. I found her experiencing abdominal pain, and she had a history of diabetes. I advised her to go to the doctor, but she showed me a type of local alcohol called "Amarikeli," telling me that it is what she drinks to relieve her abdominal pain. What should I tell her?

question_kinyarwanda: Mwiriwe neza! Umugore w imyakayaka mirongo ine n'irindwi afite ibiro mirongo itandatu na bitatu; aboneza urubyaro akoresheje urushinge; aje ambwira ko ahorana ubukonje,agahora afite isereri, akaribwa n'umutwe. Mubajije igihe abimaranye ambwira ko abimaranye iminsi irindwi. Muhaye taransferi ngo age kukigo nderabuzima yanga kujyayo ngo nta bwisungane mu kwivuza afite. Ubwo namufashe iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umurwayi w'umugore w'imyaka 40 ufite ibiro 63, yaje afite umutwe, isereri no kumva akonje mu gihe cy'iminsi irindwi nyuma yo gukoresha depo-provera. Ubuvuzi bw'ibanze yakorerwa ni ugupima umuriro no gukora tederi kugira ngo harebwe niba nta malaria arwaye. Niba nta muriro cyangwa malaria, ahabwe paracetamol yo kugabanya umutwe kandi asobanurirwe ko imwe mu ngaruka z'inkingo z'uburumbuke ari umutwe, imihango idasanzwe, guhinduka kw'imyitwarire no kongera ibiro. Bityo, ibi bishobora kuba ari ingaruka ariko kugira ngo bimenyekane neza, agomba kujya kwa muganga kugira ngo harebwe niba nta zindi mpamvu z'uburwayi zishobora gutera ibyo bimenyetso. Kwa muganga, barakora ibizamini bitandukanye kugira ngo bakore iperereza ryimbitse, niba nta zindi mpamvu z'uburwayi ariko afite ibimenyetso bikomeye, bashobora guhindura uburyo bw'inkingo bakamuhitishamo ubundi buryo nyuma yo gusobanurirwa uburyo bwose.
question_english: Good afternoon! A woman who is forty-seven years old and weighs sixty-three kilograms, she is using a contraceptive injection. She came to me saying she always feels cold, dizziness, and headache. When I asked how long she has been experiencing those symptoms, she said that she has been experiencing those symptoms for seven days. When I gave her a referral to go to the health center, she refused to go because she doesn't have health insurance. What can I do to help her?

question_kinyarwanda: Nasuye umugore utwite ku nshuro ya mbere, umugore ufite mu myaka makumya n’itanu, ufite ibiro mirongo itandatu na kimwe. Mwigisha ibimenyetso mpuruza, mwigisha indyo yuzuye musobanurira akamaro ko kurya ibinini bya feri. Mubwira ko byongera amaraso no kuyakomeza. Ambwira ko amaraso atayabura kubera arya imbuto ngo ibinini bya feri sigombwa. Ni iki nakora?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Nasuye umugore utwite bwa mbere ufite imyaka makumyabiri n’itanu kandi upima ibiro mirongo itandatu n’imwe. Namwigishije ibimenyetso byo kwitondera mu gihe cyo gutwita, ifunguro ryuzuye, kandi musobanurira akamaro ko gufata ibinini byongera amaraso. Namubwiye ko ibi binini bifasha kongera no gukomeza amaraso. Yansubije ko adakeneye ibinini byongera amaraso kuko arya imbuto. Nakora iki? Mwigishe ko abagore batwite bafite ibyago byo kubura maraso afashe kubera kugabanuka kw’amaraso mu gihe cyo gutwita, umugire inama yo gukomeza kurya imbuto kandi umugire inama yo kujya kwa muganga gupimisha ikigero cy’amaraso (hemoglobin) kugira ngo harebwe niba akeneye ibinini byongera amaraso.
question_english: I visited a first-time pregnant woman who is twenty-five years old and weighs sixty-one kilograms. I taught her about warning signs during, Balanced diet, and explained the importance of taking iron supplements. I told her that these iron supplements help increase and strengthen blood. She responded that she doesn't need iron supplements because she eats fruits. What should I do?

question_kinyarwanda: Umugore w'imyaka mirongo itatu n'itanu ufite ibiro mirongo itanu. Anywa ibiyobyabwenge amaze umwaka umwe abinywa. Asigaye asakuza mu mudugudu agenda yivugisha mu muhanda, agira isereri akitura hasi, ababara umutwe cyane. Namugiriye inama yo kureka ibiyobyabwenge arananira, ambwira ko ari byo bimutungiye abana. Nabazaga niba hari ubundi buvuzi mwamuha.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Urakoze kubaza ikibazo cy'umugore w'imyaka mirongo itatu n'itanu unywa ibiyobyabwenge, avuga ko amaze umwaka abinywa, asigaye asakuza cyane mu mudugudu akagenda yivugisha, akagira isereri akanitura hasi, ababara umutwe cyane, wamugiriye inama yo kureka ibiyobyabwenge aranga, akubwira ko ari byo bimutungiye abana. Mu by'ukuri uyu muntu yamaze kubatwa n'ibiyobyabwenge, kuko buriya ibiyobyabwenge nk'inzoga nyinshi n'itabi bibamo icyo nakwita nk'uburozi bwa nicotine, ku buryo umuntu ubinyweye bituma yumva atabireka, ariko kwa muganga haba abaganga bashinzwe ubuzima bwo mu mutwe no kuganiriza abantu nkabo babaswe n'ibiyobyabwenge, baba barabyize ari inzobere muri ibyo bintu ku buryo umuntu wabaswe n'ibiyobyabwenge baramufasha mu buryo bw'ibiganiro, kandi babona ibiganiro nta cyo bitanga, bafite n'imiti bashobora kumuha ku buryo yasubira ku murongo. Ni byiza rero ko wafasha uyu mubyeyi ukamuganiriza ukanamushishikariza kujya ku kigo nderabuzima, kugira ngo abonane n'umuganga ushinzwe ubuzima bwo mu mutwe. Urakoze!
question_english: A thirty-five-year-old woman weighing fifty kilograms has been using drugs for one year. She now shouts in the neighborhood, talks to herself on the road, feels dizzy and falls down, and experiences severe headaches. I advised her to stop using drugs, but she refused, telling me that it helps her raise her children. I am asking if there is any other treatment you could provide for her.

question_kinyarwanda: Umugore ufite imyaka mirongo itanu n‘ibiri, afite ibiro mirongo itaratu n’umunani. Ari kuvugishwa arasakuza cyane, aho twari turi mu biganiro byo kwibuka jenoside yakorewe abatutsi mu 1994. None mushyize ahantu hatuje mumfashe. None ubwo ko mbona afite ikibazo cy'ihungabana, namukorera ubundi buhe bufasha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugore w'imyaka 52 ufite ibiro 38, yavugaga cyane mu biganiro byo kwibuka Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, afite ibibazo by’ihungabana. • Niba koko mwarananiwe kumugarura mu buzima busanzwe, uwo mugore ashobora kuba afite ikibazo cy’uburwayi bwo mu mutwe cyitwa Ihungabana rikabije (PTSD) kibaho ku bantu bahuye n’ibibazo bikomeye by’ihungabana byabaye mu bihe byashize. Kandi nanone, abarwayi benshi bafite PTSD baba bafite n’ibindi bibazo byo mu mutwe nk’indwara y’agahinda gakabije, indwara y’ubwoba, cyangwa indwara ya bipolar, bityo rero akeneye muganga w’indwara zo mu mutwe kugira ngo avurwe neza hakoreshejwe imiti n’ubujyanama.
question_english: A fifty-two-year-old woman, weighing thirty-eight kilograms, has been speaking loudly during our discussions to commemorate the genocide against the Tutsi in 1994. I have taken her to a quiet place. Help me. Since I see she has a trauma issue, what other help can I provide her?

question_kinyarwanda: Umukobwa w'imyaka cumi n’itanu ufite ibiro mirongo ine n’umunani, yari mu mihango ayimazemo iminsi ibiri, kw’ishuri bari muri siporo aza kugira isereri yitura hasi. Baje kumpamagara nakora iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze kubaza iki kibazo. Uyu mukobwa w’imyaka cumi n’itanu ufite ibiro mirongo ine n’umunani yari ari mu mihango, ayimazemo iminsi ibiri. Ku ishuri, ubwo bari muri siporo, yagize isereri yitura hasi maze baguhamagara kugira ngo umenye uko ameze. Mubyukuri, kuba yari ari mu mihango imaze iminsi ibiri si ikibazo gikomeye, ariko kuba yagize isereri akitura hasi ni byo bikwiye kwitabwaho. Ibi bishobora guterwa n’uko nubwo imihango imara hagati y’iminsi ibiri n’irindwi, ashobora kuba yaratakaje amaraso menshi cyane, bikamuviramo ikibazo cyo kubura amaraso (anemia). Kubw’ibyo, uyu mukobwa agomba koherezwa ku kigo nderabuzima kimwegereye kugira ngo asuzumwe hamenyekane icyateye iyo sereri, hanyuma ahabwe ubuvuzi bukwiye. Murakoze.
question_english: A fifteen-year-old girl weighing forty-eight kilograms had her period for two days. While at school during sports, she experienced syncope and fell down. They called me. What should I do when they call me?

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'umuyeshuri w'imyaka cumi nine, yakorewe ihohoterwa n'umunyeshuri bigana ufite imyaka cumi nawe, ariko ikibazo aba afite ni mu rugo bahora bamutoteza ngo asubize inda aho yayikuye. Uwo mwana afite ihohoterwa rikabije cyane, mugira inama y'uko yamenyesha ubuyobozi kugira ngo ajye mu ikibazo cye bamufashe kumuhuza n'ababyeyi. ndagirango mungire inama ikindi nakorersa uwo mwana, kugirango inda atwite azabyare umwana ufite ubuzima bwiza?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze cyane. -Bimenyeshe isange one stop center ikwegereye, abayobozi b'ibanze na police. -Mutange inyigisho kuri uwo muryango, ndetse no mu muryango w'uwo mwana w'umuhungu wamuteye inda. -Igisha iyo miryango yose iteranye maze mushake igisubizo cyiza. -Abo bana bose mubigishe ubuzima bw'imyororkere. -Mubapime indwara zose. -Mwite ku mubyeyi n'umwana atwite.
question_english: A fourteen-year-old student was abused by a fourteen-year-old classmate, but the problem she has is that she is constantly harassed at home, being told to return the pregnancy to where she got it from. The child is severely abused, and I recommend that she informs the authorities so they can address the situation and help connect her with her parents. Please advise me on what else I can do for her, so that she can have a healthy pregnancy and give birth to a healthy baby.

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umwana w'umukobwa ufite imyaka ine, ibiro cumi nabitandatu, muwake cumi na gatandatu, arwaye inkorora n'ibicurane amaze iminsi ibiri afashwe. Musuzuma nkoresheje tayima nsanga ariguhumeka vuba vuba inshuro mirongo ine neshanu ku munota, nsanga arwaye umusonga.Namuha iyihe miti?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Tubashimiye ubwitange mugira mu kwita ku barwayi, n'uko mwakiriye uwo mwana w'umukobwa ufite imyaka ine, ibiro cumi na bitanu, muwake cumi na gatandatu, arwaye inkorora n'ibicurane amaranye iminsi ibiri, yahumekaga inshuro mirongo ine neshanu. Mumuhe utunini twa amoxiciline mirongine azajye afata utunini tune mugitondo, na tune numugoroba igihe cyiminsi itanu. uzasubire kumureba nyuma yiminsi itanu ariko nagira ikibazo kidasanzwe cg iminsi itani igashyira atarakira azaze transfer ajye kubitaro bamufashe byisumbuye.
question_english: I received a four-year-old girl, sixteen kilograms, and sixteen MUAC. She is experiencing a cough and flu for two days. I tested her using a timer, I found that she is breathing rapidly at a rate of forty-five breaths per minute and I found that she has pneumonia. What medication should I give her?

question_kinyarwanda: Umugabo w'imyaka mirongo itanu upima mirongo irindwi n'umunani yangezeho afite ikibazo cyo kuva imyuna kandi ngo abimaranye iminsi itatu. Namugirariye inama yo kujya kwa muganga avuga ko yataye mitiweli, none uyu mugabo ndamukorera iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugabo w’imyaka 50 upima ibiro 78 kg Afite ikibazo cyo kuva imyuna bimaze iminsi itatu. 1\. Mubuze kuba yakunama cyangwa ngo ararame, musabe kureba imbere. 2\. Mushyire agatambaro gatose ku mazuru kuko gashobora gutuma kuva bihagarara no gufasha imitsi yacitse kwisubiranya. 3\. Mupime umuvuduko w’amaraso: Niba uri hejuru, ni ikimenyetso mpuruza ko wazamutse cyane. Niba uri hasi, bivuze ko yatakaje amaraso menshi cyane. 4\. Musobanurire ko ibya Mituelle abitekereza amaze kwivuza, kuko kutivuza kare bishobora kumuviramo urupfu cyangwa guturika udutsi two mu bwonko niba umuvuduko w’amaraso uri hejuru.
question_english: A 50-year-old man weighing 78 kilograms came to me with a complaint of nose bleeding that he has had for three days. I advised him to go to the hospital, but he said he lost his health insurance card. What can I do for this man?

question_kinyarwanda: Umugabo w'imyaka mirongo irindwi, bamupimye indwara zitanduza, none ibisubizo bye bigaragaza ko basanze arwaye umuvuduko. None bamubwiye kujya gufata imiti yabyanze ngo ntawo arwaye, ndamufasha iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Urakoze, uyu murwayi akeneye ibisobanuro birambuye, ushobora kumubwira ko ashobora kujya kwa muganga kongera kwemeza niba abifite cyangwa atabifite, nibimara kwemeza ko abifite kwa muganga bazagufasha kumwumvisha akamaro ko gutangira imiti hakiri kare.
question_english: A seventy-year-old man was tested for non-communicable diseases, and the results showed that he has high blood pressure. However, he refused to take the prescribed medication, claiming he is not sick. How can I help him?"

question_kinyarwanda: Umugore w'imyaka makumyabiri n’itatu, angezeho ambwira ko ava nta kame. Ambwira ko akoresha uburyo bwo kuboneza urubyaro, ubwo akoresha urushinge, ubwo depo rw’amezi atatu. Mubwiye ko agomba kujya kwa muganga. Ese hari ubundi bufasha namuha? murakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Ubufasha bundi wamuha nuko umubwira ko agomba kubibwira muganga neza, ariko umubaze niba bije aruko atangiye gufata urwo rushinge kuko ibitera kuva ari byinshi k'umugore. Ikindi umubwire afate ibintu byo kunywa byinshi birimo ibyongera amaraso kugira ngo atagira isereri akitura hasi.
question_english: A 23-year-old woman came to me and reported irregular bleeding. She mentioned that she uses a three-month injectable contraceptive (Depo). I advised her to go to the hospital for further evaluation. Is there any additional support I can provide to her? Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Nasuye umuryango ufite umwana w'umuhungu ufite imyaka icyenda; ufite ubumuga bw'ingingo; bamukingirana, batamugaburira. Mbagira inama ko ari umwana nk'abandi na we ashoboye. Nabazaga ko hari ubundi bufasha namufasha.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze kandi mwabagiriye inama nziza kuko uwo ni umwana nk'abandi ukwiye byose ahubwo ukeneye n'ubundi bufasha. IBINDI -Ganira nababyeyi be maze bakubwire igihe amaranye ubwo bumuga, n'icya biteye. -Ganira nababyeyi bakubwire impamvu bamukingirana batemera ko asohoka -Bafashe kumva ko ari umwana nk'abandi kandi afite ejo heza haza. -Babaze niba baramujyanye kwa muganga, niba akurikiranwa neza niba batarabikoze bibashishikarize kandi nawe ubaherekeze. -Babaze niba hari ikindi kibazo yaba afite umufashe kandi nugira ikibazo natwe uduhamagare tugufashe. -Mugihe bikomeje kwanga itabaze inzego z'ibanze zisure uwo muryango maze bafashe umwana. -Ganira nuwo mwana wumve we uko abyumva nuko atekereza unumve ibyifuzo bye.
question_english: I visited a family with a nine-year-old boy who has a physical disability; they keep him confined and do not feed him properly. I advised them that he is just like other children, and he is capable. I was asking if there is any other help I could provide for him.

question_kinyarwanda: Umugore w'imyaka mirongo irindwi n'ibiri, yavuze ko arwaye marburg kubera ko yigeze kuyirwara akayikira, none akeka ko yaba ari yo yongeye kurwara. Nimumfashe, namukorera iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Urakoze. Ushobora kumuha paracetamol yo kugabanya ububabare n'umuriro, umushishikarize kunywa amazi menshi kandi umwohereze ku ivuriro kugira ngo yitabweho biruseho.
question_english: A seventy-two-year-old woman has said she has Marburg disease because she once had it and recovered, and now she suspects it might be the same illness again. Please help me, what can I do for her?

question_kinyarwanda: Umubyeyi yanzaniye umwana w'umukobwa ufite imyaka ine, afite ibiro cumi na bitanu, yaje ambwira ko ari guhitwa, mubaza inshuro yituma mu isaha ambwira ko yituma inshuro enye zinarenga mwisaha. Ndamusuzuma nsanga arwaye impiswi muha imiti. Ngiye kumusura, nsanga urugo rw'iwabo rw'abantu batanu barwaye icyorezo cya korera. Mbafashe iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Bahe imiti ya zinc, ubahe ORS babe banywa, ubundi murinde abandi gukomeza kujyayo, mubigishe ku isuku, ubundi ubohereze kwa muganga byihuse babahe ubufasha banaze kureba icyabiteye muri urwo rugo.
question_english: A parent brought me a four-year-old girl weighing fifteen kilograms, telling me that she has diarrhea. I asked how many times she defecates in an hour, and she told me it was more than four times an hour. I examined her and found that she had diarrhea and gave her medication. When I went to visit, I found that five people in her household were suffering from a cholera outbreak. What can I help them?

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana n'umukobwa w'imyaka itanu, afite ibiro makumyabiri, umubyeyi we yambwiye ko umwana aguye hasi akaba avunitse ukuguru. Mbajije umubyeyi niba umwana nta bundi burwayi asanganywe ambwira ko ntabwo, umwana namwandikiye taransiferi. Ese hari ubundi bufasha namuha bwisumbuye? Murakoze
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Mugihe umwana afite ibimenyetso byokuvunika ukuguru, hari ibintu by'ingenzi ushobora gukora mbere yo kumwohereza kwa muganga kugenzura neza ibikomere kwirinda guhungabanya akaguru ushaka uburyo bwiza bwokumufasha no kuba mumutuzo Hano ntabwo twakwibagirwa kumushyikiriza muganga kugira ngo amukorere isuzuma ryimbitse murakoze cyane!!!!
question_english: A five-year-old girl, weighing twenty kilograms, her mother told me that the child had fallen to the ground and broken her leg. I asked her mother if the child had any other medical conditions and she said there's not, I wrote the child a transfer. Is there any other help I can give her in higher level? Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Mwiriwe neza, umugore w'imyaka mirongo itatu nine aje ambwira ko ababara umutwe, umugongo, umuriro wa mirongo itatu n'umunani n'igice, mwitegereje mbona yacitse intege mufata ikizamini cya malariya, nsanze ari negatifu. Ese uyu murwayi namukorera iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Mwiriwe neza! Mubushobozi bwokuba uri gufasha umugore ufite ibimenyetso byo kubabara umutwe, umugongo, umuriro, ndetse n'uko yacitse intege.  Muri iki gihe,n'ubwo wakoze ibizamini cya malariya kandi kikaba kigaragaje ko nta malariya afite, hari ibintu byinshi byatuma agira ibimenyetso nk'ibi, nk'ibindi bibazo by'ubuzima. Ibyingenzi wamufasha nI ibi: Kuruhuka ndetse no gushyika kubaganga, kuko ikizamini cya malariya cyagaragaje ko nta malariya afite, hashobora kuba hari indi ndwara cyangwa ikibazo cy'ubuzima kiri gutera ibimenyetso.  Byaba byiza kumujyana kwa muganga kugira ngo hamenyekane neza impamvu y'uburwayi. Ni ngombwa kumujyana kwa muganga kugirango hagaragare impamvu z'ibimenyetso byose afite.
question_english: Hello, a thirty-nine-year-old woman comes to me and tells me that she has headache, back pain, fever of thirty-eight and a half. I look at her and i see that she is weak and take a malaria test, i find that it is negative. What can i do for this patient?

question_kinyarwanda: Umukecuru w'imyaka mirongo irindwi n'ibiri, ibiro mirongo itanu na birindwi. Yaje angana afite umuriro, mupima nkoresheje termometere nsanga afite umuriro wa mirongo itatu n'umunani. Mufatira tederi, tedeli nsanga ni postifu. Ngiye kumuha umuti ariwo sisi fuwa katire, ansubiza ko mu buzima bwe atari yarya ikinini ahubwo aragana mu kinyarwanda. Ndamwinginga aranga ngera nubwo mubwira ngo muhamagarize izindi nzego, arananira. Ni iki nakora? Murakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Uwo mukecuru ufite malaria wanze imiti, tugomba twitabaza inzego z'ibanze n'iz'umutekano agakurikiranwa.
question_english: I have attended to an old woman aged seventy-two, weighing fifty-seven kilograms. She has come looking unwell with a fever, and when I have measured her temperature using a thermometer, I have found she has a fever of thirty-eight degrees. I have taken a rapid test, and the test has turned out positive. When I was about to give her medication, which is 6*4, she has responded that in her entire life she has never taken pills but has relied on traditional medicine. I have pleaded with her, but she has refused. Even when I have suggested calling other authorities, she has remained adamant. What can I do? Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Umugore wimyaka makumyabiri n'ibiro mirongo ine na bibiri , arahinda afite umuriro wa mirongo itatu numunani aradiyara , araruka , kumunsi adiyara inshuro eshanu acitse intege abimaranye amasaha makumyabiri nane. Mubajije niba nta kindi kibazo cy'ubuzima asanganywe , ambwira ko ntacyo. Namugiriye inama yo kunywa amazi meza kandi menshi. Ese hari indi nama nagira uyu mugore kugira ngo agire ubuzima bwiza?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: mufatira ikizamini cya malariya ukoresheje tederi hanyuma urebe nimba nta malariya afite, ikindi umuhe uwoles kugira ngo ataba yagize umwuma kubera iyo diyare, ubundi nurangiza umwoherereze ku kigo nderabuzima babashe kumukurikirana
question_english: A 20-year-old woman weighing 42 kilograms has a fever of 38 degrees Celsius, diarrhea, and vomiting. She has had diarrhea five times a day and has been feeling weak for the past 24 hours. When asked if she has any other health issues, she said no. I advised her to drink plenty of clean water. Is there any other advice I can give her to improve her health?

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'umuhungu ufite imyaka ibiri afite ibiro umunani. Uburwayi afite; araruka ibyo yariye, arituma inshuro ebyiri ku munsi zirenga ibintu byoroshye. Namubajije ubundi burwayi asangaganywe, ambwira ko ntabwo. Namupimye ikizigira cy'ukuboko, nsanga afite cumi na rimwe n'ibice bitanu. Mwamfasha iki ku kibazo cy'uyu mwana?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'umuhungu w'imyaka 2 upima 8kg, afite MUAC ya 11.5cm, araruka kandi afite impatwe inshuro zirenga ebyiri ku munsi. Uyu mwana agaragaza ibimenyetso bya gastroenteritis n'imirire mibi. Mumuhe zinc na ORS, mubashishikarize kumuha amazi menshi kugira ngo yirinde umwuma kandi amwonse kenshi gashoboka mu rugendo rwo kujya kwa muganga. Ibi ni ikibazo gikomeye rero, nyamuneka mujyane uyu mwana kwa muganga kugira ngo avurwe neza SAM (imirire mibi ikabije) na gastroenteritis (bakteri niba bifitanye isano n'umuriro). -Bazamuha amazi anyuzwa mu mutsi (IV Fluids) kugira ngo yongere ahabwe amazi. -Bazatangira kumugaburira buhoro buhoro bakoresheje F-75. -Bazatangiza antibiyotike niba ari gastroenteritis iterwa na bakteri. -Bazakora ibindi bipimo no kuvura.
question_english: An eight-kilogram two-year-old boy is ill. He vomits everything he eats and has loose stools more than twice a day. When I asked him about his other medical conditions, he told me that he did not have any. I measured his mean upper arm circumference and found that it was eleven and a half centimeters. How can you help me with this child's problem?

question_kinyarwanda: Mwiriwe neza, nakiriye umwana w'umuhungu afite imyaka ine, n'ibiro cumi na birindwi, arwaye inkorora n'ibicurane, afite umuriro, muwake afite cumi na kane , umuriro afite mirongo itatu na karindwi n'ibice bitanu. Mbajije umubyeyi igihe umwana amaze arwaye, ambwira ko ari ibyumweru bibiri ariko umuriro awumaranye ibyumweru bitatu. Mubajije niba hari ubundi burwayi abana nabwo ambwira ko ntabwo, ariko ngo hari mukuru we wari umaze igihe arwaye igituntu umwana muhaye taransiferi. Ndabaza niba hari ikindi namufasha. Murakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Mwiriwe neza! Murakoze kubaza iki kibazo cy’uyu mwana w’umuhungu ufite imyaka ine, ibiro cumi na birindwi (17kg), arwaye inkorora n’ibicurane, afite umuriro, ndetse MUAC ye ni 14 cm. Umuriro afite ni mirongo itatu na karindwi n’ibice bitanu (37.5°C). Ubajije umubyeyi igihe umwana amaze arwaye, akubwira ko ari ibyumweru bibiri, ariko umuriro awumaranye ibyumweru bitatu. Ubajije niba hari ubundi burwayi abana nabwo, akubwira ko nta bwo, ariko ngo hari mukuru we wari umaze igihe arwaye igituntu. Wamuhaye transferi ukaba ubaza niba hari ikindi wamufasha. Mbashimiye uburyo mwakiriyemo uyu mwana ufite inkorora n’umuriro, n’uburyo mwagerageje gukusanya amakuru akenewe. Kuba mukuru we yaramaze igihe kinini afata imiti y’igituntu, hari ibyago byinshi by’uko uyu mwana yaba yaranduye igituntu, kuko cyandurira mu mwuka no mu gukoresha ibikoresho bimwe n’uyirwaye, nk’isahani, agakombe, ikiyiko, n’ibindi bikoresho bifashisha barya cyangwa banywa. Tugendeye ku bimenyetso uyu mwana afite, nk’umuriro amaranye ibyumweru bitatu, inkorora amaranye ibyumweru bibiri, no kuba afite umuntu begeranye cyane warwaye igituntu, bihita bigaragaza ko uyu mwana nawe ashobora kuba arwaye igituntu. Inama waha umubyeyi Gufata umwana we nk’urwaye igituntu kugira ngo atanduza abandi. Kumurinda gusangira n’abandi bana, akagira isahani ye, akanywera ku gikombe cye, akagira uburiri bwe gusa. Gukingura amadirishya igihe ari kumwe n’abandi bantu. Kubuza abandi bantu bose kumwegera uko biboneye, kandi niba bishoboka, agomba kwambara agapfukamunwa. Uyu mwana agomba guhita ajyanwa kwa muganga byihutirwa, kandi umujyanama akamuherekeza, kugira ngo bahabwe serivisi nyazo, harimo no gutanga amakuru nyayo. Murakoze.
question_english: Good evening, I received a four-year-old boy weighing seventeen kilograms, suffering from cough and flu, with a fever. His pulse rate is fourteen, and his temperature is thirty-seven point five degrees. When I asked the parent how long the child has been sick, they told me it has been two weeks, but the fever has lasted for three weeks. When I asked if there were any other illnesses the child had, they said no, but mentioned that his older sibling had been suffering from tuberculosis, and the child was given a transfer. I ask if there is anything else I can assist with. Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Umurwayi afite imyaka itanu ibiro cumi na birindwi, muwake cumi na gatandatu ni umukobwa,ari gukorora agahumeka nabi,akaba nta bundi burwayi yari asanganywe. Mupimye nkoreshe tayima inshuro ahumeka nsanga ni mirongo ine na kabiri; afite umusonga, muha amogisi none ahise agaruka haziyemo n'impiswi. Mfite zenke; nayimuha nayo akayivanga na amogisi?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'imyaka 5, ibiro 17, ufite umusonga n'impiswi. Mubaze niba ntamuriro, niba awufite upime TDR, umuhe amoxicillin yo kumuvura umusonga, umuhe zinc 20mg rimwe ku munsi umuhe ORS Afate 10mls ukubye ibiro afite, Umushishikarize kunywa ibyo kunywa bihagije, ucunge ko ataruka cyangwa akaba yarushaho guhumeka nabi, urebe ibimenyetso by'umwuma . Niba hari kimwe mu bimenyetso afite, umwohereze kwa muganga hafatwe ibipimo nk'amaraso, umusarani, nakenera umwuka kubwo guhumeka nabi awuhabwe. Hugura umubyeyi kongera isuku kubera ko umwanda ushobora gutera iyo ndwara y'impiswi.
question_english: A 5-year-old girl weighing 17 kilograms with MUAC of 16 is coughing and having difficulty breathing. She has no previous health issues. I measured her respiratory rate using a timer, and it was 42 breaths per minute. She has pneumonia, so I gave her amoxicillin. However, she has now returned with diarrhea. I have zinc; can I give it to her along with the amoxicillin?

question_kinyarwanda: Muraho. Umubyeyi anzaniye umwana w'umuhungu w'umwaka umwe, ibiro icumi. Ambwira ko afite ikibazo cyo guhumeka bigoranye. Mubajije igihe yafatiwe ambwira ko ari umunsi umwe. Mushizeho tayima nsanga ari guhumeka inshuro mirongo ine. Mubwiye ko yihangana ari bumere neza. Muhaye amogisi ibinini bibiri, kabiri ku munsi mu minsi itanu. Nabazaga ko hari ubundi bufasha naha uyu mwana?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: uMrakoze kubaza ikibazo cy'umwana wumuhungu w'umwaka umwe ufite ibiro icumi akaba yaje afite ikibazo cyo guhumeka bigoranye wamupima ukoresheje tayima ugasanga ahumeka inshuro mirongo ine ku munota kandi akaba abimaranye umunsi umwe ukaba wamufashije umuha umuti amoxiciline ibini bibiri kabiri ku munsi muminsi itanu hanyuma umusaba ko agenda akita ku mwana akamuha imiti akamufubika umwana azakira. wakoze cyane ni byo koko uyu mwana akurikije inshuro ahumeka afite ikibazo cy'umusonga wakoze kumuha umuti w'umusonga kandi ukigisha umubyeyi uko agiye gukurikirana umwana. uyu mwana namara iminsi itanu amaze imiti akirwaye ubwire umubyeyi azamugarure umuhe taransiferi amujyane ku kigo nderabuzima kugira ngo abaganga bamusuzume byisumbuye wakoze cyane!
question_english: Hello. A parent has brought me a one-year-old boy weighing ten kilograms. They have told me he has difficulty breathing. When I have asked how long he has had the issue, they have said it has been one day. I have timed his breathing and found he is breathing forty times per minute. I have told them to be patient as he will get better. I have given him two tablets of amoxicillin, to be taken twice a day for five days. I am asking if there is any other assistance I can provide to this child?

question_kinyarwanda: Umudamu w'imyaka mirongo itatu, ibiro mirongo itandatu na kimwe. Afite isereri kandi arababara mu nda. Maze mukorera ikizamini cy'inkari nsanga ntatwite, ese hari ubundi bufasha nari kumuha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umudamu w'imyaka 30, ibiro 61, arababara mu nda afite n'isereri, ikizamini cy'inkari cyerekanye ko adatwite. Mubaze ibindi bimenyo byagufasha gusobanukirwa neza, urugero igice cyo mu nda kibabara, isesemi, kuruka ,umuriro, kunyara akababara, gucibwamo n'ibindi. Mushishikarize kujya kwa muganga bakore ibindi bizamini byimbitse n'ibindi bipimo kugirango avurwe bakurikije ibyo babonye. Mushishikarize kunywa amazi meza kandi ahajyije .
question_english: A 30-year-old woman weighing 61 kilograms is experiencing dizziness and abdominal pain. I conducted a urine test, and she is not pregnant. Is there any other assistance I could offer her?

question_kinyarwanda: Mwiriwe neza! Umugabo w'imyaka mirongo ine n'itatu n'ibiro mirongo irindwi . Angezeho arimo gutaka akanuye amaso umuvandimwe we ambwiye ko bari bari kurya inyama, inyama ikamuniga ikanga kumanuka ngerageje gukubita ingumi mu gatuza mwiyegamije, inyama yanze kumanuka, muhaye transferi. Nabazaga niba hari ubundi bufasha naha uyu muntu. Murakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Mwiriwe neza! Niba umugabo afite ibibazo byo kumva atamerewe neza nyuma yo kunywa cyangwa kurya inyama, bishobora kuba ari ikibazo cyo kumuniga. Kubera ko yatanze ikimenyetso cyo gutaka, ndetse akaba afite amaso akanuye, bishobora kugaragaza ko ari ikibazo cy'umwuka cyangwa kuba atabona neza, bityo byaba byiza kugana vuba kwa muganga cyangwa mu ivuriro kugira ngo haboneke ubufasha bwihuse.ndetse ni byiza Kwihutira gusaba ubufasha akitabwaho cyane. Gutanga ubutabazi bwihutirwa ni ibintu byiza byamufasha guhabwa ubuvuzi bw'ibanze. Mu gihe yageze mu bitaro cyangwa ku ivuriro byihuse.
question_english: Good afternoon! A forty-three-year-old man weighing seventy kilograms came in, groaning and with wide eyes. His brother told me that they were eating meat, and it got stuck in his throat and wouldn’t go down. I tried to paunch him in the chest, but the meat wouldn’t dislodge, so I gave him a referral. I was asking if there is any other help I can provide to this person. Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'umuhungu ufite imyaka makumyabiri ibiro mirongo itatu na birindwi. Yaje angana afite umuriro , mufatira tederi , nsanga ni negatifu. Mugihe ngiye kumuha transfer mubaza ubundi burwayi umwana asanganywe , ansubiza ko afite igituntu. n' iki nakora murakoze
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umusore w’imyaka 20, ufite ibiro 37 kg, yaje afite umuriro. Namupimye tifoyide, ibisubizo biba negative. Mbere yo kumuha urupapuro rumwohereza, namubajije niba afite izindi ndwara, ambwira ko afite uburwayi bw'igituntu. Mubaze niba ari ku miti y'igituntu. Mubaze ibindi bimenyetso afite, nko guta ibiro no kubira ibyuya nijoro. Mufatire ikizamini cya HIV. Mupime na TDR ya malaria. Niba ibisubizo ari negative, Mwohereze kwa muganga kugira ngo akomeze kuvurwa neza. 🏥
question_english: A 20-year-old boy weighing 37 kilograms came in with a fever. I tested him for typhoid, and it was negative. When I was about to give him a transfer, I asked if he had any other illnesses, and he said he has tuberculosis. What should I do? Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Mbona umugabo ufite unywa ibiyobyabwenge, ndangije mubaza igihe ki abimaranye, arangije ambwira ko abimaranye imyaka irindwi ,ndangije mubaza icyiza cyabyo, arambwira ngo yumva aribyo byiza, mubwira ko no kubivaho nabyo byaba byiza kuruta uko yabinywa ndangije mbaza inama ndamubwira ati kubivaho ni kimwe ubuzima bukiyongera none muga umugabo yambwiye ko agiye kubivaho harikindi nagombaga kumubwira muga ngira inama icyiza si ukubivaho?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Uwo umugabo unywa ibiyobyabwenge, mubajije igihe amaze abifata, ambwiye ko amaze imyaka irindwi, mubajije ikiza abibonamo, ambwira ko atekereza ko ari byiza, ndangije mugira inama yo kubireka kugira ngo agire ubuzima bwiza. Musobanuriye ibibi byo kunywa ibiyobyabwenge nko kuba imbata yabyo, kurwara indwara zo mu mutwe, kudategura ejo hazaza n'ibindi.  Mumubwire kureka kunywa ibiyobyabwenge. Saba inshuti ze n'abagize umuryango we bamufashe mukumwigisha.
question_english: I see a man who takes drugs, i finish asking him how long he has been doing it, he finishes telling me that he has been doing it for seven years, i finish asking him what's good about it, he tells me that he thinks it's good, i finish asking him for advice and i tell him that it's one of the best ways to improve your life.

question_kinyarwanda: Muraho, umwana w'umukobwa w'imyaka cumi n'itanu ufite ibiro mirongo ine n'umunani, angezeho arimo arira cyane. Mubajije icyo abaye, ambwira ko ari kuribwa. Mubaza ikibazo afite, Ambwira ko ari mu imihango. Mubajije niba hari ubundi burwayi afite, ambwira ko ntabwo. Ndamwihanganishije, muha transiferi. Nababazaga niba hari ubundi bufasha naha uwo mwana w'umukobwa.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze kubaza iki ikibazo cy'umwana w'umukobwa w imyaka cumi n'itanu ufite ibiro mirongo ine n' umunani, wakugezeho arimo kurira cyane,wamubaza icyo abaye aka kubwirako Ari kuribwa,wamubaza ikibazo afite akakubwira ko Ari mu mihango,wamubaza niba ntabundi burwayi afite, akubwira ko ntabwo.ukamwihanganisha,ukamuha taransiferi. Ukaba ubaza niba ntabundi bufasha mwaha uwo mwana w,umukobwa. Birashoboka cyane ko kuribwa cyane kubana b,ababakobwa bamwe bibabaho,bitewe n,imisemburo yabo ituma habaho imihango,bakaba bagira uburibwe bwinshi mugihe ibyari kuzatunga umwana bisohokana n,intanga y'umugore bigatera uburi bwinshi,gusa ntabwo biba kubakobwa bose .Kuko hari abaribwa cyane,hari abaribwa gacye,hari n'abataribwa mu gihe cy'imihango bitewe n'imisemburo yabo uko ikora mu mubiri wabo. Rero iyo umukobwa agiye mu mihango akagira uburibwe burengeje kwihanga kwe, yoherezwa kwa muganga agafata imiti imugabanyiriza uburibwe nka paracetamol,Diclofenac, Ibuprofen nindi. Uyu mukobwa muhe taransiferi imujyana ku kigo Nderabuzima ahabwe ubufasha. Murakoze.
question_english: Hello, a 15-year-old girl weighing 48 kilograms approached me, crying. I asked her what was wrong, and she told me she was in pain. When I asked what the issue was, she said she was on her period. I asked if she had any other illness, and she said no. I comforted her and gave her a pain reliever. I was wondering if there is any other assistance I could provide to the girl.

question_kinyarwanda: Mwiriwe neza, umugore w'imyaka mirongo ine n'ibiri, afite ibiro mirongo itandatu na kimwe. Amaze iminsi itatu abyaye musuye mu rugo iwe nyuma y'iminsi itatu abyaye, nsanga aribwa umutwe bikabije, agira isereri, ari kuva. Mubajije igihe abimaranye, ambwira ko abimararanye iminsi ibiri, muhaye transiferi ngo ajye ku kigo nderabuzima, yanze kujyayo. Ubwo namufasha iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Ni ugukomeza kumwigisha yuko ibyo bimenyetso afite ari ibimenyetso mpuruza bishobora kumushyira mu kaga, akaba yanapfa. Hanyuma, umuhamagarire ambulance ize imutware kwa muganga, bamuhe ubufasha bwihutirwa.
question_english: Good evening, a 42-year-old woman weighing 66 kilograms gave birth three days ago. I visited her at home and found that she had severe headaches, dizziness, and was bleeding. When I asked how long she had been experiencing these symptoms, she told me it had been two days. I gave her a transfer note to go to the health center, but she refused to go. How else can I assist her?

question_kinyarwanda: Umurwayi ufite imyaka makumyabiri n'itanu, afite ibiro mirongo itanu n'umunani ni umuhungu. Afite umuriro wa mirongo itatu n'icyenda n'ibice bitanu. Ari kubabara umutwe, akaba yari asanganywe indwara y'ubumuga bwo mu mutwe. Mufatiye tederi (TDR) nsanga ni positifu afite malariya. None mfite six fois quatre. None Nayimuha afite ubumuga bwo mu mutwe?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze kubaza iki kibazo cy'umurwayi w'imyaka makumyabiri n'itanu, ufite ibiro mirongo itanu n'umunani w'umuhungu. Akaba afite umuriro wa mirongo itatu n'icyenda n'ibice bitanu, ubabara umutwe kandi asanganywe indwara y'ubumuga bwo mu mutwe, none tederi wamufatiye yabaye positifu. Nkuko bigaragara uyu murwayi afite malaria kandi rwose umuti wo kumuha ni kwariteme six fois quatre kandi kuba asanzwe afite uburwayi bwo mu mutwe, aba ashobora kurwara n'izindi ndwara nka malaria kandi yemerewe guhabwa imiti yayo nk'abandi barwayi. Uyu murwayi rero uramuha imiti ya malaria six fois quatre nk'uko wavuzeko uyifite ariko ukurikirane ko abasha kuyinywa neza nk'uko wabimubwiye, yubahirije amasaha kandi akanywa dose ikwiye kuko iyo umuntu asanzwe afite uburwayi bwo mu mutwe, hari igihe usanga adahuza ibintu neza cyangwa ngo abashe gukurikiza amabwiriza nkuko yayahawe. Nusanga uyu murwayi ashobora kumva no gukurikiza amabwiriza uramuha imiti, umubwire n'uko ayinywa ariko nusanga adashobora kumva amabwiriza kubera ikibazo cy'uburwayi bwo mu mutwe urifashisha umuntu wo mumuryango we cyangwa undi umuba hafi, amufashe kujya anywa imiti ya malaria. Murakoze kumufasha!
question_english: A 25-year-old patient, weighing 58 kilograms, is male. He has a fever of 39.5 degrees. He is experiencing a headache and has had a mental disability. I've performed a rapid diagnostic test (RDT) and found it positive for malaria. Now I have six times four. Should I give it to him considering he has a mental disability?

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'umuhungu ufite imyaka makumyabiri. Afite ubumuga bwo kutabona. Yagiye ku isoko gusaba ibyo kurya, ahanuka ku mukingo kuko ntawe afite umwereka aho agomba kunyura. Ahita ahanuka ku mukingo aravunika. Avunika akaguru kandi ahantu yahanutse nta muhanda uhari ngo abashe kugera kwa muganga. Ngerageje gutumaho umuryango we, bambwira ko yapfuye kare umunsi atareba nk'abandi ngo ntibabasha kumujyana kwa muganga ntagihe cyo guta. Mwamfasha iki ngo ndengere umwana?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze kubaza iki ikibazo cy' uyu mwana w' umuhungu ufite imyaka makumyabiri. Ufite ikibazo cy'ubumuga bwo kutabona.Wagiye ku isoko gusaba ibyo kurya ,ahanuka ku mukingo Kuko ntawe afite umwereka aho agomba kunyura. Ahita ahanuka ku mukingo aravunika,avunika akaguru Kandi ahantu yahanutse nta muhanda uhari ngo abashe kugera kwa Muganga. Wagerageje gutumaho umuryango we,bakubwira ko yapfuye kera umunsi atareba nk,abandi,ngo ntibabasha kumujyana kwa muganga,nta gihe cyo guta. Ukaba icyo twagufasha ngo umurengere umwana. Tubashimiye kuba mwabashije kuhagera ngo mutabare uyu muhungu wavunitse ukuguru,Kandi akaba afite ikibazo cy,ubumuga bwo kutabona,Kuko hari imiryango myinshi igifite imyumvire mibi yo kumva ko umuntu ufite ubumuga runaka cyangwa ku rugingo runaka ari ishyano,igisebo,ibyago nandi magambo apfobya abo bantu bafite ubwo bumuga cyangwa abatesha agaciro,akabambura uburenganzira bwabo. Niyo mpamvu hashyizweho amategeko arengera abantu bafite ubumuga runaka,Kandi areba buri wese ushatse kuyarengaho. Icyo wafasha uyu muhungu,n,ugusigasira imvune nkuko mwabyize, kugirango adakomeza kubabara,mushake ingobyi ya kinyarwanda,igare cyangwa moto,umuhe taransiferi mumwohereza ku kigo Nderabuzima byihutirwa. Ubundi mufatanye n,ubuyobozi bw, umudugudu n,ubw,akagali muganirize uwo muryango,nibakoza kwinangira,hakurikizwe amategeko arengera abantu bafite ubumuga. Murakoze.
question_english: A twenty-year-old boy has come to me. He is blind and has gone to the market to beg for food. He has fallen off a slope because he has had no one to guide him on where to pass. He has injured himself and broken his leg, and where he fell, there is no road to take him to the hospital. I have tried to call his family, and they have told me that he has already died the day he stopped seeing like others, so they couldn't take him to the hospital as they have had no time to waste. What can you do to help protect this child?

question_kinyarwanda: Umurwayi w'imyaka mirongo itatu n'irindwi w'umugabo apima ibiro mirongo itanu na bine, yaje yacitse intege, ababara umutwe ndetse n'umugongo. Mfashe umuriro agira mirongo itatu n'umunani n'ibice bitanu, mfashe tederi (TDR) agira positif kandi uyu murwayi asanzwe afite ikibazo cyo mu mutwe afata imiti ya buri kwezi. Kandi njye mfite six fois quatre muhaye transiferi. Mumfashe, nari kumuha imiti kandi hari imiti afata buri kwezi?
