answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugabo w'imyaka 37 ibiro 54 ari gutaka gucika intege,umutwe no kubabara umugongo,ubushyuhe bwe ni 38.5 ikizamini cya TDR cyabaye pozitifu kandi afite ubumuga bwo mu mutwe anafata imiti buri kwezi Ntugomba guhita uha umurwayi Coartem iyo afite indwara yo mu mutwe kandi afata imiti ya anti-psychotics, kuko imwe muri iyo miti zishobora kudakorana na Coartem. Ku bw’ibyo, umurwayi agomba koherezwa ku bitaro kugira ngo ahabwe indi miti ivura malaria itari Coartem niba iboneka. Niba idahari, abaganga bazasuzuma inyungu n’ibyago, maze nibasanga inyungu ziruta ibyago, bazayimuha.
question_english: A 37-year-old male patient, weighing 54 kg, came in complaining of weakness, headache, and back pain. I took his temperature and found it to be 38.5°C. His malaria test (TDR) was positive, and he has a history of mental health issues for which he takes monthly medication. And I have coartems tablets I provided him with a referral (transfer). Could you assist me? Should I administer treatment, given that he is already on medication for his mental health condition?

question_kinyarwanda: Umugabo w'imyaka mirongo itanu n'itatu, ufite ibiro mirongo ine n'icyenda yaje kwivuza. Mubaza uko arwaye, ambwira y'uko afite inkororo irengeje ibyumweru bibiri. Mugira inama yo kujya ku kigo nderabuzima. Namufasha iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Mwakoze kwakira uwo mugabo w'imyaka mirongo itanu n'itatu, ufite ibiro mirongo ine n'icyenda waje avuga ko arwaye inkorora irengeje ibyumweru bibiri, nibyiza ko mwamugiriye inama yo kujya kukigonderabuzima, ikindi mwamufasha nukumubaza ko hari ibindi bimenyetso afite nko kugira umuriro mwinshi, kubira ibyunzwe nijoro, gutakaza ibiro, mukamubaza niba anywa inzoga n'itabi, niba yarakoze mibirombe by'amabuye yagaciro ubyandike kuri transfer ye ajye kukigonderabuzima bagufashe.
question_english: A fifty-three-year-old man, weighing forty-nine kilograms, has come for treatment. When I have asked him about his condition, he has told me that he has had a cough for more than two weeks. I have advised him to go to the health center. How can I help him?

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'umukobwa w'imyaka itatu ufite ibiro cumi na bibiri na garama magana arindwi, afite muwake(MUAC) ya cumi na kane n'igice, arahumeka cyane. Ndamupimye na tayima nsanga arahumeka inshuro mirongo ine n'umunani, ndeba ibindi bimenyetso ngo ndebe ko nta bundi burwayi afite. Nsanga ibiganza bye byererutse bigaragara ko amaraso yatangiye kumubana makeya. Mwohereje ku kigo nderabuzima rero ngo abe yakwitabwaho. Nibabazaga niba nta bundi bufasha umuntu yamuha mu gihe ataragera kwa muganga?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umukobwa w'imyaka itatu, upima ibiro cumi na bibiri na garama magana arindwi, afite MUAC ya 14.5 cm kandi ahumeka cyane. Namupimye nsanga ahumeka inshuro 48 mu munota. Narebye ibindi bimenyetso ngo ndebe niba afite ibindi bibazo by’ubuzima. Nabonye ko intoki ze zisa n’iz’umweru, bigaragaza ko ashobora kuba afite amaraso make. Namwohereje ku kigo nderabuzima kugira ngo yitabweho birushijeho. Igisubizo: R/ Anemia Kunanirwa guhumeka Tanga ubufasha bwihutirwa bwo kumujyana ku kigo kugira ngo bapime hemoglobine n’ubushyuhe bw’umwuka. Niba HB iri hasi (\< 7g/dl), wohereza ngo ahabwe amaraso no kwitabwaho birushijeho.
question_english: A three-year-old girl weighing twelve kilograms and seven hundred grams has a MUAC of 14.5 cm and is breathing heavily. I tested her and found she is breathing 48 times per minute. I checked for other signs to see if she has any other health issues. I noticed that her hands are pale, indicating that her blood levels might be low. I referred her to the health center for further care. I was wondering if there is any other assistance I can provide her before she reaches the clinic?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umurwayi w'umugabo afite imyaka mirongo itatu , afite ibiro mirongo itanu nicyenda. Arwaye umutwe cyane , namubajije icyaba cyamuteye umutwe , ambwira ko amaze ibyumweru bibiri adasinzira. Niki namukorera?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umurwayi w’umugabo w’imyaka 30 upima ibiro 59. Afite umutwe ukabije kubera ko ataryamye neza mu byumweru bibiri bishize. Uwo murwayi ashobora kuba afite umutwe uterwa no kubura ibitotsi. Ugomba kumugira inama yo kuryama bihagije hanyuma ukamwohereza ku bitaro kugira ngo asuzumwe neza kandi avurwe. Niba afite ikibazo cyo kubura ibitotsi, azavurwa hakoreshejwe uburyo bwo guhindura imyitwarire (cognitive behavioral therapy), kandi bishobotse avurwe igihe gito akoresheje imiti nka benzodiazepines cyangwa imiti irwanya kwiheba nka amitriptyline. Niba umutwe ukabije cyane, ashobora guhabwa paracetamol 1 gram inshuro eshatu ku munsi.
question_english: I received a 30-year-old male patient weighing 59 kilograms. He has a severe headache. When I asked what might have caused the headache, he told me that he hasn't slept for two weeks. What can I do for him?

question_kinyarwanda: Umumama w'imyaka mirongo itatu n'ibiri afite ibiro mirongo itandatu na bitanu. Uburwayi afite: Kugira isereri cyane, kubaba umutwe akababara mu kiziba cy'inda. Namubajije uburwayi asanganywe abwira ko ntabwo, uretse ko akoresha uburyo bwo kuboneza urubyaro agashinge ka mezi atatu. Mubajije ikindi kibazo afite ambwira y'uko ari kuva cyane. Namugiriye inama yo kurya imbuto, imboga, ibikomoka ku matungo. Ni ubuhe bujyanama mwampa ngo ngire uyu murwayi?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze kwakira uyu mu mama, IBINDI UKWIYE KUMENYA \- Igihe bimaze niba anibuka uko byatangiye akubwire. \- Niba aheruka kwipimisha ubwandu bwa sida n'igisubizo. \- Niba nt amuntu mu muryango we urwara umuvuduko. \- Reba niba yerurutse. IBISHOBOKA UYU MURWAYI YABA AFITE \- Inda iri kuvamo cyangwa yatwitiye hanze. \- Amaraso yabaye macye kubera kuva cyane. \- Ikibazo ku nkondo y'umura. -Ubundi burwayi bushingiye cyangwa bwaterwa n'amaraso ,nyababyeyi,n'ibindi. UBUNDI BUFASHA \- Mwakire urebe ko wamugabanyiriza ububabare. \- Pima umuriro nusanga ari mwinshi unakore TDR. \- Pima inda urebe ko atwite -Umwohereze kwa muganga bapime ku nkondo y'umura, inda, amaraso barebe ko atabaye macye, umuvuduko, banamucishe mu cyuma. \- Mukorere raporo y'ibyo wamukoreye abijyane kwa muganga.
question_english: A thirty-two-year-old mother weighs sixty-five kilograms. She is experiencing severe dizziness, headache, and abdominal pain. When I asked about her medical history, she said there was none, except that she has been using birth control injections for three months. When I asked her another question, she mentioned that she was bleeding. I advised her to eat fruits, vegetables, and animal products. What additional advice would you give me for this patient?

question_kinyarwanda: Umugabo w'imyaka mirongo itanu yaje angana, ambwira ko yumva ababara ku rurimi kandi ko hariho n'ibisebe. Namugiriye inama yo kugana ivuriro, kuko bishobora kuba byamuviramo kanseri y'ururimi, ati:"reka reka ntagihe mfite." Hakorwa iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Ni ukumuha inama yo kumva akamaro ko kwisuzumisha hakiri kare, kuko gutinda kwivuza bituma uburwayi bukura. Ni byiza rero ko yisuzumisha kugira ngo bamufashe.
question_english: A fifty-year-old man comes to me, telling me that he feels pain on his tongue and that there are also sores. I advise him to go to the clinic because it can lead to tongue cancer, and he says, "No, no, I don't have time." What can be done?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umuhungu w'imyaka cumi n'umunani ufite ibiro mirongo itandatu. Yambwiye ko yafashwe ku ngufu n'umugore w'imyaka mirongo itanu, none arumva atangiye kubyimba amabya n'igitsina kiravamo amashyira. Nabazaga ko uwo murwayi hari ibindi bizamini yakorerwa.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Mwohereze kwa muganga bamukorere ikizamini cya RPR n'icya VIH, barebe ko atamwanduje izo ndwara, barebe ko nta zindi ndwara yamwanduje zandurira mu mibonano mpuzabitsina, ubundi umwohereze kwa muganga bamufashe kugera aho bamufasha, kuko yarahohotewe koko.
question_english: I received an eighteen-year-old boy weighing sixty kilograms. He told me that he was raped by a fifty-year-old woman, and now he feels his testicles are starting to swell, and pus is coming out of his penis. I was asking if there are other labs that could be done for that patient.

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana muto w'umukobwa wimyaka ine ufite ibiro cumi na bitanu na MIWAKE ya cumi na gatandatu bamunzaniye afite ibipimo mirongo itatu n’umunani byumuriro mufatiye tederi nsanga nta malariya afite none uyu Mwana mukorere iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umwana muto w'umukobwa w'imyaka ine ufite ibiro cumi na bitanu na MIWAKE ya cumi na gatandatu bamunzaniye afite ibipimo mirongo itatu n’umunani by'umuriro mufatiye tederi nsanga nta malariya afite . Biragaragara ko uyu mwana ari mumirire mini Tanga imiti y'umuriro Wigishe kandi unasobanurire umubyeyi Hanyuma ube wamwohereza kwa muganga
question_english: A four-year-old girl weighing fifteen kilograms and sixteen muac, they bring her with a thirty-eight fever and she doesn't have malaria, so what can i do for this child?

question_kinyarwanda: Umurwayi w'umuhungu w'imyaka cumi n'irindwi, ibiro mirongo ine, yaje ataka mu nda kandi afite umuriro wa mirongo ine, mupimye nsanga nta malariya afite, ndamwohereza. Hari ubundi bufasha nari kumuha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Urakoze kohereza umurwayi kugira ngo akomeze kwitabwaho, hanyuma muhe paracetamol kubera uwo umuriro mwinshi.
question_english: A 17-year-old male patient, weighing 40 kilograms, has come complaining of abdominal pain and has had a fever of 40 degrees. I've tested him and found he doesn't have malaria, so I've referred him. Is there any other assistance I could have provided?

question_kinyarwanda: Mwiriwe neza, Umugabo w'imyaka cumi nicyenda afite ibiro mirongo irindwi na bine. Ari gukorora ababara mugatuza. Mubajije igihe inkorora ayimaranye ambwira ko ayimaranye ibyumweru bitatu. Namwohereje ku kigo nderabuzima ngo ajye kwisuzumisha igituntu ambwira ko yivuza imiti yikinyarwanda. Ubwo namufasha iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Komeza kumugira inama ko imiti ya gakondo ishobora guteza indwara z’umwijima n’iz’impyiko, bityo agomba kubanza gupimwa kugira ngo avurwe hakurikijwe ibisubizo by’ibipimo. Nzi ko bigoye kumwumvisha, ariko ugomba gusubiramo inyigisho kenshi kugira ngo abashe kubyumva neza.
question_english: Hello, A man who is thirty-nine years old weighs seventy-four kilograms. He is coughing and has chest pain. When I asked him how long he has been coughing, he told me it has been three weeks. I sent him to a health center to get tested for tuberculosis, but he told me he is treating himself with traditional medicine. How can I help him?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umugabo ufite imyaka makumyabiri n'icyenda, aje afite umuriro, asanzwe akunda kurwara malariya, namukoreye tederi iba negatifu. Mwohereza ku kigo nderabuzima ati keretse umperekeje. Mwamfasha iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Mwakoze cyane kubufasha mwatanze kuri uyu mugabo. Ikintu mwamufasha ni ukumuha transiferi yanditseho umuriro wasanze afite, wandikeho n'igisubizo cya tederi wamukoreye kugira bize korohereza umuganga uramwakira. Ikindi uze kumusobanurira ko kujyana na we atari ngombwa kubera ko ibyo wari kumufasha usobanura muganga wabyanditse ku rupapuro bityo muganga araza kubibona. Ikindi umwibutse kukuzanira isubizabutumwa kugira bikorohereze kumukurikirana.
question_english: I received a twenty-nine-year-old man who came in with a fever and has a history of malaria. I conducted a TDR test, and it was negative. He insists on being accompanied to the health center. what can you help me?

question_kinyarwanda: Mwiriwe. Hashize iminsi itatu mvuye umwana w'umuhungu impiswi, afite umwaka n'amezi atandatu, afite ibiro cumi na kimwe, muwake afite cumi na gatatu. Ndamusuye nsanga ari kurushaho kurwara. Mbajije umubyeyi niba ataramuvuje mu kinyarwanda ambwira ko ari kugerageza indi miti y'ikinyarwanda kuko akeka ko bamuroze. Mpise mwandikira transiferi, musaba guhagarika imiti yose. Nibazaga niba hari ubundi bufasha namuha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umwana w’umuhungu w’imwaka 1 n’amezi 6 ufite ibiro 11 amaze iminsi 3 afite impiswi kandi ubuzima bwe bwakomeje kuzamba muri iyo minsi 3 ishize, kandi ababyeyi be bamuhaga imiti ya gakondo. • Ugomba guhita umujyana kwa muganga ako kanya kuko ashobora kujya mu ihungabana bitewe no kubura amazi menshi mu mubiri. Yanatakaje umunyu mwinshi, bityo rero akeneye kongererwa amazi n’umunyu kugira ngo umubiri we ugarure imbaraga. • Kwa muganga bagomba gusuzuma umusarani we barebe niba harimo udukoko twatera indwara, hanyuma bamuvure uko bikwiye. • Bagomba no gupima isukari yo mu maraso ye. Niba basanze iri hasi, bazamuha dextrose kugira ngo bamurinde igabanuka ryayo rikabije.
question_english: Good evening. It has been three days since I have seen a boy with diarrhea. He is one year and six months old, weighs eleven kilograms, and has a mean upper arm circumference of thirteen centimeters. When I visited him, I found that his condition has been worsening. When I asked the parent if they have sought treatment in traditional medicine, they told me they have been trying other traditional remedies because they suspect he is bewitched. I have immediately written a transfer for him, asking them to stop all medications. I am wondering if there is any other assistance I could provide?

question_kinyarwanda: Muraho umubyeyi anzaniye umwana w'umuhungu w'imyaka cumi n'umwe, ibiro makumyabiri na bitatu. Ambwira ko afite umuriro ari kubabara mu nda. Mubajije ko niba nta bundi burwayi asanganwe, ambwira ko ari ntabwo, mubwiye ko yihangana aribuze kumera neza. Mushizemo igipimo cy'ubushuhe terimometere, musanzemo umuriro mirongo itatu n'icyenda, mukorera tederi musanzemo malariya. Muhaye sisi fuwa turuwa afata ibinini bitatu kabiri ku munsi. Nabazaga niba nta bundi bufasha naha uyu mwana?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Uyu ni umwana w'imyaka 11 upima ibiro 23 wageze kwa muganga afite umuriro wa dogere 39 Celsius n'ububabare mu nda, kandi ikizamini cya malariya cyagaragaje ko afite malariya. Uyu mwana afite malariya yoroshye kandi wakoze neza kumuha imiti ya malariya, ariko kubera ko uyu mwana apima ibiro 23, ugomba kumuha coartem 6\*2, ibinini 2 kabiri ku munsi mu gihe cy'iminsi 3 nk'uko amabwiriza abiteganya. Niba hari imiti igabanya umuriro nka paracetamol, muhe paracetamol anywa cyangwa ayishyirwe mu kibuno 15mg/kg uko bikenewe kugira ngo wirinde ko yagira umuriro mwinshi ushobora gutera ibindi bibazo, niba idahari, ushobora kumwohereza ku kigo nderabuzima bakamufasha. Sobanurira umubyeyi uburyo bwo kwirinda malariya, ibimenyetso by'ingaruka zikomeye, n'igihe cyo gusubira kwa muganga. Kora isuzuma ry'ibikorwa kugira ngo umenye niba uburyo bwo kwirinda malariya bukurikizwa mu rugo.
question_english: Hello, a parent brought in an 11-year-old boy weighing 23 kilograms. He told me the child has a fever and is experiencing abdominal pain. When I asked if he had any other underlying conditions, the parent said no. I advised them to manage the symptoms as the child should start feeling better soon. I checked his temperature using a thermometer and found a fever of 39°C. I conducted a rapid test and diagnosed malaria. I gave them treatment of six times three and prescribed three tablets twice a day. Is there any additional support I can offer this child?

question_kinyarwanda: Mwiriwe neza! Umugore w'imyaka mirongo itatu n'irindwi afite ibiro mirongo itandatu na bine. Aje ambwira ko aboneza urubyaro akoresha uburyo bw'ibinini, akaba ababara mu nda, akabara umutwe, akagira isereri, isesemi. Mubajije igihe abimaranye, ambwira ko abimaranye ibyumweru bibiri. Mwohereje ku kigo nderabuzima ngo ajye kwisuzumisha, yanze kujyayo. Ubwo namufasha iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Ndumva wamubwira yuko ibyo bivurwa no kwa muganga iyo umuntu agize ikibazo kijyanye no kuboneza urubyaro, ikindi nukumubwira neza ko atinze kwivuza byamugiraho ingaruka atari byiza kuguma mu rugo. Ikindi nuko numva afite bimwe mu bimenytso erekana ko yarwara maralia cyangwa se akaba atwite. Byaba byizw umufatiye TDR na test de grosesse ukareba, wasanga ntakirimo akajya kwa muganga byihuse. Wagira icyo ubona ukamuha imiti ari nka maralia!
question_english: Hello! A thirty-seven-year-old woman weighing sixty-four kilograms reported using birth control pills and experiencing abdominal pain, headache, dizziness, and nausea. When I asked how long she has had these symptoms, she stated it has been ongoing for two weeks. I referred her to the health center for a check-up, but she declined. How can I help her?

question_kinyarwanda: Umurwayi ufite imyaka makumyabiri, ibiro mirongo itanu na bitaratu ni umuhungu. Afite umuriro wa mirongo itatu n'icyenda, akababara umutwe, akaba yarasanganywe uburwayi bw'imbasa. Mufatiye tederi nsanga ni positifu afite malariya. None mfite sisi fuwa katere(six fois quatre). None nayimuha afite n'imbasa?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umurwayi w'umugabo w'imyaka 20 uzwiho kuba yaragize poliyo, yaje afite umuriro wa dogere 39 kandi basanze afite malariya. Uyu murwayi afite malariya ishingiye ku kuba yaranarwaye poliyo. Ugomba kumuvura ukoresheje coartem 6\*4 nk'uko bisanzwe kuko nta bimenyetso bihari byerekana ko coartem itakoreshwa ku murwayi ufite virusi ya poliyo. Mwigishe ku kwirinda malariya kandi uge umukurikirana. Mwigishe ibimenyetso mpuruza ndetse n'igihe cyo gusubira kwa muganga.
question_english: A twenty-year-old patient, weighing fifty-six kilograms, is a boy. He has a fever of thirty-nine degrees, suffering from a headache, and has an other condition of polio. I've performed a rapid test and found he is positive for malaria. Now I have six times four tablets. Should I give them to him considering he also has polio?

question_kinyarwanda: Muraho,umugore w'imyaka mirongo itatu n'ibiri ufite ibiro mirongo itandatu na bitanu, yaje kwivuza ambwira ko ari kubabara umutwe ambwira ko ari kubabara mu ngingo. Mupimye umuriro nsanga afite mirongo itatu n'icyenda temperaca. Mufatiye tederi nsanga afite malaririya. Nta bundi burwayi asanganwe, ariko aratwite. Mfite imiti sisifuwakatere. Ubwo se namuvura? Nabazaga ngo kugira ngo mungire inama.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Uyu mugore w'imyaka mirongo itatu n'ibiri ufite ibiro mirongo itandatu na bitanu, yaje kwivuza ambwira ko ari kubabara umutwe ambwira ko ari kubabara mu ngingo. Mupimye umuriro nsanga afite mirongo itatu n'icyenda temperaca. Mufatiye tederi nsanga afite malaririya. Rero hano uramubaza inda atwite amezi ifite kuko mu gihembwe cya mbere ntibyemewe kumuha coartem, munsi y'amezi 3 ntibyemewe ariko hejuru wamuvura.
question_english: Hello, a thirty-two-year-old woman weighing sixty-five kilograms has come to me for a consultation and has told me she has a headache and joint pain. I've measured her temperature and found it to be thirty-nine degrees. I've tested her and found she has malaria. She has no other underlying conditions, but she is pregnant. I have six times four(six fois quatre) medication. So, should I treat her? I am asking to get advice.

question_kinyarwanda: Umurwayi ufite imyaka itatu, ibiro makumyabiri , ni umukobwa. Azanwe n'umubyeyi avuga ko umwana inka yamwishe imutera ihembe ku kaguru. Mbajije umubyeyi ko nta bundi burwayi afite, ambwira ko ntabwo. Mfashe agatambaro keza, muhanagura ku kaguru nsanga inka aho yamushinze ihembe hari igisebe, nsanga hagiyemo icyondo. Muhaye transiferi kugira ngo ajye kwa muganga. None ubundi bufasha nagombaga kumuha ni ubuhe?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Uyu murwayi ufite imyaka itatu, ibiro makumyabiri, ni umukobwa. Inka yamwishe imutera ihembe ku kaguru. ku kaguru nsanga inka aho yamushinze ihembe harimo icyondo Geregeza koza igisebe ugisukure ukuremo Icyondo. Maze ushyireho agatambaro gasukuye, upfukeho. Hanyuma akaguru gafite igisebe ukagumishe mu mwanya wako. Umwohereze kwa muganga bamufashe.
question_english: The patient is a three-year-old, twenty kilograms, female. Brought by the mother who says that the child was hurt by a cow and was horned on the leg. I asked the mother if she had any other illnesses, she told me no. I took a clean cloth, wiped it on the leg and found that where the cow had put her horn was infected, and found that there was mud in it. I give her a transfer to go to the hospital. So what else support was i supposed to give her?

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'umukobwa ufite imyaka itatu, nyina yamunzaniye arwaye guhitwa, namusuzumye nsanga ahitwa inshuro zirenga eshanu. Namuhaye zenke(zinc) na ORS. Nkomeje gusuzuma Nsanga yabyimbye amashinya. None nta bundi bufasha mwamuha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umukobwa w’imyaka itatu yazanywe na nyina afite impiswi. Namusuzumye nsanga yituma inshuro zirenga eshanu ku munsi. Namuhaye zinc na ORS. Nyuma yo kumusuzuma neza, nasanze amenyo ye yabyimbye. Hari ubundi bufasha bwiyongera nabaha? Uyu mwana muto arwaye gastroenteritis ifitanye isano n’umuriro, akenshi iterwa na virusi, bagiteri, n’udukoko twanduza. Ashobora kuba ari kumera amenyo y’inyuma (premolars), bishobora gusobanura kubyimba kw’amenyo no kugira impiswi bitewe n’impamvu z’umubiri zijyanye no kumera amenyo. Mumuhe ORS ingana na 10 mls/kg nyuma ya buri mpiswi kandi mumushishikarize kurya indyo yuzuye, ndetse mumuhe zinc sulfate kugira ngo bifashe mu gukiza urukuta rw’amatako.
question_english: A 3-year-old girl was brought by her mother with diarrhea. I examined her and found she was passing stool more than five times a day. I gave her zinc and ORS. Upon further examination, I found her gums were swollen. Is there any additional assistance I can provide?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umwana w'umuhungu ufite imyaka itanu, ibiro cumi n'umunani. Aje afite impiswi, namupimye muwake, muha zek na wolesi. Nsubiye kumusura nsanga ntiyorohewe. None mwamfasha iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Nakiririye umwana w’imyaka itanu upima ibiro 18 wari ufite impiswi. Namupimye MUAC kandi namuhaye zinc na ORS. Ngarutse kumusura nasanze atarakize. Wamfasha ute muri iki kibazo? Impiswi ku mwana ishobora kuba ikimenyetso cy’udukoko twibasira amara, kwandura ibiryo n’ibindi kandi bisaba kwitabwaho byihuse no kumuha imiti yica inzoka. Impiswi ishobora gutera umwuma ukabije ndetse n’urupfu niba itavuwe. Mumuhe ORS 180ml nyuma ya buri mpiswi, zinc sulfate mu minsi 10, niba nta mpinduka nyuma y’amasaha 48, mumujyane kwa muganga kugira ngo hakorwe isuzuma hamenyekane icyateye impiswi idakira no kumwitaho birushijeho.
question_english: I received a five-year-old boy weighing 18 kg who came with diarrhea. I tested his MUAC and gave him zinc and ORS. When I visited him again, I found that he wasn't feeling better. How can you assist me in this situation?

question_kinyarwanda: Mwirewe, Nakiriye umugore w'imyaka mirongo itatu n'umunani, afite ibiro mirongo i itadatu na birindwi, ari gukorora, kubabara umutwe, kuribwa mu nda kandi akagira n'umuriro. Mubajije igihe bimaze, ambwira ko ari iminsi ibiri. Terimo afite mirongo itatu n'umunani, tederi ni positifu. Mubajije niba nta bundi burwayi abana nabwo ambwira ko afata imiti ya kanseri. Nibabazaga icyo nakorera uyu murwayi. Murakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugore w'imyaka 38 yaje kwa muganga afite inkorora, umutwe, umuriro, n'ububabare mu nda bimaze iminsi 2, asanzwe arwaye kanseri,tederi yabaye negatifu. Uyu murwayi yari afite malariya yiyongera ku ndwara ya kanseri asanganwe. Muhe coartem nk'uko isanzwe ihabwa abantu bakuru, ariko umubwire kurya no kunywa imiti ndetse no gukomeza kuvurwa kanseri umwizeza ko nta ntakibazo kiri mu kunywa coartem hamwe n'imiti kanseri.
question_english: Good afternoon, I received a thirty-eight-year-old woman weighing thirty-seven kilograms. She has a cough, headache, abdominal pain, and fever. When I asked how long she had been experiencing these symptoms, she told me it had been two days. Her temperature was 38 degrees, and the malaria test was positive. When I asked if she had any other illnesses, she said she was on cancer treatment. What can I do for this patient? Thank you.

categories: {asrh,other,"Infectious diseases Sexual Transmitted Diseases Urinary tract infections Sexual health education "}
question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umusore w'imyaka makumyabiri n'itanu, ufite ibiro mirongo itandatu na bibiri. Ambwiye ko arimo kwihagarika akababara mu gitsina. Mubajije igihe bimaze, ambwira ko ari iminsi ibiri, mubajije niba nta yindi ndwara abana nayo ambwira ko ntayo. Mubajije niba yaba yarakoze imibonano mpuzabitsina idakingiye ambwira ko yayikoze, mubwiye yuko gukora imibonano idakingiye byamuviramo kwandura indwara zidakira harimo, virusi itera SIDA, umwijima wo mu bwoko bwa B, ndetse n'izindi ndwara, imitezi na mburugu n'izindi. Muhaye transiferi. Ndabaza niba hari ikindi namufasha.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umusore w’imyaka 25 upima 62 kg, yabwiye ko amaranye iminsi 2 agira ububabare mu myanya ndangagitsina igihe ari kwihagarika. Afite amateka yo gukora imibonano mpuzabitsina idakingiye. Icyo wamugira inama: Koresha agakingirizo . Kubungabunga isuku y’imyanya ndangagitsina. Kumubaza niba afite ibindi bimenyetso nka: · Amatembabuzi ava mu gitsina · Umuriro  umuhe imiti igabanya umuriro. Mumwohereze gukora isuzuma rya urinalysis na culture, ndetse no gufata ikizamini cy’amaraso.
question_english: I received a 25-year-old young man weighing 62 kg. He told me that he experiences pain in his genitals when urinating. I asked how long he had been experiencing this, he said it had been two days. I asked if he had any other illnesses, and he said he had none. I inquired whether he had engaged in unprotected sexual intercourse, he admitted that he had. I informed him that engaging in unprotected sex could lead to contracting incurable diseases such as HIV/AIDS, hepatitis B, as well as other sexually transmitted infections like gonorrhea and syphilis. I then gave him a transfer. I am asking if there is anything else I can do to help him.

question_kinyarwanda: Umugore w'imyaka mirongo ine, aboneza urubyaro yabihishe umugabo kuko atabishaka, amuhoza ku nkeke kandi afite abana b'indahekana. Hakorwa iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugore w'imyaka 40, aboneza urubyaro abihishe umugabo we kuko atabishaka. Amuhoza kunkeke kandi bafite abana bindahekana. Ganiriza umuryango ubijyishe ibyiza nakamura ko kuboneza urubyaro, n'ingaruka zo kubyara indahekana. Harimo imirire mibi idakwiriye biva kubucyene, kubura ubushobozi bwo kwivuza, bityo abana bakagwinjyira. Ijyisha umugabo ko guhoza ku nkeke uwo bashakanye aricyaha gihanwa n'amategeko iyo agiriwe inama ntazikurikize. Bijyisheko iyo umuryango ushyize hamwe bakumvikana bajyera kwiterambere. Bityo bikaba inyungu ku giti cyabo n'igihugu muri rusanjye n'abana babo bakabaho ubuzima bwiza.
question_english: A forty-year-old female use family planning, she hide it from her husband because he didn't want to, harassed her and had fabulous children. What can be done?

question_kinyarwanda: Muraho, umwana w'umuhungu wimyaka ine, ibiro cumi na bitanu, azanwe n'umubyeyi we, ambwiye ko umwana afite umuriro, inkorora, agacika intege. Mubajije igihe yafatiwe, ambwira ko amaze iminsi ibiri. mufatiye tederi na tayima nsanga ni negatifu. Muvuye umusonga, umwana muhaye amogisi ibinini bibiri kabiri ku munsi mu minsi itanu. Nabazaga niba hari ubundi bufasha naha uyu mwana?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Uyumwana w'umuhungu wimyaka ine, ibiro cumi na bitanu, azanwe n'umubyeyi we, ambwiye ko umwana afite umuriro, inkorora, agacika intege. Wakoze kubw'ubufasha wamuhaye ariko harikindi wakongeraho Niba hari ibinini bigabanya umuriro muhe Hanyuma niba wamuhaye amogosi ukabona akomeje guhumeka nabi, Mwohereze kwa muganga babe bamufatira amaraso n'ibindi bizami barebe ikibitera
question_english: Hello, a four-year-old boy weighing fifteen kilograms was brought in by his parent, who told me the child has a fever, a cough, and is weak. When I asked how long he had been sick, they told me it had been two days. I tested him for malaria and took his temperature, and both results were negative. I diagnosed him with pneumonia and gave him amoxicillin, two tablets twice a day for five days. I am asking if there is any other assistance I can provide for this child.

question_kinyarwanda: Muraho! nasuye umugore utwite ku nshuro ya kane , ufite imyaka makumyabiri nirindwi , ufite ibiro mirongo itanu na bitandatu. Twasubiye mu bimenyetso mpuruza twize bwashize. Namubajije ko nta kibazo afite , ambwira ko arikujya abona amaraso mu gitsina kandi nta burwayi yari asanganywe. Mugira inama yo kujya kwa muganga bakamufasha , arambwira ngo arajya gushaka umuti wo mu kinyarwanda ko bamuroze. Nabazaga ngo namugira iyihe nama?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugore utwite ufite imyaka 27, ibiro 56, arava amaraso mu gitsina, nta bundi burwayi asanganwe, bamugiriye inama yokujya kwa muganga aranga ngo aragana mu kinyarwanda. Inama: 1. Kumwumvisha ko kuva amaraso mu gitsina bifite ingaruka k'umwana no k'umubyeyi bombi, bityo rero aramutse atagannye ibitaro ashobora kuhasiga ubuzima bwe nubw'umwana we atwite. 2. Kugana ibitaro agahabwa ubufasha neza, kandi ko ari ikibazo cyihutirwa.
question_english: Hello! I visited a 27-year-old pregnant woman for her fourth pregnancy. She weighs 56 kilograms. We reviewed the warning signs we learned previously. When I asked if she had any issues, she told me that she has been experiencing vaginal bleeding and had no prior illnesses. I advised her to go to the hospital for help, but she said she would seek traditional medicine because she believes she has been bewitched. What advice should I give her?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umwana w'umukobwa w'imyaka itanu, ibiro cumi na bitandatu. Yaje ababara mu nda ariko yabyimbye amaso, mwohereza kwa muganga nyuma y'iminsi itatu nsanga aracyarwaye. Mungire inama.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Tubashimiye gukurikirana uwo mwana w'umukobwa w'imyaka itanu, ibiro cumi na bitandatu, waje kubareba yabyimbye amaso, nyuma yo kumwohereza kwa muganga akaba akirwaye, inama wamugira ni ugusubira kwa muganga bakamufasha.
question_english: I received a five-year-old girl weighing sixteen kilograms. She came in with abdominal pain and swollen eyes. I referred her to the hospital, but after three days, I found that she is still unwell. Please advise me on what to do next.

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umugore w'imyaka mirongo ine n'ibiri, afite ibiro mirongo itandatu na bine, amaze iminsi itatu abyaye, ari kuva cyane, nta bundi burwayi yari afite, ahindura ibyo yibinze inshuro zirenga ebyiri mu isaha, ibyo yibinze ni igitenge. Namugira iyihe nama? Nimungire inama.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: urakoze kumugeraho -mufashe agere kwa muganga akokanya barebe impamvu banamufashe banamurinde infection -mushishikarize isuku mumyambaro ye no mu mirire -mushishikarize kurya neza no gukomeza kwonsa umwana
question_english: I received a 42-year-old woman, weighing 64 kg, who gave birth three days ago. She has heavy vaginal bleeding but has no other health issues. She changes her sanitary pad more than twice an hour, and the she is using piece of cloths. What advice should I give her? Please advise.

question_kinyarwanda: Umugabo afite imyaka mirongo n'itanu, afite ibiro mirongo itandatu, afata imiti igabanya ubwandu bwa sida. Madamu we ntashaka ko bongera kuryamana ngo atamwanduza, yamuhaye akato. Mbafashe iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Nibyiza ko ubajije iki kibazo cy'umugabo w'imyaka mirongo itanu ufite ibiro mirongo itandatu ufata imiti igabanya ubukana bwa sida ariko madamu we ntashaka ko bongera kuryamana kugira ngo atamwanduza. birumvikana niba umugabo arwaye umugore ari muzima ntago yahita amwemerera ngo baryamane kuko nawe ashobora kumwanduza virusi itera sida kuko yandurira mumibonano mpuzabitsina idakingiye. gusa bisanzwe bibaho ko habaho imiryango ibana umwe arwaye undi ari muzima kandi ntabagire ikibazo bagira gusa hari icyo bisaba, icyambere uwomugabo agomba kuba afata imiti neza kuburyo ingano ya virusi iba iri mumaraso igabanuka akagira byibuze virusi ziri munsi ya magana atanu kuko iyo bimeze gutya ibyago byo kwanduza biba ari bikeya. ikindi nuko bagomba kuganira kuburyo bwa kwirinda mugihe cy'imibonano nko gukoresha agakingirizo kandi bishobora kubafasha bagakomeza kubana ntakibazo bagiranye. Murakoze!
question_english: A 55-year-old man weighing 60 kg is taking antiretroviral medication for HIV. His wife does not want to have sexual relations with him to avoid being infected, and she isolated him. What can I do to help them?

question_kinyarwanda: Mwaramutse! Ngeze kuri kaburimbo mpasanga umuntu w'umusaza imyaka mirongo itanu , wagize impanuka ari kuva amaraso cyane mu mutwe no mu mazuru. Mbajije abantu bari bahari bashungereye, ndahabakuye kugira ndebe ko yagarura ubuyanja. Mubajije niba nta bundi burwayi asanzwe afite , ambwiye ko ari ntabwo. Nitabaje amburase kugira ngo imugeze kwa muganga bambwiye ko yaboneka nyuma y'iminota mirongo itatu. None uwo murwayi namufashe iki? murakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umurwayi w’umugabo w’imyaka 50 yagaragaje kugira amaraso menshi aturuka mu mazuru no mu gutwi nyuma yo kugira impanuka yo mu muhanda, kandi ambulance izahagera nyuma y’iminota 30. Uyu murwayi ashobora kuba afite ikomeretsa ku bwonko (Traumatic Brain Injury - TBI). Nanone, ashobora kugira ihungabana riterwa no gutakaza amaraso menshi (Hypovolemic Shock) bitewe n’ukuntu akomeza kuva amaraso mu mazuru no mu gutwi. Ubusanzwe abarwayi bakomerekejwe n’impanuka bakurikiranwa hakurikijwe amabwiriza ya ATLS: * Umuyoboro w’ubuhumekero, guhumeka, guhumeka kw'amaraso, ubumuga bushobora guterwa n’impanuka, Kumenya ibindi bikomere bishobora kuba bihari. * Ibi bituma ugomba gukurikirana ibiteye impungenge ku buzima bwe witonze Ibikwiye gukorwa ako kanya: * Urahita umuryamisha yubitse umugongo ku murongo wihese. * Niba hari aho ava amaraso agaragara, shyiraho umwenda usukuye cyangwa bande imufashe guhagarika kuva amaraso.
question_english: Good morning! I arrived at the main road and found a 50-year-old man who had an accident and was bleeding heavily from his head and nose. I asked the people who were gathered around to step back so I could check if he was conscious. When I asked if he had any other illnesses, he said no. I called an ambulance to take him to the hospital, but they told me it would arrive in 30 minutes. What assistance can I provide to this patient in the meantime? Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Umugore ufite imyaka mirongo inani n'ibiri afite ibiro mirongo itanu na bibiri afite umuriro degere mirongo tatu n'umunani n'ibice bitanu awumaranye umunsi umwe asanzwe afite umuvuduko w'amaraso mfashe tederi(TDR) iba positif ndebye mu bubiko imiti nsanga yashizemo, uyu muntu ndamuha ubuhe bufasha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugore w'imyaka 82 upima ibiro 52, afite umuriro (38°C) amaranye umunsi 1, azwiho kugira umuvuduko w'amaraso, RDT yagaragaje ko ari nziza kandi nta miti mfite mu bubiko. • Byiza, ugomba kumwohereza ku kigo nderabuzima cya hafi kugira ngo atangire gufata imiti ya malariya vuba bishoboka kandi ahabwe n'imiti igabanya umuriro nka paracetamol, kandi umugire inama yo kongera gufata amazi menshi, gukomeza gufata imiti igabanya umuvuduko w'amaraso niba yaratangiye kuyifata, no kugabanya umunyu mu byo arya.
question_english: An eighty-two-year-old woman weighing 52 kilograms has a fever of 38 Celsius degrees for one day. She has a story of hypertension. I have performed a rapid diagnostic test (RDT) which came out positive. Upon checking the stock, I found that there is no medication available. What assistance should I provide to this person?

question_kinyarwanda: Mwiriwe, ndi umujyanama w'ubuzima nakiriye umwana w'umuhungu ufite imyaka makumyabiri, ibiro mirongo itanu na kimwe, afite umuriro nta bundi burwayi asanganwe. Namukoreye tederi(TDR) iba negatifu(negatif) namuhaye taransiferi (Transfer) ntiyabyakira neza. Mwamfashe iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Mwakoze kwakira uwo mwana w'umuhungu ufite imyaka makumyabiri, ibiro mirongo itanu na kimwe, afite umuriro nta bundi burwati afite. Mwamukoreye tederi iba negatifu. Ikindi mwamufasha ni ukumubaza niba nta bindi bimenyetso afite, nko gukorora, kubabara umutwe,... Ikindi mukamubwira ko umuriro atari indwara ahubwo ari ikimenyetso cy'indwara, bityo agomba kujya kwa muganga bakareba ikintu kiri kumutera uwo muriro.
question_english: Hi, I am a health counselor and I am receiving a twenty-year-old, 51 kilogram male child with fever and no other medical history. I made for him a Test Diagnostic Rapid and it was negative. I gave him a transfer and he didn't receive it well. What can you help me?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umurwayi w'igitsina gabo, afite imyaka cumi n'icyenda afite ibiro mirongo irindwi na bibiri yaturutse mu mudugudu w'umukamba. Ibimenyetso afite, ari kuribwa cyane mu nda, mu bitugu arikumva hakamo umuriro. Akagira ikirungurira n'iseseme, ariko ntaruka. Inama natanze ni uko aba aretse inzoga, akoresha amata y'inshyushyu agishyushye. Ikibazo mbaza, isuzuma yakorerwa n'ubuvuzi yahabwa ni ubuhe?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umusore ufite imyaka cumi n'icyenda, afite ibiro mirongo irindwi na bibiri, ari kuribwa cyane mu nda, mu bitugu ari kumva hakamo umuriro. Ibi bimenyetso birerekana ko arwaye igifu. Uwo musore. Watangira umuha amata. Nubwo hari imiti tumuvurisha. Ibyo agomba kwirinda: Yirinde inzoga n'urusenda. Hanyuma tumuvurisha antibiotics ubwoko bubiri na anti acid, urugero: Amogisi na ciprofloxacine, noneho ugashyiraho omeprazole.
question_english: I have received a male patient, 19 years old, weighing 72 kilograms, who has come from Umukamba village. His symptoms include severe abdominal pain, shoulder pain accompanied by fever. He experiences heartburn and nausea but does not vomit. The advice I have given is to avoid alcohol and use warm milk. My question is, what examination should be conducted and what treatment should be provided?

question_kinyarwanda: Muraho neza! Ngeze ahantu nsanga umudamu ari gukubita umwana yamukomerekeje mu mutwe umwana w'imyaka itatu. Mubajije niba nta bundi burwayi asanzwe agira ambwira ko ari ntabwo. Mwohereje kwa muganga ambwira ko atarajyayo ko agiye kumusekurira ibyatsi agashyiramo. Uwo mubyeyi namufasha iki? Murakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Uwo mwana w' imyaka itatu wakoremekejwe na nyina, atinze kuvurwa yata ubwenge, agomba kumujyana ku bitaro bakamucisha mu cyuma,nyuma akitabwaho, umubyeyi yabyanga, tukitabaza inzego z'umutekano.
question_english: Hello! I arrived at a place and found a woman beating a 3-year-old child, injuring the child’s head. When I asked if the child had any existing health conditions, she told me no. I referred them to the hospital, but she told me they hadn’t gone yet and that she was going to give the child some herbal treatment. How can I assist this mother? Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Mwiriwe! nakiriye umwana w'umuhungu afite imyaka makumyabiri,ibiro mirongo itanu n'icyenda. Afite inkorora n'ibicurane n'umuriro mwinshi. Mubajije igihe amaze afashwe ambwira ko amaze iminsi itatu arwaye. Mubajije niba nta bundi burwayi asanganywe ambwira ko ntabwo, Mubajije kandi niba ntayindi miti yanyoye, ambwira ko ntayo. Mufatiye tederi nsanga ni pozitifu. Mupimye umuriro sanga afite mirongo itatu n'umunani. Ndikubaza ngo mufashe kumenya imiti ndamuha n'ikigero cyayo murakoze?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Nakiririye umwana w’umuhungu ufite imyaka makumyabiri kandi upima ibiro mirongo itanu n’icyenda. Afite inkorora, grippe, n’umuriro mwinshi. Namubajije igihe amaze arwaye, ambwira ko amaze iminsi itatu arwaye. Namubajije niba afite izindi ndwara asanzwe afite, ambwira ko nta zo afite. Namubajije niba hari imiti yindi yafashe, ambwira ko nta yo yafashe. Nakoze ikizamini cya TDR, kiba positif. Napimye ubushyuhe bwe,nsanga ari 38°C. **Igisubizo:** Afite malariya. Mumuhe Coartem ibinini 4 inshuro 2 ku munsi mu minsi 3. Paracetamol 1g gatatu ku munsi. Mugire inama yo kuruhuka bihagije.
question_english: Good evening! I received a male child who is twenty years old and weighs fifty-nine kilograms. He has a cough, flu, and a high fever. When I asked how long he has been sick, he told me he has been ill for three days. I asked if he has any other pre-existing conditions, and he said no. I also asked if he has taken any other medication, and he said he has not. I conducted a TDR, and it came out positive. I measured his temperature and found it to be thirty-eight degrees. I am asking for your help to determine the medication I should give him and the dosage. Thank you!

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umugabo ufite imyaka mirongo itandatu, ibiro ni mirongo cyenda, umuriro mirongo itatu nakarindwi n'ibice bitanu, aje arwaye ambwira ko amaze ibyumweru bitandatu akorora kenshi, kandi ambwira ko iyo nkorora akorora nta gikororwa cyiza. Mugiriye inama yo kugana muganga .Hari icyo mwanyongereraho kugira ngo mufashe?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Uramubaza niba yarigeze ahura n'abandi barwayi b'igituntu, hanyuma umwohereze kwa muganga.
question_english: I received a sixty-year-old man weighing ninety kilograms, with a temperature of 37.5°C. He told me that he had cough that has lasted for six weeks, and he reports that the cough has sputum or phlegm. I advised him to see a doctor. Is there anything else you would recommend to assist him?

question_kinyarwanda: Umurwayi ufite imyaka ine, ibiro cumi na bitatu ni umukobwa. Ari gukorora, agahumeka nabi, akaba nta bundi burwayi yari asanganywe. Mupimye nkoresheje tayima inshuro ahumeka nsanga ni mirongo ine na kabiri, afite umusonga. Muha amogisi. None ahise agaruka haziyemo n'impiswi. None mfite zenke nayimuha na yo akayivanga na amogisi?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Yego wamuha iyo zenke akayinywa ndetse niyo amogisi akayikomeza. Ubundi ukamubwira ibimenyetso mpuruza kugira ngo nibibaho azihutire kumujyanama kwa Muganga
question_english: A four-year-old patient, weighing thirteen kilograms, is a girl. She is coughing, breathing poorly, and had no prior illnesses. I measured her breathing rate using a timer and found it to be forty-two; she has pneumonia. I gave her amoxy. She immediately returned back she has also developed diarrhea. Should I give her the zinc i have as well and combine it with amoxy?

question_kinyarwanda: Mwiriwe! Umusore w'imyaka makumyabiri n'ine ambajije niba gukoresha agakingirizo katahera mu gitsina cy'umugore mu gihe cy'imibonano mpuzabitsin. Uyu musore mufashe iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Mwiriwe neza, Urakoze kubariza uwo musore w’imyaka 24 wakubajije niba gukoresha agakingirizo katahera mu gitsina cy’umugore mu gihe cy’imibonano mpuzabitsina. Bijya bibaho ko agakingirizo gashobora guhera mu gitsina cy’umugore, ariko si kenshi. Izo mpungenge uwo musore afite zirumvikana. Gusa, ni ngombwa gukoresha agakingirizo igihe cyose ugiye gukora imibonano mpuzabitsina n’uwo mutashakanye, kuko gafasha mu kurinda kwandura indwara zandurira mu mibonano mpuzabitsina, harimo na SIDA, ndetse kakanarinda gutera inda itateganyijwe. Ariko, gukoresha agakingirizo bisaba kubanza kubigiraho ubumenyi bw’ibanze, ubifashijwemo na muganga cyangwa undi muntu wabihuguriwe. Iyo wabanje kubyigishwa, izo mpungenge zo kuba kahera mu gitsina cy’umugore zirashira kandi ugakoresha neza. Ni byiza rero ko wamwigisha uko bagakoresha, niba ubizi, kandi ugafite ukabimwereka. Niba ntako ufite, wamwohereza ku kigo nderabuzima, aho muganga ushinzwe urubyiruko yamwigisha neza, bityo izo mpungenge zikagenda. Murakoze!
question_english: Hello! A twenty-four-year-old man asked me whether the use of condoms could result in them getting stuck in a woman's vagina during an intercourse. How can I help him?

question_kinyarwanda: Mwaramutse, umuntu w’umubyeyi anzaniye umwana w'imyaka ibiri, aje ambwira ko yaraye ahitwa mpaka mu gitondo. Mubajije uko bimeze ambwira ko ari guhitwa inshuro zirenze eshatu, musizemo igipimo cya muwake, apima cumi na kabiri,muhaye taransiferi(Transfeur) kugira amujyane kwa muganga, ambwira ko atarajyayo kubera narimbonye arimo mu mirire mibi. None uwo mubyeyi namufashe iki? Murakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'imyaka 2 yaraye ahitwa inshuro zirenze eshatu. MUAC ni 12. Reba ko adafite ibimenyetso by'umwuma ukabije. Mubaze ibindi bimenyetso yaba afite, nko kuruka, umuriro, kubyimba inda. Muhe zenke na ORS. Mujyire inama ko kuba umwana ahitwa cyane ari byiza kumujyana kwa muganga kugirango nibiba ngombwa, agacyenera imiti yo muri serumu ayibone. Mubwire ko agomba kujya kwa muganga hagafatwa ibizamini n'ibipimo kugirango arusheho kwitabwaho bakurikije ibyo babonye. Muganirize kumirire myiza y'umwana, iyuzuye ni nayo y'umwihariko. Mubwire ko kuba umwana ari mu mirire mibi bimuhatira kutagororoka kandi ko kujya kwa muganga bamufasha bakamuha inama bakamuha ibimufasha kugira ngo akomeze kugirira imirire myiza. Ijyisha umubyeyi isuku haba mubyo ategurira umwana cyangwa muri rusanjye.
question_english: Good morning, a parent brought in a 2-year-old child and said the child had been vomiting all night until morning. When I asked about the situation, the parent mentioned that the child had vomited more than three times. I took a measurement of the child’s temperature, which was 12°C (this seems like a mistake, as normal body temperature is around 37°C, so you may want to confirm this). I gave a referral letter (Transfer) to take the child to the hospital, but the parent said they haven't taken the child yet because they believed it was due to poor nutrition. How should I assist this parent in this situation? Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Muraho, umwana w'umukobwa w'imyaka icumi, ibiro cumi n'umunani azanwe n'umubyeyi we avuga ko afite ikibazo cy'inkorora, akaba arimo no guhu guhitwa. mubajije niba nta bundi burwayi asanganywe, ambwira ko ari ntabwo. Mubajije igihe yafatiwe, ambwira ko amaze iminsi itatu. Mubwiye ko yihangana ari bumere neza. Muhaye transiferi, nabazaga niba hari ubundi bufasha namuha.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umukobwa w'imyaka 10, apima ibiro 10, arakorora akanahitwa hashize iminsi 3. Nta bundi burwayi asanganywe. Umwana umaze iminsi 3 ahitwa, ugomba kureba niba nta mwuma afite ariko n'ubwo yaba ntawo, ugomba kumuha ORS akajya anywa uko avuye ku musarani kugira ngo ye kuguma gutakaza amazi menshi. Inkorora ye, reba niba adafite ibindi bimenyetso bikomeye nko guhumeka imbavu zikagwamo, utuzuru tukabyina, umuriro, n'ibindi... Kuko amaze iminsi myinshi, mwohereze kwa muganga kugira ngo bamusuzune banakore ibizamini maze bamenye ikiri gutera inkorora no guhitwa.
question_english: Hello, a ten-year-old girl weighing eighteen kilograms has been brought in by her parent, saying she has a cough and is also experiencing diarrhea. When I've asked if she has any other pre-existing conditions, she's told me no. When I've asked how long she has been sick, she's told me it has been three days. I've told them to be patient as she will get better. I've given her a referral and asking if there is any other assistance I can provide.

question_kinyarwanda: Mwiriwe neza, umugabo w'imyaka makumyabiri n'itanu, afite ibiro mirongo itanu n'umunani, aje akorora ababara mu gatuza ahinda umuriro. Mubajije igihe inkorora ayimaranye ambwira ko ayimaranye icyumweru kimwe. Mwohereje kukigo nderabuzima yanga kujyayo ngo arivuza imiti y'ikinyarwanda. Ubwo namufasha iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugabo w'imyaka makumyabiri n'itanu, upima ibiro mirongo itanu n'umunani, aje akorora, yumva ububabare mu gituza, kandi afite umuriro.  Yamaranye iyo nkorora, Fata isaha,  Pima umusonga, Fata TDR ya malariya, Kora ikizamini cya VIH. Niba byose bisanzwe, mwohereze gukora isuzuma ry'amatembabuzi yo mu bihaha.
question_english: Good evening, a twenty-five-year-old man, weighing fifty-eight kilograms, comes coughing, feeling chest pain, and having a fever. When asked how long he has had the cough, he tells me he has had it for one week. I've referred him to the health center, but he's refused to go, saying he is treating himself with traditional medicine. How can I help him?

question_kinyarwanda: umukobwa ufite imyaka makumyabiri afite ibiro mirongo itanu na bitaratu, afite imihango amaranye iminsi cumi n'ine, asanzwe akoresha uburyo bwo kuboneza urubyaro, atangiye kugira isereri no kubabara umutwe. Namugiriye inama yo kujya kwa muganga ngo bamufashe, aranga ngo batamuseka. None namuha ubuhe bufasha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Mubwire ko kwa muganga haba icyumba cy' urubyiruko ko rwose ntawe umenya ibye, ubundi umufashe uhamagare ushinzwe urubyiruko amwakire neza kandi mu ibanga ntawe umenye ibyabaye. Mubwire ko tugira ibanga ry' urubyiruko rwaje rutangana kandi tukabaha ubufasha ntawundi ubimenye wohanze.
question_english: A twenty-year-old girl weighing fifty-three kilograms has been on her period for fourteen days, she usually uses family planning methods, and she has started feeling dizzy and having headache. I have advised her to go to the doctor for help, but she's refused, fearing they might laugh at her. What assist can I give her?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umwana w'umuhungu w'imyaka itanu, ibiro cumi n’icyenda, yaje afite umuriro n'ibisebe byinshi, namukoreye ikizamini kibaye negatifu mwohereza kwa muganga. Musuye nyuma y’iminsi ine nsanga byabisebe ntibirakira. Mungire inama?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Uyu ni umwana w'umuhungu w'imyaka itanu ufite ibiro 19 wagejejweho umuriro n'ibikomere byinshi. Ashobora kuba afite ibikomere byanduye, sepsis, cyangwa umuriro wa typhoide. Mujyane ku bitaro kugira ngo hakorwe ibizamini birimo hemoculture, FBC, electrolytes ndetse n'ubundi buvuzi bushoboka burimo antibiyotike, bityo niba hemoculture yakozwe mutegereze ibisubizo kugira ngo hakoreshwe antibiyotike zihariye.
question_english: I received a five-year-old boy, weighing nineteen kilograms, who came with a fever and many wounds. I conducted a test which was negative and referred him to the hospital. I visited him after four days and found that the wounds had not healed. What should I do?

question_kinyarwanda: Banzaniye umwana ufite imyaka, umwaka n'amezi arindwi afite ibiro icyenda na garama magana atanu. Umwana ngo ntabasha kurya nicyo kibazo afite. Ndebye mbona yabyimbye ibirenge , ndebye no mumaso mbona arererutse cyane .Nawe namwohereje kwa muganga ngo barebe ikibazo cyiyo ndwara kimubuza kurya. Murakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Ni byiza cyane. -Egera uwo muryango ubasure urebe uko babayeho n'uko bategura amafunguro yabo. -Bigishe ku ndwara z'imirire mibi, aho zituruka, kuzirinda no kuzirwanya, bigishe akarima kigikoni, gutunganya amazi,i ndyo yuzuye. -Bigishe no kwirinda izindi ndwara nka malaria, inzoka n'izindi. -Kuboneza urubyaro ntubyibagirwe. -Reba ko muri ako gace ntabandi barimo mukore ubukangurambaga bwimbitse.
question_english: They brought me a seven-month-old child who weighs nine kilograms and five hundred grams. The child is unable to eat, which is the main issue. Upon examination, I noticed that his feet are swollen, and he has Vitiligo I referred him to the doctor to investigate the underlying cause of his inability to eat. Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Mwiriwe neza, mugabo w'imyaka mirongo ine nitanu, aje ambwira ko afite umuriro. Mupimye mbona afite umuriro wa mirongo itatu n'umunani n'igice, afite inkorora irengeje ibyumweru bibiri. Nitegereje mbona arabira ibyuya, mugira inama yo kujya kwa muganga. None uyu mugabo ni iki kindi namufasha ? Urakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Turabashimiye kuba mwakiriye uyu mugabo w'imyaka mirongo ine n'itanu ufite umuriro wa mirongo itatu n'umunani n'igice, akagira inkorora irengeje ibyumweru bibiri ari no kubira ibyuya. Ikintu wafasha uyu mugabo ni ukumubwira akagabanya imyenda yambaye niba yifubitse kugirango umuriro udakomeza kwiyongera, agafata agatambaro akagakoza mu mazi yakazuyazi agashyira kugahanga kugirango umuriro ugabanuke. Ikindi ni ukumupima malaria ukoresheje tederi wasanga ari positive ukamuha imiti ya malaria bine mu gitondo ibindi bine nimugoroba. Wasanga iri negative ukamugira inama yo kujya kwa muganga bakamufasha byisumbuyeho.
question_english: Good afternoon, a forty-five-year-old man came to me complaining of a fever. I measured his temperature and found it to be thirty-eight and a half degrees Celsius. He has had a cough for more than two weeks and is sweating excessively. I advised him to go to the hospital. What else can I do to help this man? Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umwana w'umuhungu w'imyaka itatu ibiro cumi na bitatu yaje afite umuriro umusatsi waracuramye. Namukoreye ikizamini kiba negatifu mwohereza kwa muganga. Nasubiye nyuma y'iminsi itatu nsanga umusatsi uracyacuramye mungire inama.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Nakiririye umwana w’umuhungu w’imyaka itatu upima ibiro cumi na bitatu wari ufite umuriro n’imisatsi yorohereye. Namukoreye ikizamini cyagaragaje ko ari nta kibazo, maze mwohereza ku bitaro. Nyuma y’iminsi itatu, narakurikiranye nsanga imisatsi ye icyorohereye. Niba umwana yaravuwe ku bitaro agasezererwa ariko agifite imisatsi yorohereye, inama yanjye ni ukureba niba afite amaguru, mu maso cyangwa inda byabyimbye, cyangwa niba yarananutse cyane, ashobora kuba arwaye kwashiorkor kandi akeneye kongererwa indyo yuzuye cyane cyane ibiribwa bikungahaye ku ntungamubiri ziva mu nyama, ibishyimbo, umwijima, ibinyampeke, ibiribwa bitanga ingufu, imboga n’imbuto, ndetse n’amazi meza. Gutoza ababyeyi gutegura indyo yuzuye ni ngombwa. Hanyuma gukurikirana umwana kugira ngo harebwe niba hari impinduka.
question_english: I received a three-year-old boy weighing thirteen kilograms who came in with a fever and brittle hair. I conducted a test that came back negative and referred him to the hospital. After three days, I followed up and found that his hair was still brittle. Please advise me on what to do next.

question_kinyarwanda: Umurwayi ufite imyaka mirongo itatu n'ibiri w'umuhungu. Afite imyaka mirongo itanu n'itatu. Yaje ataka umutwe ari no gutengurwa. Mufashe umuriro agira mirongo itatu n'umunani n'ibice bitanu. Mfashe tederi iba positifu, kandi arwara indwara y'igicuri aba ku miti. Kandi nge mfite sisi fuwa katere. Muha taransiferi. Mumfashe nari kumuha imiti kandi afata imiti y'igicuri?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Mfite umurwayi w’umugabo w’imyaka mirongo itatu n’ibiri. Yaje avuga ko afite umutwe n’isereri. Nafashe umuriro we, wari mirongo itatu n’umunani n'igice. Nakoresheje ikizamini cyihuse, cyagaragaje ko ari positif. Afite indwara y’igisusumizi kandi ari ku miti. Afite kandi inkorora ikomeye. Namuhaye urupapuro rwo kumwohereza. Ushobora kumfasha kumenya niba namuha imiti mu gihe ari ku miti y’igisusumizi? Igisubizo: Yego agomba gufata coartem 6\*4 nta kwivanga Mumugire inama yo gukomeza gufata imiti y’igisusumizi. Urupapuro rwo kumwohereza ni igihe agaragaza ibimenyetso by’uburemere gusa.
question_english: I have a thirty-two-year-old male patient. He has come complaining of a headache and dizziness. I have taken his temperature, and it was thirty-eight point five. I performed a rapid diagnostic test, and it was positive. He has epilepsy and is on medication. He also has a severe cough. I have given him a transfer. Can you help me decide if I should give him medication while he is on epilepsy medication?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umugore w'imyaka mirongo itatu n'umunani, arababara mu kiziba cy'inda, ababara n'umugongo, mubaza niba nta bundi burwayi ambwirako ntabwo. Usibye ko ibyo byatangiye igihe yabonezaga urubyaro, ni iki namufasha kugira ngo agire ubuzima bwiza ? Murakoze
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugore w'imyaka 38 ufite ububabare mu nda hasi no mu mugongo bwatangiye nyuma yo gukoresha uburyo bwo kuboneza urubyaro kandi nta bundi burwayi afite. Icyo ushobora gukora kugira ngo umufashe kugira ubuzima bwiza, ushobora kubanza kumubaza ubwoko bw'uburyo bwo kuboneza urubyaro yakoresheje, niba ari akuma ko mu mura (IUD) kuko ari ko gakunze gutera ububabare mu nda yo hasi no mu mugongo, ushobora kumwohereza kwa muganga kugira ngo yitabweho birushijeho. Kwa muganga, umukozi w'ubuzima azamuha imiti igabanya ububabare nka Ibuprofen mu gihe cy'iminsi nk'itanu kandi anakore isuzuma ry'inkari n'ibiva mu gitsina, kugira ngo harebwe niba nta ndwara zifata inzira y'inkari kuko nazo zishobora gutera ububabare mu nda yo hasi kandi zikaba zikunze kuboneka ku bantu bakoresha IUD. Niba ububabare bukomeza nyuma y'igihe runaka akoresha imiti igabanya ububabare, ushobora kumugira inama no kumufasha kubona ubundi buryo bwo kuboneza urubyaro.
question_english: I received a 38-year-old woman complaining of lower abdominal pain and back pain. When I asked if she had any other health conditions, she said no. However, she mentioned that these issues started when she began using contraceptives. What can I do to help her achieve good health? Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Umusore w'imyaka makumyabiri n'irindwi yagiye mu bitaro kubera uburwayi bwo mu mutwe. Baramuvuye arasezera ageze iwabo imiti bamuhaye kunywera mu rugo ntiyayinywa; bituma asubira inyuma kandi kumusubizayo ntibyoroshye kuko nta bushobozi iwabo bafite. Twamufasha gute?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umusore w'imyaka makumyabiri n'irindwi yagiye mu bitaro kubera uburwayi bwo mu mutwe. Wahagaritse imiti atarayimara. Hari icyo twamufasha nk'ubuvugizi bwimbitse bwibanze kuri sosiyete ngo imufashe Noneho no munzego zikwegereye bakaba bamuha uruhushya rwokwivuza akajya kubanza akabonana na muganga wo mu mutwe akamufasha bakamuha imiti imukwiye
question_english: A twenty-seven-year-old young man went to the hospital due to mental illness. He was treated and discharged, but when he got home, he did not take the medication he was given to use at home, which has led to a worsening of his condition, it is also difficult to readmit him because his family has no means. How can we help him?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umwana w'umuhungu umaze iminsi ibiri avutse; afite ibiro bine,arwaye inkorora n'ibicurane, nta bundi burwayi yavukanye. Namusuzumye nkoresheje tayima nsanga ari guhumeka inshuro mirongo itandatu n'eshanu ku munota, nemeje ko arwaye umusonga. Nemerewe kumuvura?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Uwo mwana w'iminsi ibiri mwohereze kwa muganga nibyo byiza. -Gira inama Maman we amwonse amujyane kwa muganga.
question_english: I received a baby boy who is two days old; he weighs four kilograms and has a cough and common cold, with no other congenital health issues. I examined him using a timer and found that he is breathing sixty-five times per minute, I confirmed that he has a pneumonia. Am I allowed to treat him?

question_kinyarwanda: Umugabo w'imyaka mirongo itatu n'umunani, bamuzanye ambwira bambwira yuko afite inkorora amaranye ibyumweru bibiri, ari kubabara umutwe, afite umuriro mwinshi. Mukoreye tederi nsanga nta malariya afite. Nabagiriye inama yo kumujyana kwa muganga ngo bamukurikirane barebe ko nta gituntu cyaba kirimo. Nababazaga nimba hari ikintu namukorera mbere y'uko agera ku ivuriro.Murakoze
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Tanga parasetamoro, babaze amateka y'uko yaba yarahuye na muganga w'igituntu, yirinde guhura n'abandi bantu, hanyuma ajyanwe kwa muganga kugira ngo hakorwe irindi suzuma no guhabwa imiti.
question_english: A thirty-eight-year-old man was brought to me, and they told me that he had been coughing for two weeks, has a headache, and a high fever. I conducted a rapid test and found that he doesn't have malaria. I advised them to take him to the hospital for further examination to check if it might be tuberculosis. I was asking if there is anything I could do for him before he reached the health facility. Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Mwiriwe neza, umukobwa w'imyaka cumi n'irindwi, afite ibiro mirongo itanu n'umunani, afite ikibazo cy'uko yafashwe ngufu, mubajije igihe bimaze bamufashe abwiye ko bimaze iminsi itatu. Mubwiye kujya ku kigo nderabuzima ajye kwisuzumisha yanze kujya yo, ngo iwabo batabimenya. Ubwo namufashije iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umukobwa w'imyaka 17 upima ibiro 58 yakorewe ihohoterwa rishingiye ku gitsina hashize iminsi itatu ariko yanga kujya kwa muganga kugira ngo umuryango we utabimenya. Uyu mwana yakozweho ihohoterwa rishingiye ku gitsina. Ugomba kumumenyesha ko uwamukoreye ihohoterwa agomba guhanwa kandi ko agomba kujya kwa muganga kugira ngo asuzumwe no kureba ibimenyetso by'ihohoterwa. Mwigishe ko ari ingenzi kujya kwa muganga nyuma yo gufatwa ku ngufu kugira ngo bapime indwara zandurira mu mibonano mpuzabitsina ashobora kuba yaranduye. Mwigishe ko niba akiri mu masaha 72 ari bwo ashobora guhabwa imiti yo kuboneza urubyaro yihutirwa kugira ngo yirinde gusama atateganyije, imiti yo kwirinda indwara zandurira mu mibonano mpuzabitsina, imiti yo kwirinda virusi itera SIDA, kandi ko gutinya ko umuryango we abimenya bishobora kumushyira mu kaga ko kwandura indwara zandurira mu mibonano mpuzabitsina, gusama atateganyije, cyangwa kwandura virusi itera SIDA. Mwigishe kujyana uwo mugabo ku buyobozi kugira ngo ahabwe ubutabera akwiye.
question_english: Good evening, a 17-year-old girl weighing 58 kilograms has a problem; she was sexually assaulted. When I asked her how long it had been since it happened, she told me it had been three days. I advised her to go to a health center for a medical check-up, but she refused, saying she did not want her family to know. What assistance did I provide to her?

question_kinyarwanda: Umugore w'imyaka mirongo itatu afite ibiro mirongo irindwi yaje kuboneza urubyaro afata microgen, namubajije ko nta kibazo afite ambwira ko afite uburwayi bwa diyabete. None namuha serivisi yo kuboneza urubyaro?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Oya, ntabwo wamuha ibyo binini byo kuboneza urubyaro kuko byongera umuvuduko w'isukali mu mubili ahubwo bigatuma diabete irushsho gukara. Ahubwo wamugira inama akajya kwa muganga bakamuha ibijyanye n'ubuzima afite.
question_english: A 30-year-old woman weighing 70 kilograms came for family planning and took Microgynon. When I asked if she had any health issues, she mentioned having diabetes. Should I provide her with family planning services?

question_kinyarwanda: Muraho! Nasuye Umugore ufite umwana w'umuhungu , ufite amezi cumi narindwi , ufite ibiro cumi na bibiri. Nasanze yarasubiye inyuma ku biro mubaza niba yararwaye , ambwira ko atarwaye. Muganirije mubaza niba amuha imfashabere akanamwonsa kenshi ku munsi , ambwira ko amugaburira ariko yamukuye kw’ibere. Mubwire uwo mubyeyi ni iyihe nama namugira?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze kuri iki kibazo mubajije cy'umugore ufite umwana w'umuhungu ufite amezi cumi n'arindwi, ufite ibiro cumi na bibiri. Kuba wasanze yarasubiye inyuma ku biro kandi atarigeze arwara, ariko nyina akaba yaramukuye ku ibere… Ubundi, kugira ngo umwana akure neza, bitangira akiri munda, aho umubyeyi yitaho ubuzima bwe mu gihe atwite. Iyo abyaye, agomba konsa neza byibuze amezi atandatu, umwana yonka ntakindi avangiwe, habe n’amazi, keretse ari umuti yandikiwe na muganga. Iyo yujuje amezi atandatu, atangira guhabwa imfashabere igizwe n’indyo yuzuye ikubiyemo ibitera imbaraga, ibyubaka umubiri, n’ibirinda indwara. Aha, umwana abanza konka, akagaburirwa nyuma kugeza agize umwaka. Naho nyuma y'umwaka, ukomeza kumwonsa ukanamugaburira, ariko ukita ku kumugaburira mbere yo konka kugeza byibuze yujuje imyaka ibiri. Ushobora no gukomeza kumwonsa n'iyo imyaka ibiri yarenga, kuko nta kibazo biteye. Uyu mubyeyi rero ntakwiye gukura umwana ku ibere ataruzuza byibura imyaka ibiri, kuko ibi bigira ingaruka ku mwana, nko gutakaza ibiro no kugabanyuka kw’ubwenge. Niba atari ikibazo cy’uburwayi cyabimuteye, wamugira inama yo gukomeza konsa umwana kugeza yujuje imyaka ibiri, ukamubwira akamaro kabyo, kandi ugakomeza gukurikirana niba abikora, kugira ngo umwana atazakomeza gusubira inyuma, bikaba byamuviramo imirire mibi. Murakoze!
question_english: Hello! I visited a woman with a 17-month-old boy who weighs 12 kilograms. I found that he had lost weight, and when I asked if he had been sick, she said no. I talked to her and asked if she was giving him supplementary food and breastfeeding him frequently, and she said she was feeding him but had weaned him off breastfeeding. What advice can I give this mother?

question_kinyarwanda: Umuryango ugizwe n'abantu batanu. Bafite abana babiri b'abahungu n'abandi babiri b'abakobwa. Abahungu babiri yabajyanye ku ishuri naho abakobwa babiri bo ntibiga. Nabajije uyu muryango impamvu batajyanye abana b'abakobwa ku ishuri, ambwira ko burya kubyara abakobwa ngo ni ugutemesha; ngo niyo mpamvu atigeze abashyira mu ishuri. Uyu muryango nawufasha nte?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Mwakoze gusura uyu muryango. \- Baganirize kuri gahunda y'uburinganire hagati y'ibitsina byombi ibyiza byayo, impamvu Leta yabihisemo, kandi ko ari gahunda iri guteza imbere igihugu. \- Baganirize kubyiza byo guha abana bose amahirwe n'ibibi byo kubima amahirwe, ubereke ko abo bakobwa wasanga aribo bashobora kubateza imbere kurusha abahungu rero bahabwe amahirwe angana. \- Bereke ibibi by'ubusumbane mu bana nitonesha ry'abana bamwe bagasiga abandi ko bitera imyiryane mu bana bikadindiza iterambere ry'umurayngo n'igihugu. \- Tanga raporo mu nzego z'ibanze na isange one stop center nabo bagufashe kuri uyu muryango \- Egera abo bana nabo ubaganirize bose bityo bo ntizabazabe nk'ababyeyi babo.
question_english: A family consists of five people. They have two boys and two girls. The two boys were taken to school, but the two girls do not attend school. When I asked the family why they didn’t send the girls to school, they told me that having girls is like having laborers, which is why they never sent them to school. How can I help this family?

question_kinyarwanda: Umukobwa w'imyaka mirongo itatu ibiro mirongo itandatu,yaje angana afite umuriro mirongo itatu na karindwi. Musuzumye, nsanga nta marariya afite ndetse ntana serivisi zo kuboneza urubyaro akoresha. Ese, hari ubundi bujyanama nari kumuha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umukobwa w'imyaka 30, ibiro 60kg. Afite umuriro 37. Bamupimye marariya basanga ntayo afite. Nta buryo bwo kuboneza urubyaro akoresha. Kuba marariya yabaye negative. Mushishikarize kunywa amazi ahagije, kuko umuriro ushobora gutera umwuma ukabije, niba ufite imiti y'umuriro muheho. Umukurikirane umenye ko atakomerejwe. Mugire inama yo kuruhuka bihagije, no kwiyitaho bihagije, no kurya indyo yuzuye. Muganirize kubijyanye no kuboneza urubyaro. Umupime urebe ko adatwite. Nusanga adatwite umwigishe uburyo butandukanye bwo kuboneza n'ibyiza byabyo.
question_english: A thirty-year-old woman weighing sixty kilograms came to me with a fever of thirty-seven degrees. Upon examination, I found she does not have malaria and is not using any family planning services. So, is there any other advice I could give her?

question_kinyarwanda: Mwaramutse, umubyeyi anzaniye umwana w'umuhungu ufite imyaka itatu, ambwira ko ari guhuhumeka cyane. Mushyizemo igipimo nsanga ari guhumeka inshuro mirongo ine. Muhaye ibinini by'umusonga, amogisi. Mubajije nimba nta bundi burwayi asanzwe agira abwiye ko ari ntabwo. None ubu uwo mubyeyi namufashe iki? Murakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umubyeyi anzanira umwana w'umuhungu w'imyaka itatu akambwira ko ahumeka cyane. Iyo murebye, nsanga ahumeka inshuro mirongo ine ku munota. Namuhaye amogisi. Urakoze ku byo wakoze ariko ibi ni ikimenyetso cy'uburwayi bukomeye. Birashoboka cyane ko ari boronkiyolitisi mu bana bato. Urashobora gukora tederi kugira ngo ukureho malariya. Niba hari imiti igabanya umuriro, urashobora kuyimuha. Ohereza umurwayi niba atagaragaza impinduka.
question_english: Good morning, a parent brings me a three-year-old boy and tells me that he is breathing heavily. When I check, I find that he is breathing forty times per minute. I give him asthma medication, amoxicillin. When I ask if he has any other underlying conditions, he says he does not. What else can I do to help this parent? Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Umugabo afite imyaka mirongo itatu, yafataga imiti igabanya ubukana bwa sida ageze aho arayihagarika, hashize ukwezi atangira kugira ikiziba kanwa akajya akorora igikorwa kivanze n'amaraso. Namugira inama? ki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugabo w'imyaka 30 yahagaritse gufata imiti igabanya ubukana bwa virusi itera SIDA (ART), nyuma y'ukwezi atangira kugira ibisebe mu kanwa bidakira, no gukorora ibimanyu by'amaraso byivanze n'ububore. Ni izihe nama namugira? Guhagarika gufata imiti igabanya ubukana bwa virusi itera SIDA (ART) bituma ubwinshi bwa virusi bwiyongera, umubare wa CD4 ugabanuka ndetse n'ubudahangarwa bugahungabana, bigatera indwara z'ibyuririzi zitera SIDA, indwara zikomeye ndetse n'urupfu. Abarwayi bacu bagira indwara z'ibyuririzi nka oral candidiasis, igituntu cyangwa pneumocystis Jiroveci pneumonia bishobora kuba bibi cyane. Guhugura abarwayi, kubaha ubufasha mu by'ubuzima bwo mu mutwe no mu mibanire ku bijyanye no gukomeza gufata imiti ni uburyo bw'ibanze bwo kubafasha ako kanya. Nyuma niba bemeye, babohereze ku bitaro kugira ngo bakorerwe isuzuma no kuvurwa izo ndwara z'ibyuririzi.
question_english: A 30-year-old man stopped taking antiretroviral therapy (ART) for HIV, and after a month, he started experiencing persistent mouth sores and coughing up mucus mixed with blood. What advice should I give him?

question_kinyarwanda: Mwiriwe neza! umugore w'imyaka makumyabiri nirindwi yapfushije umwana wumwaka umwe. Guhera ubwo rero yumva afite ubwoba, afite kwiheba ntabwo ashaka kwegerana n'abantu. Nabagisha inama y'icyo namufasha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugore w'imyaka 27 wabuze umwana we w'umwaka umwe yaje afite amarangamutima yo guhangayika, gutinya no kwigunga. Uyu murwayi ashobora kugira agahinda gakabije. Uyu murwayi ashobora kugira ihungabana riturutse ku byabaye. Ohereza ku bitaro kugira ngo ahabwe inama z'ubujyanama mu by'ubuzima bwo mu mutwe.
question_english: Good afternoon! A twenty-seven-year-old woman lost her one-year-old child. Since then, she feels anxious and scared, and she does not want to be around people. I would like your advice on how to help her.

question_kinyarwanda: Mwaramutse? Umubyeyi anzaniye umwana witemye ku kaboko, ari kuva amaraso menshi cyane, umwana ufite imyaka ibiri w'umukobwa, mubajije niba nta burwayi asanzwe afite ambwiye ko ari ntabwo, mwohereje kwa muganga yanga kujyayo. None umubyeyi namufasha iki? Murakoze!
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Mwaramutse neza! Iyo umwana afite igikomere ku mubiri, kandi amaraso akava menshi cyane, ni byiza ko bwihutirwa kugira icyo ukora. Nk'uko ubyanditse, imbogamizi ni uko umubyeyi w'umwana yanze kumujyana kwa muganga, kandi muri ubu buryo, igikomere gikomeye kigomba gufashwa vuba. Dore bimwe mu byingenzi wakora byiza Gufata icyemezo cyoguhagarika amaraso: Niba amaraso ari menshi, gerageza gukoresha igitambaro cyangwa ikindi kintu gikunze kuba gihari nka serviette, cyangwa ikindi gishobora gufasha guhagarika amaraso. Shyiraho igitambaro ku gice cy’akaboko aho amaraso arikuva hanyuma ukoreshe umwenda cyangwa ikindi kintu gishobora kubihagarika. Muri rusange, igikomere ku kaboko gishobora gukira neza mu gihe gifashwe hakiri kare, kandi kubyitaho ni ngombwa kugira ngo umwana adahura n'ingaruka zikomeye. Ni ingenzi ko umubyeyi yitabira kugana muganga no gushaka ubufasha bwihuse.
question_english: Good morning? A mother brought me a child who was cut on the arm, who was bleeding a lot, a two-year-old girl, when i asked her if she had any regular illnesses she told me that she did not, I sent her to the doctor and she refused to go there. So what can i help the mother? Thank you!

question_kinyarwanda: Mwiriwe neza! Umwana w'umusore w'imyaka cumi n'ibiri angezeho mbona arimo kurira cyane. Ambwira ko bari bari kurya we n'abavandimwe be, bakamumenaho isosi ishyushye y'inyama mu ijosi ndetse no mu gatuza, akaba yunutse ari kubabara cyane. Mubajije niba iwabo bari bahari, ambwira ko ntabari bahari, mubwira ko yitegura nkamujyana kwa muganga kuko iwabo batariyo. Muhaye transiferi, ndamuherekeje kwa muganga. Ese uyu mwana hari ubundi bufasha namuha? Murakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umuhungu w’imyaka cumi n’ibiri yaje ansanga arira cyane. Yasobanuye ko ubwo we na bashiki be bari bari kurya, basutse isosi y’inyama ishyushye ku ijosi no ku gituza, bikamubabaza cyane. Igihe namubazaga niba ababyeyi be bari mu rugo, yambwiye ko batari bahari.  Namubwiye ko yitegura kugira ngo njyane kwa muganga, kuko ababyeyi be batari bahari. Namufashije kugera kwa muganga kandi ndamuherekeza. Hari ubundi bufasha nshobora guha uyu mwana? Murakoze. Uyu mwana yakomeretse ku ijosi no ku gituza kubera ubushye, arimo kubabara cyane, ahakomeretse hashobora kwandura, gukomera kw’aho hashye no kubura amazi bitewe n’ubuso bw’ahakomeretse.  Mushishikarize kunywa amazi no kurya, muhe imiti ibabaza iriho, niba afite ibisebe byuzuye amazi, ntuzabikoreho kandi umujyane kwa muganga kugira ngo ahabwe imiti ibabaza, imiti yica udukoko, kwita ku bikomere no kubipfuka, ndetse no gukora imyitozo y’ijosi kugira ngo hatabaho gukomera kw’aho hashye.  Mushishikarize kurya ibiryo bikungahaye kuri poroteyine kugira ngo ibikomere bikire vuba.
question_english: Hello! A twelve-year-old boy came to me crying a lot. He explained that while he and his siblings were eating, they spilled hot meat sauce on his neck and chest, which left him in a lot of pain. When I asked if his parents were home, he told me they were not. I instructed him to get ready so I could take him to the hospital, since his parents were not around. I facilitated his transfer and accompanied him to the hospital. Is there any additional support I can offer this child? Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umubyeyi w'umugabo, ufite imyaka mirongo ine nirindwi. Yari ari kuri moto yitura hasi akomereka ukuguru. Nabazaga muganga , ni iki nafasha uwo murwayi kugirango abone imiti?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Uwo murwayi wamufasha kugera kukigonderabuzima kugirango bamufashe, barebe niba ntamvune yagize ndetse naho yakomeretse bahapfuke Kandi ahabwe n'imiti.
question_english: I received a forty-seven-year-old man who had fallen off a motorcycle and injured his leg. I asked the doctor what I can do to assist the patient in getting medication.

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umwana w'umukobwa afite imyaka icumi ; afite umuriro wa mirongo itatu na karindwi n'ibice bitanu; awumaranye iminsi ibiri. Afite ibiheri ku mubiri wose; arababara amaso. Namugiriye inama yo kumujyana kwa muganga. Ndabaza muganga niba hariyindi miti yafata cyangwa niba hari ibindi bipimo yatanga?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze. \- Mufatire TDR. \- Mubaze niba afata imiti y'inzoka buri mezi atatu nk'uko bigenwe. \- Mubaze niba hari abandi bana bagenzi be bafite icyo kibazo. IBINDI WAKORA: \- Ntiyegere abandi bana wasanga iyo ndwara yanduza. \- Najye kwa muganga. \- Bigishe isuku n'indyo yuzuye n'izindi nama zo kubungabunga ubuzima bwiza.
question_english: I received a ten-year-old girl; she has a fever of thirty-seven point five degrees Celsius and has had it for two days. She has rashes all over her body and she is experiencing pain in her eyes. I advised her to go to the hospital. I am asking the doctor if there is any other medication she can take or if there are other tests that can be done.

question_kinyarwanda: Mwiriwe, nakiriye umwana w'umukobwa afite imyaka ine n'amezi umunani, umubyeyi we ambwiye ko umwana afite ikibazo cyo kuruka ibyo aribyo byose. Mubajije igihe bimaze, ambwira ko ari iminsi itatu. Mubajije niba nta bundi burwayi asanganywe, ambwira ko ntabwo. Mufashe MIWAKE, nsanga afite cumi nagatatu. Ese ko nsanzwe ngiye gutanga ibinini by'inzoka, muhaye albendazole hari icyo byaba bitwaye? Nabazaga niba nta bindi namufasha cyangwa se nta bundi bufasha namuha. murakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Turabashimira ubwitange mugira mu kwita kubarwayi, murakoze kutubaza ubundi bufasha mwaha uwo mwana ufite ikibazo cyo kuruka ibyo ariye byose, mupima umuriro urebe ko nta muriro winshi afite, niba afite umuriro mwinshihi, mupimishe tederi urebe niba adafite malaria, si ngombwa kumuha albendazole utazi ikintu kiri kumutera kuruka cyane ko niba ari kuruka buri kimwe nayo yayiruka muhe transiferi ajye ku kigo nderabuzima kimwegereye bamuhe ubufasha bwisumbuye.
question_english: Good evening, I received a 4-year and 8-month-old girl whose parent told me she vomits everything she eats or drinks. When I asked how long it had been happening, they said three days. I also asked if the child had any other pre-existing conditions, and they said no. I measured her MUAC (Middle Upper Arm Circumference) and found it to be 13 cm. Since I am planning to give deworming tablets, I was wondering if giving her albendazole would be appropriate. Is there any other support or treatment I could provide?

question_kinyarwanda: Umugore w'imyaka mirongo itanu n’umwe, ibiro ni mirongo itandatu na bine, aje afite umuriro mwinshi ababara mu nda n'umutwe. Mupimya umuriro nsanga ni mirongo itatu n’umunani n'ibice bitandatu. Mupimye malariya nsanga ntayo afite. Mubajije niba nta bundi burwayi asanganywe ambwira ko ntayo. Namuha ubuhe bufasha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Uwo mubyeyi wamufasha kugabanya umuriro ukoresheje agatambaro gasa neza gotose, ubundi ukamuha taransiferi akajya kwa muganga bakabasha kumwitaho.
question_english: A fifty-one-year-old woman weighing sixty-four kilograms has come with a high fever, abdominal pain, and headache. I have measured her temperature and found it to be thirty-eight point six degrees. I have tested her for malaria and found she does not have it. When I have asked if she has any other pre-existing conditions, she has told me she does not. What assistance should I provide her?

question_kinyarwanda: Mwaramutse umuntu w’umubyeyi anzananiye umwana ufite imyaka itatu ambwirako afite malariya kubera afite umuriro. Mushyizemo igipimo nsanga igipimo kiri gupima mirongo itatu na gatanu, nsanga kiri gupima mirongo itatu na gatanu, mubajije ko nta bundi burwayi afite ambwiraye ko ari ntabwo. None umubyeyi namufasha iki? Murakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umwana ufite imyaka itatu, afite malariya kubera afite umuriro. Mushyizemo igipimo nsanga igipimo kiri gupima mirongo itatu na gatanu. Urasuzuma umwana neza usobanurire mama byimbitse ko harigihe indwara zimwe na zimwe nka infegisiyo zishobora kwerekana umuriro cyangwa zikerekana ubukonje hypothermia. Rero urafasha mama w'umwana kumworosa no kumufubika no kumurinda ubukonje. Ubundi ube wamwohereza kwamuganga niba ubonako umwana anegekaye
question_english: Good morning! A parent brought their three-year-old child to me, saying the child has malaria due to a fever. I took a test, and the result showed a reading of thirty-five. When I asked if the child had any other illness, the parent said no. What can I do to help the parent? Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Umugabo w'imyaka makumyabiri numunani, ibiro mirongo irindwi afite umuriro wa mirongo itatu numunani n'ibice bitanu ari kubabara mu mihogo ari guhitwa cyane kandi kenshi yacitse intege yasheshe ibiheri ari kuva amaraso mu myenge yumubiri nta burwayi yari asanganwe. Namubwiye ko uburwayi bushobora kuba ari ibimenyetso bya mabaga mugira inama yo kwambara agapfukamunwa, akiha akato mubwira ko agomba no kwirinda gukora ingendo. Mbwira abagize umuryango gukaraba kenshi amazi n'isabune kwirinda kumukoraho no gusiga intera ya metero imwe hagati ye arabyanga ngo yaba ari ukumuha akato. Mungire inama y'icyo nabakorera.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugabo w'imyaka 28, ufite ibiro 70, afite umuriro wa dogere mirongo itatu n'umunani n'igice, aribwa mu muhogo, arahitwa cyane kandi kenshi, acika intege, yasheshe uduheri ku mubiri, kandi arava amaraso mu myenge yose y'umubiri nta ndwara yari asanzwe afite. Indwara ishobora kuba ibimenyetso by'indwara yandura. Igishe abantu uko birinda kandi barinda abandi indwara zandura no kubahiriza ingamba zose zo kwirinda kwandura.
