Mugire inama yo kwambara agapfukamunwa, kwishyira mu kato, unamubwire ko agomba no kwirinda gukora ingendo. Ubwire abo mu muryango we gukaraba intoki kenshi n'amazi n'isabune, bakirinda kumukoraho, no gusiga intera ya metero imwe hagati yabo na we hanyuma umurwayi akanywa amazi menshi.
question_english: A twenty-eight-year-old man, weighing seventy kilograms, has a fever of thirty-eight point five degrees, is experiencing throat pain, coughing severely and frequently, has become weak, has developed rashes, and is bleeding from body openings without any pre-existing conditions. I told him that the illness could be symptoms of a contagious disease, advised him to wear a mask, isolate himself, and informed him that he should also avoid traveling. I told the family members to wash their hands frequently with water and soap, avoid touching him, and maintain a one-meter distance from him, but he refused, saying it would be isolating him. Advise me on what I can do for them.

question_kinyarwanda: Mwiriwe neza. Inzoka iriye umwana w'umukobwa w'imyaka cumi n'itatu mu kiganza. Mfashe igitambaro muzirika hejuru ku kiganza aho yamuriye, kugira ubumara budakwirakwira hose. Ni ubuhe bundi butabazi bw'ibanze namuha? Murakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: umwana w'umukobwa w'imyaka cumi n'itatu yarumwe n'inzoka mu kiganza. Mfashe igitambaro muzirika hejuru ku kiganza. Ni byiza ko wamuziritse hejuru ku kiganza yaho yarumwe Ariko haribundi bufasha wamuha Mubuze kuzunguza igice cyarumwe Shyira igice cyarumwe hasi Mukarume kubera hari ububabare afite Hanyuma ukureho imyanda aho yarumwe Hanyuma wihutire kumujyana kwa muganga
question_english: Good afternoon. A snake bit a thirteen-year-old girl onto the palm. I took the cloth and tie above the palm where it bit her, to prevent the venom from spreading everywhere. What other first aid can I give her? Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Umurwayi afite imyaka ine, ibiro icyenda ni umuhungu akaba abyimbye ibirenge, umusatsi waracuramye, akaba nta bundi burwayi yari asanganywe, mupimye mowake nsanga afite cumi na rimwe; ari mu mirire mibi, nabagiriye inama yo kumuha imbuto n'imboga n'ibikomoka ku matungo. None nta bundi bufasha yakenera ngo ave mu mirire mibi?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umuhungu w'imyaka 4 upima ibiro 9 ibirenge bye byabyimbye n'imisatsi ye yaracuramye, nta zindi ndwara afite, ikizigira cy'akaboko ni 11 bigaragaza imirire mibi. Niba afite apeti, gira inama ababyeyi be yo kumuha indyo yuzuye, kandi bashake inama y'inyongera ku muntu w'inzobere mu mirire ku kigo nderabuzima kibegereye cyangwa umuntu ushinzwe imibereho myiza y'abana n'iterambere ryabo mu murenge wanyu.
question_english: The patient is a four-year-old boy weighing nine kilograms, and his feet are swollen. His hair is thinning, and he did not have any underlying health conditions. When I measured his weight, I found he was eleven kilograms, indicating poor nutrition. I advised the parents to give him fruits, vegetables, and animal products. Is there any other help he might need to overcome his malnutrition?

question_kinyarwanda: Umukobwa w'imyaka cumi n'itanu, yaje ambwira ko aribwa mu Kiziba cy'inda cyane. Mubaza igihe aherukira mu mihango ambwira ko amaze amezi atatu atayibona. mpimye tesIte de gorosese nsanga ntatwite ariko arababara cyane. Mugira inama yo kujya kwa muganga ambwira ko iwabo bataragura mituweli. Twamufasha gute?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze cyane -Uwo mukobwa wasanga afite ikibazo gikomeye cyane nka infection, gutwita n'ubwo utabibonye cg izindi ndwara. -Nimumujyane kwa muganga,hamagara iwabo bihutire kwishyura mutuel.
question_english: A fifteen-year-old girl came to me and told me that she has severe pain in her lower abdomen. When I asked her when she last had her period, she told me that it has been three months since she had it. I tested her for pregnancy and found that she is not pregnant, but she is in a lot of pain. I advised her to go to the hospital, but she told me that her family has not yet purchased health insurance. How can we help her?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umugabo w'imyaka mirongo itatu afite ibiro mirongo itandatu, afite umuriro wa mirongo ine. Amaze iminsi ibiri afashwe. Nta bundi burwayi afite. Namukoreye tederi, nsanga afite malariya. None imiti yanshiranye. Mukorere iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugabo w'imyaka 30 ufite ibiro 60 yaje afite umuriro wa 40 kandi tederi yerekanye ko arwaye ariko umujyanama w'ubuzima nta miti afite. Biragaragara ko umurwayi afite malariya. Hita uvura umuriro ukoresheje imiti igabanya umuriro nka parasitamoro. Ntutinde, muhe kowariteme ibinini 4 kabiri ku munsi mu minsi itatu ikurikiranye. Niba nta kowariteme ufite, saba umujyanama w'ubuzima hafi aho kugufasha. Niba bidashoboka, ohereza umurwayi ku kigo nderabuzima kugira ngo avurwe. Bigishe uburyo bwose bwo kwirinda malariya.
question_english: I received a thirty-year-old man weighing sixty pounds who has a fever of forty degrees Celsius. He was diagnosed two days ago and has no other diseases. I performed a rapid diagnostic test and confirmed he has malaria, but I don't have medication. What can I do for him?

question_kinyarwanda: Muraho neza, nd’umugore w'imyaka mirongo irindwi n'ibiri, mpima ibiro mirongo itanu n’icyenda. Nagize ingorane nkuka amenyo yose, none kugira ngo mbashe kurya, nukubinombanombera. Ese Iyo nombe ihoraho ntabwo yatera umuntu inzoka?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Uyu ni umugore ufite imyaka 72, afite ibiro 59 kandi nta menyo afite kandi akoresha amenyo mu guhekenya. Afite ikibazo cyo guhekenya kubera guta amenyo. Gukoresha ishinya mu guhekenya ntibizatera inyo mu mubiri we. Ikizamuviramo udusebe mu mubiri ni ukurya ibiryo byanduye birimo amagi y'inzoka zikuze.
question_english: Hello, I am a 72-year-old woman, weighing 59 kilograms. I have been experiencing difficulty chewing due to tooth loss, so I have to use my gums to eat. Does persistent gum use lead to worms in the body?

question_kinyarwanda: umugore ufite imyaka mirongo itatu n'itatu, upima ibiro mirongo itandatu na birindwi, aje kwivuza,ambwira ko amaze ukwezi akonje, yumva ko adashaka umugabo we. Mubajije uburyo akoresha aboneza urubyaro, ambwira ko akoresha agapira k'imyaka itatu kandi ngo amazemo umwaka umwe, ambwira ko nta bundi burwayi asanganywe. Muhaye taransiferi(transfeur). Mumfashe, ubwo hari ikindi kintu namukorera?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugore w'imyaka 33, upima ibiro 67, yaje gushaka inama z'ubuvuzi. Ambwira ko amaze ukwezi yumva akonje kandi atakifuza umugabo we. Igihe namubazaga ku ikoreshwa ry’uburyo bwo kuboneza urubyaro, yavuze ko amaze umwaka akoresha IUD (igikoresho gishyirwa mu mura), gikoreshwa imyaka itatu. Avuga kandi ko nta bindi bibazo by’ubuzima azwiho. Igisubizo: Mumusuzume neza niba twiteguye mbere yo gukora imibonano mpuzabitsina. Mubaze niba nta makimbirane afitanye n’umugabo we cyangwa niba atarimo kwiheba. Mushishoze niba atari indwara zandura. Agomba koherezwa kureba muganga kugira ngo hakorwe iperereza ryimbitse no kumuvura.
question_english: A 33-year-old woman, weighing 67 kilograms, comes to seek medical advice. She tells me that she has been feeling cold for a month and no longer desires her husband. When I asked her about contraceptive use, she mentioned that she has been using an IUD (intrauterine device) for a year, which is effective for three years. She also says she has no other known health issues. After giving her a transfer (referral), what else can I do for her?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umugabo ufite imyaka mirongo ine n'itatu, afite ibiro mirongo irindwi, afite umuriro wa mirongo ine, asanzwe afite ubwandu bw'agakoko gatera sida. Namukoreye tederi(TDR), nsanga afite malariya. Ubwo namuha indi miti ya malariya, afata imiti y'ubwandu bw'agakoko gatera sida?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugabo w'imyaka mirongo ine n'itatu, ibiro mirongo irindwi, akaba afite umuriro. Tederi yabaye pozitifu. Asanzwe afata imiti igabanya ubukana bw'agakoko ka sida. Ubufash**​**a: Ntaco bitwaye m**​**uhe coartem na paracetamol, akomeze n'imiti ye asanzwe afata.
question_english: I received a 43-year-old man weighing 70 kilograms, with a temperature of 40°C. He is known to be HIV positive. I performed a rapid diagnostic test (TDR) and found that he has malaria. Should I giver him anti_Malaria drugs when he is taking HIV medication?

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'umuhungu w'imyaka cumi n'itandatu yangezeho angisha inama y'ibyamubayeho ambwira ko yateye umukobwa inda, nawe ukiri muto w'imyaka cumi n'itanu mubaza impamvu yishoye muri ayo mahano igihe kitaragera, kandi ingaruka zikaba zigiye kumubana nyinshi. Namubajije niba yarabibwiye ababyeyi arampakanira ko atarihingatsa, yewe n'umukobwa ntiyigeze abwira ababyeyi ko atwite, ni ibanga ryabo hagati yabo kandi umuhungu yambwiye ko atiteguye gutunga urugo. Mubwira ko agomba kwegera ababyeyi akababwira ibyamubayeho, agasaba imbabazi imiryango bakareba uko bigenza, aba bana bombi bakabafasha kuva mu kibazo bagiyemo, umwana uzavuka akarererwa mu muryango igihe cyazagera bakazabana bagejeje imyaka. Umuhungu yambwiye ko umwanzuro yawufashe azatoroka. Ndagikemura mbigenze nte?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Ushobora kumugira inama ko n'ubwo yahunga atari igisubizo cyiza ku kibazo. Akwiye gusaba imbabazi no gukemura ikibazo n'umuryango.
question_english: A sixteen-year-old boy came to me seeking advice about what had happened to him, telling me that he had impregnated a girl, who is also young, aged fifteen. I asked him why he engaged in such acts at an inappropriate time, considering the many consequences he would face. I asked him if he had told his parents, and he denied it, saying he had not confessed, and even the girl had not told her parents that she was pregnant. It was a secret between them, and the boy told me he was not ready to support a family. I told him that he must approach his parents and tell them what had happened, ask for forgiveness from the families, and they should figure out how to handle the situation, helping both children out of the problem they are in, and the child to be born should be raised within the family until the time comes when they are of age to live together. The boy told me that he had decided to run away. How should I resolve this?

question_kinyarwanda: Natanze ikiganiro mu baturage ku ndwara y'icyorezo cy'ubushita bw'inkende, mbagaragariza uko ifata nuko bayirinda na bo bafata ingamba z'uko bagiye kuyirinda. Nabazaga niba hari ikindi nari kubafasha.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Natanze ikiganiro mu baturage ku bijyanye n’icyorezo cy'ubushita bw'inkende, nsobanura uko cyandura n’uburyo bwo kukirinda, kandi nabo bafashe ingamba z’uburyo bazakirinda. Bagomba kandi gutanga amakuru ku gihe niba hari ukekwaho kuba yaranduye. Icy'ingenzi ni itumanaho, ubufatanye, no gukorera hamwe.
question_english: I gave a talk to the community about the monkeypox epidemic, explaining how it spreads and how to prevent it, and they also took measures on how they would prevent it. I asked if there was anything else I could help them with.

question_kinyarwanda: Umukobwa w'imyaka makumyabiri n'umwe aje ambwira ko ashaka kuboneza urubyaro mubwiye ko batangirira kwa muganga, ambwira ko niba atari njye ndamukorera ntabwo arajyayo. Namuha ubuhe bufasha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Ndumva ubufasha wamuha bwa mbere nuko wakwitanga ukamuherekeza noneho ukavugana na muganga nawe akaza kumwakirira mu cyumba cy' urubyiruko ukamubwira ko ari ibanga kandi ko ntawe uzabimenya rwose.
question_english: A 21-year-old girl came to me and told me she wants to take a contraception . I told her that they start at the hospital, but she told me that if I am not the one to help her, she will not go there. What help can I give her?

question_kinyarwanda: Mwiriwe neza. Umusore w'imyaka makumyabiri n'itandatu ufite ibiro mirongo itanu na bibiri. Amanutse mu giti cy'amapera yari yuriye ari kurya amapera, abanza umutwe hasi. Arimo kuva amaraso mu kanwa no mu mazuru, ntarimo kuvuga. Mpamagaye ambulance imbwira ko iribuhagere mu isaha imwe n'igice. Nabazaga, ese hari ubufasha naha uyu mwana w'umusore? murakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Uyu musore w'imyaka makumyabiri n'itandatu ufite ibiro mirongo itanu na bibiri. Umanutse mu giti cy'amapera yari yuriye ari kurya amapera, abanza umutwe hasi. Arimo kuva amaraso mu kanwa no mu mazuru, ntarimo kuvuga. Haricyo waba umufashije mu gihe ambulance itaraza mu isaha; Gerageza kumusukura n'agatambaro keza na mazi. Nurangiza ugabanye kuva kwa kw'amaraso. Umupfuke ahari igikomere hanyuma uhamagare iyo ambulance
question_english: Good evening. A twenty-six-year-old young man weighing fifty-two kilograms has fallen from a guava tree he has climbed while eating guavas, landing headfirst. He is bleeding from the mouth and nose and is not speaking. I have called an ambulance, and they have told me it will arrive in an hour and a half. I am asking if there is any help I can give this young man. Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Muraho, nasuye umugore avuye kubyara ku nshuro ya kane abyaye. Mubaza ko yateganije gahunda yo kuboneza urubyaro, ambwira ko azaboneza hashize umwaka. Ambwira ko iyo umuntu amaze kubyara atahita asama musobanuriye ko agomba guhita anboneza kuko yasama. Mungire inama namugira.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Muraho, nasuye umugore uherutse kubyara umwana we wa kane. Igihe namubazaga niba yarateganyije gahunda yo kuboneza urubyaro, yambwiye ko azabitangira nyuma y'umwaka umwe. Yavuze ko umuntu atashobora gusama ako kanya nyuma yo kubyara. Igisubizo R/ Mumusobanurire ko ashobora gusama, kandi mumugire inama yo gutangira gahunda yo kuboneza urubyaro ako kanya.
question_english: Hello, I visited a woman who had just given birth to her fourth child. When I asked if she had planned for family planning, she told me she would start after one year. She mentioned that a person cannot conceive immediately after giving birth, but I explained to her that she could conceive and advised her to start family planning right away. What advice can I give her?

question_kinyarwanda: Umugore ufite imyaka mirongo itatu, afite ibiro mirongo itanu bitandatu umuriro wa mirongo itatu n numunani arwaye covid. Yabibwiwe na muganga bamukurikiranye. Ngiye kureba ko yemeye kuguma mu kato, ambwira ko agumye mu kato abana be batabona icyo barya. namufasha iki kindi?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugore afite imyaka 30, afite ibiro 56kgs, umuriro wa 38°, covid-19 positive. Ubufasha: Gutanga ubusobanuro buhagije ku murwayi, nkamwereka ingaruka ubu burwayi butera aramutse asubiye mu rugo adakize, kuko ashobora kwanduza abo mu rugo rwe. Kumuha umwanya wo kuganira n'umuganga ushinzwe ihungabana ryo mu mutwe, akamuganiriza bihagije, bityo bigatuma asobanukirwa bihagije uburwayi afite n’ingaruka bitera. Gusaba umurwayi gukomeza imiti ya covid-19, akazataha akize.
question_english: A thirty-year-old woman, weighing fifty-six kilograms, has a fever of thirty-eight and is suffering from COVID. She was told by her doctor to stay in quarantine. She mentioned that if she stayed in quarantine, her children would not have anything to eat. What else can I help her with?

question_kinyarwanda: Umadamu w'imyaka mirongo itandatu , afite ibiro mirongo itanu na bitanu , yaje angana ambwira yuko afite isereri kandi ari kubara umutwe cyane. Mubajije niba hari ubundi burwayi asanganywe, ambwira ko arwara umuvuduko w'amaraso. Namubajije niba asanzwe afata imiti kwa muganga , ambwira ko atari yafata imiti yabaye abyihoreye. Ni ubuhe bujyanama mwampa ngo mpe uwo murwayi?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze kubaza iki ikibazo cy,uyu mudamu w, imyaka mirongo itandatu,ufite Ibiro mirongo itanu na bitanu,yaje agusanga akubwira ko isereri Kandi Ari kubabara umutwe. Umubajije niba hari ubundi burwayi asanganywe, akubwira ko arwara umuvuduko w,amaso.Umubajije niba asanzwe afata imiti,akubwira ko atari yafata imiti yabaye abyihoreye.ukaba ubaza ubujyanama twaguha ngo uhe uwo murwayi. Nibyo koko uyu mudamu ufite ikibazo cy, isereri no kubabara umutwe akeneye inama,Kuko indwara y, umuvuduko w, amaraso itera ibibazo byinshi ku muntu udafata imiti Kandi ntiyubahirize amabwiriza ya Muganga.  Kuko uyi ndwara y, umuvuduko w, amaraso,iba iterwa nuko umutima uba utabona amaraso ahagije awujyamo ngo yuzuze ibyumba byawo biwugize,bigasaba ko utera inshuro nyinshi zirengeje izisanzwe kugirango haboneke amaraso akwiye. -Bishobora guterwa n,umuntu ufite ibinure byinshi ku nyama zigize umutima,bikabangamira umutima gutera,ariyo mpamvu amavuta atari meza k'umuntu kurwara umuvuduko. -Bishobora guterwa n,imitsi ijyana amaraso n,iyavanayo biba byarakwedutse,kdi nubushobozi bw iyo mitsi bwaratakaje imbaraga bitewe n,imyaka y ubukure,bityo nabyo bikaba byatera umuvuduko w,amaraso. Bishobora guterwa n,undi burwayi butandukanye,butera imitsi y, amaraso kuziba,nabyo bikaba byatera umuvuduko w, amaraso ndetse n,ibindi. Iyo umuntu afite iki ikibazo cy, umuvuduko w, amaraso,akunda kugira ibimenyetso bitandukanye,harimo isereri nyinshi no kuribwa umutwe nibindi. Iyo umunyu urwaye umuvuduko w, amaraso afashe imiti neza,akubahiriza inama ahawe na muganga.Urugero: -Kunywa amazi menshi Kandi meza -Gukora siporo kugirango imitsi izibuke. \_Kurya umunyu mucye cyangwa ku wuhagarika mugihe wabisabwe na Muganga. -Kurya amavuta make cyangwa kuyahagarika mu gihe wabisabwe na Muganga. Ubufasha waha uyu mudamu, musobanurire ibi byose byavuzwe haruguru,umuhe taransiferi imujyana ku kigo Nderabuzima byihutirwa kugirango asuzumwe hakiri kare,ahabwe imiti. Murakoze.
question_english: A 60-year-old woman weighing 55 kilograms came to me complaining of dizziness and severe headaches. When I asked if she had any other illnesses, she told me that she has high blood pressure. I asked if she was taking any medication for it, and she said she had stopped taking her medication. What advice can I give this patient?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umubyeyi w'umugabo ufite imyaka mirongo irindwi nine, yari avuye kunywera ahantu inzoga ageze mu rugo aranyerera yikubita hasi kuri sima, ava amaraso menshi. Nabazaga muganga niki nafasha uwo murwayi kugira abone imiti?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Fata agatambaro gafite isuku umuhambire kugirango ye gukomeza kuvirirana hanyuma umwohereze kwa muganga bamuhe ubufasha bwihutirwa.
question_english: I received a seventy-nine-year-old man who had come home from a bar. He slipped and fell on the cement, bleeding profusely. I asked the doctor what I could do to help the patient get the medicine.

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'umukobwa ufite imyaka ine, afite ibiro cumi na bibiri na muwake cumi na gatanu, arahitwa inshuro eshanu ku munsi, abimaranye umunsi umwe, nta bundi burwayi asanzwe afite. Ndebye mu bubiko bw'imiti nsanga hasigayemo mike. None ndamufasha nte?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Nubwo umwana atabimaranye igihe, ni ukumufasha atararemba. Ubwo rero ni ukumuha zenke, ndetse ukamuha na ORS kugira ngo atabasha kugira umwuma.
question_english: A 4-year-old girl, weighing 12 kg with a MUAC of 15 cm, has been experiencing diarrhea five times a day for one day. She has no other underlying illnesses. Checking the medication stock, I found it is very limited. How can I assist her?

question_kinyarwanda: Mwirewe neza, umusore w'imyaka makumya nitatu bamurohoye mu mazi yamize amazi menshi. Mbanje kumva ko umutima utera, nsanze uri gutera. Mukanze mu nda mufasha kugarura amazi. Ni ubuhe bundi butabazi namuba? murakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Ubundi bufasha wamuha nukumwohereza kwa muganga bakareba ko nta kindi kibazo afite. Niba wakanze neza ukabona amazi yashizemo. Ubundi umuhe ibyo kunywa, kandi umuhumurize umubwire ko aribukire nta kibazo
question_english: good afternoon, a twenty-three-year-old youth was rescued from drowning water has swallowed much water. I firstly heard if his heart was beating, i found that it is beating. I press in his abdomen to help restore water out. What other aid am i to give him? Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Mwamutse neza, umukecuru w'imyaka mirongo itandatu n’ibiri afite ibiro mirongo itandatu na bitanu, afite ikibazo cyo gukorora cyane agacira amaraso. Mubajije igihe inkorora ayimaranye ambwiye ko ayimaranye ibyumweru bitatu, mwohereje ku kigo nderabuzima yanze kujyayo. Ubwo namufasha iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: birasaba kumwigisha cyane warangiza ukanamuherekeza kugira ngo abashe kujya gutanga igikororwa barebe niba nta gituntu afite bityo abashe guhabwa ubuvuzi
question_english: Good morning, a sixty-two-year-old woman with sixty-five kilogrammes, has a problem of hemoptysis. When i asked her how long she has had a cough, she told me that she had it for three weeks. I give her a transfer letter to the health center and she refused to go there. What could I help her?

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'umuhungu w'imyaka icyenda yaje kwivuza afite umuriro, Mufatiye tederi(TDR) nsanga ni positifu kandi nta miti mfite. ndamufasha iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze kumwakira. -Mufashe kubona umuti ugabanya umuriro, -Mwohereze ku kigo nderabuzima bamufashe kubona imiti, -Mwigishe uburyo bwose bwo kwirinda malaria we n'umuryango we, -Kora iyo raporo uyohereze ku babishinzwe bagufashe ntuzongere kugira ikibazo cyo kubura imiti.
question_english: A nine-year-old boy came for treatment with a fever. I tested him with a rapid diagnostic test (RDT), and it was positive, but I do not have any medication available. How can I assist him?

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana ufite imyaka ine n'amezi atatu w'umukobwa,afite ibiro cumi na bine. Yangeze imbere afite umuriro mwinshi ku gipimo cya mirongo itatu n'icyenda. Musuzumye mbona arikanga ubusa kandi ashikagurika ndetse anahondobera, kandi nta kintu na kimwe yabasha kurya cyangwa kunywa. Muha umuti ugabanya umuriro, mwohereza ku ivuriro. Ese n'ubuhe bufasha uwo mwana yahabwa?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umukobwa w’imyaka ine n’amezi atatu apima ibiro cumi na bine. Yaje angana afite umuriro mwinshi wa dogere mirongo itatu n’icyenda (39°C). Ibi bishobora kuba ari malariya isanzwe. * Fata ikizamini cya malariya (TDR) n’ikizamini cya VIH. * Fata ibipimo bya timer. * Muhe imiti igabanya umuriro (*antipyretics*). Niba malariya ibonetse ari positive, ayivurwe uko bikwiye. Niba TDR ari negative, ashobora koherezwa kwa muganga kugira ngo akomeze gukurikiranwa no kuvurwa.
question_english: A four-year-old and three-month-old girl weighs fourteen kilograms. She came to me with a high fever of thirty-nine degrees. Upon examination, I noticed she was easily startled, trembling, and she was dozing. She could not eat or drink anything. I gave her fever-reducing medication and referred her to the clinic. What kind of help can be provided to this child?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umurwayi w'igitsina gore, afite imyaka cumi n'itatu, afite ibiro mirongo itatu na bibiri, yaturutse mu mudugudu w'umukamba. Ibimenyetso afite: ababara umutwe, kubabara mu ngingo, afite umuriro mwinshi. Isuzuma nakoze nkoresheje terimometere, umuriro nasanze ari mirongo itatu n'icyenda n'ibice bine. Nsuzuma amaraso nkoresheje tesite rapide, ibisubizo ni negatifu, mubajije uburwayi asanganywe ambwira ko afite virusi itera sida. Ikibazo mbaza, ni irihe suzuma risumbyeho yakorerwa? Ese yahabwa imiti ingana iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Urakoze kubaza ikibazo cy’umurwayi wakiriye. Afite imyaka 15, apima ibiro 32, yaje afite ibimenyetso byo kubabara umutwe no mu ngingo, ndetse afite umuriro mwinshi. Wapimye umuriro, usanga ari 39.4°C. Wasuzumye ukoresheje TDR, ikaba ari negative. Ubajije umurwayi, akubwira ko asanzwe afite virusi itera SIDA. None urabaza niba hari irindi suzuma yakorerwa cyangwa indi miti yahabwa. Nibyo koko, uyu mwana ararwaye. Iyo umuntu afite umuriro ugera kuri iki kigero, aba arembye, kandi ni byiza ko ahabwa ubufasha bwihuse. Kugabanya uyu muriro, yagombye guhabwa ibinini bya Paracetamol (500 mg), anywe ikinini kimwe mu gitondo, saa sita, na nimugoroba, mu minsi itatu. Ubundi, hagakorwa ibizamini by’amaraso bareba niba nta yindi infection afite mu mubiri ishobora gutera uyu muriro mwinshi. Ibindi bikwiye gukorwa: Mufashe byibuze abone Paracetamol vuba. Umubwire akuremo imyenda, areke kwifubika kuko ari gushyushye. Uhite umwohereza kwa muganga kugira ngo bamusuzume byimbitse. Urakoze.
question_english: I evaluated a thirteen-year-old female patient weighing 32 kilograms, from Umukamba village. She presented with a headache, joint pain, and a high fever as symptoms. The examination I conducted using a thermometer showed a body temperature of 39.4°C. I tested her blood using a rapid diagnostic test, which returned negative results.When I inquired about any pre-existing illnesses, she disclosed that she has HIV. My question is: what advanced examinations can be conducted for her, and what dosage of medication would she be given?

question_kinyarwanda: Mwiriwe! umusore w'imyaka makumyabiri ni'itanu; afite ibiro biri hagati ya mirongo itandatu na mirongo itandatu na bitanu; yari hejuru y'imodoka itwaye imbaho arahanutse akubita umutwe hasi; umutwe urangiritse; museguye urubaho ngo amaraso atamushiramo ntari kuvuga ariko ari guhumeka. Mpamagaye ambulance none hashize iminota mirongo ine itarahagera. Nabazaga ikindi nafasha uyu muntu mu gihe ambulanse yaba itarangeraho.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Mu gihe mugitegereje imbangukiragutabara mwiyegamize, kugira ngo abashe kubona umwuka, imbangukiragutabara ize byibuze agihumeka.
question_english: Good afternoon! A twenty-five-year-old man; he weighs between sixty and sixty-five kilograms; he fell from a truck carrying boards and hit his head on the ground; his head is injured; I placed his head straight on the board to prevent blood loss; he is not speaking but he is breathing. I called an ambulance, and it has been forty minutes without arriving. I was asking what else I could do to help this person while waiting for the ambulance.

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umwana w'umuhungu afite imyaka icyenda afite ibiro makumyabiri na bitatu, afite ikibazo cyo kubabara umutwe kandi amaso akayabyiringira cyane, ku buryo usanga amaso yose yabyimbye yatukuye. Nabajije nyina niba hari ubundi burwayi uwo mwana yari asanganywe ambwirako ari ntabwo. Mugira inama yuko yamujyana kwa muganga bakamufasha. Nabazaga uyu mwana nta bundi bufasha yahabwa?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Wakoze kumwohereza ku kigo nderabuzima kugira ngo bamufashe.
question_english: I received a nine-year-old boy weighing twenty-three kilograms who is experiencing severe headaches and significant eye swelling, with both eyes red and swollen. I asked his mother if the child had any pre-existing conditions, and she said no. I advised her to take him to the hospital for assistance. I am asking if there is any other help that can be provided to the child before they reach the hospital.

question_kinyarwanda: Mwiriwe! Nakiriye umugore w'imyaka mirongo itatu n'irindwi, afite ibiro mirongo itandatu na bibiri, ari gukorora, ari kubabara umutwe, ari kugira isereri n'umuriro mwinshi. Mubajije igihe bimaze ambwira ko amaze iminsi ibiri ababara, mubajije niba nta bundi burwayi abana na bwo, ambwira ko ntabwo, kandi nta yindi miti yanyoye. Terimo yanyeretse ko afite mirongo itatu na karindwi n'ibice bitanu, tederi ni positifu. Ngiye kumuvura, nabazaga igipimo cy'imiti ndamuha n'iminsi agomba kuyifata. Murakoze?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Uramuha coartem ya 6\*4 abifate iminsi 3 yose. Ariko umwohereze bamuvure n'inkorora kuko na yo ayifite, bamuhe n'imiti yongera amaraso.
question_english: Hello! I evaluated a thirty-seven-year-old woman, weighing sixty-two kilograms. She is coughing, has a headache, is feeling dizzy, and has a high fever. When I asked how long she had been in pain, she said two days. And when I asked if she had any other illnesses, she said no, and that she had not taken any other medication. The thermometer showed her temperature was 37.5°C, and the rapid diagnostic test (RDT) was positive. I am preparing to treat her and would like guidance on the appropriate dosage and duration of medication. Thank you!

question_kinyarwanda: Umubyeyi w'umugore ufite imyaka mirongo ine n'umwe, yaje kwivuza afite ibiro mirongo itandatu na bitanu, ababara umutwe yacitse intege, aboneza urubyaro n'urushinge rw'amezi atatu rwa depoporovela. Afite umuriro mwinshi, avuga ko amaze iminsi avuye mu mutara, yabuze na apeti. Namufashe tederi nsanga afite malariya, muha ibinini bya sisi fuwa katere mu minsi itatu. Mugira inama yo kunywa amazi menshi no kurya imbuto. Namufashe n'umuriro nsanga afite hejuru ya mirongo itatu n'icyenda. Hanyuma rero ambwira ko ari kuva, kandi ntabwo ari igihe cy'imihango. Ubwo namufasha iki kugira ngo areke no kuva?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Ongeraho paracetamol kuri coartem hanyuma umwohereze ku bitaro kugira ngo akorerwe ibindi bizamini anitabweho.
question_english: A forty-one-year-old woman came for treatment weighing sixty-five kilograms, complaining of headaches, weakness, and using a three-month Depo-Provera injection for family planning. She has a high fever, says she recently returned from Umutara, and has lost her appetite. I took her TDR and found she has malaria, so I gave her six times four tablets to take for three days. I advised her to drink plenty of water and eat fruits. I also checked her fever and found it was over thirty-nine degrees. Then she told me she was bleeding, and it was not her menstrual period. What can I do to help her stop bleeding?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umurwayi w'umugabo ufite imyaka mirongo itanu. Ari guhumeka nabi agahumeka insigane ari kubasha kuvuga. Uwo murwayi afite ubundi burwayi bwa asima. Namugiriye inama yo kujya yo kwirinda kujya mu mbeho. Nabazaga muganga ni iki nafasha uwo murwayi kugira abone imiti?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Uwo murwayi wamwohereza ku kigo nderabuzima kugirango yitabweho kuri ubwo burwayi afite bwa asima.
question_english: I've received a male patient who is fifty years old. He is breathing poorly, gasping for breath, and struggling to speak. That patient has a pre-existing condition of asthma. I've advised him to avoid cold environments. I'm asking the doctor what I can do to help that patient get medication?

question_kinyarwanda: Umurwayi ufite imyaka makumyabiri n'itandatu, ibiro mirongo itanu na birindwi, ni umuhungu afite umuriro wa mirongo itatu n'icyenda. Ari kubabara umutwe akaba yari asanganywe uburwayi bw'ubumuga bwo mu mutwe. Mufatiye tederi nsanga ni pozitifu afite malariya. None mfite sisi fuwa katere, none nayimuha afite ubumuga bwo mu mutwe?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze kwakira uwo murwayi w'umuhungu ufite imyaka 26 n'ibiro 57, umuriro wa 39, akaba yarafite ibimenyetso byo kubabara umutwe kandi yarasanganywe ikibazo cy'uburwayi bwo mu mutwe. Wamufatiye tederi, iba positive. Ni ngombwa ko agomba gufata umuti wa malariya, kwariteme sisi fuwa katere. Kuba afite ikibazo cyo mu mutwe, uburwayi bwe ntibuvuze ko yareka imiti, ahubwo yakoherezwa ku bitaro cg se ku kigo nderabuzìma, agasuzumwa n'abaganga bashinzwe indwara zo mu mutwe.
question_english: A 26-year-old patient, weighing 57 kilograms, is a male with a fever of 39 degrees. He is experiencing a headache and has a history of mental disability. I conducted a TDR and found he is positive for malaria. Now I have Coartem, should I give it to him considering his mental disability?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umukecuru w'imyaka mirongo itandatu n'umwe. Yaje ambwira ko umwana we afashwe n'inda kandi atigeze ajya kwipimisha kuko yari yaragiye m'umujyi, aza ari bubyare. Mugira inama ko ahita ajya kwa muganga ko bari bumwakire. Nabazaga muganga niba haribindi bizamini yatanga?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umukecuru w'imyaka 61 yambwiye ko umukobwa we atwite kandi agiye kubyara, namugiriye inama yo kumujyana kwa muganga ako kanya. • Noneho, ugomba kubagira inama yo kujya kwa muganga ako kanya kugira ngo bakurikirane umwana n'umubyeyi kugeza abyaye kugira ngo harebwe ko byagenda neza.
question_english: I received a 61-year-old woman who told me that her daughter is pregnant and hasn’t been for a check-up because she had been in the city. She came back and is about to give birth. I advised her to take her daughter to the hospital immediately, assuring her that they would attend to her. I was asking the doctor if there are any additional tests that should be conducted?

question_kinyarwanda: Umurwayi yangezeho ambwira ko afite ikibazo cyo mu mutwe, tumubajije uko yafashwe yatubwira ko nawe atabizi. Twamugiriye inama yo kujya kwa muganga aratubwira ngo ntabwo yajya kwa muganga ntacyo arwaye. Ubwo mwangira iyihe nama yo kugira ngo mufashe?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Muherekeze kwa muganga muri service iganiriza ikanavura uburwayi bwo mu mutwe.
question_english: The patient has come to me and told me that he has a mental problem. When I asked him how it started, he has said that he doesn't know. I have advised him to go to the doctor, but he has told me that he wouldn't go to the doctor because he is not sick. What advice would you give to help?

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'imyaka cumi n'umunani, ibiro mirongo ine n'icyenda, ni umuhungu, afite ibiheri, afite inturugunyu, afite n'umuriro wa mirongo itatu n'icyenda. Nta burwayi asanganywe. Namubwiye ko ubwo burwayi bushobora kuba ari ibimenyetso bya mpox( ubushita bw'inkende). Namugiriye inama yo gukaraba kenshi amazi meza n'isabune, mugira inama yo kwiha akato, mugira n'inama yo kwirinda ingendo mu gihe agitegereje ubuvuzi, arabyanga ngo ntabwo yabishobora kuko arya ari uko avuye gushakisha. Mungire inama y'icyo namukorera.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: kubera umuriro afite urapima tederi urebe niba nta na malariya, hanyuma umwohereze ku kigo nderabuzima cyangwa se uhamagare abashinzwe indwara z'ibyorezo ku kigo nderabuzima babashe kumugeraho, kugira ngo babashe kumufasha byihutirwa banapime ibizamini, barebe niba koko ari indwara y'ubushita bw'inkende.
question_english: An 18-year-old boy weighing 49 kilograms came to me with pimples, rashes, and a fever of 39°C. He has no known pre-existing conditions. I suggested that his symptoms might indicate mpox (monkeypox). I advised him to wash frequently with clean water and soap, isolate himself, and avoid traveling while waiting for medical care. However, he refused, saying he cannot manage that because he only eats if he goes out to work. What should I do to help him?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umugabo w'imyaka mirongo itanu; afite ibiro mirongo itandatu na kimwe; afite umuriro wa mirongo ine; asanzwe nta burwayi afite; namukoreye tederi nsanga afite malariya; none imiti yanshiranye. None mukorere iki? Mungire inama.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugabo w’imyaka 50 ufite ibiro 61 afite ubushyuhe bwa 40°C, kandi igipimo cya **RDT** cyagaragaje ko afite malaria, ariko nta miti ya malaria mufite. • **Ni byiza** ko wohereza umurwayi ku kigo nderabuzima kibegereye **vuba bishoboka**, kugira ngo atangire gukoresha imiti ivura malaria ako kanya, ndetse ahabwe n’imiti igabanya umuriro.
question_english: I received a fifty-year-old man; he weighs sixty-one kilograms and has a temperature of forty degrees Celsius. He has no known health issues; I performed a rapid diagnostic test and found that he has malaria. And my medication has finished. What should I do? Please advise.

question_kinyarwanda: Mwaramutse neza! Umubyeyi w'imyaka mirongo ine n'ibiri afite ibiro mirongo itandatu na bine, amaze icyumweru abyaye. Ari kuva cyane, akababara umutwe bikabije, ari gutengurwa. Mubajije igihe abimaranye, ambwira ko abimaranye iminsi itatu. Mwohereza ku kigo nderabuzima yanga kujyayo ngo bizikiza. Namufasha iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Mwaramutse! Umubyeyi w’imyaka mirongo ine n’ibiri, upima ibiro 64, yabyaye icyumweru gishize. Ari kugira kuva gukomeye nyuma yo kubyara, umutwe ukabije, ndetse no guhinda umushyitsi. Igihe namubazaga igihe amaze agira ibi bimenyetso, yavuze ko bimaze iminsi itatu. Namugiriye inama yo kujya ku kigo nderabuzima, ariko yanze, yizera ko ibimenyetso bizashira ubwabyo. Ndamufasha nte? Umurwayi urimo kuva nyuma yo kubyara ni ikibazo gikomeye cy’ubuvuzi bw’ababyeyi gikeneye kwitabwaho byihuse kandi neza kuko gishobora gutera kuva gukabije, guhungabana kw’amaraso, ndetse n’urupfu. Ibimenyetso by’umutwe bishobora kuba ikimenyetso cy’uko yabuze amaraso menshi. Mwigishe ko ibi byitwa kuva gukomeye nyuma yo kubyara, biterwa akenshi n’ibice by’inkomoko y’inda byasigaye cyangwa ibibazo byo kuva bishobora gutera urupfu niba bidavuwe neza. Hanyuma mumujyane ku bitaro kugira ngo akorerwe isuzuma ryimbitse, iperereza, no kuvurwa.
question_english: Good morning! A forty-two-year-old mother, weighing 64 kilograms, gave birth a week ago. She is experiencing severe postpartum hemorrhage, a severe headache, and shivering. When I asked how long she had been experiencing this, she stated that it had been three days. I advised her to visit the health center, but she refused, believing the symptoms would resolve on their own. How can I help her?

question_kinyarwanda: Muraho, umubyeyi anzaniye umwana w'umuhungu imyaka cumi n'ibiri, ibiro makumyabiri na bibiri, ambwira ko afite umuriro ari kubabara mu nda. Mubajije niba hari ubundi burwayi asanganywe, ambwira ko ari ntabwo. Mubwiye ko yihangana aribuze kumera neza. Mushyizemo igipimo cy'ubushuhe, terimometere, afite umuriro wa mirongo itatu ni'cyenda. Mukoreye tederi, musanzemo marariya. muhaye sisi fuwa turuwa, afata ibinini bitatu kabiri ku munsi mu minsi itatu. Ese hari ubundi bufasha naha uyu mwana?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Wakoze kumuha imiti ya malariya ariko ni ukumugira inama yo kuza kumushyiraho agatambaro gatose kugira ngo umuriro ugabanuke hanyuma akamugirira n'isuku mu byo amuha yaba ari ibiryo ndetse n'ibikombe anyweramo n'ibyombo ariraho.
question_english: Hello, a parent brought me a 12-year-old boy weighing 22 kilograms. The parent said he has a fever and abdominal pain. When I asked if he had any pre-existing conditions, they said no. I told them to be patient, as he will recover soon. I measured his temperature with a thermometer, and he had a fever of 39°C. I performed a rapid diagnostic test (RDT) and found that he has malaria. I prescribed Coartem, three tablets twice a day for three days. What other help can I give this child?

question_kinyarwanda: Mwiriwe, nakiriye umusore w'imyaka makumyabiri n'umwe afite ibiro mirongo itanu na bitandatu ambwiye ko ari kubabara umutwe cyane, kandi amaze iminsi yumva afite agahinda gakabije. Mubajije igihe amaze ataka umutwe, ambwira ko ari iminsi irindwi. Mubajije niba nta bundi burwayi asanganwe ambwira ko abana n'ubwandu bw'agakoko gatera SIDA. Mubajije impamvu ahorana agahinda ambwira ko amaze ukwezi ahagaritse imiti imufasha kugabanya ubwandu bw'agakoko gatera SIDA bitewe no kuyirambirwa bityo bikaba bimutera agahinda kubera ko ubwo ubwandu yabuvukanye. Mugiriye inama yo kujya kwa muganga aho batanga inama bakanafasha ababana n'ubwandu bw'agako gatera SIDA, kandi mubwira ko kwandura agako gatera SIDA bitavuze gutakaza ubuzima. Musobanurira ko aramutse akurikije inama ahabwa na muganga byamugirira akamaro ndetse n'ubuzima bwe bukarushaho kuba bwiza. Nabazaga niba hari ubundi bufasha namuha bwisumbuye, murakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umusore w'imyaka 21, ufite ibiro 56 yaje afite umutwe ukabije w'icyumweru 1 kandi avuga ko yumva afite agahinda kenshi cyane ndetse arwaye VIH/SIDA kandi yahagaritse gufata imiti amezi 1 ashize. • Uyu musore arwaye indwara y'agahinda gakabije (MDD) kandi akeneye koherezwa ku bitaro guhura n'umuganga w'ubuzima bwo mu mutwe kugira ngo yitabweho haba mu buvuzi bw'imitekerereze cyangwa imiti niba bikenewe.
question_english: Good evening, I received a twenty-one-year-old young man weighing fifty-six kilograms who told me he has a severe headache and has been feeling deeply depressed for days. When I asked how long he has been experiencing the headache, he told me it has been seven days. When I asked if he has any other pre-existing conditions, he told me he is living with HIV. When I asked why he is always feeling depressed, he told me that he stopped taking his antiretroviral medication a month ago because he got tired of it, which has been causing him sadness since he was born with the virus. I advised him to go to a health center where they provide counseling and support for people living with HIV, and I told him that being infected with HIV does not mean losing life. I explained to him that if he follows the advice given by the doctor, it would benefit him and improve his quality of life. I asked if there is any additional support I could provide him, thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Umugabo w'imyaka mirongo itatu yatemye umugore w'imyaka makumyabiri n'umunani, amutema akaboko ariko ntikaragara igufwa riracika, ubwo naba bantabaje,mugeraho maze kumugeraho mpita mfata ubusenge ndetse n'ibikarizo byari biri hafi aho ngaho kuko aribyo nabashaga kubona, mba ndahambiriye nshyizeho ndinganiza neza kugira igufwa rigumemo ritaza gutana, ubwo ngubwo ahasigaye mpita mpambiriza umugozi w'ingemu, mpita muhamagarira ambulanse yo kumutwara. None muga tugire inama y'icyo twakora.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugabo w'imyaka 30 yakase umugore w'imyaka 28, amukata ukuboko cyane, bituma agira igikomere gikomeye ariko amagufwa atagaragara. Ubwo nahamagarwaga ngo ntabare, nagezeyo ako kanya nkoresha ibiti n'imyenda byari hafi aho kugira ngo mfate ukuboko neza. Nabigenje buhoro kugira ngo amagufwa agume mu mwanya wayo maze mpfundikira n'udupfuko. Nyuma yaho, nahamagaye imbangukiragutabara ngo imujyane kwa muganga. Igisubizo R/ Imiti igabanya ububabare niba bishoboka Kandi ukomeze gufata uku kuboko neza Ujyanwe kwa muganga byihuse kugira ngo ahabwe ubuvuzi bukwiye
question_english: A 30-year-old man cut a 28-year-old woman, cutting her arm severely, causing a fracture without exposing the bone. When I was called to intervene, I arrived and immediately used wooden splints and cloths that were available nearby to immobilize the arm. I carefully secured it to ensure the bone remained in place and wrapped it with a bandage. Afterward, I called for an ambulance to take her to the hospital. Please doctor advise on what to do ?

question_kinyarwanda: Helo, nakiriye umwana w'umukobwa afite umwaka n'amezi umunani afite ibiro cumi na bine muwaka afite cumi na gatatu n'ibice bitanu, umubyeyi we ambwiye ko ari kwituma ibyoroshye cyane kandi by'amazi. Ari kwituma ishuro eshatu ku munsi, mubajije igihe amaze arwaye ambwira ko ari umunsi umwe, mubajije niba nta wundi burwayi yavukanye ambwira ko ntabwo mubajije kandi niba nta yindi miti yanyoye, ambwirako ntayo. Ndamuvuye muhaye zenke ibinini bibiri ku munsi mu minsi icumi. muhaye na esiro ipaki imwe muri litiro kandi bigomba kumara amasaha makumya n'ane. Imiti muhaye ahise ayiruka. Ndikubaza icyo namufasha cyisumbuye?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Uyu ni umwana w'umukobwa w'imyaka 1.8 upima ibiro 14 wazanywe afite impiswi, yahawe ORS na zinc ariko nyuma araruka imiti. Uwo mwana afite gastroenteritis ikaze ishobora guterwa n'udukoko tw'ibinyabuzima cyangwa virusi kandi afite ibyago byo kugira hypovolemia, kutaringanira kw'imyunyu ngugu mu mubiri, na hypoglycemia. Kuva ubu arimo kuruka, komeza kumuha ORS na zinc ariko kandi umwohereze ku bitaro kugira ngo akurikiranwe neza. Ku bitaro, bazareba uko ahagaze mu bijyanye no gutakaza amazi mu mubiri hanyuma bamuhe serumu (IVFs) bijyanye n'uko ahagaze. Niba kuruka bikabije cyane, azahabwa imiti irwanya kuruka. Hypoglycemia no kutaringanira kw'imyunyu ngugu mu mubiri bizakosorwa. Ibizamini nk'isuzuma ry'umusarani, na malariya niba afite umuriro bizakorwa, kandi niba basanze afite udukoko tw'ibinyabuzima, azahabwa albendazole cyangwa mebendazole. Nyuma yo gukira umwuma, azakomeza guhabwa ORS 10mls/kg nyuma ya buri musarane woroshye. Ababyeyi bazahabwa inyigisho ku isuku no gutegura neza amafunguro.
question_english: Hello, I received a baby girl who is one year and eight months old, weighing fourteen kilograms. This year, she is thirteen and a half kilograms. Her parent told me that she is having very soft and watery stools. She is defecating three times a day. When I asked how long she has been sick, they told me it has been one day. I also asked if she was born with any other illness, and they said no. I asked if she had taken any other medication, and they said no. I treated her by giving her zinc, two tablets per day for ten days. I also gave her one pack of ORS in a liter, which should last for twenty-four hours. The medication I gave her caused diarrhea immediately. I am wondering what else I can do to help her?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umugabo wanyoye inzoga nyinshi arikwinyarira, arababara umutwe kandi guhagarara ntibishoboka. Uyu murwayi namufasha iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugabo wanyoye inzoga nyinshi kandi uri kwihagarika, afite umutwe kandi ntashobora guhagarara. Reba niba ahumeka neza, reba niba avuga, niba arimo kuruka, muhe ORESI. Muhe amazi yo kumufasha kuguma ahumeka neza. Musabe kuruhuka mu buriri igihe gito. Azamera neza. Niba atameze neza na gato, Mujyane ku kigo nderabuzima kugira ngo yitabweho biruseho.
question_english: I have received a man who drank a lot of alcohol and is urinating on himself, he has a headache and cannot stand. How can I help this patient?

question_kinyarwanda: Bazanye umwana w'umukobwa imyaka icumi, ibiro makumyabiri na bitanu ataka umutwe, afite isereri ariko afite umuriro mupimye musangaga mirongo itatu n'umunani ni'igice mufashe tederi iba negatifu, mubajije ambwira ko afite diabete. Uyu murwayi namufasha iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Turabashimira kubufasha mwahaye uyu mwana w'umukobwa w'imyaka icumi ubabara umutwe, munda, afite iserereri akaba arwaye na diabete.  Mwakoze kumupima umuriro na malaria ikindi wakora n'ukumubaza uko afata imiti ya diabete nimba ayifata nkuko bikwiye. Ukamubaza n'ibiryo amaze iminsi afata niba atarya ibiyo birimo isukari nyinshi. Ukamugira inama yo gufata imiti neza, kunywa amazi menshi no kwirinda ibintu birimo isukari nyinshi. Ukamugira inama yo kujya ku kigonderabuzima bakamufasha byisumbuye. Mukomeze gukurikirana uyu mwana muto.
question_english: A 10-year-old girl weighing 25 kilograms was brought in, complaining of a Headache, dizziness and fever. She has a fever of 38.5 Celsius degree. With rapid diagnostic test (RTD), I tested her fo malaria, end the result was negative. Upon inquiry, she disclosed that she has diabetes. What can I do for this patient?

question_kinyarwanda: Naganirije ababyeyi bafite umwana w'umukobwa w'imyaka cumi n'irindwi watwise inda imbura gihe, mbabwira kumugaburira indyo yuzuye, kumufasha kuruhuka neza bihagije, kumurinda ihohoterwa no kumubwira amagambo mabi. Ni iki kindi nabwira uyu muryango?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Mubyukuri uyu mwana w'umukobwa aracyari muto bishoboka cyane ko afite inda yatwise kuriyi myaka17 ibyo wababwiye n'ingenzi muburyo bwimirire no kwirinda ihohoterwa ryahato nahato Birinda kumubwira amagambo amukomeretsa . Uyu muryango rero ufite inshingano nyishi zo kwita kuri uyu mwana muburyo bwo kugana kwa muganaga kugira ngo akurikiranwe neza n'abaganga munshingano zabo ndetse kuko yatwaye inda akiri muto biba byiza akurikiranwe n'inzobere mukuvura abagore babyigiye
question_english: I talked to the parents of a 17-year-old girl who got pregnant at an early age. I advised them to provide her with a balanced diet, ensure she gets enough rest, protect her from any form of abuse, and avoid speaking negatively to her. What else should I tell this family?

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'imyaka ibiri, ibiro cumi na bitatu ni umuhungu. Arwaye impiswi, nta burwayi yari asanganywe. Nabajije umubyeyi w'umwana inshuro yituma kumunsi, ambwira ko yituma inshuro eshatu kandi birebire nk'amazi. Namuhaye umuti zenke na silo, ngira n'inama umubyeyi yo kwita ku isuku , nyuma yimminsi ibiri namusuye nsanga atoroherwa. Mungire inama y'icyo nakora.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'imyaka 2 upima ibiro 10 afite impiswi, arituma inshuro 3 ku munsi. Nta bundi burwayi asanganywe. Yafashe zinc na silo ntiyoroherwa. Mushishikarize kunywa cyane, cyangwa kumwonsa kenshi. Akomeze afate silo na zinc. Uhite umuha transiferi ajye kwa muganga hamwegereye, kujyira ngo hafatwe ibizami byimbitse, ahabwe n'imiti bijyanye n'ibisubizo babonye.
question_english: A two-year-old child, weighing thirteen kilograms, is a boy. He is suffering from diarrhea, with no prior illnesses. I've asked the child's parent how many times he defecates in a day, and told me he defecates three times, and it is watery. I've given him zinc and oral rehydration salts, and I've advised the parent to maintain hygiene. After two days, I visit and find that he is not getting well. Please advise me on what to do.

question_kinyarwanda: Mwiriwe neza, umubyeyi w'imyaka mirongo itatu n'umwe, amaze iminsi cumi n'itatu mu mihango. Akoresha uburyo bwo kuboneza urubyaro hakoreshejwe urushinge. Ambwiye y'uko ababara umutwe, umugongo, agira isereri. Nitegereje, mbona ari kuribwa no mu nda. Uyu mubyeyi mukorere iki? Murakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Tubashimiye ko mwakiriye uwo mubyeyi w'imyaka mirongo itatu n'umwe , amaze iminsi cumi n'itatu mu mihango, akoresha urushinge mukuboneza urubyaroy, ababara umutwe, umugongo, agira iserereri.  Icyo wakorera uwo mubyeyi ni ukumwihanganisha mukamubwira ko bijya bibaho kubantu bamwe na bamwe baboneza urubyaro ariko ko igihe bikabije atabasha kubyihanganira yajya kwa muganga bakamufasha, bakareba ko ntakindi kibazo afite cyaba kiri kumutera icyo bibazo.
question_english: Good afternoon. A thirty-one-year-old mother has been menstruating for thirteen days. She uses injectable contraception. She told me that she has a headache, back pain, and dizziness. When I examined her, I noticed she was experiencing abdominal pain. What can I do for this mother? Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Umubyeyi w'umugabo w'imyaka mirongo itatu n'irindwi aje ambwira ko yaciye inyuma umugore we ko afite ubwoba ko yaba yaranduye indwara zandurira mu mibonano mpuzabitsina. Mubajije niba nta bundi burwayi afite ambwira ko ari ntabwo. Mujije niba nta yindi miti afata ambwira ko ari ntayo. Mubajije niba yaripimishije virusi itera sida, ambwira ko atigeze yipimisha. Mugira inama yo kujya kwipimisha izo ndwara zandurira mu mibonano mpuzabitsina no kujya kwipimisha virusi itera SIDA. Ese hari ubundi bufasha nari kumuha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Wabikoze neza. Niba afite ubwandu bwa VIH, tekereza no gupima umugore we. Mumugire inama ku byiza byo gukundana, kwizerana no gukoresha agakingirizo mu rwego rwo kwirinda mu gihe byananiranye guhagarika guca inyuma.
question_english: The parent of a 37-year-old man came to me, saying that he had cheated on his wife and was afraid he might have contracted sexually transmitted infections (STIs). When I asked if he had any other health conditions, he said no. I also asked if he was taking any medication, and he said he was not. When I inquired if he had ever been tested for HIV, he said he had never been tested. I advised him to get tested for STIs and HIV. Is there any other support I could provide him?

question_kinyarwanda: Mwaramutse, ngeze ahantu muri kabari nsanga abantu bari kurwana umwe akomeretsa undi mu umutwe ava amaraso menshi ndetse yamukuyemo n'ijisho, mubajije imyaka ye ambwira ko afite imyaka mirongo itanu, mubajije niba nta bundi burwayi asanzwe agira ambwiye ko ari ntabwo, mpamagaye ambilansi kubera atari kureba imbwira ko irahagera nyuma nibura yiminota makumyabiri, none umubyeyi uwo murwayi namufasha iki? Murakoze
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Mwaramutse, nageze ahantu mu kabari nsanga abantu barwana. Umuntu umwe yakomeretse ku mutwe kandi yaviriranaga cyane, ijisho rye ryari ryasohotse. Igihe namubazaga imyaka ye, yambwiye ko afite mirongo itanu. Igihe namubazaga niba afite izindi ndwara zishobora kuba afite, yavuze ko nta zo afite. Igisubizo R/ Ihungabana ry’umutwe. Ihungabana ry’umubiri. R/o kuvunika kw’amagufa y’umutwe. Hamagara imbangukiragutabara no kumujyana byihutirwa. Mu gihe mutegereje, mwirinde ko amaraso akomeza kuva aho yakomeretse.
question_english: Good morning, I arrived at a place in a bar and found people fighting. One person was injured on the head and was bleeding heavily, and his eye was gouged out. When I asked his age, he told me he was fifty. When I asked if he had any other underlying health conditions, he said no. I call an ambulance and I was told it would arrive in about twenty minutes because it was far away. Now, what can I do to help this injured person? Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Umurwayi afite imyaka mirongo ine, ibiro mirongo itandatu, numuhungu afite umuriro wa mirongo itatu n'icyenda akababara umutwe, akaba yari asanganywe uburwayi bw'igicuri. Mufatiye tederi nsanga ni pozitifu, afite malariya. None ngomba kumuha sisi fuwa katere. Nayimuha arwaye igicuri?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: yego muhe ntakibazo akdni akomeze kwikurikirana kwa muganga nkinisanzwe,natororoherwa muminsi 3 azajye kwa muganga bamufashe
question_english: The patient is forty years old, weighs sixty kilograms, and is a boy with a fever of thirty-nine degrees and a headache. He has a history of epilepsy. I took his TDR and found he is positive for malaria. Then i must give him six times four. Can I give it to him while he has epilepsy?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umugore w'imyaka mirongo itanu n'itanu, afite ibiro mirongo itandatu na bitanu, namufatiye umuriro nsanga afite mirongo itatu na karindwi, abana n'ubwandu, afata imiti. Amaze iminsi icumi ababara mu nda n'umutwe bikabije cyane. Nkore iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Ndumva icyo wamufasha wamujyana kwauganga bakamurebera ikibitera.  Kuko wasamga ari ingaruka ziyo miti, wasanga ari ubundi burwayi buje. Mubwire yihute ajye kwa muganga bamufashe.
question_english: I received a 55-year-old woman weighing 65 kilograms. I measured her temperature, and it was 37.4°C. She is living with HIV and is on medication. She has been experiencing severe abdominal and headache for the past ten days. What should I do?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umurwayi w'umuhungu ufite imyaka makumyabiri afite ibiro mirongo ine na bitanu yaje avuga ko ababara umutwe afite umuriro mupimye umuriro nsanga afite itatu n’umunani mufashe tederi iba negatifu mwohereza kwa muganga none uyu murwayi hari ubundi bufasha namuha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze kubaza iki kibazo cy’umwana w’umuhungu ufite imyaka makumyabiri. Afite ibiro mirongo ine na bitanu. Yaje avuga ko ababara umutwe kandi afite umuriro. Umupimye, wasanze afite umuriro wa mirongo itatu n’umunani. Wamukoreye TDR, iba negatifu, maze uhita umwohereza kwa muganga. Ukaba ubaza niba nta bundi bufasha wamuha. Mbanje kubashimira uburyo mwamufashije uyu murwayi w’umuhungu waje aribwa umutwe, anafite umuriro. Mwakoze TDR ikaba negatifu, mugahita mumwohereza kwa muganga. Rwose mwabikoze neza cyane. Kuba ari kubabara umutwe kandi afite umuriro ni ibimenyetso bihuriweho n’indwara nyinshi zitandukanye. Ni yo mpamvu iyo umuntu aje aribwa umutwe kandi afite umuriro, iyo akorewe TDR ikaba negatifu, aba agomba guhabwa transfer imujyana ku kigo nderabuzima bakamusuzuma, kugira ngo barebe ubundi burwayi yaba afite. Kandi agahabwa imiti igabanya umuriro no kuribwa umutwe, nka paracetamol. Rero, ni byiza kuba mwahise mumuha transfer imujyana ku kigo nderabuzima ngo bamukurikirane. Murakoze.
question_english: A 20-year-old male patient weighing kilograms came with complaints of headache and fever. Upon examination, his temperature was 38 Celsius degree. A rapid diagnostic test(RTD) for malaria was performed, and the result was negative. The patient was referred to a healthcare facility for further evaluation. Is there any additional support I can provide for this patient?

question_kinyarwanda: Mfite umurwayi W'umugabo afite imyaka mirongo itanu n'itandatu afite inkorora ayimaranye ibyumweru bitatu asanzwe afite virusi itera SIDA nta bundi burwayi afite. Uyu murwayi yagenerwa iyihe miti? Ese namubwira kwihutira kwa muganga?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umurwayi w'igitsina gabo w'imyaka 56 ufite inkorora y'ibyumweru 3 akaba afite virusi itera sida, asanzwe ari ku miti. Ubwa mbere, inkorora y'umurwayi yerekana inzira yanduye, kuko asanzwe yanduye virusi itera sida kandi akaba ari ku miti ashobora kuba afite ubwandu bwanduye nk'igituntu. Ikintu cya mbere ugomba gukora ni ukwirinda ukoresheje agapfukamunwa, hanyuma ugahita woherezwa ku kigo nderabuzima. Ku bitaro bazatandukanya umurwayi, bafate vitals zirimo spo2, hanyuma bongereho ogisijeni niba desaturating ku kirere cy'icyumba, bafate amateka yuzuye, basuzume neza umubiri kugeza ku maguru kandi basabe iperereza nka gene x pert, hanyuma bazakemura uburwayi hakurikijwe ibisubizo.
question_english: I have a 56-year-old male patient who has had a cough for three weeks and is already HIV positive and has no other illnesses. What medication should this patient be given? Can I tell him to go to the hospital immediately?

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'umukobwa ufite imyaka cumi n'ibiri, ibiro mirongo ine na bibiri, yafashwe ku ngufu baramusambanya, umubyeyi we yanga ko abantu babimenya, yiha kubihisha. Mungire inama y'icyo namusobanurira.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze kutubaza uko mwafasha uwo mwana w'umukobwa w'imyaka cumi n'ibiri, ibiro mirongo ine na bibiri, yafashwe ku ngufu baramusambanya, umubyeyi we yanga ko abantu babimenya. Icyo mwasobanurira uwo mubyeyi ni uko uwo mwana agomba kubona ubutabera kugira ngo akire ibikomere afite yatewe no gufatwa kungufu. Umusobanuriro kandi ko nubwo mu Rwanda itegeko ritemerera abantu gukuramo inda hari abantu bataryozwa icyaha igihe babikoze, abo bantu bakaba bari mubyiciro bitanu, icyambere ni umuntu wafashwe kungufu, icya kabiri ni umwana uri munsi y'imyaka cumi n'umunani, icya gatatu ni umuntu wabanishijwe n'umugabo atabishaka, icya kane ni umuntu watewe inda n'uwo bava inda imwe ku gisantera cya kabiri, icya gatanu ni umuntu byemejwe na muganga ko inda ishobora kumugiraho ingaruka. Uwo mwana w'umukobwa rero agomba kujya kwa muganga bakamufasha kugira ngo ataza gusama inda atateganije, barebe ko bamurinda no kwandura indwara zandurira mu mibonano mpuzabitsina cyane cyane agakoko ka virus itera sida.
question_english: A twelve-year-old girl, weighing forty-two kilograms, was raped, and her parent refused to let people know, choosing to hide it. Advise me on what I should explain to her.

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umugabo w'imyaka mirongo ine n'itatu y'amavuko, yaje arwaye ahinda umuriro akorora ababara n'umugongo. Namufatiye ikizami cy'umuriro agira mirongo itatu n'icyenda n'ibice bibiri nafashe tederi (TDR) mpima amaraso ye nsanga tederi ye inyereka ko ari positif uwo mugabo arwaye malaria. Namuhaye ibinini bya coartem nibyo nakoresheje muvura, byose hamwe byari ibinini makumyabiri na bine agomba kunywa mu munsi itatu, namuhaye imiti ya mbere y'ibanze agomba kunywera mu rugo. Mugira inama yo gufata amafunguro kenshi kandi buri munsi kandi buri gihe. Nabazaga nimba nta y'indi nama namuha cyangwa ubundi bufasha namukorera. Murakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Urakoze, wabikoze neza cyane. Gira inama umurwayi yo kuryama mu nzitiramibu no kwirinde ibidendezi by'amazi bikurura imibu.
question_english: I received a 43-year-old man who came in with a fever, a cough, and back pain. I measured his temperature, which was 39.2°C. I conducted a malaria rapid test (TDR), which came out positive, indicating he had malaria. I treated him with Coartem tablets, providing a total of 24 tablets to be taken over three days. I gave him the initial dose to take at the health center and instructed him to continue taking the rest at home. I also advised him to eat frequently and consistently every day to regain strength. I am asking if there are additional recommendations or support I could provide to him. Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Umuntu w'umugabo w'imyaka mirongo itatu n'irindwi. Nsanze ariguhohotera umwana w'imyaka cumi n'ine. Ndagirango mungire inama, icyo nafasha umwana uri guhohoterwa. Nakora iki nafasha iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Fasha umwana umugeze ku kigo nderabuzima ku muntu ushinzwe abahohotewe kugira ngo abashe kumufasha mu buryo bwihuse. Na we amwohereze ku kigo gishinzwe ihohoterwa muri isange one stop center kugira ngo abone ubufasha.
question_english: A thirty-seven-year-old man. I found him abusing a fourteen-year-old child. I would like you to advise me on how I can help the child who is being abused. What can I do to help the child?

question_kinyarwanda: Mwiriwe neza, umusore w'imyaka makumyabiri n'umunani n'ibiro mirongo itandatu na bibiri angezeho ambwira ko ipusi imaze kumuruma agatsinsino, mubajije igihe imuririye ambwira ko hashize nk'amasaha abiri, mubwiye ko yihangana ko ari bukire akamera neza, muhaye transferi bambwira ko nta muntu n'umwe uhari w'iwabo, mubwiye ko ngiye kumuherekeza nkamugeza kwa muganga. Mungire inama y'ubufasha namuha.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umusore wimyaka 28 ibiro 60 wariwe nipusi. 1.nimba ababara muhe paracetamol, 2.umuhe taransiferi ajye kwamuganga bamuhe vagise.
question_english: Good afternoon, a 28-year-old man weighing 62 kg came to me and told me that a cat had bitten him on the heel. When I asked when it happened, he said it was about two hours ago. I reassured him that he would be fine and gave him a transfer. However, he told me that there was no one available at his home to assist him, so I decided to accompany him to the hospital. Please advise on any additional support I can provide him.

question_kinyarwanda: Hello, nakiriye umugore we w'imyaka mirongo itatu numunani, afite ibiro mirongo itandatu na bitanu, ambwiye ko ari gukorora kubabara umutwe, kuribwa mu nda no kugira umuriro mwinshi. Mubajije niba nta bundi burwayi yari asanganywe ambwira ko ntabwo, mubajije igihe amaze afashwe ambwira ko ari iminsi ibiri. Mfashe ibipimo by'ubushyuhe nsanga afite mirongo itatu na karindwi nibice bitanu, mfashe tederi nsanga ari postif. Ndamuvuye muhaye umuti wa mbere ahita awuruka, nyuma y'iminota y'amasegonda icumi muhaye undi nawo arawurutse. Ndabaza icyo nakora cyisumbuye. Murakoze
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Icyo wakora ni uguhita umuha tranfer agahita ajya kwa muganga byihuse kuko aribo bafite umuti wamufasha igihe maralia yabonetse kandi akaba aruka imiti yose urimo kumuha,gusa ikindi wakora ni ugukomeza kumuha ibyo kurya no kunywa kuko n'ubwo yaruka ntihabura na duke dusigaramo. Kandi kuko arwaye inkorora nabwo wamubwira agahita nayo ayivuza kuko nayo yatuma aruka , kandi bahita banamuvura n'umutwe kuko kwa muganga bo babyemerewe.
question_english: Hello, I received a 38-year-old woman, weighing 65 kilograms, who complained of a cough, headache, abdominal pain, and high fever. When I asked if she had any underlying conditions, she said no. She reported that she has had these symptoms for two days. I checked her temperature and found it to be 37.5°C, and I did a rapid diagnostic test (RDT), which came back positive for malaria. After giving her first-line medication, she vomited, and after another 10 seconds, I gave her a second dose, but she vomited again. What should I do next? Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umurwayi ufite imyaka itatu n'amezi makumyabiri n’ane, n’umuhungu yaje afite ibiro cumi na bine, mupimye umuriro nsanga afite mirongo itatu na karindwi, umubyeyi yambwiye ko ahumeka nabi mupimye tayima nsanga afite mirongo itatu na karindwi, nsanga afite umusonga mufashe, muvura umusonga muha ibinini mirongo itatu agafata ibinini bibiri buri munsi. None umurwayi hari ubundi bufasha bundi namuha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Urakoze kuri iki kibazo cy'umurwayi, umwana w'umuhungu ufite imyaka itatu waje afite ibiro cumi na bine wamupima ugasanga afite umuriro wa mirongo itatu na karindwi kandi ahumeka nabi. Wapima ukoresheje tayima akagira mirongo itatu na karindwi ugasanga afite umusonga, ukamuvura umuha ibinini bya amoxiciline agafata ibinini bibiri inshuro ebyiri ku munsi. Wakoze cyane uyu mwana ufite iyi myaka urwaye umusonga woroheje avurwa n'umujyanama w'ubuzima agahabwa imiti nk'uko wabikoze cyakora ugomba kwigisha umubyeyi kujya aba hafi y'umwana akamufubika akamurinda imbeho kugira umwana atarushaho kuremba cyangwa akongera gufatwa n'undi musonga kandi wari wamuhaye imiti wakoze cyane rero gufasha uyu mwana.
question_english: I received a patient who is three years and twenty-four months old, a boy who came weighing fourteen kilograms. When I measured his temperature, I found it to be thirty-seven degrees. The parent told me he was breathing poorly, and when I measured his respiratory rate using timer, I found it to be thirty-seven. I diagnosed him with pneumonia, treated him for pneumonia, and gave him thirty tablets, taking two tablets daily. Now, is there any other assistance I can provide to the patient?

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'umukobwa w'imyaka cumi n'umunani ibiro mirongo itanu na birindwi. Angezeho ambwira ko ari kubabara mu nda, ko afite umuriro n'umutwe wari urimo kubabara. Mubajije n'igihe yafatiwe ambwira ko amaze iminsi ibiri. Mubajije igihe aherukira kujya mu mihango ambwira ko ayirimo. Mubwiye ko yihangana ari bukire. Muhaye taransiferi. Ese hari ubundi bufasha naha uyu mwana w'umukobwa?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: wakoze kumufasha -mufashe abone paracetamol abanze agabanye umuriro n'umutwe -mufatire TDR urebe nusanga afite malaria umuhe coartem -mushishikarize kurya neza no kunywa bihagije,no kwirinda indwara
question_english: An eighteen-year-old girl weighing fifty-seven pounds reached out to me and reported having a stomachache, fever, and headache. When asked how long she had been feeling this way, she mentioned it had been two days. Upon inquiring about her last menstruation, she indicated that she was currently menstruating. I told her to be patient, that she would be okay, and I provided her with a transfer. Is there any other help I can give to this girl?

question_kinyarwanda: Umuhungu w'imyaka cumi n'itanu ufite ibiro mirongo itatu na bibiri arwaye ibiheri ku mubiri, arishimagura yatukuye amaso kandi afite umuriro mwinshi wa mirongo itatu ni'cyenda. Mubwiye ko ibimenyetso afite ari iby'icyorezo cy'ubushita bw'inkende, mpise mubwira ko yihutira kujya kwa muganga, akajya ku kigo nderabuzima kimwegereye. Hari ikindi namukorera cyangwa imiti namuha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Icya mbere yagakwiye kuba afatirwa ikizamini cya tederi, noneho ashyirwe mu kato agatandukanywa n'abandi kugira ngo atabanduza. Noneho nyuma yo kumutandukanya n'abandi, mushake uburyo mu mugeza ku kigonderabuzima uretse ubushita bw'inkendeye umubiri mu bimenyetso afite n'iseru yaba irimo ndetse na beori ikigonderabuzima ari cyo cyamufasha abashe gufatirwa ibindi bizamini, bamenye neza icyo arwaye.
question_english: A fifteen-year-old boy, weighing thirty-two kilograms, has skin rashes, is scratching, has red eyes, and a high fever of thirty-nine degrees Celsius. I told him that his symptoms are indicative of an outbreak of monkeypox, and I advised him to go to the nearest health center immediately. Is there anything else I can do for him or any medication I should give him?

question_kinyarwanda: Mwaramutse, umubyeyi utwite angezeho afite imyaka mirongo itatu n'itanu, ambwira ko indara yaraye imurya mpaka mu gitondo. Mubwiye ngo ajye kwa muganga ambwira ko atarajyayo. Mubajije niba ntayindi miti yafashe ambwira ko yariye ikimbazi n’ijoro. None umubyeyi namufashe iki? Murakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umubyeyi ufite imyaka 35, aratwite, inda yaraye imurya mpaka mugitondo, ntabwo ashaka kujya kwa muganga, yariye ikimbazi nijoro. Uyu mubyeyi agomba kuganirizwa akabasha kugana kwa muganga, kuko ashobora kuba ari kubise akaba yabyarira murugo kandi kubera ko yanyweye imiti ya kinyarwanda umwana akaba yagirira ikibazo munda.
question_english: Good morning. A pregnant mother has come to me; she is thirty-five years old and has told me that she has had pregnancy pain throughout the night until morning. I have told her to go to the hospital, but she has said she hasn't gone yet. When I asked if she has taken any other medication, she told me she has eaten Ikimbazi herbs at night. So, what should I do for the mother? Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umugabo w'imyaka mirongo itatu n'ibiri, ibiro mirongo itandatu na bitanu. Yaje afite umuriro aribwa mu nda. Namubajije niba nta kindi kibazo afite, yambwiye ko afite umuvuduko w'amaraso. Namwohereje kwa muganga ageze kwa muganga musuye nyuma y'iminsi itatu nsanga aracyarwaye. Mungire inama.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Komeza umufashe cyane cyane mu bijyanye no kumufasha mu mibanire.
question_english: I received a thirty-two-year-old man weighing sixty-five kilograms. He has come with a fever and abdominal pain. I have asked him if he had any other health issues, and he has told me that he has hypertension. I referred him to the hospital, and after three days, I have visited him and found that he was still sick. Please advise me.

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'umuhungu ufite imyaka ibiri; afite ibiro cumi na bitanu; muwake ya cumi na gatanu. Uburwayi afite, afite inkorora arakorora cyane nticika, namubajije ubundi burwayi asanganywe ambwira ko ntabwo. Namubwiye kurya imbuto, kunywa amazi atetse no gukora umutobe w'indimu uvanzemo n'ubuki. Mwamfasha iki kuri ubu burwayi bw‘uyu mwana?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Uyu mwana mwohereze kwa muganga kuko ibyo ntibyahita bikiza inkorora neza gusa nabyo ntabireke, bamurinde imbeho, akomeze arye ananywe cyane ibishyushye.
question_english: A two-year-old boy weighs fifteen kilograms and has a mid-upper arm circumference (MUAC) of fifteen centimeters. He has a persistent cough and coughs frequently. When I asked if he has any other illnesses, he said no. I advised him to eat fruits, drink boiled water, and make a lemon juice mixed with honey. What additional help can I provide for this child's condition?

question_kinyarwanda: Mwiriwe neza! Umugore w'imyaka mirongo ine n'icyenda agize ikibazo cy'isereri yikubita hasi. Mbanje kumva ko ahumeka muryamishije urubavu rw'ibumoso ahinnye akaguru. Ni ubuhe bufasha bundi namuha? Murakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Uyu ni umugore w'imyaka 49 wagize isereri agwa hasi, yaryamishijwe urubavu rw'ibumoso ahinnye akaguru. Uyu mugore ashobora kuba yari afite ikibazo cy'isukari nke mu mubiri, akaba ari byo byatumye agira isereri akagwa. Wakoze neza cyane kumuryamisha urubavu, no kugenzura niba ahumeka. Ugomba kureba niba uwo murwayi yataye ubwenge cyangwa akibufite. Niba abasha kuvuga cyangwa kurya, shaka ikintu kirimo isukari, nk'amazi arimo isukari, umutobe, n'ibindi, maze umuhe. Namera neza, uhite umenya ko byari ikibazo cy'isukari nke mu mubiri, maze umushishikarize kurya neza no kunywa amazi ahagije. Naba atabasha kuvuga cyangwa kurya, umwohereze kwa muganga kugira ngo akorerwe isuzuma ryimbitse no kuvurwa hakoreshejwe uburyo bugezweho nko kumwongerera isukari.
question_english: Good afternoon! A forty-nine-year-old woman has experienced dizziness and fell down. I first checked if she was breathing while lying her on left rib side, with her leg bent. What other help can I provide her? Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Nasuye umugore umaze icyumweru abyaye w'imyaka makumyabiri n'irindwi ariho akibyara bwa mbere, tuganiriye ambwira ko yamaze kubyara muganga amubwira ko guhita yonsa umwana ako kanya bituma akura neza kandi akagira ubuzima bwiza, numva ntabyitayeho, arashaka kwisinzirira mubwira ko konsa umwana buri mwanya bituma umwana akomera kandi akagira ubuzima bwiza. Nabazaga niba hari ubundi bufasha nari kumuha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze kuba mwaragiriye inama uyu mubyeyi ubyaye bwa mbere kandi ibyo mwamubwiye nibyo, icyo wakongeraho: -Mubwire ibyiza byo guha umwana ibere kenshi kandi ibere gusa mugihe byibuze cy'amezi atandatu. -Kumubwira ko atari n'umwana ubyungukiramo gusa ahubwo ko nawe bimugirira akamaro, bikamufasha gutuma umubiri we umenyera gukora amashereka menshi,bikanamurinda indwara yo kuba yabababara amabere, akaba yabyimba akanazana ubushye. -Byongera urukundo n'ubusabane hagati y'umwana n'umubyeyi. -Bituma nawe umubyeyi arushaho kumva ko ari umubyeyi. -Bigirira akamaro abandi bana ashobora kuzabyara kuko bazasanga afite amashereka mesnhi n'umubiri warabimenyereye. -Mwigishe uko bafata ibere ,uko bonsa neza,n'inshuro bonsa. -Mushishikarize isuku ihagije,kurya neza,kunywa amazi. -Mube hafi akomeze kugenda abyiyumvamo anabikora kuko kuva ari ubwa mbere, akeneyeko mumuba hafi. -Ganiriza umuryango we abo babana n'abo bajye bamuba hafi, banamushishikariza ibyo twavuze haruguru. -Musobanurire igihe yazahera umwana imfashabere ku mezi atandatu.
question_english: I visited a 27-year-old woman who has just given birth a week ago and is a first-time mother. During our conversation, she told me that the doctor advised her to breastfeed the baby immediately after birth to help the baby grow well and have good health, but she seems not to care about it and prefers to sleep. I told her that breastfeeding the baby frequently helps the baby become strong and have good health. I was asking if there is any other support I should offer her.

question_kinyarwanda: Umugabo w'imyaka mirongo nirindwi, arata ibiro bikabije amaso ye ahorana amarira, iminwa ye yacitse ibisebe, abimaranye iminsi itandatu. Namubajije niba hari ikindi kibazo cy'uburwayi afite ambwira ko ari ntabwo icyakora, ambwira neza yuko anywa itabi ryinshi. Namugiriye inama yo kurihagarika, mbese hari indi nama nagira uyu mugabo kugira ngo asubire mu buzima bwiza?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugira inama yo gufata indyo yuzuye, harimo ibyubaka umubiri, ibirinda indwara, ndetse n'ibitera imbaraga. Hanyuma mwohereze ku kigo nderabuzima babashe kumufasha ibindi bikurikiyeho.
question_english: A 70-year-old man has been experiencing significant weight loss, persistent tearing in his eyes, and cracked, sore lips for the past six days. When I asked if he had any other health issues, he said no, but he did mention that he smokes heavily. I advised him to quit smoking. Is there any other advice I can give him to help him regain good health?

question_kinyarwanda: Umubyeyi w'imyaka mirongo itatu nibiro mirongo itandatu na kimwe, afite isereri kandi ababara munda. Maze kumukorera ibizamini byose bishoboka iby'inkari n'ibindi byose nsanga nta twite. Ese ni izihe nama zindi nari kumuha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umubyeyi w'imyaka 30 ufite ibiro 61 wazanywe afite isereri n'ububabare mu nda. Uyu mugore ashobora kuba afite infekisiyo y’inzira z’inkari, gastrite. Koherezwa ku bitaro kugira ngo hakorwe isuzuma rya laboratwari nko gusesengura inkari no kumusuzuma inda, hakoreshejwe ultrasound ndetse n'ubuvuzi bukurikira bushoboka burimo imiti igabanya ububabare, guha umubiri amazi binyuze mu nzira ya serumu. NS cyangwa RL
question_english: A 30-year-old parent weighing 61 kilograms is experiencing dizziness and abdominal pain. After conducting all possible tests, including urine tests, I found that she is not pregnant. What other advice could I give her?

question_kinyarwanda: Mwaramutse! Ngeze ku muhanda nsanga har’umubyeyi wafashwe n'inda, mubajije imyaka hafi ambwira ko afite imyaka mirongo ine, nitabaje ambulance imbwira ko irahagera nyuma y'iminota makumyabiri , mubajije nimba nta bundi burwayi afite ambwira ko ari ntabwo, none uwo mubyeyi namufashe iki? Murakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Uwo mubyeyi wamuguma iruhande kugirango impinduka zose yagira ube umuri hafi. Ashobora kubyara ambulansi itarabageraho icyo gihe wamufasha.
question_english: Good morning! I reached the road; I found a woman who was in labor. When I asked her age, she said she is around forty. I called an ambulance, and they told me they would arrive in twenty minutes. When I asked if she has any other health issues, she said she does not. What help can I provide to this woman? Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Nasuye uruhinja ku munsi wa gatatu ruvutse ni umuhungu, afite iminsi itatu, afite ibiro bibiri namagarama ijana. Narebyeko afite ibimenyetso mpuruza nsanga ntabyo ariko yari avukanye ibiro bike. Nasanze bamukikiye, mbasobanurira ko bagomba kumuheka mu gatuza atari yambara, umubiri w'umwana we wegeranye n'uw'umubyeyi kandi akamwotsa kenshi kugirango yuzuze ibiro kubera ko umuhondo w'amashereka ariwo rukingo rw'indwara, kandi akirinda kumuha abantu bamukikira. Mu ntoki arambwira ngo ntabwo yakwimana umwana. Ni iyihe namugira?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Uruhinja rw'umuhungu rumaze iminsi 3: Apima ibiro 2.100 kg. Nta bimenyetso mpuruza afite. Umubyeyi we wamugiriye inama yo gukora Kangaroo (kumuryamisha mu gituza atambaye, na nyina atambaye, kugira ngo bahuze ubushyuhe), kumwonsa cyane, no kutamuha abantu, ariko nyina yabyanze. Banza umusobanurire ko ibiro 2.100 kg ari ikimenyetso cy’umwana wavukanye ibiro bike, kuko nibura umwana agomba kuvuka afite byibuze 2.500 kg kuzamura. Banza umenye aho yavukiye, niba ari kwa muganga cyangwa mu rugo. Mubaze niba yarapimishije inda inshuro zose basabwa. Menya niba yonka neza. Ubundi umwohereze kwa muganga kuko afite ibiro bike. Ageze ku kigo nderabuzima, bazamwohereza mu bitaro bikuru kugira ngo bakurikirane neza uko agenda akura anunguka ibiro. Amaze gukwiza ibiro 2.500 kg, nibwo asezererwa.
question_english: I visited a newborn baby boy on his third day of life. He is three days old and weighs 2.1 kilograms. I checked for danger signs and found none, but he was born with low birth weight. I noticed they were swaddling him, so I explained that they should carry him skin-to-skin in the chest (kangaroo care), with the baby’s body in close contact with the mother’s, and that he should be breastfed frequently to gain weight. I also emphasized the importance of colostrum as the first vaccine and advised them to avoid passing the baby around to different people. The mother replied that she could not deny others the opportunity to hold the baby. What advice can I give her?

question_kinyarwanda: Mwiriwe neza! umukobwa w'imyaka makumyabiri n'itandatu afite ibiro mirongo ine na birindwi. Iyo ariye ibiryo bikomeye arwara ikirungurira. Arabaza igitera ikirungurira?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Uramuha transfer ajye kwa Muganga barebe niba atari igifu arwaye, hanyuma bamuhe imiti ibasha kumworohereza.
question_english: Good evening! A twenty-six-year-old girl weighs forty-seven kilograms. When she eats solid food, she suffers from heartburn. She is asking what causes heartburn?

question_kinyarwanda: Umubyeyi ufite umwana w'umukobwa ufite amezi atatu n'igice, yaje angana ambwira ko umwana we afite intege nke, ko atonka akurura amashereka. Mugira inama yo kumwigisha kuyakama no kuyamuha akoresheje igikombe gisukuye kidafite imihiro hejuru. Nabazaga ko hari ubundi bufasha namufasha.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: kutonka k'umwana ntabwo ari ibisanzwe ahubwo ni ikimenyetso mpuruza. Ni byiza ko yihutira kugera kwa muganga bakareba impamvu yacitse intege atari kubasha gukurura ngo yonke bityo bakabasha kumuvura ikiri gutera ibyo kugirango abashe kugira ubuzima bwiza.
question_english: A mother with a three-and-a-half-month-old daughter came to me, saying her child is weak and unable to breastfeed properly, pulling milk without success. I advised her to learn how to express breast milk and feed the baby using a clean, smooth-edged cup. I am asking if there is any additional support I can provide.

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'umuhungu w'imyaka cumi n'itandatu ibiro mirongo ine, ambwiye ko ari kubabara umutwe, afite umuriro kandi akaba yafunze amazuru. Mubajije igihe yafatiwe ambwira ko amaze icyumweru. Mufashe tederi nsanga ari negatifu muhaye transiferi. Nabazaga, ese hari ubundi bufasha uyu musore nari kumuha?
