answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umuhungu ufite imyaka 16, ibiro 40, ababara umutwe, afite umuriro, yafunze amazuru. Amaze ibyumweru afashwe. Tederi ibaye negatifu. Ubundi bufasha: * Kumuha amogisi mirigarama 500 inshuro eshatu ku munsi mu minsi 5, yabasha gukira akaguma murugo, -Yaba atorohewe akagaruka agahabwa transferi akagana kwa muganga.
question_english: A 16-year-old boy weighing 40 kilograms told me he was experiencing a headache, fever, and a stuffy nose. When I asked how long he had been feeling this way, he told me it had been a week. I performed a malaria test, which came back negative, and I gave him a referral. I was asking if there was any additional assistance I could have provided to this boy?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umwana w'umuhungu ufite imyaka itatu, afite ibiro cumi na bitatu, afite muwake ya cumi na kabiri n'igice, abyimbye ibirenge n'amatama. Nta burwayi bundi yari afite.Musuzumye nsanga afite imirire mibi ihutiyeho.Namukorera iki? Nimungire inama.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Mwigishe uko bategura indyo yuzuhe, harimo ibyubaka umubiri, ibitera imbaraga n'ibirinda indwara. Hanyuma umwohereze kwa muganga muri service y'imirire bamuhe inyongeramirire.
question_english: I received a 3-year-old boy weighing 13 kilograms, with MUAC of 12.5, swollen feet and cheeks. He had no other known illnesses. After examining him, I found that he has acute malnutrition. What should I do for him? Please advise me.

question_kinyarwanda: nakiriye mugore w'imyaka mirongo itatu yaje ambwira ko yafashwe ku ngufu n'abantu atazi none yabuze imihango kandi yatinye kujya kwa muganga ngo adasanga atwite cyangwa yaranduye virusi itera sida nibazaga niba uyu murwayi hari ubundi bufasha yahabwa.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Nakiririye umugore w'imyaka 30 wambwiye ko yahohotewe n'abantu batazwi. Kuva icyo gihe ntiyongeye kubona imihango, kandi yari afite ubwoba bwo kujya kwa muganga kubera gutinya ko yaba atwite cyangwa yaranduye virusi itera SIDA. Igisubizo R// Kuva ryari? Itariki ya nyuma ni iyihe? Tugomba kumwigisha no kumwumvisha kujya kwa muganga, kugira ngo asuzumwe kandi yirinde/ yikingire hakiri kare, indwara zandurira mu mibonano mpuzabitsina n'inda itateganyijwe. Icya kabiri, ku nyungu ze bwite, uwakoze icyaha agomba guhanwa bikomeye. Kandi agomba guhabwa ubufasha mu by'ubuzima bwo mu mutwe no mu mibanire n'abandi.
question_english: I received a 30-year-old woman who reported to me that she was sexually assaulted by unknown individuals. She has since missed her menstrual period and was afraid to go to the hospital for fear of being pregnant or being contracted HIV. I was wondering if there is any other support or assistance that can be provided to her.

question_kinyarwanda: Umurwayi ufite imyaka ine, ibiro cumi na bitandatu, ni umukobwa. Ari gukorora, agahumeka nabi, akaba nta bundi burwayi asanganywe. Namupimye nkoresheje tayima incuro ahuhumeka nsanga ni mirongo ine na kabiri, afite umusonga. Muha amogisi. None ahise agaruka haziyemo n'impiswi. None mfite Zinc. Nayimuhana nayo akayivanga na Amogisi?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Yego, kandi ushobora kongeramo ORESI kugira ngo wirinde umwuma.
question_english: The patient is a 4-year-old girl weighing 16 kilograms. She is coughing, having difficulty breathing, and does not have any other known illnesses. I measured her breathing rate using a TIMER and found that it was 42 breaths per minute, indicating that she has pneumonia. I gave her amoxicillin .But suddenly she is back experiencing diarrhea. I have Zinc. Can I give her Zinc along with the amoxicillin?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umwana w'umuhungu ufite imyaka ine, ibiro cumi na bitanu, asanzwe akunda kurwara impiswi.Yaje afite impiswi, na mupimye miwake(MUAC) muha zenke na ors. Mwamfasha iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Niba akunda guhora arwaye impiswi ndumva wamwohereza kwa muganga bakamufasha bakamufatira ibindi bizame kuko ubwo afite indi ndwara arwaye, unigishe ababyeyi be ko bagomba kumurinda indwara z' umwanda kuko inshuro nyinshi impiswi iterwa n'umwanda no kunywa amazi mabi. ubigishe kunywa amazi atetse.
question_english: I received a four-year-old boy weighing fifteen kilograms, who often suffers from diarrhea. He came with diarrhea, and I measured him MUAC, gave him zinc and ORS. How can you help me?

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'imyaka ibiri n'igice, ibiro ni icumi maganatandatu, aje afite umuriro mwinshi, ahitwa birebire inshuro esheshatu ku munsi. Mubajije niba nta bundi burwayi asanganywe ambwira ko ntabwo. Namuha ubuhe bufasha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umwana w’imyaka 2 n’igice, ufite ibiro 10.6, yaje afite umuriro mwinshi n’impiswi (yituma inshuro 6 ku munsi nta bindi bibazo by’ubuzima afite). • Mwohereze kwa muganga ako kanya, kuko kwituma amazi inshuro 6 ku munsi bishyira umwana mu kaga ko kujya mu bibazo by'ihungabana ry'umubiri (bitewe no gutakaza amazi mu gihe ari guhitwa.), kubura intungamubiri no kugira imihangayiko y’umuriro mwinshi, bityo agomba koherezwa kwa muganga kugira ngo ahabwe amazi anyuzwa mu mutsi (Normal saline/Ringer's lactate) kugira ngo hatabaho kubura amazi n’intungamubiri mu mubiri, zenke sulfate (kugabanya ubukana no kugabanya uko guhitwa), imiti igabanya umuriro (IV paracetamol 10-15mg/kg).
question_english: A two-and-a-half-year-old child, weighing 10.6 kg, came in with a high fever and experiencing diarrhea six times a day. When I asked if he/she had any other health issues, the mother said no. What assistance can I provide to this child?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiye umubyeyi w'umugabo w'imyaka mirongo itatu n'itandatu, yari ari gukinga ibirahure kiramanuka kitura ku kuguru arakomereka. Nabazaga muganga ni iki wafasha uwo murwayi kugira abone imiti?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umurwayi w'umugabo w'imyaka 36 ufite akaboko k'akaguru kagonzwe n'ikintu cyamugwiriye ku kaguru. Uyu murwayi ashobora kuba afite igikomere gishobora kuva amaraso. Ashobora kuba afite igufa ryavunitse. Hita ufasha kugabanya ububabare ukoresheje imiti igabanya ububabare nka paracetamol. Fasha guhagarika kuva amaraso ushyiraho umwenda cyangwa bandeji ikanda. Niba hari igufa ryavunitse, shyira akaguru mu mwanya utanyeganyega. Ohereza umurwayi kwa muganga kugira ngo akomeze kwitabwaho no gukorerwa isuzuma.
question_english: I visited a father, a 36-year-old man, who was closing a window when it fell and injured his leg. I was asking the doctor what could be done to help this patient get medication.

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umubyeyi w'umugabo, wari ufite imyaka mirongo irindwi nine. Yari ari gukinga urugi yikubita inyundo arakomereka. Nabazaga muganga ni iki nafasha uwo murwayi ngo abone imiti?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Muhambirire aho yakomeretse, ubundi umwohereze kwa mugamga byihuse.
question_english: I have received a male patient who is seventy-nine years old. He has been locking the door and hit himself with a hammer, injuring himself. I have been asking the doctor what I could do to help that patient get medication.

question_kinyarwanda: Muraho, umubyeyi anzaniye umwana w'umuhungu w'imyaka icumi, ibiro makumyabiri, ambwira ko afite umuriro ari kubabara mu nda. Mubajije ko niba nta bundi burwayi asanganywe, ambwira ko ari ntabwo. Mubwiye ko yihangana aribuze kumera neza. Mushizemo igipimo cy'ubushyuhe, tayimametero musanzemo umuriro wa mirongo itatu nicyenda. Mukorera tederi, musanzemo malariya. Muhaye sisifuwaturuwa, afata ibinini bitatu kabiri ku munsi mu minsi itatu. Ese hari ubundi bufasha naha uyu mwana?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Ongeramo paracetamol kandi ukurikire uko ubuzima bw’umurwayi bugenda bumeze.
question_english: Hello, a parent brought me a ten-year-old boy weighing twenty kilograms and told me he has a fever and abdominal pain. When I asked if he had any other illnesses, they said no. I told them to be patient as he would soon feel better. I took his temperature using a thermometer and found it was 39 degrees. I tested him for malaria, and the result was positive. I gave him six times three, with three tablets to be taken twice a day for three days. Is there any other assistance I can provide for this child?

question_kinyarwanda: Mwiriwe neza, umugabo ufite imyaka mirongo ine n'itanu ibiro mirongo irindwi na bine. Aje akorora aribwa umutwe ababara mugatuza. Mubajije igihe amaranye inkorora ambwira ko ayimaranye ibyumweru bitatu, muhaye taransiferi ngo ajye ku ivuriro, aranze ngo nta bwisangane mu kwivuza afite. Ubu namufasha iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugabo wimyaka 45, ibiro 74, arakorora ,arababara umutwe, aranababara mugatuza, abimaranye ibyumweru 3, yanze taransiferi ngo ntabwisungane mukwivuza afite. Mubaze ibindi bimenyetso yaba afite nkokujyira umuriro, kubira ibyuya nijoro, gutakaza ibiro. Umubaze niba inkorora ari akayi cyangwa akorora agacira. Musobanurireko ashobora kuba yaranduye indwara y'igituntu bityo ko icyinjyenzi arukujya kwa muganga bakamupima agahabwa ubufasha, ibyu bwisungane bakazaba babikurikirana nyuma. Birashoboka ko yaba ari n'umusonga byose birashoboka. Niyompamvu kujyakwamuganga aribyo byihutitwa ngo hakorwe ibizamini avurwe bitewe n'uburwayi babonye noneho ibyubwisungane bigakomeza.
question_english: Good afternoon, a forty-five-year-old man weighing seventy-four kilograms came in with a cough, headache, and chest pain. When I asked how long he had been coughing, he said three weeks. I gave him a referral to go to the clinic, but he refused, saying he has no health insurance. How can I assist him now?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umwana w'umukobwa w'imyaka cumi nirindwi,yaje arwaye, afite agahinda kenshi, ababara umutwe ndetse ababara mugice cyinda, namubajije igihe ibyo bimenyetso abimaraniye ambwira ko abimaranye umunsi umwe, nakomeje kumuganiriza nshakisha n'ibimenyetso ambwira ko yaraye afashwe kungufu ariko akaba yatinye kubibwira ababyeyi.,Namugiriye inama yuko ari byiza ko yakihutira kujya kwa muganga mbere y'amasaha mirongo irindwi nibiri. Namwandikiye agatabo ka transiferi ndangije ndakamuha ahita ambwira ko atinya ko hari undi muntu wabimenya. Nafashe umwanzuro ndamuherekeza mujyana kwa muganga mushyikiriza ababishinzwe. Nabazaga niba nta bundi bufasha namuha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umukobwa wimyaka cumi n'irindwi, agaragaza agahinda gakabije, kubabara umutwe, no kubabara mu nda nyuma yo gufatwa ku ngufu ahura n'ihohoterwa rishingiye ku gitsina, kwishinza amakosa, agahinda gakabije. Akeneye kuganirizwa no guhumurizwa n'uko mu masaha 72 habonetse uburyo bwo kumuvura no kwirinda gusama, indwara zandurira mu mibonano mpuzabitsina harimo na virusi itera sida, gonorrhea, syphilis., kumuha parasetamol 1g na ibuprofen 400mg yo kumukuriraho ububabare hanyuma akamwohereza ku bitaro ngo asuzumwe agakoko ka virusi itera sida, niba uwafashe kungufu (ukekwaho kuba yaramufashe) afite virusi itera sida cyangwa atabizi uko ateye, ibipimo bya laboratwari bigomba gukorwa kandi bikavurwa uko bikwiye.
question_english: I received a girl who is seventeen years old, presenting with severe sadness, a headache, and abdominal pain. When I asked her how long she had been experiencing these symptoms, she said it had been one day. As I continued to speak with her to gather more information, she mentioned that she was raped but she was afraid to tell her parents. I advised her that it would be best to seek medical attention within the seventy-two hours. I wrote her a transfer note and gave it to her, but she expressed fear that someone might find out. I decided to accompany her to the medical facility and handed her over to the appropriate authorities. I would like to know if there is any additional support I can provide her.

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'umuhungu ufite imyaka cumi n'icyenda, umubyeyi we yamuzanye ambwira yuko ari kurira, ari kuvuga ibigambo biterekeranye, musuzumye nsanga ari kuvuga ibigambo bidasobanutse, nabagiriye inama yo kumujyana kwa muganga ngo bamurebere ko nta kibazo cyo mu mutwe yaba afite, none uyu muntu namufasha iki mbere y'uko ajya kwa muganga? Murakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Uyu mwana w'umuhungu ubufasha yahabwa ni ubwo kujya kwivuza kwa muganga, agahabwa ubufasha bumukwiriye kukibazo afite .  Gusa, mbere y'uko ajya kwa muganga, hari ibintu byingenzi wakora kugira ngo umufashe: 1. Kumuba hafi no kumwumva ku kibazo afite ukamutega amatwi ku kibazo afite mu buryo butuje cyane kandi akakwiyumvamo kandi mugahuza ibyiyumviro. 2. Gushakisha neza indi mpamvu nyamukuru y'ikibazo gituma avuga amagambo aterekeranye. 3. Kumufasha kugaruka mubuzima busanzwe bwa buri munsi igihe ari kumwe n'abandi. Wamufasha gusubira mu murongo w'ibitekerezo byiza binyuze mu kumubaza ibibazo byumvikana. 4. Kumuha umwanya agatuza muriwe, iyo arira cyangwa avuga amagambo atumvikana, umuha umwanya agatuza.  5. Mugihe urimo uramuha ubwo bufasha bwose ni ngombwa kwihutira Kumugeza kwa muganga bakabasha kumukorera isuzuma.
question_english: A 19-year-old boy was brought to me by his parent, who told me that the boy had been crying and speaking incoherently. When I examined him, I found that he was indeed speaking in a disorganized manner. I advised them to take him to the hospital to check if he might have a mental health issue. Now, I ask, how can I help this person before he goes to the hospital? Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Umukobwa, amezi atandatu, ibiro icyenda, umuriro mirongo itatu n'umunani, aje ari kubabara, ntiyonka neza, abimaranye iminsi itatu, mupimye, nta musonga afite, ari kurushaho kuremba kuko ari kumera amenyo. Ni iki nakora kugira ngo mufashe mbere yo kumwohereza?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze kubaza iki kibazo cy'uyu mukobwa ufite amezi atandatu, ibiro icyenda, umuriro mirongo itatu n'umunani. Waje ari kubabara, ntiyonka neza, abimaranye iminsi itatu. Umupimye nta musonga afite, ari kurushaho kuremba kuko ari kumera amenyo. Ukaba ubaza icyo wakora kugirango umufashe mbere yo kumwohereza. Uyu mwana ugeze mu gihe cyo kumera amenyo aba ashaka gufata ikintu cyose agishyira mu kanwa kuko aba ari kuribwa no kuryaryatwa. Niyo mpamvu ugomba kwigisha nyina akamugirira isuku, akamurinda ibintu byose byamwangiza mu kanwa n'ibintu byose bifite umwanda kuko bimutera kurwara indwara z'umwanda. Kandi akamwitaho akamwonsa uko ashoboye. Iyo umwana ameze gutya, aba agoranye kumenya icyiri kumutera kubabara no kutonka neza. Kuba umwana ageze mu gihe cyo kumera amenyo akagira ibi bimenyetso, ntabwo twabishingiraho, tuvuga ko ari cyo kibazo umwana afite gusa. Ahubwo hagomba gukorwa ibindi bizamini, agasuzumwa inzoka n'izindi ndwara zose, kandi agahabwa imiti ijyanye n'uburwayi afite. Rero, muhe ubu bufasha, umusobanurira ukurikije ibyavuzwe haruguru, uhite umuha taransiferi imujyana kw'ivuriro. Murakoze.
question_english: A girl, six months old, weighing nine kilograms, has a fever of thirty-eight, came while in pain, not breastfeeding well, has had it for three days, when i examined, has no pneumonia, is getting worse because she is having teeth eruption. What can I do to help before sending her?

question_kinyarwanda: Umuhungu w'imyaka cumi n’icyenda y'amavuko yaje angana, arambwira ngo yahuye n'umugore bakorana imibonano mpuzabitsina idakingiye, kandi uwo mugore arwaye agakoko gatera SIDA. Namubwiye ko agomba guhita ajya kwisuzumisha kwa muganga. Mungire inama, hari ikindi nari kumumarira?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze! -Mubaze niba byashoboka ajyane n'uwo mugore bongere babapimire hamwe. -Mwohereze kwa muganga nibyo. -Agomba gufashwa bitarenze amasaha byibuze 48. -Mwigishe ubuzima bwimyororokere,kwita,gukoresha agakingirizo. -Shaka uko waganira nuwo mugore numubona maze nawe umwigishe.
question_english: A nineteen-year-old boy came to me and said he had an unprotected sexual intercourse with a woman infected with HIV. I advised him to immediately go for a medical check-up. Please advise me, is there anything else I could have done for him?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umugore w'imyaka makumyabiri n'itanu ufite ibiro mirongo itanu na bibiri ambwiye ko amaze kwipimisha VIH inshuro ebyiri, abaganga bakamubwira ko ibisubizo bye bidasobanutse. Uyu mubyeyi namufasha iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Ubusanzwe iyo umuntu yipimishije VIH bakamubwira ko igisubizo kidasobanutse, bamubwira kuzagaruka nyuma yiminsi cumi nine. Yagaruka basanga bidasobanutse bakamufatira amaraso yo mu mutsi bakayapimira kurwego rw' isumbuye. Ubwo rero wamwohereza kukigonderabuzima bamufasha bitewe naho byari bigereye.
question_english: I received a twenty-five-year-old woman who weighs fifty-two kilograms. She told me that she has been tested for HIV twice, and the doctors told her that her results were inconclusive. How can I help this patient?

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'umuhungu w'amezi cumi n'abiri, afite ibiro cumi na kimwe n'amagarama magana atanu; ari kuruka; ari guhinda n'umuriro. Mupimye umuriro nsanga afite mirongo itatu na karindwi nibice bitanu. Mufatiye TDR nsanga nta malariya afite. None mwamfasha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umwana wumuhungu afite amezi 12 ibiro 11.5kg Ari kuruka arahinda n'umuriro wa 37.5, tederi yabaye negatifu. Reba umwana ko nta bindi bimenyetso mpuruza afite harimo kubura ubwenge, umwuma ukabije, guhumeka nabi ,gucibwamo. Niba bihari mubaze igihe abimaranye. Mushishikarize kunywa cyangwa konka cyane adakomeza kugira umwuma. Kuko umwana uruka aba yagorana mu gufata imiti , muhe transiferi ajye kwa muganga basubiremo tederi n'ibindi bizami, bityo ahabwe ubuvuzi bujyanye nuko basanze arwaye.
question_english: A twelve-month-old boy weighs eleven kilograms and five hundred grams; he is vomiting; he has a fever. I measured his temperature and found it to be thirty-seven point five degrees. I tested him with a TDR and found he does not have malaria. So, can you help me?

question_kinyarwanda: Umubyeyi ufite umwana w'umukobwa w'imyaka itatu n'amezi icyenda, aje angana afite ikibazo cyo gukorora, amaze iminsi itatu akorora. Afite ibiro cumi na bitanu magana abiri. Ndamupimye nsanga arahumeka mirongo ine na gatatu, na gatanu. Muhaye amoxi mirongo ine ngo ajye amuha ibinini bine, kabiri ku munsi mu minsi itanu. Nabazaga ko hari ubundi bufasha mwamuha.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umubyeyi ufite umwana w'umukobwa w'imyaka itatu n'amezi icyenda, aje angana afite ikibazo cyo gukorora, amaze iminsi itatu akorora. Afite ibiro cumi na bitanu magana abiri. Ndamupimye nsanga arahumeka mirongo ine na gatatu muhaye amoxi. Baza uburyo yavutse. Niba abasha konka mupime TDR ya malaria. Ariko turatekereza cyane umusonga w'abana, rero nubona TDR ari negative umwohereze bajye kumufata amaraso, barebe infection yo mu maraso babe bamuha ubundi bwoko bw'imiti.
question_english: A parent with a three-year and nine-month-old daughter has come with a complaint of coughing, which has lasted for three days. She weighs fifteen kilograms and two hundred grams. I've examined her and found she breathes forty-three and five times per minute. I've given her forty milligrams of amoxicillin to take four tablets, twice a day for five days. I would like to ask if there is any other assistance you could provide her.

question_kinyarwanda: Mwaramutse Neza! Umugore w'imyaka mirongo irindwi n'ine, afite ibiro mirongo itanu na kimwe, afite ikibazo abana n'agakoko gatera sida. Ambwiye ko aho ababara munda; akaribwa umutwe cyane; agacika intege; akagira isereri. Mubajije igihe abimaranye ambwiye ko abimaranye iminsi irindwi. Namwohereje ku kigo nderabuzima ngo ajye kwivuza yanze kujyayo ngo ni muhe umuti. Ubu namufasha iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Mwaramutse neza!Murakoze kubaza iki kibazo cy'uyu mugore w'imyaka mirongo irindwi nine ,ufite ibiro itanu na kimwe ufite ikibazo cyuko abana n'agakoko gatera sida, akubwiye ko ari kubabara mu nda, akaribwa mu mutwe cyane agacika intege ,akagira isereri . Umubajije igihe abimaranye akubwira ko abimaranye iminsi irindwi ,wamwohereje ku kigo nderabuzima ngo ajye kwivuza yanze kujyayo ngo umuhe imiti .ukaba ugisha inama y'ubufasha wamuha. Nibyo koko hari abantu benshi bagira imyumvire nkiyi,uyu mukecuru afite ,cyangwa barwara ntibagire ikibazo kibahangayikisha ahubwo abenshi ugasanga bashaka kwivuza buryo bwa magendu kandi bafite ibimenyetso bikomeye nk,ibyo,uyu mubyeyi afite byo kuribwa mu mutwe,mu nda, gucika intege ndetse n'isereri. Tugendeye ku bimenyetso afite iyo umuntu agize ikimenyetso cyo kuribwa umutwe dukeka indwara nyinshi zitandukanye kubera ko umutwe niho ubwonko buri kandi nibwo buyobora imikorere y,umubiri wose bivuze ko aba ari ikimenyetso cyerekana ko mu mubiri hari ikibazo kidasanzwe wenda akaba arwaye umuvuduko w'amaraso, diyabete ,kuba afite ibibyimba byo mu mutwe kuba haraziyemo n'ubundi burwayi . uyu mubyeyi agomba kwegerwa akaganirizwa akumvishwa yuko ibi bimenyetso byo kuribwa mu nda,umutwe ,gucika intege no kugira isereri bitizanye gusa ahubwo hari ubundi burwayi butaramenyekana bubyihishe inyuma,cyangwa bikaba bishoboka ko imiti ayifata nabi ntiyubahirize amabwiriza yahawe na muganga bikaba byaratumye ntacyo imumarira . Niyo mpamvu agomba kuganirizwa ibi byose maze agafashwa . uyu mubyeyi ubufasha wamuha hakurikijwe ibi byavuzwe haruguru ,nuko waganiriza abo mu muryango we, ukamuha taransiferi imujyana ku kigo nderabuzima kimwemwegereye wabona batabyumva neza ukamwijyanira akavurwa. Murakoze.
question_english: Good morning! A seventy-four-year-old woman, weighing fifty-one kilograms, has an issue living with the HIV virus. She told me that she feels abdominal pain; has severe headaches; feels weak; and experiences dizziness. When I asked her how long she has been feeling this way, she told me it has been seven days. I referred her to the health center for treatment, but she refused to go and asked me to give her medicine. How can I help her now?

question_kinyarwanda: Umugore yaje ku gipimo gukurikirana imikurire y'umwana. Umwana n'umukobwa afite ibiro bine namagarama magana atanu, afite amezi atatu. Agarutse kugipimo nsanga umwana yahombye ibiro; mubaza niba umwana yararwaye, ambwira ko atarwaye. Mubaza ko amwotsa kenshi, ambwirako amwotsa kenshi. Mugira inama yo kumujyana kwa muganga ambwira ko atabona umwanya wo kujyayo. N'iki namubwira?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugore yaje ku ivuriro gukurikirana uko umwana we akura. Uwo mwana ni umukobwa upima ibiro bine na garama magana atanu, kandi afite amezi atatu. Yatakaje ibiro ugereranyije n’imyaka afite. None muhe inama, mumwigishe ko uyu mwana ashobora kugira ikibazo cy’imikurire, bityo ni ingenzi cyane kujya ku kigo nderabuzima kugira ngo ahabwe inama zindi no gukurikiranwa neza.
question_english: A woman came to the clinic to monitor the growth of her child. The child is a girl weighing four kilograms and five hundred grams, and she is three months old. When she returned to the clinic, I found that the child had lost weight; I asked if the child had been sick, and she told me she had not been sick. I asked if she breastfeeds her often, and she told me she does. I advised her to take the child to the hospital, and she told me she doesn't have time to go there. What should I tell her?

question_kinyarwanda: Umugore w'imyaka makumyabiri nitandatu amaranye n'umugabo we imyaka ine bashakanye, bari kugisha inama bambwira ko batabyaye. Mbagira inama mbabwira umugore ko ugomba kumenya iminsi ye y'ukwezi k'umugore, bamara kuyimenya bakagerageza kugabanyamo kabiri bagakora umushyikirano ku munsi uri hagati muri iyo minsi, kandi mbagira inama yo kwegera abaganga kugira ngo bibafashemo. Noneho nabaza, ese inama nabagira ni iyihe? Mukoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugore w'imyaka 26 umaze imyaka 4 arushinze ariko yananiwe gusama.  Icyo wamufasha; ubanze umubaze kenshi ahura n'umugabo we ese ni buri munsi? niba atari byo, umujyire inama yo kumenya igihe cye cy'uburumbuke maze asabe umugabo we kuba ahari muri icyo gihe. Niba bahura buri munsi, ubagire inama yo kujya kwa muganga kugira ngo bapimwe neza kandi bavurwe uko bikwiye.
question_english: A twenty-six-year-old woman, who has been married to her husband for four years, came seeking advice because they have not been able to conceive. I advised the woman to track her menstrual cycle, determine her ovulation period, and try to have intercourse around the midpoint of her cycle. I also recommended that they consult doctors for further assistance. What additional advice can I offer them? Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Nasuye ingo ndimo mbarura abagore n'abakobwa bashobora gusama, nsanga umugore w'imyaka makumyabiri n'itatu afite ibiro mirongo itanu mubaza igihe aherukira mu mihango ambwira ko amaze amezi atatu atabona imihango. Mubaza ko nta burwayi afite ambwira ko ntabwo mugira inama yo kujya kwa muganga, bakamusuzuma ko atwite ambwira ko hakiri vuba ko azajyayo hashize amezi atanu, namusobanuriye ibyiza byo kubimenya kare arabyanga, mungire inama y'icyo nakora.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Ni umugore ufite imyaka 23 n'ibiro 50, amaze amezi 3 atabona imihango. Kubera ko uyu mugore ashobora kuba atwite n'iyo yaba yanze kujya kwa muganga, ukwiye gukomeza kumwigisha ibyiza byo kumenya ko atwite hakiri kare, ukamuha amahirwe yo kugura mu ma farumasi akuma gapima inda kakamufasha kumenya ko atwite, kandi ukamuha n'imiti azahabwa nk'inyongera ya feri, urukingo rwa tetatus, gupima stis, hepatite, kugira ngo bimufashe kwita ku buzima bwe n'ubw'umwana atwite. Niba akomeje kwanga, nakongeraho ibimenyetso mpuruza nko kuva amaraso mu gihe cyo gutwita, ku buryo aramutse abonye ko hari aho ava amaraso mu gitsina, cyangwa se amasohoro ava mu gitsina, agomba guhita ajya ku kigonderabuzima.
question_english: I visited households to count women and girls of childbearing age, and I found a 23-year-old woman weighing 50 kilograms. When I asked her about her last menstrual period, she told me she hasn't had one for three months. I asked if she had any health issues, and she said no. I advised her to go to the hospital for a pregnancy test, but she said it's too early and that she would go after five months. I explained the benefits of knowing early, but she refused. Please advise me on what I should do.

question_kinyarwanda: Umubyeyi yazanye umwana w'umukobwa w'imyaka itatu, ibiro cumi na bitanu, ababara mu nda ari guhitwa inshuro nyinshi, mupimye nsanga arwaye impiswi. Ese hari ubundi bujyanama nari kumuha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Ubujyanama wamuha ni ubwo kugira isuku, ari ku mubiri, ari mu byo bategura byo kurya ndetse n'isuku aho batuye. Bakagira umuco wo gukaraba intoki kenshi, koza amasahane bariraho bakayashyira ku izuba kugira ngo yumuke neza, ndetse no gukaraba intoki n'amazi meza n'isabune bavuye mu bwiherero cyangwa nyuma yo guhanagura umwana witumye. Ubundi kandi wamukorera esiro (OSR) akajya kwa muganga ayinywa.
question_english: A mother brought a three-year-old daughter who weighs 15 kg. abdominal pain is being repeatedly and diarrhea for many times. When she was tested for diarrhea got positive result. Was there any other advice i could give her?

question_kinyarwanda: Umurwayi w'umukobwa w'imyaka cumi n’irindwi, ibiro mirongo ine, yaje ataka umutwe kandi afite umuriro wa mirongo ine,mupimye nsanga nta malariya afite, ndamwohereza. Ese hari ubundi bufasha nari kumuha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Wari kumubwira agakaraba umubiri wose n'amazi akonje, kugira ngo umuriro ugabanuke, ubundi agahita aza ku kigo nderabuzima, kugira ngo bakore ibizamini byimbitse.
question_english: A 17-year-old girl, weighing 40 kilograms, came complaining of a headache and a temperature of 40°C. I tested her and found that she does not have malaria. I transferred her. Is there any other help I should provide her?

question_kinyarwanda: Nasuye umugore ufite umwana w'amezi cumi n'atanu w'umukobwa. Afite imirire mibi ya karande, yahawe shisha kibondo. Nsanga shisha kibondo yayivanze n'indi fu. Mugira inama y'uko shisha kibondo itajya ivangwa n'indi fu, kuko harimo intungamubiri zituma umwana ava mu mirire mibi ya karande. Nabazaga niba hari ubundi bufasha namuha.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Mwakoze gusura uyu mugore ufite umwana w'amezi cumi n'atanu w'umukobwa akaba afite imirire mibi ya karande, bakaba baramuhaye shisha kibondo. Ikintu wafasha uyu mwana, ni ukugira inama umubyeyi w'uyu mwana ukamusobanurira ko shisha kibondo bayinywa itavangiye. Ikindi akagerageza gutegurira umwana indyo yuzuye irimo ibirinda indwara, ibyubaka umubiri n'ibitera imbaraga. Ikindi umwibutse kujya yitabira igikoni cy'umudugudu kugirango yige gutegura indyo yuzuye.
question_english: I have visited a woman with a fifteen-month-old baby girl. She has chronic malnutrition and has been given Shisha Kibondo. I have found that she has mixed Shisha Kibondo with another flour. I have advised her that Shisha Kibondo should not be mixed with other flour because it contains nutrients that help the child recover from chronic malnutrition. I am asking if there is any other assistance I could provide her.

question_kinyarwanda: Uwineza ni umwana w'umukobwa w'imyaka ibiro cumi na bibiri, mama we yamuzanye ambwira ko umwana afite umuriro kandi ahumeka nabi mpimye tederi sanga ni negatifu. Mpimye inshuro ahumeka nsanga nta kibazo cy'umusonga afite ariko mama we, ambwira ko yabanaga na nyirakuru akirutsa igituntu kandi umwana akaba agenda ananuka yanga kurya. Mwandikira tarasiferi ambwira ko nta mituweli twamufasha gute?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Ohereza umurwayi ku bitaro kandi hirindwe guhura n'abandi bantu. Bagomba gushaka mutuweri (health insurance) vuba bishoboka.
question_english: Uwineza is a twelve-year-old girl. Her mother brought her to me, telling me that the child has a fever and is breathing poorly. I tested for malaria, and it was negative. I checked her breathing rate and found no signs of pneumonia, but her mother told me that she used to live with her grandmother, who had tuberculosis, and the child is losing weight and refusing to eat. I wrote for her a transfer and he informed me that she hasn't health insurance. How should we assist her?

question_kinyarwanda: Umurwayi ufite imyaka itanu, ibiro cumi na bitatu muwake(MUAC) cumi na gatanu. Ni umuhungu arakorora, agahumeka nabi, akaba nta bundi burwayi yarasanganywe. Mupimye nkoresheje tayima nsanga ahumeka inshuro mirongo ine n'ebyiri afite umusonga. Muha amogisi ahise agaruka haziyemo n'impiswi, none mfite zenke. Nayimuha nayo akayivanga na amogisi?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umwana w’imyaka 5, upima ibiro 13, ufite MUAC ya cm 15, waje afite inkorora n’ingorane mu guhumeka hamwe n’umuvuduko w'ubuhumekero wa 42 cpm, yavuwe akoresheje amoxicillin arakira ariko ubu afite impiswi. Uyu mwana yari afite umusonga woroshye wavuwe, kandi ubu ashobora kuba afite gastroenterite iterwa n'udukoko tw’umubiri cyangwa virusi. Niba umwana atari mu bushuhe bukabije kandi ashobora kurya no kunywa, mugaburire umuti wongera amazi mu mubiri (ORS) 10 ml/kg nyuma y'uko ahiswe. Mumuhe zenke sulphate kandi mu mushishikarize kunywa amazi ahagije. Mwigishe ku isuku ihagije ndetse no gutegura neza ibiryo. Mukomeze kumuha amoxicillin kugeza igihe dose yagenwe irangiye. Niba impiswi idakira, mumujyane ku kigo nderabuzima kugira ngo bapime umusarane we, kandi niba basanze afite udukoko tw’umubiri, arahabwa albendazole.
question_english: A 5-year-old boy, weighing 13 kg, with a mid-upper arm circumference (MUAC) of 15 cm, came in with a cough and difficulty breathing. He has no prior medical conditions. Using a timer, I measured his respiratory rate and found it to be 42 breaths per minute, indicating pneumonia. I gave him amoxicillin, and his condition improved, but he later developed diarrhea. Now I have zinc. Should I give it to him alongside the amoxicillin?

question_kinyarwanda: Mwaramutse, umugabo w'imyaka mirongo ine n’ibiri, yaje angana afite ibiro mirongo itanu n’icyenda, ambwira ko amaze iminsi ababara ariko yari yasheshe n'ibiheri ku mubiri, mubaza icyo yabaye ambwira ko amaze imyaka itatu abana na virusi itera SIDA, None ariko ntahandi ababara usibye gushesha ibyo biheri byari bisheshe ku mubiri. None mwangira inama yo namubwira, nabazaga ko niba hari ubundi bufasha yafata kugira ngo abone n'indi miti yanywa, murakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Mwaramutse neza! Murakoze kubaza ikibazo cy'uyu mugabo w'imyaka mirongo ine n'ibiri waje akugana afite ibiro mirongo itanu n'icyenda akubwira ko amaze iminsi ababara ariko yari yasheshe n'ibiheri ku mubiri umubaza icyo yabaye akubwira ko amaze imyaka itatu abana na virusi itera sida none akaba ari ntahandi ababara usibye gushesha ibyo biheri byari bisheshe ku mubiri none ukaba ubaza inama twakugira wamuha, kandi ukaba wabazaga ko hakiri ubundi bufasha wamuha kugira ngo abone indi miti. Nibyo koko iyo umuntu afata imiti igabanya ubwandu bw'akoko gatera sida bishoboka ko ashobora kugira ikibazo runaka ariko kuba uyu mugabo yaramaze imyaka itatu afata imiti ntagire ikibazo kindi ayigiraho cyangwa imutera, hagomba kurebwa no gusuzumwa bihagije bakareba ko atari ubundi burwayi bwaziyemo, basanga ari ukubera imiti igabanya ubwandu bw'agakoko, gatera sida yamuhindutse akaba yahindurirwa ubundi bwoko, basanga ari Indi ndwara yaziyemo, agahabwa imiti agakira. Murakoze!
question_english: Good morning, a 42-year-old man came to me weighing 59 kilograms. He said he had been in pain for a few days and had lesions on his body. When I asked about the cause, he mentioned that he had been living with HIV for three years. However, he doesn't have any other pains except for the rash. What advice should I give him, and is there any additional assistance I can provide in terms of medication or treatment? Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Mwaramutse. Umuntu w'umudamu ufite imyaka mirongo ine n'itanu angezeho ambwira ko bamushyize agapira mu kaboko, ambwira ko kagiye kenda kugera mu gatuza. Mubajije ko ntabundi burwayi asanzwe agira, ambwira ko ari ntabwo. None mubwiye ko yajya kwa muganga. None uyu mubyeyi niki kindi namufasha? Murakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: murakoze -Muhumurize umubwire ko bibaho kandi ko bari bumufashe -Najye kwa muganga -Muganirize kubundi buryo bwo kuboneza kandi ko abishaka yahindura -Naba ataraboneza yibuke kuba akoresha uburyo natureli ,bwo kubara cyangwa agakingirizo
question_english: Good morning. A 45-year-old woman has approached me and told me that they have inserted a contraceptive implant in her arm, and she said it is about to reach her chest. When I have asked her if she has any other existing illnesses, she has said no. I have told her to go to the hospital. Now, what else can I do to help this woman? Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'umukobwa w'imyaka mirongo itatu n’itanu aje kwivuza ataka umutwe cyane, ambwira ko rimwe akonja agatitira, ubundi agashyuha akabira ibyuya ahantu hose k’umubiri, mupimye musangana umuriro wa mirongo itatu n’icyenda, mufatiye tederi(TDR) iba positifu(positifu), mubajije mu buzima busanzwe ambwira ko yavukanye ubwandu kandi afata imiti. None namufasha iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugore w’imyaka 35 yaje ashaka kwivuza, yitotomba ko arwaye umutwe ukabije. Yavuze ko rimwe na rimwe yumva akonje kandi agahinda umushyitsi, hanyuma ako kanya akumva ashyushye cyane agashyuha umubiri wose. Napimye ubushyuhe bwe, bwari 39°C, kandi nakoze ikizamini cyihuse cya malariya (RDT), cyagaragaje ko afite malariya. Yavukanye virusi itera SIDA kandi ari ku miti. Muhe Coartem nk’umuti wa malariya. Komeza kumuha imiti ya SIDA. Muhe imiti igabanya ubushyuhe. Hanyuma ashobora koherezwa nyuma gupimwa ingano ya virusi mu maraso niba ameze neza.
question_english: A 35-year-old woman came seeking treatment, complaining of a severe headache. She mentioned that she sometimes feels cold and shivers, then suddenly feels hot and sweats all over her body. I measured her temperature, which was 39°C, and performed a rapid diagnostic test (RDT) for malaria, which resulted positive. When I asked about her medical history, she said she was born with HIV and is on medication. How can I assist her?

question_kinyarwanda: Umukobwa w'imyaka cumi n'umunani, yangeze imbere ambwira ko yagiye kwipimisha ubwandu bw'agakoko gatera sida asanga yaranduye. Yibaza uburyo yanduyemo byamuyobeye kandi ya yahakanye ko adashobora kunywa imiti. Yafashwe iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze kubaza iki kibazo cy’umwana w’umukobwa ufite imyaka cumi n’umunani, wakugeze imbere akubwira ko yagiye kwipimisha ubwandu bw’agakoko gatera SIDA agasanga yaranduye. Yibaza uburyo yanduyemo bikamuyobera, kandi yahakanye ko adashobora kunywa imiti. Ukaba ubaza icyo yafashwa. Nibyo koko, dukurikije ibyabaye kuri uyu mukobwa, birababaje, cyane ko atazi uko yanduye agakoko gatera SIDA. Gusa, agomba kubanza kumenya ko agakoko gatera SIDA kandurira ahantu hatandukanye, urugero: Igihe umwana avuka, nyina afite ako gakoko, akaba yamwanduza igihe atafashe imiti. Mugihe habayeho guhuza amaraso n’undi ufite ako gakoko gatera SIDA (nko mu mpanuka runaka). Mugukoresha ibikoresho bicyeba, nk’urwembe, umwe afite agakoko gatera SIDA. Mu mibonano mpuzabitsina idakingiye, umwe afite ako gakoko. Gukora ku matembabuzi y’ufite igisebe (nk’amaraso y’ufite agakoko gatera SIDA), n’ibindi. Nyuma yo gusobanurirwa ibi byose, akagirwa inama y’uko umuntu ufite ubwandu bw’agakoko gatera SIDA, iyo afashe imiti neza, abaho igihe nk’icyo yari kubaho, kandi ko ubuzima bukomeza. Akibutswa ko atari we wenyine urwaye. Rero, uyu mukobwa agomba kugira umuntu umuba hafi, akamufasha kwiyakira no kumva umumaro wo gufata imiti igabanya ubukana cyangwa ubwandu bw’agakoko gatera SIDA. Murakoze!
question_english: An eighteen-year-old girl has come to me and told me that she's gone for HIV test and found out she was infected. She's wondered how she's got infected as it's confused her, and she's even refused to take medication. What can be for her?

question_kinyarwanda: Mwiriwe neza, Umugabo w'imyaka mirongo ine n'ibiro mirongo itandatu na bibiri, afashwe n'umuriro w'amashanyarazi aho yari arimo gusakara inzu ye ari gukuraho amategura ashaka gushyiraho amabati. Ameze nabi ntago ari kuvuga ndetse afite n'imbeho mubwiye ko yihangana ko ari bumere neza. Muhaye taransferi ariko muhamagariye ambulance. Nibabazaga niba hari ubundi bufasha namuha, murakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze -Wimuha taransiferi hamagara byihuse imbangukiragutabara,menyesha ubuyobozi bugufashe -Kora ubutabazi bwibanze
question_english: Good afternoon, I received a 40-year-old man weighing 62 kilograms who was electrocuted while repairing his roof, removing old roofing materials to install new ones. He is in bad condition, unable to speak, and has cold sweats. He told me he is enduring the pain and that he will be fine. I gave him a transfusion and called an ambulance. I was asking if there is any other assistance I can provide him. Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Nasuye mwana w'umukobwa, afite iminsi icyend,a afite ibiro bitatu n'amagarama maganatandatu. Naganirije ababyeyi be mbasobanuje ibimenyetso mpuruza, nta burwayi yavukanye ariko bambwiye ko umukondo wanze gufatana, hararangaye mbagira inama yo kujya kwa muganga bambwira ko bashyiramo amata y'umuvumu kugira ngo haze gufatana. Nabagira iyihe nama?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Ni ukugana ivuriro.
question_english: I visited a baby girl, she is nine days old, weighs three kilograms and six hundred grams. I talked to her parents and explained the warning signs, she was not born with any illness but they told me that her umbilical cord has not healed, it is open, and I advised them to go to the hospital and they told me they are applying fig tree milk to help it heal. What advice should I give them?

question_kinyarwanda: Nagiye mu nteko y'abaturage igizwe n'abagabo makumyabiri n'abagore mirongo itandatu. Bose bari mu kigero cy'imyaka cumi n'umunani kuzamura. Twaganiriye ku bimenyetso by'indwara z'ibyorezo, ariko ukabona ntibabyumva. Hakorwa iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Icyakorwa nugukomeza ubukangurambaga kuko guhindura imyumvire bisaba kwigisha guhoraho.niyo mpamvu ugomba kubasobanurira uburyo bwose bushoboka bwo kwirinda ibyorezo ndetse ukanababwira ingaruka z,indwara z, ibyorezo kugirango bamenye uburemere bwabyo
question_english: I have gone to an assembly of citizens composed of twenty men and sixty women. They have all been aged eighteen and above. We have discussed the signs of epidemic diseases, but it is clear they do not understand. What should be done?

question_kinyarwanda: Umubyeyi yazanye umwana w'imyaka ibiri nigice w'ibiro icyenda ari gukorora kenshi no kuruka kandi bitari bisanzwe bimubaho mufatira tayima nsanga nta kibazo afite. Ese ni ubuhe butabazi bundi nari kumuha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakze. -Mushishsikarize umubyeyi we kumugaburira neza no kumuha icyo kunywa gisukuye. -Muhe transferi bajye kumukorera ibizamini barebe ikibazo afite banamuvure.
question_english: A mother brought a 2.5-year-old weighing 9 kilograms who was experiencing severe coughing and vomiting, which was unusual for them. I assessed the child for pneumonia using timer but found no issues. What additional care or intervention coul I provide?

question_kinyarwanda: Mwiriwe, nagiye gukangurira umubyeyi gukingiza urukingo rw'amezi abiri n'igice, umwana w'umukobwa ufite ibiro bitandatu. Nsobanurira umubyeyi we akamaro k'inkingo ambwira ko Iyo bamukingiye agira umuriro mwinshi, bigatuma umubyeyi ngo arambika icupa aho bateye urushinge. Nabazaga nti mungire inama naha uwo mubyeyi.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Mwiriwe, nagiye gushishikariza umubyeyi gukingiza umukobwa we w’amezi 2.5 upima ibiro 6.  Nasobanuriye umubyeyi ibyiza by’inkingo, ariko ambwira ko iyo umwana akingiwe, ahita agira umuriro mwinshi, bigatuma umubyeyi ashyira icupa aho bamutewe urushinge. Igisubizo R// Kugira ngo avuge ko bibaho kandi ari ibisanzwe, gufata umuti ugabanya umuriro mu minsi mike gusa ariko kubahiriza gahunda y’inkingo ni ingenzi cyane!  Usobanurire n’ibyiza byazo.
question_english: Good afternoon, I went to encourage a mother to vaccinate her 2.5-month-old daughter who weighs 6 kilograms. I explained the benefits of vaccines to the mother, but she told me that whenever the child is vaccinated, she develops a high fever, which leads the parent to apply a bottle where the injection was given. I was asking for advice to give to the mother.

question_kinyarwanda: Umubyeyi azanye umwana w'umuhungu ufite imyaka ibiri, ibiro cumi na bine, afite ikibazo cy'impiyiswi ivanze n'amaraso. None mbajije umubyeyi ambwira ko nta bundi burwayi afite, ariko afite imirire mibi. None namuha iyihe miti?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umwana afite ikibazo cy'impiyiswi ivanze n'amaraso kandi afite imirire mibi, ni ngombwa kubanza kumujyana kwa muganga kuko afite ibimenyetso mpuruza ikugira ngo harebwe neza imiterere y'uburwayi bwe. Impiyiswi ivanze n'amaraso bishobora kuba ibimenyetso by'ikibazo gikomeye gikeneye inama no kuganirwaho neza na muganga nk'ibibazo cyangwa indwara zifitanye isano n'imirire mibi. Gusa igishoboka ni ukugana muganga ubifite mu nshingano ze.
question_english: A parent brought in a two-year-old boy who weighs fourteen kilograms and has blood-tinged diarrhea. When I asked the parent, she said that the child has no other illnesses but has malnutrition. What medication should I give him?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umwana wumukobwa w'imyaka itanu, ufite ibiro cumi na bitatu, amaze iminsi itatu afashwe, umuriro ni mirongo itatu na gatandatu n'bice bitanu, arababara umutwe cyane, amaso ye yabaye umutuku, acika intege cyane. Namubajije niba nta bundi burwayi afite ,umubyeyi ambwira ko ari ntabwo. namugiriye inama yo kujya amuha amazi menshi, kuyanywa inshuro nyinshi. Nabazaga niba hari ubundi bufasha mwamuha, cyangwa imiti mwamuha.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze kuba mwakiriye uyu mwana w’umukobwa w’imyaka itanu, ufite ibiro cumi na bitatu. Amaze iminsi itatu afashwe, afite umuriro wa mirongo itatu na gatandatu n'ibice bitanu, aribwa umutwe cyane, amaso ye yabaye umutuku, kandi acika intege cyane. Wamubajije niba nta bundi burwayi afite, umubyeyi we akubwira ko nta bwo. Wamugiriye inama yo kujya amuha amazi menshi, kunywa inshuro nyinshi. Wabazaga niba hari ubundi bufasha twamuha cyangwa imiti twamuha. Tubashimiye ubufasha n’inama nziza mwagiriye nyina w’uriya mwana yo kunywa amazi menshi inshuro nyinshi. Ni byo rwose! Ariko kuba uriya mwana aribwa umutwe cyane, akaba acika intege, kandi amaso ye akaba yabaye umutuku — ibi ni ibimenyetso mpuruza ku buzima bw’umwana kuko hagomba kumenyekana impamvu y'ubwo burwayi bwose. Ushobora gusanga uyu mwana afite: Ikibyimba cyo mu mutwe (tumor), Uburwayi bw’amaso, Indi infegisiyo, n’ibindi. Ni yo mpamvu uyu mwana agomba koherezwa kwa muganga byihutirwa kugira ngo asuzumwe hakiri kare, kuko nta kintu kiza ku buzima kidafite icyagiteye. Rero, uyu mwana mu muhe taransiferi imujyana ku kigo nderabuzima bamusuzume. Murakoze!
question_english: I received a five-year-old girl, weighing thirteen kilograms, who has been sick for three days, with a fever of thirty-six point five degrees, experiencing severe headaches, her eyes have turned red, and she is very weak. I asked if she had any other illness, and the parent told me no. I advised them to give her plenty of water, to drink it frequently. I was asking if there is any other assistance you could provide her, or any medication you could give her.

question_kinyarwanda: Mwaramutse, umubyeyi anzaniye umwana w'amezi arindwi, ambwira ko yari ari guhinda umuriro. Mushyizemo igipimo gipima mirongo itatu na karindwi n'ibice bitanu. Mufashe tederi iba negatifu. Mubajije niba ntabundi burwayi yari asanzwe afite, ambwiye ko ari ntabwo. mubajije nimba mbere yo kuzana umwana nta yindi miti yamuhaye. Ambwira ko yamuhaye imiti y'ibyatsi. None umubyeyi namufasha iki ? murakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Uyu ni umwana w’amezi arindwi wagize umuriro wa dogere 37.5 hamwe na tederi itagaragaza malariya, kandi yari yarakoresheje imiti ya gakondo. Uyu mwana ashobora kuba afite umuriro no kwangirika k'umwijima. Ugomba kohereza umurwayi kwa muganga kugira ngo bakore isuzuma rya malariya. Kwa muganga, bazakora isuzuma rya malaria, kandi niba bigaragaye ko arwaye malariya, umwana azahabwa imiti ya malariya vuba bishoboka. Gutoza ku bijyanye no kwirinda malaria no kumenya igihe cyo gusubira kwa muganga. Gutoza ku bimenyetso by'ingaruka zikomeye. Guhugura ku kwirinda gukoresha imiti ya gakondo kuko yangiza umwijima.
question_english: Good morning, a parent brought me a seven-month-old baby and told me the baby had a fever. I took the temperature, which was 37.5 degrees. I tested for malaria, and the result was negative. When I asked if the baby had any other pre-existing conditions, the parent said no. I also asked if the parent had given the baby any medication before bringing them, and they told me they had given herbal medicine. How can I assist the parent further? Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Uno munsi twagiye mu muryango ufite abana babiri ndetse na nyina. Nyina afite imyaka mirongo ine umwana umwe afite imyaka cumi n'itanu , bose ni abakobwa. Tubagezeho dusanga bazanye ubuheri umubiri wose , bafite umuriro kandi bababara umutwe bacitse intege no mu ngingo. Turangije dupima umuriro dusanga bafite mirongo itatu n'icyenda , turangije dupima malariya dusanga ntayo bafite. Duhita tubagira inama yo kugana ikigo nderabuzima kuko wasanga ari ibyorezo nka mabaga ndetse n'ibindi n'ubushita bw'inkende. None muganga turashaka ko utugira inama nimba hari undi muti wabona turasaba ko mutugira inama.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Inama yo kujya ku kigonderabuzima niyo kuko hari haradutse indwara ya mpox yandura cyane, ibyiza ni ukubujyana kwa muganga, ariko mukabarinda kwegera abandi kuko mutazi neza iyo ariyo, bakirinda kuba bakwanduza abandi, kandi mukababwira kugira isuku, bakanywa amazi menshi.
question_english: Today, we visited a family with two children and their mother. The mother is 40 years old, and one of the children is a 15-year-old girl. When we arrived, we found that they had rashes all over their bodies, a fever, headaches, and weakness in their joints. We measured their temperature and found it to be 39 degrees Celsius. We tested them for malaria, and it was negative. We advised them to go to the health center because it could be an outbreak of diseases like measles or monkeypox. Doctor, we are seeking your advice on any other treatment options you might suggest.

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'umukobwa afite imyaka itatu, ahorana inkorora n'ibicurane bidakira abimaranye umwaka umwe. Nabajije nyina niba nta kindi kibazo cy'ubuzima uyu mwana afite ambwira yuko yavukanye ubwandu bw'akoko gatera sida, kandi ko amuha imiti. Mbese uyu mwana namuha inama yihe kugira ngo yongere kumera neza?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umukobwa w’imyaka itatu amaze umwaka arwaye inkorora idakira n’ibimenyetso by’ibicurane. Nabajije nyina niba hari izindi ndwara afite, ambwira ko umwana yavukanye agakoko gatera SIDA kandi ari kuvurwa. Ni izihe nama namugira kugira ngo uyu mwana azamure ubuzima bwe? Umwana ufite inkorora idakira n’ibimenyetso by’ibicurane bishobora kuba ibimenyetso by’indwara zifata abantu bafite ubudahangarwa buke nk’igituntu, pneumocystis jeroveci pneumonia, ingaruka z’imiti cyangwa izindi mpamvu zisaba iperereza ry’ubuvuzi. Mujyane kwa muganga bapime ingano y’agakoko mu maraso (viral load) n’umubare wa CD4, bigishe ababyeyi ku bijyanye no gukurikiza neza imiti no kurya indyo yuzuye, bakore iperereza, kandi bakurikirane umwana neza kandi kenshi ku gihe.
question_english: A three-year-old girl has been suffering from a persistent cough and cold symptoms for a year. I asked her mother if there were any other health issues, and she mentioned that the child was born with HIV and is receiving treatment. What advice can I give to help this child improve her health?

question_kinyarwanda: Mwaramutse! umubyeyi anzaniye umwana w'umwaka nigice, umwana w'umukobwa ambwira ko yaraye ahitwa, mubaza incuro abwira ko ari eshatu. Mubaza niba nta bindi yamuhaye ambwirako yamuhaye imiti y'ibyatsi. Muhaye siro na zenke.None uwo mubyeyi namufasha iki? Murakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'umukobwa ufite umwaka n'igice, yaraye ahitwa 3 mu ijoro. Nyina yamuhaye imiti y'ibyatsi, bamuhaye sirocco na zenke. Reba umwana niba adafite ibimenyetso by'umwuma ukabije, guteberayo kw'amaso, gukweduka k'uruhu no kumagara iminwa. Mubaze niba nta bindi bimenyetso afite nk'umuriro, kuruka cyangwa urebe niba inda yabyimbye. -Akomeze kunywa zinke na siro. -Mushishikarize kunywa kenshi gashoboka. -Shishikarize umubyeyi isuku ihagije. -Mwihanangirize ko guha umwana imiti y'ibyatsi ishobora kumwangiriza umwijima. -Mwohereze kwa muganga niba afite bimwe mu bimenyetso byavuzwe haruguru, bakore ibizamini barusheho kumufasha bijyanye nuko basanze ibisubizo bimeze.
question_english: Good morning! A parent brought me a one-and-a-half-year-old girl and told me that she had diarrhea from night before. When I asked how many that happens, the parent said three times. I asked if she had given her anything else, and the parent mentioned that she had given her herbal medicine. I provided her with oral rehydration solution (ORS) and zinc. What can I do to help this child? Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umwana w'umuhungu ufite imyaka cumi n'irindwi, afite ibiro mirongo itanu n'umunani, afite umuriro wa mirongo itatu n'umunani, afite umuvuduko w'amaraso. Namusuzumye nkoresheje tederi(TDR) nsanga arwaye malariya. Nemerewe kumuha imiti ya malariya kandi afite umuvuduko w'amaraso?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umuhungu w'imyaka 17 ufite ibiro 58 afite umuriro wa 38 akaba arwara umuvuduko w'amaraso, bamupimye basanga arwaye malaria. Yego cyane rwose, hita umutangiza imiti ya malaria kubera ko ntakibazo igirana n'iy'umuvuduko w'amaraso. Mufashe no kubona parasetamolu kugira ngo imugabanirize umuriro. Mubwire ko aramutse atangiye kuruka cyangwa guhitwa, yakwihutira kujya kwa muganga kuhira bamuhe ubuvuzi bwisumbuyeho.
question_english: I've received a 17-year-old boy weighing 58 kilograms, with a temperature of 38 degrees, and with blood pressure. I've examined him using a rapid diagnostic test (RDT) and found he has malaria. Am I allowed to give him malaria medication while he has blood pressure?

question_kinyarwanda: Umusore w'imyaka makumyabiri n'icyenda afite ibiro mirongo itanu n'icyenda. Yafashwe ari kuribwa umutwe cyane. Namubajije ubundi burwayi asanganywe ambwira ko asanzwe arwara igicuri. Namuhaye ubujyanama bwo kuzajya aruhuka cyane. Mwamfasha iki ku bundi bujyanama nagira uyu murwayi?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Uyu musore w'imyaka makumyabiri n'icyenda, afite ibiro mirongo itanu n'icyenda. Yafashwe ari kuribwa umutwe cyane. Namubajije ubundi burwayi asanganywe, ambwira ko asanzwe arwara igicuri. Uramubaza niba nta muriro, nta sereri cyangwa gucika intege. Umubaze niba nta miti afite y'igicuri uyimuhe. Umuhamagarire psychologist (abaganga bo mu mutwe). Apimwe malaria na TDR. Nusanga ari positifu umutangize coartem.
question_english: A twenty-nine-year-old man weighing fifty-nine kilograms presented with a severe headache. When I inquired about having any other illnesses, he informed me that he has epilepsy. I advised him to get adequate rest. What additional guidance can you provide for me, to counsel this patient?

question_kinyarwanda: Umuhungu w'imyaka cumi nirindwi, ibiro mirongo ine na birindwi. Yaje angana afite umuriro wa mirongo itatu nicyenda kandi arimo guhitwa. Mukorera tederi nsanga afite positifu ndamwohereza. Ese hari ubundi bujyanama nari kumukorera?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umusore w'imyaka 17 upima ibiro 47 afite umuriro wa dogere 39 n'impiswi, TDR ye ni nziza. Mumuhe umuti ugabanya umuriro nka paracetamol kugira ngo umuriro ugabanuke. Tangira kumuha imiti ivura malariya ako kanya. Reba ibimenyetso by'umwuma, umushishikarize kunywa amazi menshi kugira ngo wirinde umwuma ukabije cyangwa kugwa mu kantu. Mwohereze ku kigo nderabuzima cya hafi kugira ngo akomeze kwitabwaho. Ibuka: Umuntu wese urwaye malariya afite ibimenyetso by'uburwayi bw'igogorwa agomba kuvurirwa ku kigo nderabuzima, ntibikorerwe mu rugo.
question_english: A 17-year-old boy, weighing 47 kilograms, came in with a temperature of 39°C and diarrhea. I conducted a rapid diagnostic test, which came back positive, and I referred him. Is there any additional advice I could have provided?

question_kinyarwanda: Umurwayi ufite imyaka cumi n'icyenda; ibiro mirongo itanu na bibiri ni umukobwa, yagize ikibazo cyo kuribwa mu nda akaba yaratwite. Mubajije uko yafashwe nsanga ari kuva, mugira inama yo kunywa jus ya beterave n'ibinyomoro. None ni iki namukorera ngo areke kuva bihagarare?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Mwohereze kukigonderabuzima kugirango bamufashe kuko kuvura kunda ni ikimenyetso cyuko iyo nda ishaka kuvano.nibyiza rero kumujyana kwa Muganga kugirango yitabweho
question_english: A patient who is nineteen years old and weighs fifty-two kilograms is a girl who is experiencing abdominal pain, and she is pregnant. When I asked how it all started, I found that she is bleeding. I advised her to drink beetroot juice and tamarillo. What can I do to help her stop the bleeding?

question_kinyarwanda: Nasuye umugore ufite umwana ufata shisha kibondo, ufite amezi icyenda n'ibiro bitandatu, afite muwake ya cumi na kabiri. Nasanze atiyongera. Nta burwayi asanganywe. Mubaza impamvu umwana atiyongera, ambwira ko atazi impamvu, kandi amuha shisha kibondo. Mubaza isigaye ngo ndebe ko ayifite, arambwira ngo kubera bayinywa bose abo mu rugo yarashize. Ni iki nakora?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze kwakira uyu muryango. Rwose bagire inama unabigishe ko nkuko yitwa SHISHA KIBONDO ihabwa gusa umwana ufite ikibazo kimirire kandi ukiri muto. Babawire ko bari kwangiza ubuzima bwiza bw'uwo mwana kandi batari gutunganya ejo he heza. Babawire ko nabo gufata iyo shisha kibondo byabagiraho ingaruka mbi kuko bari kurya intungamubiri badakeneye. Babawire ko kandi bihanirwa n'amategeko. Komeza ubakurikirane urebe ko bazabihindura.
question_english: I have visited a woman with a child who takes Shisha Kibondo, who is nine months old and weighs six kilograms. I have found that the child is not gaining weight, and there is no underlying illness. I have asked her why the child is not gaining weight, and she has told me she doesn't know the reason and that she gives the child Shisha Kibondo. I have asked her for the remaining portion to see if she still has it, and she has told me that because everyone in the household consumes it, it is finished. What can I do?

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'umuhungu ufite imyaka ibiri, afite ibiro cumi na bibiri, ikizigira cy'ukuboko ni cumi na gatanu. Uburwayi afite; arakorora cyane, ari kwituma inshuro ebyiri ku munsi ibintu byoroshye, abimaranye iminsi itatu. Ubundi burwayi asanganywe, ntabwo. Namugiriye inama yo kunywa umutobe w'indimu n'ubuki, kandi akanywa amazi menshi. Namusuye mu rugo nsanga ntacyo biri gutanga. Mwamfasha iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze kutubaza iki kibazo. Uyu mwana w’umuhungu ufite imyaka ibiri, apima ibiro cumi na bibiri, naho ikizigira cye cyo mu kuboko ni 15 cm. Uburwayi afite: Arakorora cyane, yituma inshuro ebyiri ku munsi ibintu byoroshye, kandi abimaranye iminsi itatu. Ubundi burwayi asanganywe: Nta bwo wahaye inama yo kunywa umutobe w’indimu n’ubuki, kandi akanywa amazi menshi. Wamusuye mu rugo, usanga ntacyo biri gutanga. Ukaba utubaza icyo twagufasha. Igisubizo: Turabashimira uburyo mwasuzumye umwana n'uburyo mwamwitayeho. Dukurikije amabwiriza yo kuvura umwana ufite inkorora, ni byo rwose. Iyo umwana afite inkorora gusa, nta kindi kimenyetso mpuruza afite, kandi ahumeka neza (hakoreshejwe igipimo cy’umubare w’iminota), umutobe w’indimu n’ubuki biramufasha. Ariko iyo umusuye nyuma y’amasaha 12 ugasanga nta cyahindutse, agomba guhita yoherezwa ku Kigo Nderabuzima kimwegereye. Kunywa amazi ni byiza, ariko tuvuga ko umwana afite impiswi iyo yitumye birebire cyangwa byoroshye inshuro zirenga eshatu ku munsi. Uyu mwana akwiye koherezwa kwa muganga. Murakoze!
question_english: A two-year-old boy weighs twelve kilograms, with an arm circumference of fifteen centimeters. His symptoms include severe coughing and passing loose stools twice a day for three days. He has no other pre-existing conditions. I advised him to drink lemon juice with honey and plenty of water. I visited him at home and found that this is not helping. How can you assist me?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umugore w'imyaka mirongo itatu n'umunani ufite ibiro mirongo itandatu na birindwi. Ari gukorora, akababara umutwe, ibicurane, mu nda, kandi akagira n'umuriro. Mubajije igihe bimaze, ambwira ko ari iminsi ibiri. Mufata teremo afite mirongo itatu umunani, tederi(TDR) ni positifu. Mubajije niba nta bundi burwayi abana nabwo, ambwira ko afata imiti ya kanseri. Nabazaga icyo nakorera uyu murwayi.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Uwo muntu muhe imiti ya maralia nta kibazo kuko nurwaye kanseri afata imiti ya maralia iyo basanze ayirwaye. Ariko agomba kwitabwaho n'abaganga kuko imiti ya kanseri iba ifite imbaraga bakamenya ikindi bamukorera. Gusa mugomba kumubwirira ku mirire ye akamenya uko yitwara no ku minywereye agakomeza regime ye. Kandi bisaba ko bakomeza bakajya barema uko ibipimo bya diabete bimeze kugira ngo ataza kubarembana.
question_english: I received a thirty-eight-year-old woman weighing 67 kilograms. She presented with a cough, headache, cold, abdominal pain, and fever. When I asked how long she had been experiencing these symptoms, she said it had been two days. I measured her body temperature, which was 38°C, and conducted a rapid diagnostic test (RDT), which came back with positive results. When I inquired about any other illnesses, she mentioned that she was taking cancer medication. I am seeking advice on what to do for this patient.

question_kinyarwanda: Mwiriwe neza, nakiriye umukobwa ufite imyaka makumya n’ibiri afite ibiro mirongo itanu na bibiri,yambwiye ko ari kugira umuriro mwinshi kandi akababara umutwe. Afite n'inkorora amaranye ibyumweru bitatu,namupimye umuriro nsanga afite mirongo itatu na karindwi n’igice. Muhaye taransiferi ndababaza niba hari ikindi namufasha. Murakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze kwakira uwo mukobwa -Banza umukorere TEDERI urebe ko nta malaria usanze ayifite ntampamvu yo kumuha taransiferi wavura malariya kuko nta bimenyetso bikabije afite -Mubaze igihe aherukira mu mihango kuko biba bikenewe mugihe atwite inda nto ntabwo yafata kowaritemu -Mubaze niba ntazindi ndwara afite -Nubura malariya n'inda, rwose mwohereze kwa muganga bakore ibizamini byisumbuye ndetse banamufashe bikwiye
question_english: Good evening, I received a 22-year-old girl weighing 52 kg, who told me she has a high fever and a headache. She also has a cough that has lasted for three weeks. I took her temperature and found it to be 37.5°C. I gave her a transfer. I would like to know if there is anything else I can do to help her. Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'umuhungu ufite imyaka cumi n'itanu afite ibiro mirongo ine na bibiri. Aje ambaza iby'ibijyanye n'imyororokere musobanuriye ibijyanye n'imyororokere ye ariko ntiyabyumva ambaza uburyo ki namuha imfashanyigisho ariko imfashanyigisho ntayo nari mfite mbura icyo namusobanurira. None mwamfasha iki kugira ngo tubone izo mfashanyigisho tuze tubigishirizamo?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Ndumva nta kibazo wakagize nkawe w' umujyanama kuko ku ivuriro biba bihari waza bakabiguha ukagenda ukamwigisha ubimwereka. Ikindi nuko ugomba gitinyuka ukamubwira bimwe na bimwe bigenda bimubaho uko agenda akura hari ibimuzaho atajyaga abona akiri muto.  Ukumubwira nko kwiroteraho, kuzana ubwanwa, kuzana ubucakwahwa, kuzana isya nibindi nkibyo bigenda bimugeraho. Gusa umubwira mu ijwi rituje akabona ubimubwiye ubyitayeho nta kumuseka ukamusobanurira neza witonze, icyo utazi wamubwira akajya ku ivuriro haba icyumba cy' urubyiruko ni umuganga ubishinzwe akamufasha.
question_english: A 15-year-old boy weighing 42 kilograms came to me asking about sexual and reproductive health. I explained it to him, but he didn't understand and asked for educational materials. However, I didn't have any materials to give him, so I couldn't explain further. How can you help me get those materials for teaching?

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'umuhungu ufite amezi atandatu, afite ibiro umunani na mewake(MUAC) cumi na gatanu, arahitwa inshuro esheshatu ku munsi, abimaranye umunsi umwe, nta bundi burwayi asanzwe afite. uyu mwana arahabwa iyihe ngano y'umuti?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze kubaza iki ikibazo cy'uyu mwana w'umuhungu ufite amezi atandatu, ufite ibiro umunani na muwake(MUAC) cumi na gatanu, waje ahitwa inshuro esheshatu ku munsi, abimaranye umunsi umwe, ntabundi burwayi asanzwe afite, ukaba ubaza ingano y'umuti umwana ari buhabwe. Nk'uko tubizi, tuvuga ko umwana afite impiswi igihe umwana yituma birebire cyangwa ibyoroshye inshuro zirenze eshatu ku munsi' none uyu we arahitwa inshuro esheshatu bivuze koko afite impiswi ntagushidikanya. Impiswi isanzwe nta bimenyetso mpuruza utanga umuti wa ORS na Zinc. -Kuri ORS,bayikora bayivanga agapaki kamwe(1) ka ORS na litiro imwe y'amazi asukuye. Umwana ufite munsi y'imyaka ibiri ahabwa icya kabiri cy'ikirahure uko umwana yitumye. -Umwana urengeje imyaka ibiri ahabwa ikirahuri uko arutse. Kuri Zinc: Umwana ufite munsi y'amezi atandatu, ahabwa ikinini kimwe cya zinc 10 mg, ku munsi iminsi itanu. Umwana urengeje amezi atandatu umuha ibinini bibiri bya Zinc 10 mg, ku munsi iminsi itanu. Rero dukurikije iyobora mivurire y'impiswi, Uyu mwana ufite amezi atandatu arahabwa ORS ,agapaki kamwe kavanze na litiro imwe y'amazi asukuye, icyakabiri cy'ikirahuri uko umwana yitumye.. Ahabwe na Zinc mirigarama icumi ikinini kimwe ku munsi, iminsi itanu. Murakoze.
question_english: A six-month-old boy weighing eight kilograms and with a mid-upper arm circumference (MUAC) of fifteen, is vomiting six times a day and has been doing so for one day, with no other underlying illnesses. What dosage of medication should this child receive?

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'umuhungu ufite imyaka itatu, afite ibiro cumi nabi bitanu, yaje angana ambwira ko amaze iminsi aribwa munda. Ararya ibyo ariye akabiruka, nta apeti afite. Namubajije ubundi burwayi yaba asanganywe, ambwira ko ntabundi burwayi asanganywe. Mwandikiye taransiferi ngo ajye kwa muganga, agarutse bamuhaye imiti. Yagarutse ngiye kumusura nsanga noneho ari kwituma ibintu by'amazi bivanze n'amaraso. Mwamfasha iki kubijyanye n'uyu murwayi?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umuhungu w’imyaka 3 ufite ibiro 15 amaze iminsi afite ububabare mu nda. Nubwo arya, aruka ibyo yariye byose, nta bushake bwo kurya afite, kandi nta zindi ndwara yari asanzwe afite. Nyuma yo kumujyana kwa muganga, yagarutse afite imiti, ariko ubu yatangiye kujya ku musarane agahitwa amazi avanze n’amaraso. Ni ingenzi kongera kumujyana kwa muganga kugira ngo bapime umusarane we no kumuvuza uko bikwiye. Ni byiza kandi kwirinda ko abura amazi n’imyunyu ngugu mu mubiri we, ukoresheje ORS cyangwa serumu, bitewe n’uko kubura amazi mu mubiri. Indwara ushobora gukeka zirimo bacillary dysentery, amoebic dysentery, n’izindi.
question_english: A three-year-old boy, weighing fifteen kilograms, came to me complaining that he has been experiencing stomach pain for a few days. He eats but vomits everything he consumes and has no appetite. When I asked if he had any other pre-existing illnesses, he told me he did not. I wrote a transfer for him to go to the hospital, and when he returned, he had been given medication. When I went to check on him, I found that he was now passing watery stool mixed with blood. How can you help me with this patient's situation?

question_kinyarwanda: Umurwayi ufite imyaka makumyabiri n'irindwi, ibiro mirongo itanu n'umunani, ni umuhungu. Afite umuriro wa mirongo itatu n'icyenda n'ibice bitanu, akaba ari kubabara umutwe, akaba yari asanganywe indwara y'ubumuga bwo mu mutwe. Mufatiye tederi(TDR) nsanga ni positifu, afite malariya. None mfite sisi fuwa katre. None nayimuha afite ubumuga bwo mu mutwe?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugabo w'imyaka 27 ufite ibiro 58 arwaye umuriro wa 39.5 n'umutwe, kandi tederi yerekanye ko arwaye. Uyu murwayi afite malariya. Ahite avurwa umuriro akoresheje imiti igabanya umuriro nka parasetamoro. Ahabwe kowaritemu ibinini 4 kabiri ku munsi mu minsi 3 ikurikirana. Mumwigishe uburyo bwose bwo kwirinda malariya. Niba hari ibimenyetso bya malariya ikomeye, nyamuneka mujye kumujyana kwa muganga ahabwe aritezinate batanga inyujijwe mu mutsi.
question_english: A 27-year-old male patient, weighing 58 kilograms, has a fever of 39.5°C and is complaining of a headache. He also has a history of mental disability. I conducted an TDR and resulted positive indicating he has malaria. I have Coartem (6* 4) available. Can I give it to him, considering his mental disability?

question_kinyarwanda: Umurwayi ufite amezi icumi; ibiro cumi na kimwe; muwake cumi na kane ni umuhungu. Ari gukorora agahumeka nabi akaba nta bundi burwayi yari asanganywe. Mupimye nkoresheje tayima, inshuro ahumeka, nsanga ni mirongo itanu na rimwe afite umusonga. Muha amox none ahise agaruka haziyemo n'impiswi none mfite zinc. Nayimuha nayo akayivanga na Amox?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Yego zinc wayimuha akabinywana, nta kibazo. Ubundi ugakomeza ukareba uko ahumeka, wabona bikomeza kumera nabi ukamwohereza kwa muganga, cyangwa yakomeza kugira impiswi nabwo ukamwohereza bakamufasha birenzeho. Kandi ubwire mama we akomeze amwonse cyane. Wanabaza niba iwabo ntawe ufite indwara y' ubuhumekero cyangwa se igituntu. Bityo bakamufasha hakiri kare.
question_english: A ten-month-old patient weighs eleven kilograms; his MUAC is fourteen centimeters, and he is a boy. He is coughing and having difficulty breathing, and he had no other pre-existing conditions. When I measured his breathing rate, I found it to be fifty-one breaths per minute, and he has a fever. I gave him Amoxicillin, but he soon developed diarrhea. Now I have zinc. Can I give him the zinc mixed with Amoxicillin?

question_kinyarwanda: umwana w'umukobwa w'amezi makumyabiri n'abiri, ibiro umunani, umuriro mirongo itatu na gatandatu n'igice, umubyeyi we ari kunsobanuza impamvu umwana we atariyongera mu biro. Mubwiye impamvu ko atamuha indyo yuzuye, nawe ansobanu ambwira ko umugabo we atajya ahaha. Nakongeraho iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze kubaza iki ikibazo cy'uyu mwana w'umukobwa w'amezi makumyabiri n'abiri, ufite ibiro umunani, umuriro wa mirongo itatu na gatandatu n'igice. Umubyeyi we ari gusobanuza impamvu umwana we atiyongera mu biro, umubwira ko atamuha indyo yuzuye, maze agusobanurira ko umugabo we atajya ahaha. Ukaba ubaza icyo wangeraho. Ni byo koko uyu mwana kuba atiyongera mu biro ni uko afite ikibazo cy'imirire mibi, kuko atabona indyo yuzuye irimo ibitera imbaraga, ibyubaka umubiri, n'ibirinda indwara. Ibi byose umwana yakagombye kubibona kuri buri funguro agiye gufata, kuko bituma agira ubuzima bwiza kandi akiyongera ibiro, ndetse agakura no mu mitekerereze ye. None kuba uyu mugabo adahaha ni ikibazo. Ariko umugore na we ubwe agomba kwigishwa ibyiza byo kugaburira umwana indyo yuzuye, maze na we agashaka imibereho kugira ngo agaburire umwana we indyo yuzuye. Urugero rw'indyo yuzuye kandi idahenze: ibishyimbo n'amazi yabyo, igitoki, imboga (dodo), ukabiha umwana hamwe n'igikoma cy'imvange y'ibinyampeke n'ibindi. Gutegurira umwana indyo yuzuye ntabwo bisaba ibintu bihenze, ahubwo bigusaba kumenya uko itegurwa. Uyu mubyeyi mubwire ibi twavuze hejuru, kandi umuhe taransiferi yihuse imujyana ku kigo nderabuzima kiri hafi, kugira ngo ahure na muganga ushinzwe ubuzima bw'imikurire y'abana. Ikindi, nibigushobokera, uyu muryango uzawusure ubaganirize kuri ibi byose twavuze. Murakoze!
question_english: A 22-month-old girl weighing 8 kg temperature 36.5 whose a parent is explaining me why the child is not gaining weight. I explained that it might be due to not providing a balanced diet, but the parent responded by saying that her husband does not provide food. What else can I add?

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'umukobwa ufite imyaka itatu, ibiro cumi na bitatu, azanywe n'umubyeyi avuga ko afite umuriro n'inkorora. Mupimye tederi nsanga ni negatifu. Mubajije ko nta bundi burwayi yari afite, umubyeyi ambwira ko ntabundi burwayi yari afite. Muhaye inama yuko agomba kumuha umutobe w'indimu akavanga n'ubuki bw'umwimerere, akavanga n'ibitunguru. None uwo mwana namuha ubundi buhe bufasha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze -ibyo wamugiriyemo inama ni byo -muhe na amogisisirine  -muhe umuti w'umuriro -shishikariza umubyeyi kumugaburira neza no kumuha ibyo kunywa byiza -mwigishe indyo yuzuye,isuku no kwirinda malariya -iminsi 3 ishize ntagihindutse cyangwa byiyongereye, najye kwa muganga
question_english: A 3-year-old girl, weighing 13 kg, was brought by her parent, who reported that she has a fever and a cough. I tested and found no malaria. When I asked if she has any other health issues, the parent said no. I advised giving her a mixture of lemon juice, raw honey, and onions. The question is whether there is any other support I can offer the child.

question_kinyarwanda: Umurwayi ufite imyaka mirongo ine n'itanu, ibiro mirongo itandatu na bitandatu. Ni umuhungu afite umuriro wa mirongo itatu n'icyenda n'igice, akababara umutwe. Akaba yari asanganywe uburwayi bw'igicuri. Mufatiye tederi nsanga ni positifu, afite malariya. None mfite sisi fuwa katere. Nayimuha arwaye igicuri?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugabo w'imyaka mirongo ine n'itanu, ibiro mirongo itandatu nabitandatu, afite umuriro na tederi yabaye positifu akaba arwara igicuri. 1.Ntacyo bitwaye wamuha coartem, agakomeza gukurikiranwa kubijyanye nigicuri.
question_english: A 45-year-old male patient, weighing 66 kilograms, has come to me with a fever of 39.5 degrees and a headache. He has a history of epilepsy. I have tested him for malaria, and the result is positive. Now I have a question: Should I give him the malaria treatment while he has epilepsy?

question_kinyarwanda: Umusaza w'imyaka mirongo irindwi ni'tatu yaje angana ambwira ko ari gukorora cyane, kandi inkorora ayimaranye ibyumweru bitatu. Namubajije ubundi uburwayi asanganywe, ambwira ko afite ikibazo cy'uko abana n'ubwandu butera sida. Namubajije niba nsanzwe afite imiti ambwira ko ayifata, namugiriye inama yo kujya kwa muganga. Mwamfasha iki ku bundi bujyanama nagira uyu musaza?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Ni byiza kumuherekeza Kwa muganga agatanga ikizamini cy' igikororwa.
question_english: A seventy-three-year-old man has come to me saying that he has been coughing a lot, and the cough has lasted for three weeks. I have asked him about any other pre-existing conditions, and he has told me that he is living with HIV. I have asked him if he is already on medication, and he has informed me that he is taking it. I have advised him to go to the hospital. How can you help me with additional advice I can give this man?

question_kinyarwanda: Mwiriwe neza! ngeze mu nteko y'abaturage ubuyobozi bumbwira ko buri buze kumpa umwanya nkasobanurira abaturage bari mu nteko ibijyanye n'icyorezo cya mayiburuge,nabazaga niba hari uko nabona amakuru yihuse kuri icyo cyorezo kuko nta makuru ahagije ngifiteho murakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Uyu ni umujyanama w’ubuzima ukeneye inama ku hantu yakura amakuru ku cyorezo cya Mariburu. Urakoze kubaza iki kibazo, hari amabwiriza yashyizwe ahagaragara na na minisiteri y'ubuzima (RBC) mu gihe cy’icyorezo cya Mariburu kandi aboneka ku rubuga rwayo, ushobora gusura urubuga rwa minisiteri y'ubuzima (RBC) ugakuraho ayo mabwiriza kandi azagufasha cyane. Icyorezo cya Marburg cyananditswe ku mbuga zose z'umuryango mpuzamahanga wita kubuzima (WHO), ushobora gusura imbuga z'umuryango mpuzamahanga wita kubuzima (WHO) ukandika icyorezo cya Mariburu, amakuru yose azakugeraho! Urakoze!
question_english: The authorities told me that I will be given time to explain to the community members in the meeting about the Marburg virus outbreak. I was asking if there is a way I can quickly get information about this outbreak because I do not have enough details about it. Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Mwamutse, umuntu w'umusore ufite imyaka makumyabiri, ambwiye ko afite malariya, mushyizemo igipimo apima mirongo itatu ni'cyenda, mufashe tederi(TDR) iba postif, muhaye sisi foi katle mubwira ko agomba kubirya iminsi itatu akazajya arya bine bine ku ituru bine ku ituru, ubwo ku munsi ni ibinini umunani, mubajije ko nta bundi burwayi asanzwe agira ambwiye ko ari ntabwo.None uyu murwayi namufasha iki? Murakoze
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Mwaramutse neza! Murakoze kubaza iki kibazo cy'uyu muntu w'umusore ufite imyaka makumyabiri wakubwiye ko afite malariya. Umushyizemo igipimo apima mirongo itatu n'icenda. Umufashe tederi iba postifu, umuha sisi fois katre, umubwira ko agomba kubirya iminsi itatu akazajya arya ibinini bine bine ku ituro, bine ku itura. Uwo ku munsi ni ibinini umunani. Umubajije ko nta bundi burwayi asanzwe agira, akubwira ko ari ntabwo. Ukaba utubaza icyo ugomba kumufasha. Nibyo koko, iyo umuntu wese afite umuriro agomba gupimwa malariya niba nta kindi kimenyetso kidasanzwe afite. Iyo tederi ibaye positifu, ahabwa imiti. Niba negatifu, akoherezwa ku ivuriro. Uyu we wasanze tederi ari postifu, umuha imiti, umubwira uko agomba kubirya kandi wamubajije ko nta bundi burwayi afite, akubwira ko ari ntabwo. Ni yo mpamvu agomba kugirwa izindi nama z’uko agomba kwirinda malariya. Urugero: * Kuryama mu nzitiramubu ikoranye umuti * Gutema ibihuru bikikije urugo * Gusiba ibyobo birekamo amazi * Gukinga amadirishya nimugoroba kugira ngo imibu itinjira mu nzu. Kandi ukamubwira ibyo agomba kwitaho mu gihe afata imiti ya malariya ko agomba kurya neza. Arya indyo yuzuye ndetse akanywa cyane kugira ngo abashe kugira imbaraga. Uyu murwayi umwongere izi nama zavuzwe haruguru. Murakoze.
question_english: Good morning, a young man, 20 years old, told me he has malaria. I took his temperature, which was 39°C, and conducted a TDR test that resulted positive. I prescribed Coartem, advising him to take it for three days, with four tablets in the morning and four tablets in the evening, making a total of eight tablets per day. When I asked if he had any other underlying conditions, he said no. What additional support can I provide to this patient? Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umugore afite imyaka mirongo itanu n'irindwi, arababara mu nda, ababara umutwe, yacitse intege. Arahitwa umusarani uvanze n'amaraso. Namubajije igihe abimaranye, ambwira ko amaze iminsi ibiri. Namubajije ko nta bundi burwayi asanganywe, ambwira ko ntabwo. Uyu murwayi namufasha iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugore w'imyaka 57 ufite ububabare mu nda, umutwe, intege nke, no gucibwamo amaraso bimaze iminsi 2. Ni iki wamufasha? • Ugomba kumufasha vuba bishoboka kugera kwa muganga kuko utavuze inshuro anyura ku musarane ku munsi, kandi ushobora gusanga yabuze intungamubiri n'amazi menshi bitewe n'uko afite intege nke, bityo ashobora kuba akeneye kongererwa amazi no gusubiza mu buryo intungamubiri. • Ashobora kuba yabuze amaraso menshi anyuze mu musarane kandi afite ikibazo cyo kubura amaraso bitewe n'uko afite intege nke, bityo agomba kwihutishwa kwa muganga kugira ngo bapime urwego rwa HB kandi bamufashe uko bikwiye.
question_english: I received a woman aged fifty-seven, she has abdominal pain, headache, and is weak. She has diarrhea mixed with blood. I asked her how long she has had it, and she told me two days. I asked her if she has any other pre-existing conditions, and she told me no. What can I help this patient?

question_kinyarwanda: Mpuye n'umusore wakoze impanuka, akaboko kari kureba inyuma, mwamfasha iki ku burwayi bw'uyu musore?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Nahura n'umusore muto wagize impanuka, ukuboko kwe kwahindutse inyuma, ni iki namufashamo ku bijyanye n'ubuzima bwe?  Uyu musore ashobora kuba afite kuvunika no kwimuka kw'inkokora, arimo kubabara kandi afite ibyago byo kwangirika kw'imitsi n'amaraso. Ako kanya wirinda kwimura ukuboko, umushyiremo igitambaro cyangwa ikindi kintu cyose kimufasha, umuhe imiti ibabaza niba ihari hanyuma uhite umujyana kwa muganga kugira ngo bamupime, bamukosore no kumwitaho biruseho.
question_english: I meet a young man who had an accident, his arm is twisted backward, what can you help me with this young man's condition?

question_kinyarwanda: Hello! Nakiriye umwana w'umukobwa afite imyaka ine ibiro cumi na birindwi, muwake afite cumi na kane n’ibice bitanu. Umubyeyi we ambwiye ko ari guhumeka nabi kandi afite inkorora n'ibicurane ari kugira n'umuriro. Mfashe tayima nsanga ari guhumeka inshuro mirongo ine n’esheshatu ku munota, umuriro afite mirongo itatu na karindwi n'ibice bitanu. Mbajije umubyeyi niba umwana nta bundi burwayi yavukanye cyangwa abana nabwo , ambwira ko ntabwo. Mubajije kandi niba nta yindi miti yamuhaye , ambwira ko ntayo. Ndamuvuye muhaye amoxi ibinini bine kabiri ku munsi mu minsi itanu. Ndabaza niba nta bundi bufasha naha uyu mwana bwiyongera kubwo muhaye. Murakoze .
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Nibyiza kuba wakiriye umwana w'umukobwa ufite imyaka 4, ibiro 17, muwake 14.5, u​muriro 37.5 akaba kandi afite ikibazo cyo guhumeka nabi ukaba wamuhaye amogisi ni ​byiza ko umwana ahabwa abaganga bakaba bamufasha bareba n'impamvu ahumeka nabi bakamukorera ibizamini kugira n​go barebe i​mpamvu ahumeka nabi. Bityo akitabwaho n'abaganga.
question_english: Hello! I received a 4-year-old girl weighing 17 kilograms with a height of 14.5 centimeters. Her parent told me that she is having difficulty breathing, has a cough and cold, and is running a fever. I measured her respiratory rate and found it to be 46 breaths per minute, and her temperature was 37.5 degrees Celsius.
