I asked the parent if the child had any congenital or chronic illnesses, and they said no. I also asked if they had given her any other medication, and they said no. I treated her with four amoxicillin tablets, to be taken twice a day for five days. I am asking if there is any other assistance I can provide for this child in addition to the treatment I have given. Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Umugore w'imyaka makumyabiri n‘ibiri apima ibiro mirongo itanu na bibiri, umuriro wa mirongo itatu na karindwi. Ageze iwanjye ambwira ko hashize isaha umugabo amukubise urushyi, none mujisho hari kugaragaramo amaraso. Mugiriye inama yo kutongera kubyiringira ijisho, ahubwo muhaye atransiferi ngo agende ajye kwa muganga. Har’ikindi nari kongeraho?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Icyo wakongeraho ni uko, wabaganiriza bombi ukamenya icyateye amakimbirirane ukabunga, ubundi akihutira kujya kwa muganga kuko nibo bafite imiti yo kumuha
question_english: A twenty-two-year-old woman weighs fifty-two kilograms, with a temperature of thirty-seven degrees. When she arrived at my place, she told me that an hour ago her husband slapped her, and now there is blood visible in her eye. I advised her not to scratch on the eye anymore but gave her a transfer to go to the hospital. Is there anything else I should have added?

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'umuhungu ufite imyaka itatu, afite ibiri icenda bigaragara ko afite imirire mibi, kandi ababyeyi be n'abakene ntabibatunga bafite. Namugira iyihe nama?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umwana w’umuhungu w’imyaka 3, upima ibiro 9, asa nk’ufite imirire mibi, kandi ababyeyi be ni abakene badafite ubushobozi bwo gutanga indyo yuzuye. Ni izihe nama namugira? Imirire mibi mu miryango ikennye cyane ni ibisanzwe, kuri uyu mwanya; ababyeyi bakeneye kwigishwa ku bijyanye no gutegura indyo yuzuye ifite isuku.  Kwigishwa ku ngaruka z’igihe kirekire z’imirire mibi ku bana zirimo gukererwa mu mikurire no mu iterambere, gukererwa mu mikurire y’ubwonko n’imibanire, kuko ari abakene, gushyigikira gahunda y’umudugudu n’igitoki cy’umudugudu birakenewe kugira ngo bafashe uyu muryango mu mikurire no gukumira imirire mibi.
question_english: A 3-year-old boy, weighing 9 kilograms, appears to be malnourished, and his parents are poor with no means to provide adequate nutrition. What advice should I give him?

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'umuhungu w'imyaka icyenda; ibiro ni cumi na birindwi aje ababara umutwe; munda;yasheshe n'uduheri. Mubajije niba nta bundi burwayi asanganywe avuga ko ntabwo. Namuha ubuhe bufasha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umwana wumuhungu wimyaka 9 , ibiro 17. Arababara umutwe no munda, yasheshe n'uduheri ntabundi burwayi asanganywe. Mubaze ijyihe ibyo bimenyetso abimaranye, mubaze niba ntabintu bidasanzwe yariye, niba ntabintu ajya ajyiraho areriji.. Mubaze niba ntabindi bimenyetso afite nko gucibwamo, umuriro, isesemi nokuruka,gucika imbaraga nogutakaza ubwenjye,nibindi.. Mufatire TDR urebeko ntamalaria irimo. Mushishikarize kunywa amazi ahajyije niba abishobora. Muhe taransiferi ahite ajya kwamuganga bakore ibindi bizamini bafate nibipimo bamuvure bajyendeye kubimenyetso nuburwayi basanga afite.
question_english: A nine-year-old boy weighing seventeen kilograms came in suffering from a headache, stomachache, and rashes. When asked if he has any other pre-existing illnesses, he says no. What assistance can I provide him?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umwana w'umukobwa afite imyaka icumi afite ibiro mirongo itatu afite umuriro mirongo itatu' numunani n'ibice bitanu mufatiye tederi nsanga ni negatifu mubajije ko hari ubundi burwayi asanganywe ambwira ko ntabwo afite ambwira ahubwo ko umuhungu wa nyirarume yamufashe ku ngufu abibwiye nyina nyina aravuga ati uramenye ntubivuge nubivuga nzakwica uwo mwana arambwira ati ndababara cyane mu gitsina mubwira yuko mbwira nyina ko bamujyana kwa muganga bakamufasha nabazaga uyu mwana nta bindi bipimo birenze yakorerwa?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umwana w’umukobwa w’imyaka 10 upima ibiro 30 afite umuriro wa 38.5, tederi ye ni negative. Yafashwe ku ngufu na mubyara we, nyina amubuza kubibwira undi muntu uwo ari we wese kandi ari kubabara cyane mu gitsina. Kuba nyina w'uyu mwana yamubujije kuvuga ibyabaye ndabyumva, gusa, iki ni ikibazo gikomeye kandi umwana ari mu kaga, akaba ari yo mpamvu hagomba gufatwa ingamba zikomeye. Ntumusubize mu rugo kuko ashobora kongera guhohoterwa, ahubwo hamagara nyina umubwire ko umwana yababwiye ibyabaye kandi ko mutamwohereza mu rugo kuko umutekano we utizewe. Kubera nta bizamini uyu mwana yakorerwa ku rwego rw’umudugudu, byaba byiza umujyanye ku kigo cy'ubuvuzi kiri hafi cyane cyane ku bitaro, aho ashobora gusuzumwa neza no gukorerwa ibizamini bihagije. Sobanurira umwana mu buryo burambuye kandi bwumvikana ku myaka ye impamvu yo kumujyana ku bitaro n’ibishobora gukorerwa yo. Ku bitaro, bazasuzuma niba afite ibikomere by’umubiri cyane cyane mu gitsina no mu kibuno. Bazareba ko nta bimenyetso by’ihungabana afite nk’ibikomere cyangwa ibisebe, ibimenyetso bya infegisiyo nko gutukura cyangwa ibintu bisohoka mu gitsina. Nubwo afite imyaka mike, bazamufata ikizamini cy'inda kugira ngo bamenye niba adatwite. Bazamusuzuma indwara zandurira mu mibonano mpuzabitsina nka gonoreya, imitezi, hepatite C, n’izindi. Bazamusuzuma niba atarwaye infegisiyo yo mu rwungano rw’inkari. Bazamuha kandi imiti yo kwirinda kwandura virusi itera SIDA nyuma yo guhura n’uwaba ayanduye, cyane cyane niba uwamufashe ku ngufu atazwiho kuba ayifite cyangwa se n'ubundi akaba ayifite. Bazamukingira hepatite B niba atarayikingirwa. Bazamuha amantibiyotike yo kumuvura indwara zandurira mu mibonano mpuzabitsina na infegisiyo yo mu rwungano rw’inkari. Bazamuha kandi imiti igabanya ububabare. Uyu mwana akeneye gusuzumwa n’umuganga w’indwara zo mu mutwe kugira ngo harebwe uko ubuzima bwe bwo mu mutwe buhagaze, amaze ahabwe ubufasha niba bikenewe. Icy’ingenzi kuruta ibindi, akeneye ubufasha mu bijyanye n’amategeko, ihohoterwa yakorewe rigomba gutangazwa. Ni yo mpamvu buri suzuma ryose ryakozwe rigomba gukorwa hari umuhamya nk'umuforomo cyangwa umukozi ushinzwe imibereho myiza, kandi ibimenyetso byose afite bigomba kwandikwa. Ukomeze kumukurikirana na nyuma y'uko ibyo byose byaba byarangiye.
question_english: I received a ten-year-old girl weighing thirty kilograms with a fever of thirty-eight point five. I tested her for malaria, and it was negative. When I asked if she had any other illnesses, she told me she did not but said that her uncle's son had raped her. When she told her mother, her mother said, "Be careful not to say anything; if you do, I will kill you." The child told me, "I feel a lot of pain in my private parts." I told her I would inform her mother so they could take her to the hospital for help. I was asking if there are any additional tests that could be done for this child?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umuryango w'umugore n'umugabo,umugore afite imyaka mirongo itatu, umugabo afite mirongo itatu n'itanu afite abana bane abakobwa batatu n'umuhungu umwe. Baje bangisha inama kubijyanye n'uburinganire n'ubwuzuzanye. Umugabo ntabyumva yumvako uruhare runini ari urw'umugabo n'umuhungu we, kuko abakobwa ntacyo bamaze nabasobanuriye uburinganire n'iterambere ry'umuryango bimaze, mbumvisha ko uburinganire murugo butuma urugo rutera imbere w'urugo ariko umugabo we yumva yumvako umuhungu we aribo bafite uruhare runini ku rugo rwabo rw'umugore n'abakobwa be ntacyo bamaze mu rugo namugiriye inama mubwirako iterambere ry'urugo rigerwaho na bose ntawe uhejwe kandi iby'urugo ariby'umuryango atari uby'umuntu kugiti cye. Umugabo yambwiye ko n'ubundi kuva na kera ba se bari bafite ijambo ku mutungo w'urugo, mbabwira ko ibyo ari ibya kera, ubu ngo umutungo uruw'umuryango atari umuntu kugiti cye. Baguma kubisiganiraho mbabwira ibyiza byo gushyira hamwe ko bituma urugo rutera imbere ariko umugabo na niyi saha ntabyo yumvishe. Ni iki nakora ngo babyumve neza?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Mwakoze uganiriza uyu muryango w, umugore n,umugabo, umugore ufite imyaka mirongo itatu, umugabo ufite imyaka mirongo itatu n,itanu,bafite abana bane,abakobwa batatu n umuhungu umwe. Baje bakugisha inama kubijyanye n,uburinganire n,ubwuzuzanye.umugabo ntabyumva,yumva ko uruhare runini Ari urw,umugabo n, umuhungu we,Kuko abakobwa ntacyo bamaze,wabasobanuriye uburinganire n iterambere ry,umuryango icyo bimaze,ubumvisha ko uburinganire mu rugo bituma urugo rugira iterambere ry, urugo,ariko umugabo we yumvako we n, umuhungu we aribyo bafite uruhare runini ku rugo rwabo,ko uruhare rw,umugore n,abakobwa be ntacyo bamaze mu rugo, wamugiriye inama, umubwira ko iterambere ry,urugo rigerwaho na Bose ntawe uhejwe Kandi ibyo,urugo Ari iby,umuryango atari iby,umuntu umwe ku giti cye. Umugabo yakubwiye ko n,ubundi kuva na kera naba se bari bafite ijambo ku mutungo w ,urugo,ubabwira ko ibyo byari ibya kera,ubu ko umutungo ari uri uw,umuryango,atari uw,umuntu ku giti cye.Bagumye basiganiraho,ubabwira ibyiza byo gushyira hamwe ko bituma urugo rutera imbere,ariko umugabo na niyo saha ntabyo yumvishe.Ukaba ubaza icyo bakora ngo babyumve neza. Tubashimiye ikiganiro cyiza mwagiranye k,uburinganire n,iterambere mu muryango,hagati y,umugore n,umugabo n abana ba bakobwa n,abahungu.Koko haracyari abagabo bamwe batarumva ko bafite uburenganzira kimwe n,abagore,bataranumva ko abakobwa n,abahungu banganya uburenganzira. Niyo mpamvu kwigisha bihoraho,kuzageza ubwo abantu Bose tuzagira imyumvire imwe k, uburinganire n,iterambere ,abantu Bose bakagirwa imyumvire imwe,bakumva ko abana Bose bafite uburenganzira kimwe,bafite amahirwe amwe,ko bemerewe kwiga kimwe ndetse ko no ku mitungo y, umuryango bayinganyaho uburenganzira. Icyo twafasha uyu Mugabo,ni ukugirwa inama ufatanije n,abandi bumva neza uburinganire,hagakorwa ikiganiro kuriyo. Gukangurira uwo muryango kugana akagoroba kubabyeyi. Gukangurira uwo muryango kujya mu nama zose cyane iyo mu nteko Kuko havugirwa byinshi Kandi byubaka umuryango. Ubonye bikomeye kunanirana,wabibwira ubuyobozi nka mudugudu,umunyamabanga nshingwabikorwa w akagali nabandi ,bakamufasha kubyumvisha umugabo ,kugirango atazahohotera umugore cyangwa abo bana b,abakobwa. Murakoze.
question_english: I received a family consisting of a wife and a husband. The wife is 30 years old, the husband is 35, and they have four children—three daughters and one son. They came seeking advice regarding gender equality and complementarity. The husband does not understand these concepts and believes that the primary roles in the family belong to him and his son, while the daughters are of no significance. I explained to them the importance of gender equality and how it contributes to the development of the family. I emphasized that equality within the household fosters family growth and success. However, the husband insisted that his son has a greater role in the household, dismissing the contributions of his wife and daughters. I advised him that family progress is achieved through collective effort, with no one being excluded, and that family matters concern everyone, not just one individual. The husband argued that, traditionally, men in the family held authority over household wealth. I explained that those were outdated views and that, nowadays, family wealth belongs to the entire family, not just one person. Despite my efforts to outline the benefits of unity and cooperation for the betterment of the household, the husband remains unconvinced. What can I do to help them fully understand this?

question_kinyarwanda: Nasuye umugore w'imyaka mirongo ine n’umwe ufite ibiro mirongo irindwi na bitanu,akeka ko atwite. Naramupimye nsanga atwite mugiriye inama yo kujya kwa muganga,nsubiye kumusura nsanga ataragiyeyo. Musobanurira ibyiza byo kujya kwa muganga ko bituma umenya ko ubuzima buhagaze bagapima umuvuduko,bamupima virusi itera SIDA, akanamenya uko umwana ari gukura. Arambwira ngo ntabwo azajyayo umwana we akura neza ngo arabyumvaga. N’iki nakora kugira ngo ajyeyo?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugore w'imyaka 41 upima ibiro 75 bamupimye, ibisubizo byerekana ko atwite. Bamugiriye inama yo kujya kwa muganga ariko arabyanga avuga ko yizeye ko inda ye imeze neza. Ni byiza gusobanura akamaro ko gusura kwa muganga mu gihe utwite. Bifasha gukurikirana ubuzima bw'umubyeyi n'ubw'umwana uri mu nda harimo no gupima indwara zandurira mu mibonano mpuzabitsina nka VIH, Hepatite B na C, Sifirisi n'izindi zishobora kugira ingaruka ku mwana mu gihe cyo kubyara. Inkingo nka Tetanos. Bibuza izindi ndwara zishobora kubaho mu gihe cyo gutwita; nko kugira umuvuduko ukabije w'amaraso cyangwa diyabete. Mubaze ibibazo bishobora kumubuza kujya kwa muganga mu gihe cyo gutwita kandi umuhe ubufasha bushoboka bwose.
question_english: I visited a 41-year-old woman weighing 75 kilograms who suspects she might be pregnant. I tested her, and the result confirmed she is pregnant. I advised her to go to the hospital, but when I returned to check on her, she had not gone. I explained the importance of visiting the hospital for regular check-ups, including monitoring her health, checking for any complications, testing for HIV, and ensuring the baby is growing well. She told me she wouldn't go, as she believes her baby is growing fine. What can I do to encourage her to go?

question_kinyarwanda: Umuhungu ufite imyaka cumi n'irindwi, afite ibiro mirongo itanu, arababara umutwe, afite umuriro dogere mirongo itatu n'umunani. Abimaranye umunsi umwe, nta bundi burwayi asanzwe afite. Mufatiye tederi (TDR) iba positifu(positif) ndebye mu bubiko bw'umuti nsanga umuti wanshiranye. None uyu murwayi ndamufasha nte?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Biragusaba ko uwo murwayi umushakira umuti muri bagenzi bawe kuko numva niba wowe wayimaze mugenzi wawe aba awufite noneho ukabwira ushinzwe kubasabira ku ivuriro akajya kuyizana ukazawumusubiza. Kuko ndumva akagali kose katabura imiti. Ubundi umushyireho igitambaro cyiza gitose kugira ngo uzimye umuriro. Uwubuze hose wasaba n'abandi muturanye, byakwanga ukaza kuwumutwarira ku ivuriro.
question_english: A seventeen-year-old boy, weighing fifty kilograms, has a headache and a fever of thirty-eight degrees. He has had it for one day, with no other pre-existing conditions. I've performed a rapid diagnostic test (RDT) which's come out positive, but when I've checked the medicine stock, I've found that the medicine is over. Now, how can I help this patient?

question_kinyarwanda: Umugabo w'imyaka makumyabiri n’irindwi, angezeho ambwira ko afite ikibazo arwaye umutwe, ambwira ko afite umuriro, ndebye umuriro afite nsanga afite mirongo itatu na karindwi, ariko ambwira ko anababara munda. Mfashe tederi(TDR) nsanga ni negatifu (Negatif), mwohereje kwa muganga. Ese hari ubundi bufasha mumuha? Murakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze kubaza iki ikibazo cy'uyu mugabo w'imyaka makumyabiri n'irindwi,wakugezeho afite ikibazo cy'uko arwaye umutwe, akaba akubwiye ko afite umuriro.  Wamupima ugasanga afite ubushyuhe bw'umubiri bwa mirongo itatu na karindwi, wamukorera TDR ikaba negatifu, akaba anakubwira ko anababara munda, ukaba umwohereje kwa muganga. Ibyo wakoze nibyo byo kohereza uyu mugabo kwa muganga kugirango ahabwe ubundi buvuzi bukwiye,ndetse anahabwe ibinini bigabanya uburibwe bw'umutwe; nka paracetamol mugihe itamutera ikibazo cyangwa indi miti yamufasha kugabanya uburibwe. Kuko ababara no mu nda ndetse akanafatwa ibindi bizamini hakurikijwe uburyo ababaramo naho ababara. Murakoze!
question_english: A twenty-seven-year-old man came to me and told me that he had a headache, he told me that he had a fever, I checked, I found his temperature to be thirty-seven degrees Celsius., but he told me that he also had abdominal pain. I take a Rapid Diagnostic Test (RDT) it is negative; I send him to the doctor. Is there any other help I can give him? Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umwana w'umuhungu ufite imyaka ibiri, afite ibiro cumi na bitatu, amaze iminsi ibiri afashwe. Ari guhitwa cyane nta bundi burwayi afite. Ari kwituma inshuro zirenga zirenga kabiri ku munsi birebire, nsanga arwaye impiswi. Namuha iyihe miti?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Uyu ni umwana w'imyaka 2 upima ibiro 13 wazanywe afite impiswi imaze iminsi 2. Uyu mwana afite inzoka bikomeye bishobora guterwa n'inzoka zo mu nda cyangwa virusi mu nzira z'igogora. Ugomba kumuha zinc sulfate, ORS 10 ml/kg nyuma ya buri gihe tiyumye. Mubigishe kwita ku isuku bihagije, mubigishe ibimenyetso mpuruza n'igihe cyo gusubira kwa muganga. Niba impiswi ikomeje, ugomba kumwohereza kwa muganga kugira ngo bapime umusarani we, kandi niba basanze afite inzoka zo mu nda, azahabwa albendazole cyangwa mebendazole.
question_english: I've received a two-year-old boy weighing thirteen kilograms, who has been sick for two days. He has severe diarrhea with no other illness. He defecates more than twice a day liquid defecates, and I've found he has diarrhea. What medication should I give him?

question_kinyarwanda: Mwaramutse neza, umusaza w’imyaka mirongo irindwi n’ibiri, afite ibiro mirongo itandatu na kimwe, abana n'agakoko gatera SIDA, afata imiti. Ambwiye ko afite ikibazo cyo kuyinywa akayiruka, mwohereje ku kigo nderabuzima yanze kujyayo, ubwo namufasha iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugabo w'imyaka 72 ibiro 61kg, ubana n'gakoko gatera SIDA ari ku miti, ari kuyinywa akaruka, yanze kujya ku kigo nderabuzima. Mwigishe ko kuruka imita bisa nko kutayifata, umubwire ingaruka zo guhagarika imiti igabanya ubukana zirimo kuba virusi ihita ikura ku buryo bwihuse, kuba arembye byagorana ko iyo miti yongera kumuvura, kandi ibyago byo kwanduza abandi biri hejuru cyane. Akomeje kwanga kugenda, gana service yita ku bafite ubwandu bw'agakoko gatera SIDA, ubasobanurire ikibazo cy'uwo murwayi, kugira ngo babashe kumwegera bongere bamwigishe ibyiza byo gukurikiza inama abaganga n'abajyanama b'ubuzima batanga.
question_english: Good morning, a seventy-two-year-old man, sixty kilograms. He is HAV/AIDS positive and takes medication. He has told me that he takes medication and vomits. I send him to the health center and he refuses to go. Then what can i do for him?

question_kinyarwanda: Mwiriwe neza, umugore imyaka mirongo itatu n'itandatu, ambajije nimba gukoresha uburyo bwo kuboneza urubyaro hakoreshejwe agapira ko mu mura bitatera ibibyimba munda. Namufasha iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugore w’imyaka 36 yabajije niba gukoresha agapira ko mu mura nk’uburyo bwo kuboneza urubyaro bidashobora gutera ibibyimba byo mu mura. • Mwizeze ko ari uburyo bwizewe burinda gusama kandi ntaho buhuriye no gutera ibibyimba byo mu mura.
question_english: Good evening, a thirty-six-year-old woman has asked me if using a contraceptive method with an intrauterine device could cause fibroids in the abdomen. How can I help her?

question_kinyarwanda: Mwiriwe neza, umugabo w'imyaka mirongo ine n’itanu, ufite ibiro mirongo irindwi na bine, aje akorora cyane agacira amaroso. Mubajije igihe inkorora ayimaranye, ambwiye ko ayimaranye ibyumweru bitatu. Muhaye taransiferi(transfeur) ngo ajye kw’ivuriro, ageze kw’ivuriro basanga bamupimye basanga arwaye igituntu. Nyuma yo kuva kw’ivuriro naramukurikiranye, njyeze mu rugo nsanga imiti ayinywa akayiruka. Ubwo namufasha iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Mwiriwe neza! Murakoze kubaza iki kibazo cy'uyu mugabo w'imyaka mirongo ine n'itanu ufite ibiro mirongo irindwi na bine waje akorora cyane agacira amaraso, umubajije igihe inkorora ayimaranye akubwira ko ayimaranye' ibyumweru bitatu, umuhaye taransiferi ngo ajye ku ivuriro, ageze ku ivureriro bamupimyei basanga arwaye igituntu. Nyuma yo kuva ku ivuriro waramukurikiranye ugeze mu rugo usanga imiti ayinywa ayiruka, ukaba ubaza ubufasha wamuha. Ni byo koko umuntu urwaye igituntu agomba gukurikiranwa neza, akanywera imiti ku gihe kandi ku isaha imwe kandi neza, ariko iyi miti bitewe n'imbaraga iba yifitemo, iba ishaka ko umuntu ayinywa yariye indyo yuzuye kandi ihagije. Rero kuba uyu muntu ufite igituntu anywa imiti akayiruka, bigomba kumenyekana kuri muganga akabimenya, kugira ngo bamenye iminsi yatakaje ayisubizweho maze barebe uburyo bamufasha agasubizwa ku kigo nderabuzima akaba ariho ayifatira bakareba n'impamvu aruka imiti, bakamusuzuma neza, bakareba impamvu imutera kuruka imiti, basanga hari impamvu bakamuvura akabasha gufata imiti ye neza, kandi impamvu aba agomba koherezwa ku kigo nderabuzima ngo bamukurikirane, ni uko anywa imiti ayiruka, ashobora kwanduza abantu benshi. Rero muhe taransiferi imujyana ku kigo nderabuzima bamukurikiranire ubuzima bwe neza. Murakoze!
question_english: Good afternoon, a forty-five-year-old man weighing seventy-four kilograms, he came coughing profusely and hemoptysis. When I asked how long he had been coughing, he told me that he had been coughing for three weeks. I gave him a transfer to go to the clinic, when he got to the clinic he was tested and found to be suffering from tuberculosis. After leaving the clinic i followed him home and found that he was taking medication and vomiting so. So, what can i help you him?

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'umukobwa w'amezi cumi n'abiri afite n'ibiro icyenda, nyina yamuzanye ku gipimo nsanga yahombye ibiro bibiri. Mbajije nyina impamvu, ambwira ko aba adahari; aba yagiye mu mirimo kandi n'ikigoroba agasubirayo. Namugiriye inama yo kwita ku mwana akamuha indyo yuzuye. Nashakaga kubaza, hari ubundi bufasha yahabwa?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: sobanurira mama we yuko umwana uri munsi y'imyaka itanu ari uwo kwitabwaho bihagije kuko aba ashobora kugwingira haba mu gihagararo ndetse no mu bwenge bityo rero agomba kumwitaho akamutegura indyo yuzuye akabasha no kumuha umwanya akamenya nimba nta kibazo umwana afite ntabe uw'umukozi gusa
question_english: A twelve-month-old baby girl weighs nine kilograms, her mother brought her to the check-up, and I found out she had lost two kilograms. When I asked the mother why, she told me she is often absent; she goes to work and only returns in the evening. I advised her to take care of the child and provide her with a balanced diet. I wanted to ask, is there any other support she could receive?

question_kinyarwanda: Muraho! umwana w'umukobwa ufite imyaka cumi n'irindwi, ufite ibiro mirongo itanu na bitandatu, aguye hasi yari asanzwe afite ikibazo cyo mu mutima. Ntabwo ari kwinyeganyeza ariko ari guhumeka mpise muhungiza akayaga. Mpamagaye ambilanse ariko ntirahagera. Nabazaga niba hari ubundi bufasha naha uwo mwana w'umukobwa.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: UMUKOBWA UFITE IMYAKA 17, IBIRO 56 KGS, AGUYE HASI ASANZE AFITE IKIBAZO CYUMUTIMA, NTABWO ARI KWINYEGANYEZA, ARIKO ARAHUMEKA, ARAMUHUNGIJE, AMUHAMAGARIYE AMBULANSE ARIKO NTIRAHAGERA. UBUNDI BUFASHA: 1. UMUSHIRA AHANTU HATUJE 2. KUMURYAMISHA ARYAMIYE URUBAVU 3. AMBULANSE YAHAGERA AGAHITA YIHUTANWA KWA MUGANGA, AGAHABWA UBUTABAZI KUKIBAZO CYE.
question_english: Hello! A 17-year-old girl weighing 56 kilograms fell down; she already had a heart condition. She is not moving but is breathing, so I fanned her with some air. I called an ambulance, but it hasn't arrived yet. I was asking if there is any other help I can give to the girl.

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umugore w'imyaka mirongo ine ,ufite ibiro mirongo itatu numunani. Ambwira ko ari kubabara umutwe akagira umuriro mwinshi. Mubajije igihe abimaranye , ambwira ko ari iminsi itatu. Mubajije niba nta bundi burwayi asanganywe , ambwira ko ntabwo. Mubajije niba nta yindi miti asanzwe afata , ambwira ko ntayo. Mfashe ibipimo nsanga afite mirongo itatu n numunani , mfashe tederi nsanga ni positive. mubajije niba nta yindi miti yafashe , ambwira ko yanyoye imiti yo kwitsa amarozi. Ndabaza icyofasha kuko akeneye ubuvuzi bwihuse.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Yego, ugomba kumuha imiti ya malariya, hanyuma ukamubwira ko atari byiza gufata imiti ya kinyarwanda kuko yangiza umwijima.
question_english: I received a 40-year-old woman weighing 38 kilograms. She told me she was experiencing headaches and a high fever. When I asked how long she had been feeling this way, she said it had been three days. I asked if she had any pre-existing conditions, and she said no. I also asked if she was taking any other medication, and she said no. I took her temperature, which was 38°C, and tested her for malaria, which came back positive. When I asked if she had taken any other medication, she said she had taken traditional medicine to ward off evil spirits. I am seeking advice on how to help her as she needs urgent medical attention.

question_kinyarwanda: Mwiriwe neza! Umwana w'umuhungu wimyaka ine n'ibiro cumi na bitanu; azanwe n'umubyeyi we avuga ko afite umuriro n'inkorora. Mubajije niba nta bundi burwayi asanganywe ambwira ko ntabwo. Mubajije igihe yafatiwe ambwira ko amaze iminsi itanu. Mubajije niba hari icyo yamuhaye kijyanye n'imiti ambwira indimu ndetse n'ubuki, n'ibitunguru. Mufatiye tederi, mufatira tayima byose nsanga ari negatifu. Ese hari ikindi namufasha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Uyu ni umwana w'umuhungu w'imyaka 4 ufite ibiro 15, amaze iminsi 5 afite inkorora n'umuriro kandi TDR ni negative, yahawe ubuki, igitunguru, n'indimu kugeza ubu. Uyu mwana ashobora kuba afite indwara z'ubuhumekero bwo hejuru cyangwa umusonga woroshye. Kuva inkorora n'umuriro byakomeje nubwo yahawe imiti yo mu iduka, ugomba kumuvura nk'ufite umusonga woroshye. Mumuhe amoxicillin per os ku rugero rwa 25mg/kg bikaba 375mg inshuro eshatu ku munsi mu minsi 5. Ushobora kumuha ibinini 3 inshuro eshatu ku munsi mu minsi 5. Niba umuriro uri hejuru cyane, ushobora kumuha paracetamol 15mg/kg igihe bibaye ngombwa kugira ngo wirinde convulsions ziturutse ku muriro mwinshi. Mugenzure nyuma y'iminsi 2 kugira ngo murebe uko ameze. Mushishikarize kunywa amazi meza ahagije. Mubashishikarize gushyushya umwana no kumurinda imbeho.
question_english: Good afternoon! A four-year-old boy weighing fifteen kilograms was brought in by his parent, who said he has a fever and a cough. When I asked if he had any other underlying illnesses, she said no. I inquired how long he has been sick, and she replied that it has been five days. I asked if she had given him any medication, and she mentioned lemon, honey, and onions. After taking his rapid diagnostic test and timer, I found that both were negative. Is there anything else I can do to help him?

question_kinyarwanda: Mwaramutse neza, umwana w'imyaka itatu, afite ibiro cumi na bine, MIWAKE cumi nagatandatu, afite ikibazo cy'uburwayi bw'inzoka zo munda, arya atoranya akabiruka. Mubajije igihe abimaranye, ambwira ko abimaranye ibyumweru bibiri. Mpaye mama we transiferi ngo bamujyane kwa muganga, yanze kujyayo ngo nta bwisugane mu kwivuza afite. Ubu namufashea iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'imyaka itatu, afite ibiro cumi na bine, miwake cumi na gatandatu, afite ikibazo cy'uburwayi bw'inzoka zo munda, arya atoranya akabiruka. Mubajije igihe abimaranye, ambwira ko abimaranye ibyumweru bibiri. Uramwigisha cyane, Hanyuma umuhe oresi. Umuhe na zenke. Hanyuma umuhe n'ibinini by'inzoka. Wigishe umubyeyi ku mugirira isuku. Nibyanga, aribwo umuha transfer ajye kwa muganga.
question_english: Good morning, A 3-year-old child weighing 14 kilograms and with a mid-upper arm circumference (MUAC) of 16 cm is suffering from a stomach worm infection and has a poor appetite. The mother mentioned that this issue has been ongoing for two weeks. I gave the mother a referral to take the child to the hospital, but she refused, stating that she does not have medical insurance. How can I assist this child further?

question_kinyarwanda: Umugore w'imyaka mirongo ine, ibiro mirongo itanu n'icyenda, umuriro wa mirongo itatu na gatandatu n'igice, twagiranye ikiganiro. yarabyaye gatanu. Arambaza ati:" kuboneza urubyaro ni itegeko?" Namusobanuriye mubwira ko kuboneza urubyaro atari itegeko ahubwo ari uburyo bufasha abanyagihugu kugira imibereho myiza mu muryango. Hari ikindi nari kongera ho?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugore ufite imyaka 44, apima ibiro 59, afite umuriro wa 36.5, abyaye imbyaro eshanu, ari kubaza niba kuboneza urubyaro ari itegeko. Nibyo, kuboneza urubyaro si itegeko ariko ni kubw'inyungu ze bwite n'umuryango we. Fata umwanya umusobanurire ibyiza byo kubyara abana ushoboye kurera, ingaruka, n'ibyago byava mu kubyara inshuro nyinshi. Ibuka kumuhumuriza, umusobanurire uburyo butandukanye bwo kubonezamo urubyaro n'uburyo bukoramo kugirango abe yakwihitiramo ubumunogeye igihe abyemeye.
question_english: A 40-year-old woman weighing 59 kilograms, with a fever of 39.6°C, and five children, asked me: "Is family planning mandatory?" I explained to her that family planning is not mandatory, but rather a method that helps individuals and families achieve better well-being. Is there anything else I should add to this explanation?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umugore w'imyaka mirongo itatu ufite ibiro mirongo itanu na bitanu, amaze iminsi ibiri afashwe afite umuriro wa mirongo itatu numunani, nta bundi burwayi afite, namukoreye tederi(TDR) nsanga arwaye malariya. Namuha iyihe miti?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umugore w'imyaka mirongo itatu ufite ibiro mirongo itanu na bitanu, umaze iminsi ibiri afite umuriro wa dogere mirongo itatu n'umunani. Nta zindi ndwara afite. Nyuma yo gukora ikizamini cyihuse (TDR), nasanze afite malariya. Ni ubuhe buvuzi namuha? Umurwayi wasanzwemwo malariya ahabwa imiti ya malariya ako kanya, uhite umuha Coartem ibinini 6\*4 mu minsi itatu, umushishikarize kunywa amazi menshi no kurya indyo yuzuye. Umwigishe ku bijyanye no kunywa imiti neza no kurangiza imiti yose yahawe. Umwigishe ku bijyanye no kwirinda malariya, kandi nakomeza kuremba n'ubwo yanyoye imiti mu minsi itatu, azagaruke.
question_english: I received a thirty-year-old woman weighing fifty-five kilograms who has been experiencing a fever of thirty-eight degrees Celsius for two days. She has no other illnesses. After conducting a rapid diagnostic test (TDR), I found that she has malaria. What medication should I give her?

question_kinyarwanda: Umugabo w'imyaka mirongo ine n'ibiri, n'umugore w'imyaka mirongo itatu n'unumunani. Umugabo yazanaga umuhahano mu rugo n'umugore akawuzana. Bose barakora. None hashize amezi atatu, umugabo ntacyo yinjije, ariko asigaye ataha yasinze. Umudamu yaje kungisha inama. Mufashe iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugabo w'imyaka mirongo ine n'ibiri n'umugore we w'imyaka mirongo itatu n'umunani bose bazanaga umuhahano mu rugo kuko bakora bose; none hashize amezi atatu umugabo ntacyo yinjiza, ahubwo agataha yasinze. None, umugore we yaje kungisha inama. Muraho! Wabafasha ujya mu rugo rwabo kugira ngo umenye intandaro y'icyo kibazo. Nyuma, ukaganira na bo uko ari babiri, ukagerageza gutega amatwi ibitekerezo byabo bombi, maze ubundi ukabasobanurira ingaruka mbi zo gutandukana, n’amakimbirane yo mu miryango, ari ko unashimangira akamaro k’ubumwe, bityo bigatuma mushakira hamwe igisubizo kibabereye bombi.
question_english: A forty-two-year-old man and a thirty-eight-year-old woman are involved. The man brought the meal prep container to the house, and the woman works and brings meal prep containers. They both work. Now, three months later, the man has not contributed anything, and he is drunk. His partner came to me for advice. How can I help her?

question_kinyarwanda: Umukobwa w'imyaka makumyabiri n'itanu; afite ibiro mirongo itanu n'icyenda. Yaje angisha inama ambwira yuko ahohotewe n'umusore bagakora imibonano mpuzabitsina. Namubajije ubundi burwayi asanganywe ambwira ko ntabwo. Namugiriye inama yo guhita yihutira kwa muganga kugira barebe ko ataba yamuteye inda. Mwamfasha iki kubundi bujyanama naha uyu mukobwa?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umukobwa w'imyaka 25, ibiro 39, yahohotewe n'umusore bakoze imibonano mpuzabitsina, nta bundi burwayi afite. Inama: 1. Kugana ku bitaro agasuzumwa niba ataba yatewe inda, kureba niba ataba yandujwe indwara zandurira mu mibonano mpuzabitsina. Guhuzwa n'umuganga ushinzwe ubuzima bwiza bwo mu mutwe (psychologist), akabasha kumusuzuma akanamuganiriza, baramutse basanzwe ari muzima, agataha, basanze yarandujwe indwara zandura, bikavurwa.
question_english: A twenty-five-year-old girl; she weighs fifty-nine kilograms. She came seeking advice, telling me that she was abused by a young man, and they had sexual intercourse. I asked her if she had any other pre-existing illnesses, and she said no. I advised her to immediately go to the hospital to check if she might have been impregnated. How can you help me with other advice to give this girl?

question_kinyarwanda: Nasuye umuryango ugizwe n'abantu batatu bose ni igitsina gore twaganiriye ku ndwara ya ebola uko yandura n'ibimenyetso by'uyirwaye umwe ati reka ceceka ebola iba muri congo hakorwa iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Wamubwira ko kubimenya ari byiza, kuko muri congo si kure y'u Rwanda bitatubuza kuba natwe yatugeraho, ikindi ni uko abantu bajya muri congo, n'abanyarwanda nabo bari kujyayo, ubwo rero wahura nabavuyeyo bakaba bakwanduza, niyo mpamvu bagomba kubimenya bakirinda bakanarinda n'abandi babayo.
question_english: I visited a family of three women, and we discussed the Ebola virus, how it spreads, and its symptoms. One of them said, "Stop talking, Ebola is in Congo." What should be done?

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'umuhungu w'imyaka cumi n' umunani, ibiro mirongo itatu na bitanu. Yari yuriye igiti cy'ipera aranyerera, yikubita hasi igiti kimwica mu mbavu ikindi kimwica ku itako. Muhamagariye ambilansi bambwira ko yagiye gufata undi muntu ugize impanuka. Ese uyu mwana hari ubundi bufasha nari kumuha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Mu gihe utegereje ambulance ngo ize imufate, fata agatambaro gafite isuku; hanyuma ukakazirika aho ari kuva kugira ngo adakomeza kuvirirana hanyuma bakaza bakamufata.
question_english: An eighteen-year-old boy weighing thirty-five kilograms fell from a guava tree and injured his ribs and hip. I called an ambulance, but I was informed it was attending to another emergency. Is there any other assistance I could have provided to this boy?

question_kinyarwanda: Umubyeyi ufite umwana w'umuhungu w'imyaka makumyabiri n'ibiri yaje angana, ambwira ko umwana we bamuhumanije bitewe n'ibiryo yariye ahantu. Yaribwaga mu nda, afite iseseme azungera, mpita mwohereza kwa muganga. Nabazaga niba hari ubundi bufasha namufasha.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umuhungu w'imyaka makumyabiri n'ibiri avuga ko umuhungu we yanduye kubera ibiryo yariye ahantu runaka. Yari afite ububabare mu nda, isesemi, no kuzungera; Baza neza amateka y'uburwayi niba afite impiswi. Niba yaratakaje ubushaka bwo kurya cyangwa aruka, Niba afite umuriroNiba afite umuriro, reba TDR. Byongeyeho twatekereje ku ndwara y'uburwayi bw'igifu butunguranye kugira ngo dukureho typhoïde. Niba aruka, muhe ORS ZENKE . Niba nta mpinduka ashobora koherezwa kugira ngo yitabweho birushijeho.
question_english: A mother came to me with her twenty-two-year-old son reporting that her son had been contaminated due to the food he consumed at some place. He was experiencing abdominal pain, nausea, and dizziness; therefore, I immediately sent him to the doctor. I am inquiring if there is any other help I could provide for him.

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umugore w'imyaka mirongo ine n'ibiri afite ibiro mirongo tandatu na bitatu yaje avuga ko yahohotewe n'umugabo akamubuza gutekera abana ,none byamugizeho ingaruka zo kurwara umutwe ukabije, arikumva yiyanze ngo yanakiyahura, namuganirije mugira inama ntiyanyumva naabazaga niba uyu murwayi hari ubundi bufasha yahabwa?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Mwohereze kwivuza ku bijyanye n’ubuzima bwo mu mutwe, kandi mugerageze kuvugana n’uwo mugabo, muganire ku guhagarika izo ngeso.
question_english: I received a 42-year-old woman weighing 63 kilograms who came to me and said that she had been abused by a man who prevented her from cooking for the children, and that this had caused her severe headaches, and she felt self-loathing and even suicidal, I spoke to her for advice and she did not listen to me I asked if this patient could get any other help?

question_kinyarwanda: Umukobwa w'imyaka makumyabiri nitatu ufite ibiro mirongo itandatu na bibiri angeze imbere ambwira ko afite isereri n'isesemi kandi ko amaze amezi abiri atabona imigo mufatiye ikizamini cy'uko atwite nsanga adatwite ese uyu mugore ndamukorera iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze kubaza iki kibazo cy'uyu mukobwa w'imyaka makumyabiri n'itatu ufite ibiro mirongo itandatu na bibiri, ukugeze imbere akubwira ko afite isereri n'isesemi, kandi ko amaze amezi abiri atabona imihango, umufatiye ikizamini cy'uko atwite usanga adatwite ukaba ubaza icyo wamufasha. Ni byo koko iyo umugore wese aje kwivuza umuntu agasanga nta mihango aheruka kandi afite ibimenyetso bisa n'ibyo utwite agira, ni ngombwa ko umuntu agomba kureba ko atwite kugira ngo arengere ubuzima bwe n'ubw'uwo atwite. Ariko niba umupimye ugasanga adatwite, umuntu atekereza ku zindi ndwara zatera ibi bimenyetso. Ni yo mpamvu kuba afite isereri n'isesemi hagomba kurebwa ibintu byinshi bitandukanye akavurwa, kugira ngo agire ubuzima bwiza, agasuzumwa niba afite amaraso ahagije mu mubiri, niba nta diyabete afite, niba nta nzoka zo mu nda afite. Uyu mugore icyo wamufasha, ni ukumuha taransiferi imujyana ku kigo nderabuzima bakamusuzuma, bakareba impamvu yamuteye kugira isereri n'iseseme. Murakoze!
question_english: A twenty-three-year-old girl weighing sixty-two kilograms came to me and told me that she has dizziness and nausea and that she has not had her period for two months. I gave her a pregnancy test and found out she is not pregnant. What should I do for this woman?

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'umuhungu w'imyaka itatu, ibiro cumi na bibiri magana atanu, aje afite umuriro wa mirongo itatu n'umunani, inkorora n'ibicurane. Mupimye malariya nsanga ni negatifu, namuha ubuhe bufasha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umuhungu w'imyaka itatu ufite ibiro cumi na bibiri n'igice aje afite umuriro wa dogere mirongo itatu n'umunani, inkorora, n'ibimenyetso bya giripe. Tederi ni negatifu. Birashoboka ko ari umusonga Mupime umusonga ukoresheje tayima Muhe siro ya amoxicillin n'umuti wo kugabanya ububabare Hanyuma umwohereze ku kigo nderabuzima kugira ngo akomeze kwitabwaho.
question_english: A three-year-old boy weighing twelve and a half pounds comes in with a thirty-eight-degree fever, cough, and flu symptoms. If you test for malaria and it is negative, what help can I provide?

question_kinyarwanda: Umubyeyi anzaniye umwana w'imyaka itatu afite ibiro cumi na bine arahitwa ibivanzemo n'amaraso. Namugiriye inama yo kumujyana kwa muganga ambwira ko bataramushyira ku byiciro. Ndamufasha iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Mwakoze ku nama nziza mwagiriye uyu mubyeyi yo kujyana umwana kwa muganga. Ikindi wamufasha nukumusobanurira ko kuba umwana atari kucyiciro bitamubuza kuvurwa, bityo umubwire ajyana umwana kukigondera buzima kimwegereye, ariko kandi umushishikarize kujya yandikisha umwana atararenza amezi atatu avutse nicyo gihe aba yemerewe kwivuriza kubabyeyi, umwigishe kugira isuku mugutegura amafunguro yabana , umubwire ko isuku nke yongera indwara ziterwa numwanda nkinzoka zo munda, typhoidi n'izindi.Mwibuke gukomeza gukurikirana umwana.
question_english: A parent brought me a 3-year-old child weighing 14 kilograms, who is experiencing diarrhea mixed with blood. I advised them to take the child to the hospital, but they informed me that the child has not yet been categorized. What can I do to help?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umwana w'umuhungu wavukanye ibiro bikeya; ntakindi kibazo yarafite yavukanye ibiro bibiri n'ijana. Namupimye ku munzani nsanga afite ibiro bibiri n'ijana nsanga ari ibiro bike cyane. Namugiriye inama yo kumuheka kangura, nta kindi kintu mwangira inama ngo mufashe?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Nibyo uwo mwana aba agomba kuguma kanguru kugeza agize ibiro bibiri n' igice, ubundi agakomeza akamwonsa cyane. Akamurinda imbeho, kandi abajyanama bagakomeza kumukurikira bakamenya ko ibiro byiyongera, bakanamubwira gukingiza, bakanabwira uwo mudamu gukomeza kurya indyo yuzuye kugira abone amashereka ahagije!
question_english: I received a baby boy who was born with low weight; he had no other issues; he was born weighing two kilograms and one hundred grams. I weighed him on the scale and found he weighed two kilograms and one hundred grams, which I found to be very low. I advised her to carry him in a kangaroo position, is there anything else you would advise to help?

question_kinyarwanda: Nasuye umugore w‘imyaka makumyabiri n’itatu ufite ibiro mirongo itanu na bitanu, mushishikariza gahunda yo kuboneza urubyaro ntabwo yabonezaga. Nta burwayi yarafite, mwigisha ibyiza byo kuboneza urubyaro ambwira ko idini ryabo ritemera kuboneza urubyaro, ko ari kunigira abana mu nda. Ubwo namusubiza iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Mubaze niba akora imibonano mpuzabitsina, hanyuma mumugire inama ku byiza byo kuboneza urubyaro no kwirinda indwara zandurira mu mibonano mpuzabitsina mukoresheje agakingirizo.
question_english: I visited a 23-year-old woman weighing 55 kilograms to encourage her to adopt a family planning method, as she wasn’t using any. She didn’t have any health issues, so I educated her about the benefits of family planning. However, she told me that her religion does not allow family planning, claiming that it is killing unborn children. What could I respond to her?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umwana w'umukobwa w'imyaka makumyabiri n'itanu, ibiro mirongo itanu na birindwi, yaje afite umuriro ababara no mu nda, mubajije ko nta bundi burwayi afite ambwira ko afite ikibazo cyo kuva, akaba afite n'umuvuduko w'amaraso. Namwohereje kwa muganga musuye nsanga aracyarwaye. Mungire inama.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Urakoze kubaza ikibazo cy'umukobwa w'imyaka makumyabiri ni'itanu ufite ibiro mirongo itanu na birindwi waje afite umuriro ababara no mu nda, umubajije ko nta bundi burwayi asanzwe afite akubwira ko arimo kuva kandi afite umuvuduko wamaraso. Umuvuduko w'amaraso n'idwara abantu bakiri bato badakunda kurwara ifata byibuze abari hejuru y'imyaka mirongo ine kuzamura, ntabwo ari kenshi ukunda kubona umuntu w'imyaka makumyabiri yarwaye umuvuduko. Iyo bibayeho rero aba ari ikibazo, uwo mukobwa ufite umuvuduko akaba afite umuriro kandi arimo kuva. Warakoze kumwohereza ku ivuriro kandi ndabizi ko bazamufasha ku kigo nderabuzima iyo byanze bamuha taransiferi akajya ku bitaro bikuru akabonana n'abaganga b'inzobere bakamufasha. Uyu mukobwa rero reka dutuze turebe icyo kwa muganga bazamufasha kuko ntabwo yahita akira.
question_english: I received a 25-year-old girl, weighing 57 kilograms, who came with a fever and abdominal pain. When I asked if she had any other illness, she told me she had a vaginal bleeding issue and high blood pressure. I transferred her to the health center, and when I visited, I found she was still sick. Please advise me.

question_kinyarwanda: Umugore w'imyaka mirongo ine; ufite ibiro mirongo irindwi na kimwe;arava cyane kandi afite ikizengerera; yambwiye ko akoresha uburyo bwo kuboneza urubyaro. Namubajije igihe abimaranye ambwira ko abimaranye ukwezi. Namubajije niba hari ubundi burwayi agira ambwira ko ari ntabwo. Namugiriye inama yo kurya imboga n'imbuto akanywa amazi menshi. Ese namubwira akihutira kujya kwa muganga nonaha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugore w'imyaka 40 ufite ibiro 71 ukoresha uburyo bwo kuboneza urubyaro yaje ava cyane mu gitsina, amaze ukwezi kumwe, bifatanyije no kugira isereri. Uyu murwayi afite anemia iterwa no kuva cyane mu gitsina kandi bitera isereri. Uyu murwayi afite kuva kudasanzwe mu gitsina bishobora guterwa n'uburyo bwo kuboneza urubyaro akoresha. Uyu murwayi kandi tugomba kwemeza ko atwite kuko gutwita biri mu bitera kuva mu gitsina ku bagore bakiri mu myaka yo kubyara. Uyu murwayi ashobora kuba afite fibrome cyangwa kanseri y'udusabo tw'inda. Nyabuneka mu mugire inama yo kunywa amazi menshi. Kandi mudatinze mu mujyane kwa muganga. Kwa muganga bakore fbc, ultrasound, ibizamini by’imikorere y’impyiko n’umwijima. Niba hemoglobine iri munsi ya 7g/gl muhe PRBCs. Muhe serumu. Mu muhe uburyo bwo kuboneza urubyaro bukwiye. Niba ultrasound yerekanye fibrome, mumwohereze kureba muganga w’inzobere mu by’ubuzima bw’abagore.
question_english: A forty-year-old woman weighs seventy-one kilograms; she is bleeding heavily and has dizziness. She told me that she is using contraceptive method. When I asked how long she has been experiencing it, she said for a month. I also asked if she has any other illnesses, and she said no. I advised her to eat vegetables and fruits and to drink plenty of water. Should I tell her to go to the hospital immediately?

question_kinyarwanda: Umugore w'imyaka mirongo itatu nibiri ibiro ni mirongo itandatu na kimwe , aje ari kuva cyane ambwira ko abimaranye icyumweru nigice. Mubajije ko aboneza urubyaro , ambwira ko ataboneza. Mufashe igipimo cy'uko atwite nsanga ntabwo atwite. Mubajije niba nta bundi burwaye asanganywe , ambwira ko ntabwo. Namuha ubuhe bufasha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: murakoze kwakira uyu mudamu -amaze gusama kangahe -aheruka imihango ryari -ese ntabwo aheruka gukuramo inda? -mubwire ajye kwa muganga vuba wasanga afite ikibazo gikomeye -aheruka kwipimisha agakoko gatera SIDA ryali -ese yigeze yisuzumisha inkondo yumura?
question_english: A 32-year-old woman weighing 61 kilograms came in with heavy bleeding that has lasted for a week and a half. When I asked if she was using any contraceptives, she said no. I tested her for pregnancy, and she is not pregnant. I asked if she had any other illnesses, and she said no. What assistance can I provide her?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umudamu w'imyaka mirongo itatu; yaje ari kuribwa mu nda, ababara umutwe. Namubajije ko nta kindi kibazo afite, yambwiye ko ari kuva. Namukoreye ikizamini cya tederi kiba negatif. Mwohereje kwa muganga nyuma y'iminsi itatu nsanga aracyarwaye. Mungire inama.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Ni byiza ko wamufatiye tdr n'ubwo yabaye negative ariko kuko hari ibindi bimenyetso afite byo kuva kandi kuva ni ibimenyetso mpuruza ku mugore. Inama yamufaha ni yo kugana kwa muganga akamusuzuma byimbitse
question_english: I received a thirty-year-old woman who came in with abdominal pain and a headache. When I asked if she had any other issues, she mentioned that she was bleeding. I performed a malaria test, which came back negative. I referred her to the hospital, but after three days, I found out she was still unwell. What should I do? Please advise me.

question_kinyarwanda: Muraho! Nasuye umugore w'imyaka mirongo itatu n'itanu; ufite ibiro mirongo itanu na bibiri; yari afite abana umunani; nta buryo bwo kuboneza urubyaro afite; nta burwayi asanganywe; musobanurira gahunda yo kuboneza urubyaro; mubwira ibyiza byo kuboneza urubyaro; mubabajije ko azaboneza ambwira ko yumvise avuga ko iyo uboneje ukonja .Nabazaga inama nagira uyu mubyeyi?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umubyeyi wimyaka 35, afite abana 8, nta buryo akoresha bwo kuboneza urubyaro. Nyuma yo gusobanurirwa ibyiza byo kuboneza urubyaro, avuzeko yumvise bavuga ko uwaboneje akonja. Musobanurire ko ibyo ari ukubeshya ko ntaho bihuriye no gukonja. Uburyo bwo kuboneza bufite uburyo bukoramo bukarinda gusama gusa, uburyo bwakozwemo haba ubukoresha imisemburo cyangwa ubudakoresha imisemburo byose ni ugutuma udasama. Ntabwo ari ugukona cyangwa ngo bituma ukonja, Mushishikarize kujya kwa muganga ahabwe ubusobanuro buhagije, kandi bwimbitse ku bijyanye n'uburyo bwo kuboneza, n'uburyo bikowamo.
question_english: Hello! I visited a thirty-five-year-old woman who weighs fifty-two kilograms; she has eight children, and she doesn't use contraceptive method. She has no known illnesses. I explained to her the contraceptive methods and told her about its benefits. When I asked her about her plans for using contraceptive method, she mentioned that she has heard people say that using contraception can make one inactive. What advice should I give this mother?

question_kinyarwanda: Umusaza w'imyaka mirongo itanu afite ibiro mirongo itanu na bitanu, yaje angana ambwira yuko afite isereri, arimo kubabara umutwe, mubajije ubundi burwayi asanganywe ambwira ko asanzwe arwara umuvuduko w'amaraso na diyabete(Diabete). Mwamfasha iki k’ubujyanama nagira uyu murwayi.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umusaza ufite imyaka 50, ibiro 55, afite isereri, ababara umutwe. Asanzwe arwaye diyabete n'umuvuduko wamaraso. Inama: uyu mubyeyi nukumufatira ibipimo by'isukari n'ibipimo by'umuvuduko agahita yoherezwa vuba kwa muganga agahabwa ubufasha.
question_english: A 50-year-old man weighing 55 kilograms came to me, complaining of dizziness and headache. When I asked him about any other health conditions, he told me he has high blood pressure and diabetes. How can you help me with advice for this patient?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umugore w'imyaka mirongo itatu nibiri, yaje arwaye ahinda umuriro. Arikuruka cyane ndetse ababara no munda yo hasi. Namubajije igihe ibyo bimenyetso abimaraniye ambwira ko hashize iminsi itatu afashwe. Namupimye ikizamini cy'umuriro, agira mirongo itatu n'umunani n'igice. Napimye amaraso nkoresheje tederi, agira negatifu, amaraso ye agaragaza ko nta malariya arwaye. namubajije uburwayi bwe ndi gushakisha ibimenyetso, mubaza niba aboneza cyangwa akoresha uburyo bwo kuboneza urubyaro, ambwira ko ntabwo akoresha. Namubajije igihe aherukira imihango, ambwira ko hashize amezi abiri atayibona. Nafashe igipimo mupima inda, nsanga aratwite. Namugiriye inama yo kujya kwa muganga, mwemerera no kumuherekeza. Nandika transiferi ndamuha turagenda muherekeza kwa muganga. Nibazaga nimba nta bundi bufasha namuha cyangwa indi nama namugira. Murakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Wakoze kumujyana kwa Muganga Kugirango bamukurikirane we n'umwana atwite ndetse arahabwa Inama zose z'uburyo agomba kwitwara nk'umugore utwite.Nawe uzakomeza kumuba hafi no kureba ko Inama yahawe kwa Muganga azubahiriza.
question_english: I received a 32-year-old woman who came in with a fever. She was vomiting excessively and experiencing lower abdominal pain. When I asked how long she had been experiencing these symptoms, she said it had been three days. I measured her temperature, which was 38.5°C. I tested her blood using a rapid diagnostic test for malaria, and the result was negative, showing no signs of malaria. While investigating her symptoms, I asked if she was using any form of family planning, and she said she was not. I also asked when she last had her menstrual period, and she said it had been two months since her last one. I conducted a pregnancy test, which confirmed she was pregnant. I advised her to visit a doctor and offered to accompany her. I wrote a referral letter and escorted her to the hospital. I am wondering if there is any additional support or advice I can provide her. Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'umuhungu w'imyaka ine, ibiro cumi na bitatu na muwake ya cumi nagatatu, baje kumuvuza mbabajije uko arwaye, bambwira yuko atabasha kurya, ariko nanjye hari ibyo niboneraga nko kubyimba, gucurama umusatsi, mbabaza inshuro bagaburira umwana, bambwira ko bamugaburira rimwe ku munsi, mbagira inama yuko bagomba gufata umwana. None nabafasha iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umuhungu w'imyaka ine, ibiro cumi na bitatu n'umugozi wa MUAC wa cumi na gatatu, baje kwa muganga ndababaza uko ameze, bambwira ko atabasha kurya. Ariko na none nabonye ibintu nk'ibibyimba, kugwa kw'imisatsi ndababaza kenshi bamuha ibyo kurya bambwira ko bamuha rimwe ku munsi. Igisubizo R/ Gira inama y'indyo nziza, ibikungahaye ku ntungamubiri, imboga, imbuto inkunga y'umuhanga mu mirire.
question_english: A four-year-old boy, thirteen kilograms and a thirteen MUAC, they came to the doctor and i asked them how he was doing, they told me that he couldn't eat, but i also noticed things like swollen, hair loss and i asked how often they feed the baby and told me that they feed him once a day. I advised them of how they should take the baby. So what can i help them with?

question_kinyarwanda: Hashize iminsi itatu mvuye umwana w'umukobwa impiswi afite umwaka n'amezi umunani, ibiro cumi na bine, muwaka afite cumi na gatatu n’ibice bitanu, ndamusuye nsanga akirwaye ari kwituma birebire by'amazi kandi ari kwituma hejuru y’inshuro eshatu,mubajije niba muriyo minsi itatu nta bundi buvuzi yamuhaye ambwira ko ntabwo, ndebye uko amuha imiti nsanga ari neza muhaye taransiferi. Ndabaza niba hari ubundi bufasha namuha.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Ni byiza ko wamuhaye taransiferi kuko uwo mwana akeneye kwitabwaho. Iyo mpiswi amaranye iminsi ishobora kumutera umwuma bikaba byamuviramo gutakaza ubuzima. Ni yo mpamvu akeneye kujyanwa kwa muganga bakamufasha.
question_english: Three days ago, I treated a one-year-and-eight-month-old girl, weighing 14 kilograms, for diarrhea. At the time, she had a temperature of 13.5°C. I visited her again and found that she is still sick, passing watery stool more than three times a day. When I asked if she had received any additional treatment during those three days, the caregiver said no. Upon reviewing how she takes her medication, I saw OK. so I provided an oral rehydration solution (ORS). I’m asking if there is any other support I can offer her.

question_kinyarwanda: Umukobwa w'imyaka makumyabiri n'itanu yaje angana ambwira ko akorora bimaze ibyumweru bitatu. Ariko yavukanye ubwandu bw'akoko gatera SIDA namugiriye inama yo kujya kwa muganga. Ndabaza mwamufasha iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umukobwa w'imyaka makumyabiri n'itanu yaje angana ambwira ko akorora bimaze ibyumweru bitatu. Ariko yavukanye ubwandu bw'akoko gatera SIDA Mubaze igihe amaze akorora Reba niba ntabindi bimenyetso Umuriro umutwe kuruka Umufatire timer Nikizami cyumusonga winsumbane Ube wamuha amogisi Noneho umwohereze kwa muganga bajye kumufata amaraso nigikororwa hataba haraziyemo igituntu nkicyuririzi
question_english: A twenty-five-year-old girl came to me and told me that she had been coughing for three weeks. But he was born with HIV and i advised him to go to the doctor. I ask what can i do for him?

question_kinyarwanda: Helo! Nsuye urugo mu mudugudu nsangamo umwana w'umukobwa afite imyaka itatu, afite ibiro cumi na birindwi, miwake afite cumi na kane. Nsanze umwana yigaragura mu biziba by'amazi. Nganirije umubyeyi mubwira ko atari byiza kugira ibiziba by'amazi mu rugo no hafi y'urugo kuko bishobora gukurura malariya, inzoka n'impiswi bityo bikaba byatuma umwana we ahura n'ibibazo by'uburwayi. Mubwiye ko umwana we ameze neza ariko musaba guhita asiba ibyo biziba mu rwego rwo gukumira indwara zituruka ku mwanda. Ndabaza niba hari icyo nibagiwe ngo na cyo mbe ntakibabwira. Murakoze
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umukobwa w’imyaka itatu upima ibiro cumi na birindwi, kandi afite uburebure bwa cumi na bine. Nasanzeyo umwana akina mu byobo by’amazi mu mudugudu. Sobanurira ko ibyobo by’amazi ari ahantu heza hihishamo imibu, ishobora gutera malariya n’izindi ndwara nka dengue. Uretse malariya, amazi adahinduka ashobora no kuba arimo bagiteri n’udukoko dutera impiswi, kolera, n’umwijima. Sobanurira ko abana bakinira mu byobo by’amazi mabi bashobora kurwara indwara z’uruhu ziterwa na bagiteri n’imiyege iri mu mazi. Bigisha gukoresha inzitiramibu zatewe umuti igihe baryamye kugira ngo birinde imibu ibarya. Bakangurire kugira isuku nziza nko gukaraba intoki kenshi no kugira isuku aho batuye kugira ngo birinde ikwirakwira ry’indwara. Bakangurire gukuraho amazi adahinduka ku bw’ubuzima bwabo. Bigisha kugana ikigo nderabuzima kibegereye igihe babonye ibimenyetso bya malariya cyangwa ibimenyetso by’isuku nke.
question_english: Hello! I visited a home in the village and found a three-year-old girl weighing seventeen kilograms, and her height is fourteen. I found the child playing in water puddles. I talked to the parent and told her that it is not good to have water puddles in or near the home because they can attract malaria, worms, and diarrhea, which could cause health problems for their child. I told her that their child is doing well but asked her to immediately fill in those puddles to prevent diseases caused by dirt. I'm asking if there is anything I forgot to mention so that I can also inform them. Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Umudamu w'imyaka mirongo itatu afite ibiro mirongo itandatu na m bitanu. Yaje angisha inama ambwira ko ari kuva cyane. Namubajije ubundi burwayi asanganywe, ambwira yuko akoresha uburyo bwo kuboneza urubyaro rwagashinge k'amezi atatu ariko sayana. Namugiriye inama yo kwihutira kwa muganga. Ni ubuhe bujanama mwambwira nafasha uyu mudamu?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugore w'imyaka 30 ufite ibiro 65, uva amaraso menshi nyuma yo guterwa urushinge rw'amezi atatu rwo kuboneza urubyaro. Ibi bishobora guterwa no n'ubwirinzi bw'umubiri kubera uburyo bwo kuboneza urubyaro ari gukoresha. Mujyane ku bitaro kugira ngo hakorwe iperereza ryimbitse no gushakirwa ubundi buvuzi bushoboka.
question_english: A 30-year-old woman weighing 65 kilograms came seeking advice, telling me that she is experiencing heavy bleeding. I asked about any underlying conditions, and she mentioned that she uses the three-month contraceptive injection, but the bleeding is persistent. I advised her to seek immediate medical attention. What additional advice can I give to assist this woman?

question_kinyarwanda: Mwiriwe neza, umukobwa w'imyaka makumyabiri n'ine afite ibiro mirongo itanu n'icyenda, agwa hasi agatera imigeri, agacira urufuzi, mubajije igihe abimaranye ambwira ko abimaranye amezi abiri, muhaye taransferi ngo ajye ku kigo nderabuzima yanga kujyayo ngo ni amashitani. Ubwo nabafasha iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugore w'imyaka 24 upima ibiro 59 ari kugira ibihe byo kugwa, gukubita amaguru, no kugira urufuro mu kanwa bimaze amezi 2 kandi yizera ko ari imyuka mibi. Uyu murwayi ari kugira imihindagurike ishobora guterwa na epilepsie. Niba umurwayi ari kugira imihindagurike, mushyire ku ruhande, murinde ururimi rwe kugira ngo rutakomereka, kandi mumushyire ahantu hizewe. Mukwiye kubasobanurira ko iyi ndwara ishobora kubaho cyane cyane niba bafite amateka y’umuryango ariko ishobora no kugaragara mu bukure. Mubasobanurire ko niba itavuwe hakiri kare ashobora kugira ingaruka ku bwonko ziturutse ku kubura umwuka uhagije mu bwonko biba mu gihe cy’imihindagurike, kandi ko bagomba gushaka ubuvuzi vuba bishoboka. Mureke bumve neza ko kubura umwuka uhagije mu bwonko bishobora gutera urupfu rw’ubwonko, bityo bigatera uburwayi burambye ndetse n’urupfu. Nyuma yo kugirwa inama bihagije, mubohereze ku bitaro kugira ngo bakomeze gusuzumwa no kuvurwa.
question_english: Good afternoon, a 24-year-old woman weighing 59 kilograms is experiencing episodes of collapsing, kicking, and foaming at the mouth. When I asked how long she has been experiencing this, she told me it has been two months. I gave her a transfer to go to a health center, but she refused, saying it is caused by evil spirits. How can I help her?

question_kinyarwanda: Umugore w'imyaka mirongo itatu nitanu, aje kundeba afite ikibazo cyo gusemeka, no kubabara mu gatuza kandi ambwiye ko nta ndwara zidakira afite. Uyu mubyeyi namufasha gute?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugore w'imyaka mirongo itatu n'itanu usemeka akababara mugatuza. 1.Uwo mugore afite ikibazo cyo mu buhumekero rero aho ntabundi bufasha wamuha, ahubwo muhe taransiferi ajye mubitaro bamufashe
question_english: A thirty-five-year-old woman came to see me with a complaint of shortness of breath and chest pain, and she told me that she has no chronic illnesses. How can I help this patient?

question_kinyarwanda: Umusore w'imyaka mirongo itatu n'ibiri ufite ibiro mirongo itanu na kimwe, yaje angana ambwira ko amaze iminsi umunani aribwa amaso bikabije kandi yanatukuye cyane. Ndetse amaso ye arabyimbye, mubajije ko nta bundi burwayi asanzwe agira ambwira ko ntabwo. Nahise muha taransiferi, ese hari ubundi bufasha namuha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umusore w'imyaka mirongo 32 akaba afite ibiro 31, akaba ababara amaso anatukuye. 1. 1\. Afite uburebure bungana iki?, n'ubwo ntabundi burwayi akubwiye afite, urebye uwo muntu ibiro afite n'imyakaye ntibijyanye, imirire ye imeze ite? 2.Muhe taransiferi ajye kwa muganga
question_english: A thirty-two-year-old young man weighing fifty-one kilograms came to me, saying he has been experiencing severe eye pain for the past eight days, and his eyes are very red and swollen. When I asked if he had any pre-existing conditions, he said no. I immediately gave him a referral. Is there any other assistance I can provide him?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umugabo ufite imyaka mirongo itatu n'umunani, ibiro mirongo itanu na kimwe, aje afite umuriro, asanzwe arwaye igisebe. Namukoreye tederi(TDR) iba negatifu, muhaye taransiferi ntiyabyumva. Mwamfasha iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Uyu ni umugabo w'imyaka 38 upima ibiro 51, yaje afite umuriro asanzwe afite igisebe, TDR yagaragaje ko ari negative kandi umurwayi yanze koherezwa kwa muganga. Uyu murwayi ashobora kuba afite igisebe cyanduye. Ugomba kumwigisha ko niba atagiye kwa muganga, igisebe kizakomeza kwandura kandi ubwandu bukazakwira umubiri wose bigatera sepsis, septic shock hanyuma bikamuviramo urupfu. Nanone kubera ko igisebe cyanduye, igice cy'umubiri we gishobora gufatwa na gangrene bigatuma ashobora gutakaza urugingo kubera gutinda kwivuza kandi iyo gangrene nayo ishobora kumutera sepsis n'urupfu. Mwigishe ko akeneye ibizamini byimbitse no kwitabwaho neza kugira ngo niba igisebe cyanduye gishobore gukurwamo imyanda (debridement) kandi ahabwe imiti y'inkingo z'ubwandu (antibiotics) izamufasha gukira ubwandu bumutera umuriro. Nyuma yo kumugira inama no kumwigisha bihagije, umwohereze kwa muganga kugira ngo akorerwe isuzuma ryimbitse no kwitabwaho neza.
question_english: I've received a man aged thirty-eight, weighing fifty-one kilograms, who has come with a fever and has an existing ulcer. I've performed a TDR which's been negative, and I've guven him a referral and he does not understand it. How can you help me?

question_kinyarwanda: Umubyeyi yanzaniye umwana w'umuhungu ufite umwaka n'igice; ibiro n'icumi muwake ni cumi na gatatu n'ibice bitanu. Bambwiye ko umwana amaze iminsi ibiri atonka neza; adashobora no kurya. Mbona atangiye guhwekera atabasha no kunyeganyega. Umubiri wabaye umuhondo nta bundi burwayi yarasanganywe; none muhaye transiferi ntanze n'ubutumwa ku kigo nderabuzima. Mumfashe ni ikindi kihe nakorera uyu murwayi?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umwana w’umuhungu w’imyaka 1.5 ufite ibiro 10 kandi ufite MUAC ya 13.5cm yazanywe kubera kutabasha konka cyangwa kurya mu minsi 2 ishize bifitanye isano no gucika intege, afite umubiri w’umuhondo ariko nta ndwara izwi. Uyu mwana ashobora kuba afite indwara y’umuhondo. Sobanurira nyina ko indwara y’umuhondo iterwa n’impamvu zitandukanye aho bilirubine itajyanwa hanze ahubwo ikongera gusubira mu mubiri. Ibi bishobora guterwa n’indwara ya hemolytic anemia, obstructive jaundice, hepatitis cyangwa virusi ya Epstein Barr n’ibindi. Ibi biterwa no kugira bilirubine nyinshi mu mubiri, bishobora gutera gucika intege no kugira umunaniro ukabije. Ku bw’ibyo, mumujyane byihutirwa. Kwa muganga, bazakora ibizamini bitandukanye kandi bazavura hakurikijwe ibyo bazasanga.
question_english: A parent brought me a one-and-a-half-year-old boy weighing ten kilograms; his MUAC is thirteen and a half centimeters. They told me the child has not been breastfeeding well for two days and cannot eat. I have seen that he was becoming weak and unable to move. His body has turned yellow, and he had no other pre-existing illness; now I have given him a referral and sent a message to the health center. Please help me, what else can I do for this patient?

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'umuhungu w'imyaka ine afite ibiro cumi na bitanu, afite inkorora n'umuriro amaranye ibyumweru bibiri. Mama we avuga ko yamuvuje bamuha amogisi ariko indwara ntikira kandi avuga ko papa we yavuwe indwara y'igituntu umwaka ushize ariko ko umwana inkorora ye nta gikororwa ifite. Tumufashe gute?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umwana w’umuhungu w’imyaka 4 ufite ibiro 15 afite inkorora n’umuriro bimaze ibyumweru bibiri. Nyina avuga ko se w’umwana yavuwe indwara y'gituntu umwaka ushize. • Saba nyina kujyana umwana ku kigo nderabuzima kugira ngo bapime niba afite indwara y'igituntu, kandi niba ibisubizo byerekana ko akirwaye, atangire kuvurwa indwara y'igituntu ako kanya, kuko umwana afite impamvu ishobora gutuma arwara kubera ko se yari arwaye igituntu umwaka ushize. • Nanone, saba nyina gutangira kwambara agapfukamunwa kugira ngo yirinde kwandura iyo ndwara.
question_english: A four-year-old boy weighing fifteen kilograms has a cough and fever that have lasted for two weeks. His mother says he was given amoxicillin, but the illness hasn't improved. She also mentioned that his father was treated for tuberculosis last year, but the boy's cough doesn't appear to have any signs of tuberculosis. How should we assist him?

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'umukobwa w'imyaka makumyabiri n'ine wibana ampamagaye ambwira ko yumva afite umuriro mwinshi, arakorora kandi avuye i kigali. Arasuherewe afite isereri iseseme arahumeka nabi, arababara umutwe mu nda hari kumurya. Mbanje gufata ibikoresho by'ubwirinzi birimo agapfukamunwa, na ga na termometere na tederi kugirango njye kumusuzuma. Ngezeyo nsanga nta muntu uri kumwegera, bavuga ko yaba afite ibimenyetso by'icyorezo cya marbaga. Mbanje kureba ibimenyetso afite n'uburyo afite nsanga sinamukoraho. Ese muhururize muganga? Ese mwohereze kwa muganga? Mufasha iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze IBYO AFITE -Umuriro, inkorora, isereri, guhumeka nabi, kubabara umutwe no mu nda kandi aturutse kigali. IBYO KUMENYA -Aheruka mu mihango ryari -Aryama munzitiramibu -Ahuruka guhura n'abantu benshi barimo abarwaye nkawe nkuko arwaye ubu? -Aheruka kwipimisha agakoko gatera SIDA? IBYO WAKEKA -Inda -Malaria -Igituntu -Infections zindi -Niba ari igihe cy'icyorezo nacyo wagikeka IBYO GUKORA -Wigira ubwoba ntakibazo ambara gants n'agapfukamunwa -Muhumurize umubwire ko tumufasha -Fata TDR, INDA -Mufashe kubona umuti w'umuriro -Nusanga nta malaria, ntanda afite mwohereze ako kanya kwa muganga kandi uhamagare ambulance. -Mugihe mutaramenya uburwayi afite mwirinde kumwegera mutamabye agapfukamunwa na ga.
question_english: A twenty-four-year-old woman living alone called me, saying she feels very feverish, is coughing, and has just returned from Kigali. She is weak, dizzy, nauseous, breathing heavily, and experiencing a severe headache and stomach pain. I first gathered protective equipment, including a mask, gloves, a thermometer, and a rapid test kit, to examine her. When I arrived, I found that no one was approaching her because they suspected she might have symptoms of a contagious disease like Marburg. Upon assessing her symptoms and condition, I realized I couldn't touch her. Should I call a doctor? Should I send her to the hospital? How can I assist her?

question_kinyarwanda: Mwiriwe,nasuye umugore utwite ufite imyaka mirongo itatu n'irindwi ufite ibiro mirongo irindwi na bitatu. Mwigisha ibimenyetso mpuruza mwigisha imyitwarire y'umuntu utwite. Mubwira ko agomba gushaka umuntu wo gusigara ku rugo igihe yagiye kubyarira kwa muganga. Ambwira ko atabyarira kwa muganga ko umwana wa mbere yamubyariye mu rugo ntagire ikibazo. Mungire inama y'icyo nafasha uyu mubyeyi.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umubyeyi w’imyaka **37** utwite yatangaje ko **atiteguye kubyarira kwa muganga** kuko **umwana we wa mbere yavutse neza mu rugo nta kibazo.** **Igisubizo (R/):** * Umwana wa mbere **yagize amahirwe**, ariko **ntibyemewe** kubyarira mu rugo. * **Ibibazo bishobora kuvuka bijyanye n’indwara n’izindi ngaruka** ni byinshi. * **Nta baganga babihuguriwe baba mu rugo** kugira ngo bafashe umubyeyi mu gihe hagize ikibazo kibaho. * **Ni ngombwa kumwigisha** ku bijyanye n’**imigendekere y’inda**, impinduka zimwe na zimwe zishobora kuba, n’uburyo **umwana ameze mu nda bishobora gutera kugorana mu gihe cyo kubyara.** * **Hari ibyemezo bimwe na bimwe** bifatwa n’**abaganga babifitiye uburambe n’ubumenyi** kugira ngo **bafashe umubyeyi n’umwana mu gihe hari ikibazo.** * **Gukurikirana umubyeyi n’umwana mu nda** bikorwa neza mu **bitaro**, aho **abaganga babikurikirana hafi**.
question_english: Good afternoon, I visited a pregnant woman who is thirty-seven years old and weighs seventy-three kilograms. I taught her the danger symptoms and i taught her the behavior of a pregnant person. I told her that she should find someone to stay at home when she goes to deliver at the hospital. However, she says that she will not deliver at the hospital because she delivered her first child at home with no problems. Please advise me on how I can help this mother.

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'umukobwa w'imyaka ine n'amezi ataratu, umubyeyi we aje kumuvuza avuga ko umwana we yahohotewe agafatwa ku ngufu n'umuntu utaramenyekana. Mubajije niba nta bundi burwayi yavukanye avuga ko ntabwo. Mufashe muwake nsanga afite cumi nagatanu n'ibice bitanu. Muhaye transiferi nibazaga niba nta bundi bufasha namuha bwisumbuye.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Ikihutirwa ni ukugera ku kigonderabuzima, muri service ishinzwe kwakira abahohotewe, bakamuha ubufasha bwihutirwa.
question_english: A four-year-old and six-month-old girl, her mother comes to treat her and says her child was abused and raped by an unknown person. I asked if she had any other illnesses she said she did not. I took her MUAC and found that she was fifteen and a half. I gave her a transfer. I was wondering if i couldn't give her any more help.

question_kinyarwanda: Nasuye uruhinja ku munsi wa munani ni umuhungu afite iminsi umunani afite ibiro bine nigishije umubyeyi we ibimenyetso mpuruza. Ndukozeho nsanga ruri guhumeka vuba, mbaze inshuro ruhumeka, nsanga ruhumeka inshuro mirongo itandatu n'eshanu ku munota. Nta burwayi rwavukanye namwandikiye transferi ndangije yambwiye ko atajyayo ko ariko uruhinja ruhumeka. Nakomeje kumusobanurira arabyanga. Ni iki nakora?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Hamagara inzego zibanze.
question_english: I visited an eight-day-old baby boy who weighs four kilograms and taught the mother about warning signs. Upon examination, I found the baby breathing rapidly. When I counted, I found the baby breathing 65 times per minute. The baby was not born with any illnesses. I wrote a transfer for them, but the mother refused, insisting that the baby is breathing fine. I continued to explain, but she still refused. What can I do?

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'umuhungu afite imyaka itatu; afite ibiro umunani arananutse bikabije; kwa muganga bamuha sosoma akayinywa ariko ntabwo yiyongera; no murugo arya indyo yuzuye; ndamukurikirana ababyeyi be bafite ubushobozi, ariko ntago ajya yiyongera ibiro kandi afite n'ubugufi cyane. Nkore iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze kubaza iki ikibazo cy'uyu mwana w'umuhungu ufite imyaka itatu, ufite ibiro umunani,arananutse bikabije,kwa muganga bamuha sosoma akayinywa ariko ntabwo yiyongera,no murugo Arya indyo yuzuye,uramukurikirana ababyeyi be bafite ubushobozi,ariko ntago ajya yiyongera ibiro Kandi afite n'ubugufi cyane.Ukaba ubaza icyo wakora. Ni byiza kuba warakurikiranye uyu mwana w'umuhungu ufite ikibazo cy'imirire mibi,akaba Ari muri gahunda ikurikirana imikurire y,abana aho afata sosoma ndetse akaba Arya n,indyo yuzuye bitewe n,umuryango we ufite ubushobozi,Kandi nawe nk, umujyanama w, ubuzima ukaba umukurikirana,ariko umwana akaba akomeje kugira ikibazo cyo kunanuka n,ubugufi bukabije ndetse akaba atiyongera mu biro. Bishobora kuba biterwa n,ikindi cyintu runaka kitari cyamenyekana.Nko kuba afite uburwayi yavukanye cyangwa yarwaye nyuma ariko bukaba butazwi.Urugero: -Uburwayi bw,umutima -Uburwayi bwa kanseri yo mu maraso(Lekemiya) -Uburwayi bw'impyiko. -Uburwayi bw'umwijima -Uburwayi bw'inzoka nka teniya,asikarisi, bihariziyoze, ankiyilositome n'izindi. Niyo mpamvu uyu mwana agomba koherezwa kwa muganga,bakamusuzuma ubundi burwayi Yaba afite. Icyo wakora,nukugira inama uyu mubyeyi,ukurikije ibyavuzwe haruguru,hanyuma ukamuha taransiferi imujyana ku kigo Nderabuzima byihutirwa kugirango umwana asuzumwe ubundi burwayi. Murakoze.
question_english: A three-year-old boy weighs eight kilograms, and she is extremely thin. At the hospital, Sosoma fortified supplements to drink, but he doesn't gain weight; at home, he eats a balanced diet. I monitor him; his parents are capable to take care of him, but he still doesn't gain weight, and he is very short. What should I do?

question_kinyarwanda: Umugabo w'imyaka mirongo itatu ni'tatu, yaje kundeba mupima ibiro nsanga afite ibiro mirongo itatu ni icyenda, mbona afite ibiro bikeya cyane ugereranyije n'imyaka afite. Mubajije impamvu ambwira yuko yumva ababara mu gatuza, arakorora cyane, inkorora ayimaranye ibyumweru bitatu, nta ntege afite, kandi yumva ashyuhiranye cyane. Mubwira yuko mbona afite ibimenyetso by'umurwayi w'igituntu musaba ko twajyana kwa muganga ngo bajye kumupima igituntu. Ese hari ubundi bufasha nari kumuha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Mwigishe ku bijyanye na TB. Musobanurire icyo TB ari cyo, ibimenyetso byayo, uko yandura, n'uko ivurwa. Ibi bizamufasha gusobanukirwa n'uburwayi bwe no gufata umwanzuro wo gushaka ubufasha bw’ubuvuzi. Mufashe kugera kwa muganga niba adafite imbaraga zo kugenda wenyine. Mukurikiranire hafi uko amerewe. Mumushishikarize kunywa amazi menshi, gufata indyo yuzuye no kuruhuka bihagije, mwibuke kumubaza niba yarigeze guhura n’umuntu urwaye TB. Mubaze ibindi bimenyetso bijyana na byo nko kuruka, gucibwamo, n'ibindi. Mwikingire ukoresheje agapfukamunwa kandi mumushyire ahantu hihariye mukimara kugera ku kigo nderabuzima kugira ngo mutanduza abandi barwayi n’abatanga ubuvuzi kugeza igihe bigaragaye ko atanduye. Genzura niba abo mu muryango we mu muryango mugari bataranduye TB. Mwibuke kumushyigikira mu buryo bw'amarangamutima no mu mibanire niba bishoboka kugira ngo akire vuba. Mumuhumurize kandi mumwigishe uko afata imiti neza nk'uko yandikiwe n’abatanga ubuvuzi.
question_english: A thirty-three-year-old man came to see me, and when I measured his weight, I found he weighs only thirty-nine kilograms, which is very low for his age. When I asked about his condition, he mentioned that he has chest pain, a persistent cough for three weeks, and feels very fatigued and feverish. I told him that he shows signs of tuberculosis and advised him that we should go to the hospital for testing. Is there any other help I could give him?

question_kinyarwanda: Umugabo w'imyaka mirongo itandatu n'umwe, ibiro ni mirongo irindwi na bibiri, aje afite umuriro mwinshi ababara umutwe n'umugongo, mupimye umuriro nsanga ni mirongo itatu n'icyenda, mupimye malariya nsanga ntayo afite, mubajije niba nta bundi burwayi asanganywe ambwira ko ntabwo. Namuha ubuhe bufasha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: muraho urakoze kubaza iki kibazo cy'umugabo w'imyaka mirongo itatu n'umwe, ibiro mirongo irindwi na bibiri waje afite umuriro mwinshi ababara umutwe n'umugongo wamupima ugasanga afite umuriro wa mirongo itatu n'icyenda wapima malariya ugasanga ntayo afite kandi avuga ko nta bundi burwayi asanzwe agira. Uyu mugabo ararwaye kuko umuriro wa mirongo itatu n'icyenda ni m​winshi kandi hari ikintu kirimo gutuma agira uyu muriro uyu mugabo akeneye gusuzumwa byimbitse hakarebwa igituma afite umuriro ungana gutya ariko mbere yuko hagira ibindi bikorwa agomba kubanza guhabwa ibinini bya parasitamoro byo kumuvura uyu muriro mwinshi afite uyu mugabo rero muhe taransiferi yihute ajye kwa muganga kugira ngo bamufashe bamuhe imiti igabanya uyu muriro kandi banamufatire ibizamini bindi barebe niba adafite ubundi burwayi burimo nko kuba yagira infegisiyo yo mu maraso kuko nayo ibaho kandi umuntu uyifite agira umuriro mwinshi kwa muganga barasuzuma byinshi barebe kandi bo bashobora no kumuha imiti ya antibiyotike yo kumuvura infection n'indi ya parasitamoro yo kumugabanyiriza umuriro uyu mugabo mufashe umuhe transiferi ajye kwa muganga urakoze!
question_english: A sixty-one-year-old man, 72 kg, comes with a high fever, back pain and suffering from headache. I've her tested fever and got thirty-nine and malaria negative tested. I've asked him if he has got any other illness and he tells me no. What help can I give him?

question_kinyarwanda: Banzaniye umwana w'umukobwa w'imyaka cumi n'ibiri, yanze kuvuga. Ariko biragaragara ko afite agahinda kuko ntashaka ko bamureba kuko arimo kwihisha. Uwo mwana yafashwa iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umukobwa w'imyaka cumi n'ibiri wanze kuvuga. Agaragara nk'ufite agahinda kenshi kandi yihishe, adashaka ko bamubona. Uwo mukobwa ashobora kuba afite isoni, agahinda gakabije, ipfunwe rishobora guterwa no gufatwa ku ngufu, ihohoterwa, cyangwa gukorerwa iyicarubozo. Vugana na we mu ibanga, umuhe umutekano kandi umwereke ko ashobora kukwizera.  Ashobora kuba yarafashwe ku ngufu cyangwa yarakomerekejwe n'abagize umuryango we. Niba yarafashwe ku ngufu, muhe imiti yo kwirinda gusama (LEVONERGESTREL) niba ihari, kandi umwohereze kwa muganga kugira ngo akorerwe isuzuma ryimbitse no kuvurwa ku ihohoterwa cyangwa gufatwa ku ngufu.  Niba yarafashwe ku ngufu ariko atazi uwabikoze, umuhe imiti yo kwirinda gusama, imiti yo kwirinda virusi itera SIDA, imiti yo kuvura indwara zandurira mu mibonano mpuzabitsina, kandi umuhe ubumenyi. Akeneye kugirwa inama.
question_english: They brought me a twelve-year-old girl who refused to speak. She appears very sad and is hiding, not wanting to be seen. What can help this child?

question_kinyarwanda: Umugore w'imyaka mirongo itatu n'itatu aje kundeba afite ikibazo cyo gukorora igikororwa kivanze n'amaraso. Mubajije nimba hari indwara zidakira afite, ambwiye ko abana n'ubwandu bwa sida. None uyu mugore namufasha gute?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze. -muhe agapfukamunwa nonaha unamusabe kutegera abandi mugihe batarakora ibizamini. -musabe gufata imiti yubwandu neza, -mwohereze kwa muganga bamukorere ibizamini byose anace mucyuma wasanga ari igituntu cyangwa ibindi byuririrzi.
question_english: A thirty-three-year-old woman comes to see me with a cough that is mixed with blood. When I asked if she had any chronic illnesses, she told me she was HIV positive. How can I help this woman?

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'umukobwa ufite imyaka ibiri. Mufashe ibipimo, afite ibiro cumi na bibiri na magarama magana atanu na miwake cumi na gatanu, afite ikibazo cyo kurira cyane, kandi nta kintu abasha kurya. Mugiriye inama yo kujya kwa muganga, avuga ko yagiyeyo ntibamwakire kuko hari abarwayi benshi. Uyu mwana turamukorera iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'umukobwa ufite imyaka ibiri. Mufashe ibipimo nsanga afite ibiro 12 na magana atanu, na muwake cumi na gatanu. Afite ikibazo cyo kurira cyane, kandi nta kintu abasha kurya. Uyu mwana uramubaza niba afite ibindi bimenyetso nko kuruka, gucibwamo, kubabara mu nda, umuriro ndetse no kubyimba inda. Umubaze ikintu yumva yabasha kurya, cyangwa ashaka kurya. Hanyuma umugire inama yo kunywa amazi menshi no kurya imbuto, ubundi umwohereze kwa muganga kugira ngo akorerwe ibizamini, bamunyuze no mu cyuma, bamuhe n'imiti igabanya ububabare.
question_english: A two-year-old girl has come to me. I have taken her measurements; she weighs twelve kilograms and five hundred grams, and her mean upper arm circumference is fifteen centimeters. She has a problem with crying a lot and cannot eat anything. I have advised her caregivers to take her to the hospital, but she has said they went there and were not admitted because there were many patients. What can we do for this child?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umubyeyi w'umugore ufite imyaka mirongo ine nirindwi, umugabo we yamukubise aramukomeretsa. Namufashe muzana mu rugo, arara mu rugo. Nabazaga muganga, ni iki nakora?
