answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Wagombaga kumufasha kugera kwa Muganga kugirango ahabwe ubuvuzi kuko murugo ntabuvuzi ufite bwo kumuha. Ni byiza kumujyanama kwa Muganga bakamwitaho. Igikomere bakakivura ndetse agahabwa n'imiti
question_english: I received a 47-year-old mother, whose husband beat and injured her. I brought her to my home, and she spent the night there. I am asking, as a doctor, what should I do?

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'umuhungu w'imyaka ine; angeze imbere ahumeka inshuro mirongo ine n'eshatu. Mbajije mama we igihe yafatiwe, ambwira yuko abimaranye iminsi ibiri. Nsuzumye neza nsanga atari ikibazo cy'umusonga; mbajije mama we ambwira yuko yikubise hasi; nkeka ko yaba yaravunitse. None uwo mwana mufashe iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Mwohereze Kwa Muganga barebe niba yavunitse bamufashe.
question_english: A four-year-old boy; he comes to me breathing forty-three times per minute. When I asked his mother when it started, she told me it had been two days. After examining him carefully, I found it was not pneumonia; I asked his mother, and she told me he had fallen down; I suspect he might have fractured something. So, what should be done for that child?

question_kinyarwanda: Umubyeyi afite umwana w'umukobwa ufite imyaka umunani yagiye kwiga, none avuye kwiga atabasha kuvuga. Mugira inama yo kumujyana kwa muganga ambwira ko nta mitiweli agira. Namufasha iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umukobwa w'imyaka 8 udashobora kuvuga kandi umuryango we nta bwishingizi bafite bwo kumujyana kwa muganga. Uyu mwana ashobora kuba afite indwara ya autism spectrum disorder. Ugomba kubaza niba mu mikurire ye atarigeze avuga na gato, ubaze ku bindi bimenyetso by’imikurire ye niba nta kibazo cyabayeho, ubaze niba ashobora gukurikiza amabwiriza, niba yumva cyangwa atega amatwi. Hanyuma ubigishe ko niba bafite amafaranga make, bashobora kwishyura ubwishingizi bakabona ubuvuzi bidatinze kandi ko bitazongera gutinda. Hanyuma ubohereze ku bitaro ku muganga w’abana kugira ngo akomeze kubasuzuma no kubitaho. Ubizeze kandi ubamenyeshe ko nibitabwaho hakiri kare hari amahirwe yo gukira bitewe n'uko indwara isuzumwe.
question_english: A parent has an eight-year-old daughter who went to school, but now she can't speak. They want to take her to the doctor but don't have health insurance. How can I help them?

question_kinyarwanda: Mpuye n'umusore ugereranyije afite imyaka makumyabiri, ibiro mirongo itanu nsanze yikubise hasi, ari guhekenya ururimi ariko kuzana urufuzi mu kanwa ari guteraguza amaguru. Ndamufashe muryamisha neza ku rubavu, none mwamfasha iki ku burwayi bw'uyu musore?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umurwayi w’umugabo w’imyaka 20 yaguye hasi bifitanye isano no kuruma ururimi, no kugira amatembabuzi mu kanwa (kumva ifuro mu kanwa). Uyu murwayi ashobora kuba afite indwara y’igisusumizi. Ahita ashyirwa mu mwanya wo kugarura ubuzima. Shyira ikintu cyoroshye mu kanwa kugira ngo wirinde ko aruma ururimi bikomeye. Ntukamureke wenyine. Nyuma yo kugarura ubuzima, mugire inama yo kujya kwa muganga kugira ngo akorerwe Electroencephalogramu.
question_english: I encountered a young man, approximately twenty years old, weighing fifty kilograms, who had collapsed, was biting his tongue, and foaming at the mouth while jerking his legs. I assisted him by laying him on his side. How can I assist further with this young man's condition?

question_kinyarwanda: Umugore w'imyaka mirongo itandatu afite ibiro mirongo itandatu na bitanu. Amaze imyaka makumyabiri afite ubumuga bwo mu mutwe na kanseri mwitako yarasanzwe afite imiti mufasha. None yanze kuyinywa kubera ububabare. Twamufasha dute?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugore w’imyaka mirongo itandatu, ufite ibiro 65, amaze imyaka makumyabiri afite ubumuga bwo mu mutwe ndetse na kanseri, yari asanzwe afata imiti imufasha. Ubu ariko yanze kuyinywa kubera ububabare. Ibyo wakora: 1. Reba mu miti asanzwe afata niba harimo iyigabanya ububabare nka *morphine*. Niba ihari, ubanze uyimuhe kugira ngo ububabare bugabanyuke. 2. Niba nta miti igabanya ububabare afite, cyangwa nyuma yo kuyimuha agikomeza kugira ububabare, muganirize umusobanurire ko kwa muganga bamufasha kurushaho. 3. Menyesha umuryango we kugira ngo umuhe ubufasha bwihariye n’inkunga akeneye. 4. Muhe *transferri* ajye ku ivuriro aho asanzwe akurikiranirwa, kugira ngo abaganga bita ku bafite ubumuga bwo mu mutwe bamuganirize, kandi abonane n’abita ku ndwara ye ya kanseri. 5. Bamufashe kubona imiti igabanya ububabare ndetse n’ubundi buvuzi akeneye. Uyu murwayi agomba gufashwa uko bikwiye kugira ngo ububabare bwe bugabanuke kandi yitabweho mu buryo burambye.
question_english: A sixty-year-old woman weighs sixty-five kilograms. She has had a mental disability for twenty years and thigh cancer, for which she was receiving medication. Now she refuses to take it because of the pain. How can we help her?

question_kinyarwanda: Nasanze umuntu igare rimutuye hasi apfumuka inda. None se ubwo ndakora iki ngo mufashe?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Muhamagarire imbangukiragutabara byihuse kugira ngo ajye kwitabwaho.
question_english: I found someone who fell off a bicycle and their abdomen was punctured. What should I do to help them?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umubyeyi w'umugabo ufite imyaka mirongo itatu yari yuriye kuzu hejuru kubati aragwa. Nabazaga muganga, ni iki nafasha uyu murwayi?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugabo w'imyaka 30 wagize impanuka yo kugwa ahantu harehare. Icya mbere, wibanze ku mutekano wawe, ugerageze gukangura umurwayi hanyuma uhamagare ubufasha. Niba umurwayi atitaba, reba niba afite umutsi, niba nta mutsi afite, tangira gukanda mu gituza mu gihe utegereje ubufasha. Nyuma, reba inzira z'ubuhumekero niba nta kintu kibangamiye ndetse unashyire ijosi mu mwanya ukoresheje amabuye mu gihe haba hari imvune mu ijosi, urebe niba ahumeka, urebe umutsi, cyangwa niba hari aho amaraso atemba, hanyuma ufunge aho amaraso atemba. Reba urwego rw'ubushobozi bwo kumva ndetse n'ibindi bikomere byihishe bitagaragara, niba hari indi mvune, shyira mu mwanya igice cyavunitse mu gihe utegereje imodoka izamujyana n'ubuvuzi bwisumbuye.
question_english: I received a male parent who is thirty years old; he had climbed on the roof and fell. I was asking the doctor; what can I do to help this patient?

question_kinyarwanda: Umurwayi w'umuhungu w'imyaka cumi n'icyenda, ibiro mirongo ine na bibiri. Yaje ataka munda kandi afite umuriro wa mirongo itatu na karindwi. Mupimye nsanga nta malariya afite ndamwohereza. Ese hari ubundi bujyanama nari kumuha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umurwayi w’umusore w’imyaka 19, upima ibiro 42, yaje afite ububabare mu nda, umuriro wa 37°C, RDT yabaye negative hanyuma baramwohereza. • Byiza, wagombaga kumubaza niba hari ikintu kidasanzwe yariye cyangwa yanyoye, niba asanzwe anyara cyangwa yituma neza. Niba avuga ko hari ikintu kidasanzwe yariye cyangwa yanyoye, ugomba gukeka ko ari kurwara kubera ibyo kurya byamugizeho ingaruka cyangwa uburozi, hanyuma ukamwohereza ku bitaro kugira ngo avurwe neza. Ariko niba abihakanye, umwizeze, ariko niba ububabare ari bwinshi cyane, umwohereze ku bitaro kugira ngo avurwe ububabare ndetse hakorwe n’andi masuzuma no kumuvura neza.
question_english: A nineteen-year-old male patient, weighing forty-two kilograms. He came complaining of abdominal pain and had a fever of thirty-seven degrees. I tested him and found he did not have malaria, so I referred him. Was there any other advice I should have given him?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umugore w’imyaka mirongo itanu n'itanu y'amavuko, arahitwa arakorora, yacitse intege umubiri wose. Mubajije ikindi kibazo afite, ambwira ko ajya afata imiti y'ababana n'ubwandu bw’agakoko gatera SIDA. Mwohereje kwa muganga ngo yongere afate iyo miti. Murakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugore w'imyaka 55 uzwiho kuba afite VIH kandi afata imiti, yaje afite impiswi, inkorora, n'intege nke z'umubiri muri rusange. -Uyu murwayi ashobora kuba afite impiswi iterwa na VIH. -Uyu murwayi ashobora kuba afite indwara y'ibyuririzi nka PCP. -Uyu murwayi ashobora kuba afite umusonga. Muhe umuti wongera amazi mu mubiri, hanyuma umwohereze ku bitaro kugira ngo akorerwe isuzuma no kuvurwa. Ibishoboka mu isuzuma: genexpert, fbc, isuzuma ry'amase n'ifoto y'igituza (chest x-ray).
question_english: I've received a 55-year-old woman, she's had diarrhea, coughing and weak all over her body. When I've asked her if she has had any other issues, she's told me that she takes medication for people living with HIV. I've referred her to the doctor to resume taking that medication. Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umudamu w'imyaka makumyabiri n'itanu n'ibiro mirongo itanu na birindwi yaje afite umuriro ababara mu nda namubajije ko nta kindi kibazo afite yambwiye ko arwaye sida. Namwohereje kwa muganga. Musuye nyuma y'iminsi ine nsanga aracyarembye. Mungire inama?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugore w'imyaka 25 upima ibiro 57, yaje afite umuriro mwinshi n'ububabare mu nda afite SIDA. Uyu mugore ashobora kuba afite indwara z'ibyuririzi zifitanye isano na SIDA. Yoherejwe ku bitaro ariko aracyari mu mimerere ikomeye nyuma y'iminsi 4. Gahunda: -Komeza utegereze ubuyobozi bw'ibitaro, bishoboka ko imiti ari guhabwa atayikozwa. -Niba isuzuma ry'amaraso ryakozwe ku bitaro, komeza utegereze ibisubizo kugira ngo ahabwe imiti y'ibinyabuzima ikwiye.
question_english: I received a 25-year-old woman weighing 57 kilograms who came with a fever and abdominal pain. When I asked if she had any other issues, she told me she has AIDS. I referred her to the hospital. I visited her after four days and found that she was still in a critical condition. What should I do?

question_kinyarwanda: Umubyeyi w'umudugudu wa gahondo azanye umwana w'umuhungu w'imyaka itatu apima ibiro cumi na bine miwake ya cumi na gatatu n'igice. Yaje afite umuriro akorora mufatiye umuriro agira mirongo itatu n'umunani. Mfata tederi iba negatifu na tayima ambwira ko afite ikibazo mu buhumekero ,kandi mfite amogisi. Muha taransiferi. Mumfashe namuha imiti kandi afite ikibazo mu buhumekero?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: UMWANA W' UMUHUNGU W' IMYAKA 3 APIMA IBIRO 14KG MIWAKE YA 13.5 TDR NA TAYIMA NI NEGATIFU KANDI NGO AFITE IKIBAZO MU BUHUMEKERO -UYU MWANA KUBERAKO YOHEREJWE KWA MUGANGA WAREKA KUMUHA AMOGISI KUKO ISHOBORA GUTUMA BAFASHE IBIZAMI BY' AMARASO BATABONA INDWARA, -ICYO WAKORA WAMUSHIRA AGATAMBARO GATOSE KU GAHANGA KUGIRANGO UMUGABZANIRIZE UBUSHYUHE -NURANGIZA UMWOHEREZE KWA MUGANGA
question_english: A mother from gahondo village brought a three-year-old boy weighing fourteen kilograms and thirteen and a half millimeters. He came with a fever and coughed and had a fever of thirty-eight-degree Celsius. I take TDR and Timer and was negative. She told me that he has a problem with his breathing, and I have amoxicillin. I gave him a transfer. Can you help me give him medicine even if he has a problem in respiratory system?

question_kinyarwanda: Umukecuru w'imyaka mirongo itandatu n'umunani afite ibiro mirongo itanu n’icyenda. Yaje angana ambwira yuko ari kubabara umutwe kandi ari kureba ibikezikezi.Namubajije ubundi burwayi asanganywe ambwira ko arwara umuvuduko w'amaraso na diyabete (Diabete). Mubajije niba aheruka kunywa imiti ambwira ko yari yarayihagaritse ataraheruka kuyinywa. Namugiriye inama yo kunywa iyo miti kandi akayikurikiranya neza nkuko muganga yabimutegetse. Mwamfasha iki? Kubundi bujyanama nagira uwo murwayi.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugore w'imyaka mirongo itandatu n'umunani apima ibiro mirongo itanu n'icyenda. yaje ansanga avuga ko afite umutwe n'ibibazo byo kutabona neza. Namubajije ku bijyanye n'amateka ye y'ubuzima, ambwira ko afite umuvuduko w'amaraso na diyabete. Namubajije niba aherutse gufata imiti ye, maze ambwira ko yayihagaritse. Urakoze ku nama watanze. Reka twongere gupima umuvuduko w'amaraso no kugenzura isukari mu maraso. Hanyuma umwohereze yongere gufata imiti y'umuvuduko w'amaraso na diyabete. Umwigishe kutazongera guhagarika imiti.
question_english: An eighty-eight-year-old woman weighs fifty-nine kilograms. She came to me complaining of a headache and blurred vision. When I asked about her medical history, she mentioned that she has hypertension and diabetes. I asked if she had taken her medication recently, and she said she had stopped taking it. I advised her to resume her medication and to follow her doctor's instructions carefully. What additional advice can I provide for this patient?

question_kinyarwanda: Muraho, umugabo w'imyaka mirongo itanu ibiro mirongo inani na bitanu, angezeho ari kuvuga ko afite imbeho nyinshi yumva yacitse intege. Mubajije igihe yafatiwe ambwiye ko amaze iminsi ibiri, mubajije ko nta bundi burwayi asanganwe ambwiye ko ari ntabwo. Mubwiye ko yihangana aribuze kumera neza, mushyizemo igipimo terimometere cy'ubushuhe musanzemo umuriro wa mirongo itatu n'umunani. Mukoreye tederi nsanze ari positif, muhaye sisi fuwa katire ibinini bine kabiri ku munsi mu minsi itatu. nabazaga niba harindi bufasha naha uyu mugabo.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Urakoze ku kazi keza, kuri uyu murwayi muhe na paracetamol yo kugabanya umuriro.
question_english: Hello, a 50-year-old man weighing 85 kilograms came to me complaining of severe cold and feeling very weak. When I asked how long he had been feeling this way, he told me it had been two days. I also inquired if he had any pre-existing conditions, and he said no. I reassured him that he would get better soon. Using a thermometer, I measured his temperature and found it to be 38°C. I conducted a rapid test for malaria, and it came out positive. I prescribed four tablets of Coartem twice a day for three days. I am asking if there is any other assistance I could provide for this man.

question_kinyarwanda: Umurwayi ufite imyaka makumyabiri n'itandatu ibiro mirongo itanu n'umunani. Ni umugore yagize ikibazo cyo kuribwa mu nda, akaba yari atwite. Mubajije uko yafashwe nsanga ari kuva. Mugira inama yo kunywa ji(juwise) ya beterave n'ibinyomoro. None ni iki namukorera ngo areke kuva?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Urakoze kuba wakiriye uyu mugore ufite ikibazo cyo kuva kandi aribwa no mu nda cyane bikabije, ukaba wamugiriye inama yo kunywa umutobe wa betarave, gusa ntibihagije cyane. Ni ngombwa ko abona ubuvuzi bwimbitse kugira ngo hamenyekane impamvu y'ikibazo gituma ava kdi akorerwe ibizamini byose bizasuzumwa na muganga wize ibyabagore (gynecologist).
question_english: A 26-year-old woman, weighing 58 kilograms, experienced abdominal pain and was pregnant. Upon inquiry, I found out she was bleeding. I advised her to drink beetroot and mulberry juice. What can I do to help stop the bleeding?

question_kinyarwanda: Umumama w'imyaka mirongo itatu n'itatu afite ibiro mirongo itaratu na kimwe, uburwayi afite yambwiye ko afite ikibazo cyo kubabara umutwe cyane aragira isereri, namubajije niba nta bundi burwayi asanganywe ambwira ko ntabwo uretse ko akoresha uburyo bwo kuboneza urubyaro,nongeye ndamubaza mubaza niba yarigeze yipimisha umuvuduko w'amaraso ambwira ko yawipimishije agasanga arawufite n’ubuhe bujanama nagira uwo mumama?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Ni byiza ko uwo mudamu yakubwiye ibimenyetso by'uburwayi afite kugira ngo ubashe kumufasha. Kubabara umutwe cyane, kugira isereri, hamwe n’umuvuduko w’amaraso uri hejuru bishobora kuba bigaragaza ikibazo cy’umuvuduko w’amaraso mwinshi (hypertension), kandi ibi bintu ni ibintu bigomba kwitabwaho vuba na muganga gusa. Inama yo ni ingenzi nk'uko usanzwe ubikora wakomeza gukurikirana umuvuduko. Gufata imiti neza, ikiganiro na muganga ni ihame akamusuzuma, muganga akaba yamufatira ibizamini byo murwego rwe. Uburyo bwo kuboneza urubyaro bukitonderwa, kuko akeshi umubyeyi urwaye hypertension ntabwo uburyo bwo kuboneza urbyaro abukoresha, keretse habayeho ko muganga ubifite mu nshingano yamugira inama. Mu by'ukuri ni ngombwa ko uwo mubyeyi agana abaganga agahabwa ubufasha n'inzobere zabyigiye.
question_english: A 33-year-old woman weighing 31 kilograms told me she has a severe headache and dizziness. I asked her if she has any other pre-existing conditions, and she told me no, except that she uses family planning methods. I further asked her if she had ever had her hypertension status checked, and she said she had, and it was there. What advice would you give to this woman?

question_kinyarwanda: Mwiriwe! Nakiriye umwana ufite imyaka ibiri n'ukwezi kumwe; n'ibiro ikenda na garama magana atanu; nyina ambwira ko amaze icyumweru ahitwa inshuro zirenze eshatu. Rero nabagishaga inama kugirango mumbwire icyo nakora. Murakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umwana ufite imyaka 2 nukwezi 1, ibiro 9.500g, amaze icyumweru ahitwa inshuro zirenze 3. Inama: Kumuha zinc, na ORS, nyuma ugahita umwohereza kwa muganga agakorerwa isuzumwa, nibizamini, nyuma agahabwa ubuvuzi bukwiriye bagendeye kucyo ibizamini ndetse ni suzuma rya muganga ryerekanye.
question_english: Good afternoon! I received a child who is two years and one month old; weighing nine kilograms and five hundred grams; the mother tells me that he has been having diarrhea more than three times a day for a week. So, I was seeking advice to tell me what to do. Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Umurwayi afite imyaka ine, ibiro icyenda na magana atanu, muwake cumi na rimwe na magana atanu, ni umuhungu. Yacitse intege akaba yari asanganywe burwayi bw'imirire mibi, ari guhitwa birebire by'amazi kane ku munsi none ngomba kumuha zenke na oweresi, none nayimuha ari mumirire mibi?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umuhungu w'imyaka 4 ufite ibiro 9.5, MUAC ya 11, afite umunaniro kandi yari asanzwe afite imirire mibi. Afite impiswi idakama imaze iminsi 4. Yego, ugomba kumuha ORS, nta mpamvu yo kutayimuha ku bana bafite imirire mibi. Ariko ku bijyanye na zinc, niba asanzwe afata ibiryo by'ubuvuzi, ushobora kubireka kuko ibiryo by'ubuvuzi bisanzwe bifite zinc ihagije, ariko niba atabifata ushobora kumuha. Ntugomba kumuha ORS vuba cyane kuko bishobora gutera kuruka, kandi niba umwana arutse, tegereza iminota 10 wongere utangire buhoro buhoro.
question_english: The patient is a four-year-old boy, weighing 9.5 kg, MUAC is 11. He is experiencing fatigue and was already suffering from malnutrition. He has been having persistent watery diarrhea, four times a day. I need to give him Zinc and ORS (Oral Rehydration Salts). Should I give it to him while he is still malnourished?

question_kinyarwanda: Umugore w'imyaka mirongo itatu n'icyenda ufite ibiro mirongo itandatu, atuye i Nganzo. Aje kwivuza ababara umutwe afite isereri amaze ibyumweru bibiri ari mu mihango yanze gukama, afite umuriro wa mirongo itatu n'umunani n'ibice bitanu. Tederi iba positifu asanganywe n'ubwandu bw'agakoko gatera sida afata n'imiti. None namuha imiti ya malariya kandi asanzwe afata iyubwandu bw'agakoko gatera sida?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze cyane. -Muhe sisi fuwa katere nk'uko bisanzwe nta kibazo k'umuntu urwaye na SIDA. -Mufashe abone n'imiti y'umuriro nka paracetamol. -Mwohereze kwa muganga barebe niba amaraso atari kumubana macye, kubera ko afite ibimenyetso mpuruza (isereri, kuva ibyumeru bibiri) -Mwigishe kurya neza, kunywa, kurwanya malaria.
question_english: A 39-year-old woman weighing sixty kilograms, residing in Nganzo, came for treatment complaining of headaches and dizziness. She has been experiencing prolonged menstruation for two weeks, with a fever of 38.5°C. Her rapid diagnostic test (RDT) for malaria was positive. She is also living with HIV and is on antiretroviral therapy. Should I administer malaria treatment while she is already on HIV medication?

question_kinyarwanda: Umugore w'imyaka mirongo itandatu ni'irindwi yaje aruka cyane, no kwituma cyane. Nimumfashe namukorera iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Muhe zinc ayinywe na ORS ashyire muri litiro y'amazi anywe, ubundi umwohereze ku kigo nderabuzima, bamufatire ibizamini barebe ikibazo afite.
question_english: A sixty-seven-year-old woman came vomiting a lot and having severe diarrhea. What can I do to help her?

question_kinyarwanda: Umugore w'imyaka mirongo itandatu, ibiro mirongo itandatu n'umunani, umuriro wa mirongo itatu n'agatandatu n'igice. Twagiranye ikiganiro ku ndwara y'igituntu arambaza ati "ese igituntu cyo mu bihaha bakivura amezi angahe kwa muganga"? Namusobanuriye ko igituntu bakivura amezi atandatu ahwanye n'iminsi ijana na mirongo itandatu n'umunani. Hari ikindi nari kongeraho?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugore ufite imyaka 60, ibiro 68, umuriro wa 36.5. Abanza iminsi bamara bavura igituntu cyo mu bihaha. Bamubwira ko kuvurwa amezi 6. Indi nama: 1. Kumubwira ko ubwo buvuzi bw'igituntu buba mu byiciro bibiri: * iciciro cya mbere kimara amezi 2 (amezi 2, batanga imiti 4:RHZE) -icyakabiri kimara amezi 4 (AFATA IMITI 2:RH ) 1. Kwita kumirire neza, kuko nibyo bituma umubiri ukomeza ugira imbaraga, agakira neza.
question_english: A sixty-year-old woman, weighing sixty-eight kilograms, with a temperature of thirty-six and a half degrees. We had a conversation about tuberculosis, and she asked me, "How many months does it take to treat pulmonary tuberculosis at the hospital?" I explained to her that tuberculosis is treated for six months, equivalent to one hundred and sixty-eight days. Was there anything else I should have added?

question_kinyarwanda: Umukobwa w'imyaka cumi n'icyenda mugezeho nsanga bamufashe ku ngufu. Mubwiye ko agomba kwihutira kujya kwa muganga. Ese hari ubundi bufasha namuha? Murakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Agomba gushyikirizwa abaganga vuba kugira ngo ahabwe ubufasha bw'ubuvuzi no gutanga ibimenyetso by'ibyabaye. Uretse gufasha mu rwego rw'ubuvuzi,aha abaganga bamufasha muburyo bwokuba atakwandura agakoko gatera SIDA mu masahaha 78 aho bazamuha imiti PREP.ndetse n'indi ituma atatwara inda zidateganyijwe.
question_english: A 19-year-old girl arrived, and I found that she had been sexually assaulted. I told her that she must go to the hospital immediately. Is there any other assistance I can provide her? Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Naganiriye n'ababyeyi be barambaza ngo ibiryo byahiye cyane ngo biba byatakaje vitamine zibonekamo? Ngo ariko ibiryo bitahiye cyane nk'imboga, ngo nibyo biba bifite vitamine zose. Mungire inama y'icyo nabasubiza.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Wababwira ko guhisha imboga cyane, bishobora kugabanya intungamubiri n'ibindi birimo vitamini.
question_english: I talked to his/her parents, and they asked me if overcooked food loses the vitamins it contains. But they said that food that is not overcooked, like vegetables, is what contains all the vitamins. Advise me on what to answer them.

question_kinyarwanda: Mwiriwe neza, umusore w'imyaka cumi n'umunani, agize ikibazo imbwa imuriye ku kaguru, mufashije koza aho imurumye dukoresheje amazi ndi kumusukira. None ni ubuhe bundi butabazi bw'ibanze twamuha? Murakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umusore wariwe n'imbwa 1.wakoze kumwogereza aho imbwa yamurumye 2.mwohereze ku bitaro kugirango atangire inkingo zirinda ibisazi byimbwa
question_english: Good evening, an eighteen-year-old boy has been bitten by a dog on the leg, I've helped him to clean the wound using water that I've poured on it. What other first aid can we provide him? Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Umugabo w'imyaka mirongo irindwi, ibiro mirongo itanu na bitandatu, yabyimbye ibirenge, abyimba amaguru, amaso n’inda,arahumagira, ahumeka nabi iyo aryamye adaseguye. Nta burwayi yari asanganywe,namugiriye inama yo kwihutira kujya kwa muganga ngo akorerwe isuzumwa bamenye ikibimutera arabyanga. Mungire inama y'icyo namukorera.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze kubaza iki kibazo cy'uyu mugabo w'imyaka mirongo irindwi ibiro mirongo itanu na bitandatu yabyimbye ibirenge abyimba amaguru amaso n'inda arahumagira ahumeka nabi iyo aryamye adaseguye, nta burwayi yari asanganywe wamugirariye inama yo kwihutira kujya kwa muganga ngo akorerwe isuzuma bamenye ikimutera arabyanga . Ukaba usaba inama y'icyo bamukorera . Nibyo koko uyu mugabo ufite ibi bimenyetso byo kubyimbagana ibice by'umubiri wose harimo ibirenge ,inda, amaso no guhumagira igihe aryamiye, biragaragara yuko muri we afitemo ubundi burwayi butazwi nk'indwara y,impyiko zangiritse,indwara y,umwijima wangiritse ,kuba afite indwara y'umutima n,umuvuduko w, amaraso nibindindetse n'izindi .  Uyu mugabo agomba kuganirizwa hakamenyekana icyabiteye hagendeye ku buzima yaba yarabayemo: -Niba yarakunze kunywa inzoga cyane -Niba yarakoresheje imiti y ibyatsi * Kuba hari imiti yo kwa muganga yakoresheje igihe kinini -Kuba afite ikibazo cy, imirire mibi. Inama twakugira ni ugufata umwanya ukaganiriza umuryango wose,ukabafasha kumva ikibazo uyu mugabo afite,Kandi ukababwira ko kwa muganga bamusuzuma bakamuha ubufasha bukwiye. Bahe taransiferi imujyana ku kigo Nderabuzima. Murakoze. Ibi byose ni ngombwa ko birebwaho, kugira ngo hamenyekane impamvu y,ikibazo afite.
question_english: A 70-year-old man weighing 56 kilograms has swollen feet, legs, eyes, and abdomen. He is also experiencing difficulty breathing, especially when lying flat. He had no prior known illnesses. I advised him to urgently go to the hospital for a proper diagnosis, but he transferred. Please advise me on what I can do for him.

question_kinyarwanda: Alice ni umwana w'umukobwa w'imyaka itatu, ahabwa inyunganiramirire ariko akagumya gutakaza ibiro. Afite inkorora n'umuriro amaranye ibyumweru bitatu kandi bamuhaye imiti y'inkorora ya Amox ariko inkorora yanga gukira. Nafashe TDR nsanga ni negatifu. Tumufashe gute?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze. Mwohereze kwa muganga byihuse bamufatire ibizamini anace mucyuma barebe uburwayi afite. Igisha umuryango indyo yuzuye, kwirinda umwanda, malaria n’izindi ndwara.
question_english: Alice is a 3-year-old girl who is receiving nutritional supplements but continues to lose weight. She has been coughing and running a fever for the past three weeks, and I gave amoxicillin for the cough, but it doesn’t seem to improve. I performed a rapid diagnostic test, and it resulted negative. How can I help her?

question_kinyarwanda: Umugore w'imyaka mirongo itandatu n'ibiri n’ibiro mirongo irindwi aje angana, ababara amaguru, hariho ubuheri, yishimagura cyane, muha taransiferi (transfeur). Hari ubundi bufasha namuha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Tubashimira ubwitange mugira mukwita kubarwayi. Mwakoze kwakira uyu mugore w'imyaka mirongo itandatu n'ibiri, mirongo irindwi urimo kubabara amagaru, ufite uduheri, uri no kwishimagura cyane.  Ikintu wafasha uyu mugore mubaze niba ntabindi bimenyetso afite nk'umuriro, kubabara umutwe, gucika intege no kubabara mungingo. Usanze afite umuriro mwinshi wamupima malaria ukoresheje tederi yaba positive ukamuha imiti ya malaria. Ikindi umugire inama yo kugira isuku kuko indwarz'uruhu nyinshi ziterwa n'umwanda.  Umwandikire urupapuro rumwohereza kukigonderabuzima (transfer) bamufashe byisumbuyeho. Mwibuke gukomeza gukurikirana uyu murwayi na nyuma yo kuva kwamuganga.
question_english: A 62-year-old woman weighing 70 kilograms came in complaining of leg pain. She has a rash and is itching a lot. I gave her a transfer. Is there any other assistance I can provide her?

question_kinyarwanda: Nasuye umugore w'imyaka makumyabiri n’ibiri ufite ibiro mirongo itanu n’umunani, namusuye ku munsi wa gatatu yabyaye, mwigisha ibimenyetso mpuruza. Mubajije ko ari kuva ambwira ko ari kuva, mubajije inshuro ahinduye mu isaha ambwira ko ahinduye ibyo yibinze inshuro eshatu mw’isaha. Mubwiye kujya kwa muganga aranga ngo batamukora mu nda. Mungire inama icyo nakora.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Nasuye umugore w’imyaka makumyabiri n’ibiri upima ibiro mirongo itanu n’umunani, namusuye ku munsi wa gatatu nyuma yo kubyara, mwigisha ibimenyetso by’amakenga. Namubajije niba ari kuva amaraso, ambwira ko ari kuva amaraso, namubajije inshuro yahinduye mu isaha imwe, ambwira ko yahinduye udupamba inshuro eshatu mu isaha imwe. Namubwiye kujya kwa muganga, ariko aranga, avuga ko atifuza ko bamubaga. Mungire inama y'icyo nakora. Bitewe n'uko ahindura udupamba kenshi, umurwayi afite ikibazo cyo kuva amaraso menshi nyuma yo kubyara, ari nacyo kibazo cyihutirwa, gishobora gutera gutakaza amaraso menshi, guhungabana kubera kubura amaraso, ndetse n’urupfu. Mwigishe ko kubagwa atari bwo buryo bwonyine bwo kuvura umugore uva amaraso nyuma yo kubyara. Mumushishikarize kunywa amazi menshi kugira ngo akomeze kugira amazi ahagije mu mubiri, hanyuma mumwigishe ko niba atagiye kwa muganga, ashobora no gupfa ava amaraso. Hanyuma mumwohereze kwa muganga kugira ngo hakorwe isuzuma n’ubuvuzi bukwiye.
question_english: I visited a twenty-two-year-old woman weighing fifty-eight kilograms, I visited her on the third day after she gave birth, teaching her warning signs. I asked her if she was bleeding, she told me she was bleeding, I asked her how many times she changed in an hour, she told me she changed her pads three times in an hour. I told her to go to the hospital, but she refused, saying she didn’t want them to operate on her. Advise me on what to do.

question_kinyarwanda: Nasuye umugore utwite afite imyaka mirongo itatu n'ibiri afite ibiro mirongo irindwi n'umunani. Mwigisha ibimenyetso mpuruza mubwira ko agomba kwitwara nk'umugore utwite, agomba no kurya indyo yuzuye igizwe n'ibiririnda irwara: imboga, imbuto; ibitera imbaraga: ibijumba, amateke, ibirayi, ibyubaka umubiri: amagi, inyama, amata. Mubwira ko agomba kuruhuka bihagije mubwira agomba kurara mu nzitiramubu ikoranye umuti buri joro. Ambwira ko inzitiramubu ituma adahumeka neza kandi ko imubabura. Mungire inama y'icyo nakora.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugore w'imyaka 32 utwite afite ibiro 78 umwigisha ibimufasha kugira ubuzima bwiza nk'umubyeyi utwite umwigisha ibimenyetso mpuruza igihe atwite, ariko umubwiye ko agomba kurara mu nzitira mibu aranga ngo iramubabura kandi ngo ntahumeke neza. Icyo wakora, wamwigisha uko inzitiramibu ikoreshwa kuva ayifashe kugeza ayiryamyemo, ko abanza akayanika kugira ngo ubukana bw'umuti bugabanuke ko aho itazamubabura, ikindi ni uko wamwigisha cyane ko itamubuza umwuka ko aribyo aba yishyizemo umwuka uba uri inyuma y'inzitiramibu, nturi imbere, biba bingana. Mwigishe cyane ko malariya arimbi ku mugore utwite ishobora kumugiraho ingaruka zikurikira (kuvamo kw'inda, kubyara umwana udashyitse, kubura amaraso, urupfu) kandi ko imibu iyitera irumana mu ijoro abantu baryamye, inzitiramibu ni ingenzi mu kwirinda malariya.
question_english: I visited a thirty-two-year-old pregnant woman, weighing 78 kilograms. I educated her about the warning symptoms of pregnancy and advised her to practice a proper self-care as a pregnant woman. I recommended a healthy diet consisting of protective foods such as vegetables and fruits; energy-giving foods like sweet potatoes, cocoyams, and potatoes; and bodybuilding foods including eggs, meat, and milk. I also advised her to get adequate rest and to sleep under a mosquito net every night. However, she stated that the mosquito net makes it difficult for her to breathe and causes skin irritation. I seek advice on what I should do.

question_kinyarwanda: Umukobwa w'imyaka cumi n'itandatu; yaje angana ambwira ko afite ikibazo cyo kujya mu mihango ikamurya; mubaza niba nta bundi burwayi yaba afite ambwira ko ari ntabwo. Mugira inama yo kunywa amazi kenshi kandi akarya indyo yuzuye kandi akajya kwa muganga kugira ngo bamusuzume barebe impamvu; arabinyemerera; avuyeyo abwira ko byakomeje kumurya. Inama namugira iyihe? Murakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umukobwa w'imyaka cumi n'itandatu yagaragaje ikibazo cyo kugira imihango irimo ububabare, ajya kwa muganga ariko aracyababara. Uyu murwayi afite dysmenorrhea ishobora kuba ikibazo gisanzwe cy’imikorere y’umubiri cyangwa ikaba iterwa n’ibindi bibazo byihishe nk’endometriosis... Ugomba kumusobanurira ko dysmenorrhea isanzwe mu bakobwa kandi ishobora kuba igikorwa gisanzwe cy’umubiri, ariko ko niba ububabare bukabije cyane ku buryo butuma adashobora gukora ibikorwa bye bisanzwe, agomba gusubira kwa muganga. Kwa muganga bazakora isuzuma ryimbitse no kuvura bitewe n'ibizavumburwa mu isuzuma. Niba ari ikibazo cy’imikorere isanzwe y’umubiri, bazamuha ihumure kandi bamuhe imiti igabanya ububabare yo gufata mbere y’imihango. Niba ari ikibazo cy’uburwayi, ubwo burwayi buzavurwa hakurikijwe uko bimeze.
question_english: A sixteen-year-old girl came to me saying she has a problem with her periods being painful. When I asked if she has any other health issues, she said she does not. I advised her to drink plenty of water, eat a balanced diet, and go to the hospital for an examination to find out the cause; she agreed to this. When she returned, she told me that the pain continued. What advice should I give her? Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'umuhungu ufite imyaka itandatu, afite ibiro makumyabiri na bibiri, arababara umutwe, afite umuriro degere mirongo itatu n'icyenda. Abimaranye iminsi ibiri nta bundi burwayi asanzwe afite. Mufatiye tederi iba positifu. None ndamuha iyihe ngano y'umuti?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umuhungu w'imyaka itandatu, upima ibiro makumyabiri na bibiri, arwaye umutwe n'umuriro wa dogere mirongo itatu n'icyenda. Abimaranye iminsi ibiri nta bundi burwayi afite. Ikizamini cyihuse cyerekanye ko arwaye. Iyi ni malariya yoroshye. Dose iterwa n'ibiro. Ubundi batanga ibinini bine kabiri ku munsi mu minsi itatu. Bisobanura ko ari ibinini bibiri mu gitondo, hanyuma ibinini bibiri nimugoroba.
question_english: A six-year-old boy, weighing twenty-two kilograms, is suffering from a headache and a fever of thirty-nine degrees. He has had it for two days with no other underlying conditions. The rapid test is positive. So, what dosage of medication should I give him?

question_kinyarwanda: Mwiriwe, nakiriye umwana w'umukobwa afite imyaka itatu, afite ibiro cumi na bine. Umubyeyi we ambwiye ko ari kwituma inshuro eshatu kugeza kuri enye ku munsi; birebire kandi by’amazi, ambwira ko ari kugira umuriro ndetse akanga no kurya. Igipimo cy'umuriro kingaragarije ko afite mirongo itatu na karindwi nibice bitanu, muwake nsanze Ari cumi na Kane. Mubajije igihe amaze arwaye ambwira ko amaze ibyumweru bibiri. Muhaye transferi. Nabazaga niba ntakindi namukorera kisumbuye.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze kwakira uwo mwana -kumuha taransiferi ni byo nagende bamupime banamuvure -Igisha uwo muryango kukwirinda indwara zimirire mibi,umwanda no kudategura ifunguro neza nisuku -Bigishe indyo yuzuye -Bibutse gufasha umwana kubona ikinini k'inzoka cya buri mezi 3 -Bigishe kwirinda n'izindi ndwara
question_english: Good afternoon, I received a 3-year-old girl weighing 14 kilograms. Her parent told me she has been having diarrhea 3 to 4 times a day; it’s watery and prolonged. They also mentioned she has a fever and refuses to eat. The temperature reading showed 37.5°C, and her mid-upper arm circumference (MUAC) was 14 cm. When I asked how long she has been sick, the parent said two weeks. I gave her a referral. I was wondering if there is anything else I can do for her.

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'umuhungu afite imyaka ine, afite ibiro cumi na bitandatu. Ntiyumva. Kwa muganga bamuha imiti ntibirakira. Ni iki nakora kugirango ngo mufashe mbere yo kumwohereza?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umuhungu w'imyaka ine upima ibiro cumi na bitandatu ntashobora kumva. Kwa muganga, bahawe imiti, ariko nta mpinduka zabayeho. Nakora iki ngo mufashe, mbere yo kumwohereza?
question_english: A four-year-old boy weighing sixteen kilograms cannot hear. At the hospital, he was given medications, but there has been no improvement. What can I do to help him, before transferring him?

question_kinyarwanda: Umuhungu w'imyaka cumi n'irindwi afite ibiro mirongo ine na bitandatu afite umuriro wa mirongo itatu n' numunani arimo gukorora inkorora ayimaranye igihe kirekire. Mufatiye tederi(TDR) iba positif, mubajije ubuzima busanzwe avuga ko arwaye indwara y'igituntu kandi ko afata imiti. Mbasabye ubufasha ubu mukorere iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Muvure umuhe imiti ya maralia, ubundi akomeze niyo y'igituntu, kandi umubwire arye indyo yuzuye afate nibyo kunywa byinshi kugira ngo imiti itamuca intege, kandi ajye aruhuka neza, yambare agapfukamunwa atanduza abandi, kandi nabo babana bose bazajye kwipimisha. Ikindi niba bafite umwana muto babana bamwihutane kwa muganga bamuhe ubundi bufasha.
question_english: A seventeen-year-old boy weighing forty-six kilograms has a fever of thirty-eight degrees and has been coughing for a long time. A rapid diagnostic test (RDT) is positive, and when asked about his general health, he says he has tuberculosis and is on medication. I am asking for help, what should I do for her now?

question_kinyarwanda: Nasuye umwana w'umuhungu afite amezi arindwi, afite ibiro birindwi, ageza igihe cyo gufata imfashabere. Umubyeyi we musobanurira uburyo bwo kumugaburira, musobanurira indyo yuzuye, ambwira ko amuha: amagi, ibirayi,n'ibijumba. Mubwira ko agomba kongeramo imboga n'imbuto. Ambwira ko atazibona. Niki nakora?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Uyu ni umwana w’umuhungu w’amezi arindwi watangiye kurya ibiryo byiyongera ku mashereka. Nyina yajyaga kumuha amagi, ibirayi, n'ibijumba. Uyu mwana akwiye guhabwa imboga, imbuto, n'igikoma. Gira inama nyina ko aho kuvuga ko atabona imboga n’imbuto, yagurisha igi akagura imboga n’imbuto kugira ngo umwana we abone indyo yuzuye.
question_english: I visited a seven-month-old baby boy, weighing seven kilograms, who has reached the age to start complementary feeding. I explained to his parent how to feed him, explained a balanced diet, and the parent told me that she gives him eggs, potatoes, and sweet potatoes. I told her that she needs to add vegetables and fruits. She told me that she cannot find them. What can I do?

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'umukobwa ufite ibiro mirongo itatu, akagira imyaka cumi n'ine, yaje afite umuriro mpita mufatira tederi(TDR). Nkoresheje thermometre, nsanga afite umuriro wa mirongo itatu n'icyenda tederi(TDR) iba positifu (positif). Njyiye kumuha sisi fuwa katere (six fois quatre), mubajije ubundi burwayi asanganywe ,ambwira ko afite ikibazo cya HIV. N‘iki nakora? Murakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Malaria nziza, umuriro n’ubwandu bwa VIH buzwi. Tangira coartem 6\*4 ako kanya, kuko nta mpamvu ntakuka, zo kubuza coartem ku barwayi ba VIH. Shishikariza kunywa amazi n’ibiryo, niba ufite paracetamol, tanga 450 mg tds mu kanwa, kugira ngo ugabanye umuriro. Hanyuma ukurikiranire hafi, kandi ukomeze gutanga imiti ya antiretroviral.
question_english: A 14-year-old girl weighing 30 kg came in with a fever. I took her temperature using a thermometer and found it to be 39°C. I performed a TDR test, which resulted positive. I was about to give her 6*4 of Coartem (six fois quatre), but when I asked if she had any other conditions, she mentioned she is living with HIV. What should I do? Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Nasuye umuryango ufite abana batatu, babiri ari abahungu undi ari umukobwa, nsanga barabavangura. Abahungu babaha ibyo bakeneye byose, umukobwa ntahabwe ibyo akeneye. Mbagira inama yo gufata abana bose kimwe. Nabazaga niba hari ubundi bufasha nari kubaha.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umuryango ufite abana 3, abahungu 2, umukobwa umwe, barabavangura ndetse abahungu bo bagahabwa ibyo bakeneye byose. Ariko umukobwa we ntahabwe ibyo ashaka. Inama wabagiriye niyo, ikindi bagomba kumenya nuko uyu mwana bashobora kumutera agahinda, bikamugiraho ingaruka mbi cyane, aba babyeyi bagomba kuganirizwa cyane ndetse bagahuzwa n'umuganga wisanamitima akabasha kubakurikirana.
question_english: I've visited a family with three children, two boys and one girl, and I've found that they've been being treated unequally. The boys have been given everything they need, while the girl has not been given what she needs. I've advised them to treat all the children equally. I'm asking if there is any other help I could offer them.

question_kinyarwanda: Umukobwa imyaka cumi n'itanu afite mirongo itanu na bine yaje ambwira ko amaze iminsi irindwi mu mihango, kandi aba muri gahunda yo kuboneza urubyaro akoresheje ibinini by'imisemburo ibiri. yagiye kwa muganga bamuha imiti ituma iyo mihango ihagarara ,ariko ntihagarara. Twamufasha gute?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Mwarakoze kwakira uwo mukobwa IBYO TWAMUFASHA: -Nukumufasha agasubira kwa muganga -Ibyo binini nabe abihagaritse tubanze turebe ko ataribyo biri kumutera ibyo bibazo -Ese ni ubwambere babikoresheje? Niba atari ubwa mbere ibyo byo kuva ubwambere byabayeho? -Turaza no kumupima amaraso turebe ko atagabanutse kuburyo ari ngombwa ko twamwongerera. -Dukwiye kumwigisha ubundi buryo bwo kuboneza urubyaro.
question_english: A fifteen-year-old girl, weighing fifty-four kilograms, came to me saying that she has been menstruating for seven days. She uses combined hormonal pills contraceptive method. She went to the hospital, where they gave her medication to stop the bleeding, but it hasn't stopped. How can we help her?

question_kinyarwanda: Mwiriwe neza uumukobwa w'imyaka mirongo itatu n'itatu yarwaye mu mutwe afata imiti none abamutunze bavuga ko atajya arya ngo abe yabona ibimuhaza. Ese koko byaba ari ingaruka y'imiti afata?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Mwiriwe! Umukobwa w'imyaka 33 ufite ubumuga bwo mu mutwe ari gufata imiti. Abamurera bavuga ko afite irari ry'ibiryo ryinshi, bigatuma bigorana guhaza ibyo akeneye mu mirire. Ese ibi bishobora kuba ingaruka zituruka ku miti ari gufata? Igisubizo:  R/ Yego rwose, kuko nk'uko byanditswe mu nyandiko, imiti ya psychotropic ihungabanya ibimenyetso byayo ikaba yateza ihungabana ry'uburyo bwo kumva ishyira n'uburyo bwo kumva uhaze, bivuze ko itera irari ry'ibiryo rikiyongera kandi ikagabanya ikoreshwa ry'ingufu, bityo bigatera kwiyongera kw'ibiro.
question_english: Good evening! A 33-year-old girl with mental disability is on medication. Her caregivers report that she has an excessive appetite, make it challenging to meet her nutritional needs. Could this be the side effects of the medication she is taking?

question_kinyarwanda: Muraho? nakiriye umugabo w'imyaka mirongo ine n'ibiro mirongo itanu na bitanu ibipimo by'umuriro ni mirongo ine, yambwiye ko afite igituntu, namubajije iminsi amaze abimenye, yambwiye iminsi icumi. Nabazaga uyu mugabo mukorere iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Mufatire tederi, hanyuma urebe niba nta malariya afite. Hanyuma nusangage ntayo afite, arakomeza imiti y'igituntu, ahubwo ukurikirane niba ayinywa neza. Hanyuma usanze ari positifu, wamuha imiti ya malariya.
question_english: Hello? I received a man of forty and fifty-five pounds, the temperature is forty, he told me that he had tuberculosis, and when I asked how long he has known, he said 10 days. Now I am asking, what can l do for him?

question_kinyarwanda: Umugore w'imyaka mirongo ine n'itanu, afite ibiro mirongo inani, arababara amabere, yakama hakavamo rimwe na rimwe ibintu bimeze nk'amashereka, abimaranye amezi atandatu kandi amaze imyaka irindwi abyaye. Yagiye ku kigo nderabuzima bamwandikira imiti igabanya ububabare arayikoresha ariko kugeza uyu munsi aracyababara amabere kandi cyane. Mbese namuha iyihe nama kugira ngo abone ubuvuzi bwisumbuyeho?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Wamuha inama yo kujya ku kigo nderabuzima kugira ngo bongere bamusuzume, kandi bamuhuze n'umukozi ushinzwe gusuzuma no gukurikirana abafite ibibazo bya canseri y'amabere ndetse na kanseri y'inkondo y'umura. Bityo uwo mukozi yamurebera ikibazo afite ndetse akamufasha kugera ku bitaro kugira ngo bamufashe.
question_english: A 45-year-old woman, weighing 80 kg, has been experiencing breast pain for the past six months. Occasionally, a milk-like discharge comes out. She gave birth seven years ago. She visited a health center where she was prescribed pain-relief medication, which she used, but the breast pain persists and has worsened. What advice can I give her to ensure she receives more advanced medical care?

question_kinyarwanda: Mwiriwe ndi umujyanama w'ubuzima, mfite imyaka mirongo ine n'irindwi aho ntuye abantu benshi bakunda gukoresha amakara. Twagira ngo dusobanuze muganga akamaro k'amakara ku mubiri w'umuntu n'urugero rwiza uyakoresha yakoresha.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: • Noneho, gukoresha amakara y'ibanze bifata uburozi bwinshi mu gifu kandi bigabanya kwinjira kwabwo ariko si uburozi bwose. Uburozi butagomba gukoresha amakara ni nk'ibyotsa n'ibikomoka kuri peteroli, ibyuma nka fer, lithium, n'ibindi. Kandi uko bifatwa vuba ni ko bigira ingaruka nziza, ariko bishobora gukora neza kugeza ku masaha 2 nyuma yo kwandura uburozi. • Dose y'abakuze; garama 50 (ibinini 200 bya 250 mg) byasizwe bikavangwa n'amililitiro 100-200 z'amazi. • Dose y'abana; 0.5-1g/kg.
question_english: Good afternoon, I am a community health worker. I am 47 years old. Where I live, many people like to use charcoal. We would like to ask the doctor for clarification on the benefits of charcoal for the human body and the appropriate amount for someone to use.

question_kinyarwanda: Mwaramutse ngeze ngeze mwisoko umuntu aba aguye hasi abantu bamushungeye mbabwira ko bamuvaho kugira abone akuka mubajije imyaka ye ambwira ko afite imyaka mirongo itatu nitanu, mubajije nimba ntayindi miti yo asanzwe afata ambwira ko asanzwe afata imiti y'igicuri, none umurwayi namufasha iki? Murakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Mwaramutseho! Umuntu aguye hasi kandi asanzwe afite uburwayi, cyane cyane indwara zifata ubwonko nk'igicuri, ni ngombwa kumufasha byihuse no kumwitaho. No kumushyikiriza inzobere. Ukareba niba ntabundi burwayi afite gusa umufashe cyane umushyikiriza abaganga bakomeze bamuhe ubufasha.
question_english: Good morning, I've arrived at the market and someone has fallen down, people have surrounded him and I've told them to move away so that he could breathe. I've asked him his age, and he's told me he is thirty-five years old. I've asked if he has been taking any other medication, and he's told me he is on epilepsy medication. So, how can I help the patient? Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Muraho, umubyeyi anzaniye umwana w'umukobwa w'imyaka cumi n'itandatu, ibiro mirongo itatu na bitandatu, ambwira ko afite umuriro, ari kubabara mu nda. Mushyizemo igipimo (thermometre), musangamo umuriro wa mirongo itatu n’icyenda. Mukorera (TDR), musanzemo malariya. Mubajije niba nta bundi burwayi asanganywe, ambwira ko ari ntabwo. Mubwiye ko yihangana ari bumere neza. Muhaye sisi fuwa katere(six fois quatre). Nabazaga nti: "Hari ubundi bufasha naha uyu mwana?"
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umurwayi w'umukobwa w'imyaka 16 ufite ibiro 36 yaje afite umuriro wa 39, ububabare mu nda, kandi tederi yerekanye ko afite malariya, ahabwa kowaritemu n'umujyanama w'ubuzima. Uyu murwayi afite malariya kuko tederi yerekanye ko ari positive. Hita uvura malariya ukoresheje kowaritemu, ibinini 4 inshuro ebyiri ku munsi mu minsi itatu ikurikiranye. Gukemura umuriro n'ububabare ukoresheje imiti nka parasetamoro. Mushishikarize kunywa amazi menshi. Mugire inama yo kuruhuka bihagije. Mugire inama yo kuryama mu nzitiramibu. Mugire inama yo gufunga amadirishya n'inzugi kare nimugoroba. Niba hagaragaye ibimenyetso bya malaria ikomeye cyangwa ibimenyetso byo mu nda nko kuruka, ohereza umurwayi kwa muganga ngo ahabwe aritezinae inyuzwa mu rushinge.
question_english: Hello, a parent brought me a 16-year-old girl weighing 36 kilograms, reporting that she has a fever and abdominal pain. I used a thermometer and found her temperature was 39°C. I conducted a rapid diagnostic test (RDT), which confirmed malaria. When I asked if she had any other illnesses, the parent said no. I reassured her that she would feel better soon and gave her sic times four (six fois quatre) as treatment. I wanted to ask: "Is there any additional support I can provide for this child?"

question_kinyarwanda: Umurwayi wo mumudugudu wa gahodo w'umugabo afite imyaka mirongo itanu n'itandatu, agapima ibiro mirongo itandatu na bibiri. Yaje ababara umutwe, umugongo, ndetse n'ingingo zose, mufatiye umuriro agira mirongo itatu n' umunani n'ibice bitanu, mfashe tederi agira positifu, ambwira ko abana n'agakoko gatera sida, kandi mfite sisi fuwa katere. Muhaye taransiferi. Mumfashe nari kumuha imiti kandi abana n'agakoko gatera sida?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Ni byiza ko wakiriye uwo mubyeyi akaba yarafite umuriro wa 38.6, ababara umutwe, umugongo hamwe n'ingingo zose kandi ukamufasha mubumenyi bwawe aho wasanze mubipimo wamufatiye tdr ugasanga ni positive nibyizako waribumuhe umuti wa malariya 6×4 nk'uko uzifite rero kuba ari kuri regime ya ARVS ntibikuraho ko atafata imiti ya malariya kuko kuba afata imiti y'ubwandu ntaho byabangama mugufata imiti ya malariya rero mugihe ibyobyose utari kubishyikira neza ningombwa kugana muganga kugirango akomeze kumwitaho.
question_english: A 56-year-old man from Gahodo village, weighing 62 kg, came in complaining of headaches, back pain, and joint pain. I measured his temperature, which was 38.5°C. I performed a malaria test (RDT), and it resulted positive. He informed me that he is living with HIV. I have issued a transfer. Should I provide him with medication considering he is living with HIV?

question_kinyarwanda: Nasuye uyu muryango urimo umugabo w'imyaka mirongo itatu n'umwe n'umugore w'imyaka makumyabiri n'umunani, nsanga bafite ubwandu bw'agakoko gatera sida, nsanga barigunze barihebye, mbagira inama yo kujya mu matsinda ahuza abafite virusi itera sida kugira ngo babone uko bazajya baganira na bagenzi babo bisanzuye. Nibazaga niba hari ubundi bufasha nari kubafasha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Wari kubaha inama yo kujya no ku kigonderabuzima bakaganirizwa nushinzwe ubujyanama kubantu bafite virusi itera sida.
question_english: I visited a family consisting of a 31-year-old man and a 28-year-old woman, both diagnosed with HIV. I found them withdrawn and hopeless. I advised them to join support groups for people living with HIV so they can freely share and interact with others in similar situations. I am wondering if there is any other support I could have provided them?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umubyeyi azanye umwana w'umukobwa w'imyaka itanu, afite ibiro cumi na bitandatu afite umuriro mwinshi, kuruka ibyo ariye byose, umutwe, nta bundi burwayi asanganywe. Namuhaye transiferi kuko ntacyo abasha gushyira mu nda kugira bamufatire ibizami barebe. Ese hari ubundi bufasha yahabwa.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umukobwa w’imyaka 5 ufite ibiro 16 yaje afite umuriro mwinshi, atera hejuru buri kintu cyose, afite umutwe ukabije kandi nta zindi ndwara asanzwe afite. **Wakoze neza kumwohereza byihutirwa ku bitaro**, kuko bishoboka ko azagira ikibazo cyo kubura imyunyungugu mu mubiri (electrolyte imbalance) no kuma cyane (severe dehydration). Akeneye **serumu (IV fluids)** ndetse n’imiti igabanya kuruka (**anti-emetics**) kugira ngo abanze agire agahenge, hanyuma hakorwe ibindi bizamini n’ubuvuzi bukwiye.
question_english: I've received a parent who has come with a five-year-old girl, weighing sixteen kilograms, with a high fever, vomiting everything she eats, headache, and no other pre-existing conditions. I've given her a referral because she cannot keep anything in her stomach so they can take tests to check. Is there any other assistance she can be given?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umugore w'imyaka mirongo itatu n'itanu, yaje arwaye ahinda umuriro yaje akorora ndetse ababara mugingo. Namubajije iminsi amaze afashwe ambwira ko amaze iminsi ibiri, yumva nta ntege afite ambwira ko amaze ibyumweru bibiri akorora, ambwira ko amaze iminsi itatu yumva umutwe umurya,namufatiye ikizamini cy'umuriro agira mirongo itatu n'umunani. Mufatiye tederi mpimye amaraso tederi igaragaza ko ari negatifu malariya, namugiriye inama yo kujya kwa muganga muganiriza kunkorora ye imaze ibyumweru bibiri mubwira ko ishobora kuvamo inkora y'igikatu cyangwa ikamuviramo y'igituntu. Mugira inama yo kwihutira kujya kwa muganga arabyemera nibazaga niba nta bundi bufasha namuha murakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Muhe paracetamol, umubwire kwirinda kwegerana n’abandi bantu, kandi ajye kwa muganga vuba bishoboka.
question_english: I received a 35-year-old woman who came in with a fever, cough, and body pain. When I asked her how long she had been feeling unwell, she told me she had been sick for two days and felt weak. She also mentioned that she had been coughing for two weeks and had been experiencing headaches for the past three days. I measured her temperature, which was 38°C. I performed a rapid malaria test, which came back negative. I advised her to go to the hospital and explained that her prolonged cough could develop into severe tuberculosis. She agreed to seek medical attention. I was wondering if there is any other support I could provide. Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Umusore w'imyaka mirongo itatu ngo ahora yumva umutima we utera vuba vuba kandi buri gihe, namugiriye inama yo kugana muganga ushinzwe ubuzima bwo mu mutwe kugirango agire icyo amufasha kuko icyo cyaba ari kimwe mu bimenyetso by'indwara y'umuhangayiko, ati ''oya ni ibyo mu muryango''. Yafashwa iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Uyu mugabo w'imyaka 30 avuga ko ahora yumva afite umutima utera cyane. Uyu mugabo ashobora kuba afite ikibazo cy'ihungabana ariko kandi agomba gusuzumwa niba adafite indwara z’umutima. Gahunda * Komeza kumugira inama kandi ugerageze kumwumvisha ko agomba kujya ku kigo nderabuzima, aho bashobora kumufasha kubona inzobere mu buzima bwo mu mutwe. * Naramuka akomeje kwanga, umubwire ko bishobora kuba ari indwara y’umutima bityo agomba kujya ku kigo nderabuzima aho bashobora kumupima ibimenyetso by'ingenzi bakamenya uko bamufasha neza, kuko ashobora no koherezwa ku bitaro aho bashobora kumukorera isuzuma ry’umutima (ultrasound) na ECG kugira ngo bamenye niba nta ndwara z’umutima afite.
question_english: A 30-year-old man says he constantly feels his heart racing. I advised him to see a mental health specialist to help as it could be a symptom of anxiety, but he responded, "No, it is heredity." How can he be helped?

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'imyaka icumi w'umukobwa, afite ubumuga bw'ingingo zose. Abagize umuryango we baramukingirana. Mbaganiriza kenshi mbabwira ko bamubuza uburenganzira bakananira. None, twafasha iki uwo mwana?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umukobwa w'imyaka 10 ufite ubumuga bwagize ingaruka ku ngingo ze zose afungirwa n'abagize umuryango we. • Noneho, wakoze neza kubabwira ku burenganzira bw'umwana wabo, ugomba no kongeraho ko niba bamwitayeho kandi bakamuha ibyangombwa by'ibanze byose, na we ashobora kubabera ingenzi ndetse akibera ingenzi ubwe.
question_english: A ten-year-old girl with a disability affecting all her limbs. is locked up by her family members. I often talk to them, telling them that they are denying her rights, but they refuse to listen. So, how can we help this child?

question_kinyarwanda: Nasuye umugore wimyaka makumya nibiri , afite ibiro mirongo itanu na bitanu. Turaganira ambwira ko aribwa mu nda hasi umukondo. Mubaza igihe aherukira mu mihango , ambwira ko hashize amezi atatu atayibona. Nzana igipimisho cyinkari ndamupima nsanga atwite , mushishikariza kujya kwipimisha ngiye kumwandikira transifer arambwira ngo nimbe ndetse ngo azajyayo hashize amezi atanu ajyayo inshuro nkeya kuko ku ivuriro ari kure ngo ntamafaranga. Mungire inama.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze kubaza ikibazo cy'umugore wasuye w'imyaka makumyabiri n'ibiri ufite ibiro mirongo itanu na bitanu mukaganira akakubwira ko aribwa mu nda yo hasi mu mukondo umubajije igihe aherukira imihango akubwira ko amaze amezi atatu atayibona ukoresheje igipimisho cy'inkari usanga aratwite umushishikariza kujya gupimisha inda kwa muganga ariko akubwira ko azajyayo hashize amezi atanu ngo kuko kwa muganga ari kure we ajyayo inshuro nkeya. Wakoze cyane gusuzuma uyu mubyeyi ukamenya ko atwite ukamugira n'inama n'ubwo we ashaka kujyayo hashize amezi atanu uyu mubyeyi musobanurire neza impamvu yo kujya kwa muganga gupimisha inda hakiri kare. Ubundi gupimisha inda bijyana n'amezi inda ifite kugira ngo umudamu apimishe inda bwa mbere bisaba byibuze kujya kwa muganga mbere y'amezi atatu iyo hashize amezi arenga atatu akajyayo aba yararengeje igihe kandi iyo umudamu apimishije inda ku gihe ni byiza kuko bituma umudamu hari ibyo ahabwa bimufasha bigafasha n'umwana atwite kandi akabibona hakiri kare harimo nk'ibinini bya feri bimwongerera amaraso ndetse no kumenya neza ubuzima bw'umwana hakiri kare Uyu mudamu rero mushishikarize ajye gupimisha inda ni byo byiza.
question_english: I visited a 32-year-old woman weighing 55 kilograms. During our conversation, she mentioned experiencing lower abdominal pain near her navel. When I asked about her last menstrual period, she said it had been three months since her last period. I conducted a urine test and found that she was pregnant. I encouraged her to go for a medical check-up and was about to write a transfer note, but she asked me to wait, saying she would go after five months and only occasionally because the clinic is far and she doesn't have the money. Please advise on what I should do.

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umubyeyi ufite imyaka mirongo itatu n'irindwi avuga ko amaze iminsi itandatu ari mu mihango idashira kandi ava cyane. Asanzwe akoresha uburyo bwo kuboneza urubyaro rw'agapira ko mu kuboko kimyaka itanu; akaba yari amaze igihe cy'umwaka atabona imihango; kandi avuga ko agira n'isereri. Mufatiye ikizamini cy'inkari nsanga adatwite; mugira inama yo kujya ku ivuriro. Ndabaza ese n'ubuhe bufasha uwo mubyeyi yahabwa?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Uyumubyeyi ufite imyaka mirongo itatu n'irindwi avuga ko amaze iminsi itandatu ari mu mihango idashira kandi ava cyane. Asanzwe akoresha uburyo bwo kuboneza urubyaro rw'agapira mukuboko. Banza umusobanurire bimwe mungaruka zo kuboneza ko rimwe narimwe habaho ubwivumbagatane bwimisemburo akaba yava Ikindi kuko ava kandi adatwite. Wamwohereza kukigo nderabuzima bakaba bamuhindurira uburyo
question_english: I received a thirty-seven-year-old parent who said she has been experiencing continuous menstruation for six days with heavy bleeding. She has been using a five-year implant contraceptive method and had not had her period for a year. She also mentioned experiencing dizziness. I conducted a urine test and found that she is not pregnant; I advised her to go to the clinic. I ask, what kind of help can be given to this parent?

question_kinyarwanda: Muraho, nakiriye umwana w'umuhungu ufite amezi makumyabiri n'abiri, ufite ibiro cumi na bitatu, ibipimo by'umuriro ni mirongo itatu n'icyenda na mirongo ine. Ari kuruka, ari kugagara. Nababazaga uyu mwana namukorera iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Muraho, nakiriye umwana w’umuhungu ufite amezi makumyabiri n’abiri, apima ibiro cumi na bitatu, afite umuriro wa mirongo itatu n’icyenda na mirongo ine. Araruka kandi arashonje. Gahunda: kumuha umuti ugabanya umuriro Gushishikariza konsa no kumwohereza byihutirwa mu bitaro.
question_english: Hello, I've received a twenty-two-month-old, thirteen-kilogram baby boy, whose fever is thirty-nine and forty. He is vomiting and starving. I would like to ask what I can do for this child.

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umugore w'imyaka mirongo itatu nitatu y'amavuko afite ibiro mirongo itanu na kimwe na garama ijana. Yaje afite ikibazo cyo kubabara umutwe kandi ngo iyo bigeze ni mugoroba yumva afite imbeho nyinshi. Ambwira ko adaheruka kujya mu mihango hashize amezi atatu. Mwohereje kwa muganga ngo bamukurikirane. Hari ikindi namukorera? Murakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Uyu ni umugore w’imyaka 33 upima ibiro 51, ugejeje amezi atatu atabona imihango. Ashobora kuba atwite. Kora ikizamini cyo gusuzuma niba atwite. * Niba ibisubizo ari positive (atwite), agomba koherezwa mu serivisi zita ku bagore batwite (ANC - Antenatal Care) kugira ngo ahabwe ubufasha bukwiriye mu gihe cyo gutwita. * Niba ibisubizo ari negative (adatwite), agomba kugisha inama umuganga w’indwara z’abagore (gynecologist).
question_english: I received a thirty-three-year-old woman weighing fifty-one kilograms and one hundred grams. She came with a complaint of a headache and said that in the evening she feels very cold. She told me she hasn't had her period for three months. I referred her to the hospital for further examination. Is there anything else I can do for her? Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Umukobwa w'imyaka makumyabiri, ufite ibiro mirongo itanu na bitanu aje angana, ambwira ko yakoranye imibonano mpuzabitsina n'umusore w'imyaka makumyabiri n'itanu kandi bayikoze idakingiye. Mubajije amasaha amaze bayikoze, ambwira ko amaze isaha imwe. Nahise muha taransiferi. Ese hari ubundi bufasha namuha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze kubaza iki kibazo. Umukobwa w’imyaka 20 upima ibiro 55 kg yaje akugana akubwira ko yakoranye imibonano mpuzabitsina idakingiye n’umusore w’imyaka 25, hashize isaha imwe. Wamwohereje kwa muganga. Icyo wakora ubanza ni ukumwumvisha ko atari wenyine, ko muri kumwe kandi ko nta kibazo gikomeye, kugira ngo agire ihumure. Ugomba no kumenya niba yafashwe ku ngufu cyangwa niba byari ku bwumvikane, kugira ngo arusheho kwitabwaho n’abaganga b’inzobere mu by’imitekerereze, ndetse n’uwabikoze akurikiranwe n’inzego zibishinzwe. Nyuma yo kumenya ayo makuru, agomba koherezwa kwa muganga vuba bishoboka kugira ngo akingirwe inda, virusi itera SIDA n’izindi ndwara zandurira mu mibonano mpuzabitsina. Ni ingenzi ko ibi bikorwa mu gihe gito kugira ngo hagire igikorwa hakiri kare. Murakoze.
question_english: A twenty-year-old girl, weighing fifty-five kilograms, comes to me and tells me that she had unprotected sexual intercourse with a twenty-five-year-old man. When I asked her how long it had been since they did it, she told me it had been one hour. I immediately gave her a transfer. Is there any other help I can provide her?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umwana w’umukobwa, ufite imyaka itatu n’igice, ibiro cumi na bitatu. Ntashobora kunywa,kurya, no konka. Uwo mwana ubundi bufasha namuha uretse kumuha taransiferi, n’ubuhe?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umwana w’umukobwa ufite imyaka 3 n’igice, ibiro 13 kgs, ntabasha kurya no kunywa, no konka. Ubufasha: Mbere yo kumwohereza, ni ngombwa kubanza gufata ibipimo by’umuriro ndetse n’isukari. Twasanga nta muriro, agahita yoherezwa kwa muganga agasuzumwa, agahabwa ubufasha neza, kuko umwana uri munsi y’imyaka ine agomba kuvurizwa ku bitaro.  Dusanze afite isukari nkeya, ni ngombwa kubanza tukamuha isukari ivanze n’amazi, tukamuha transferi akagana kwa muganga byihuta.
question_english: I received a girl child, who is three and a half years old, weighs thirteen kilograms. She cannot drink, eat, or suckle. That child, other help can I give her except giving her a transfer, is what?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umukobwa w'imyaka cumi n'itanu ufite ibiro mirongo itanu amaze amezi abiri ajya mu mihango ava cyane. Akoresha agapira ko kuboneza urubyaro, musuzumye nsanga arereruka mu maso n'ibiganza. Mugira inama yo kurya imboga n'imbuto. Ubwo namukorera iki? Nimungire inama.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Ibyumvikana ni uko ugendeye kubimenyetso afite, birashoboka ko afite amaraso make. Rero, mwohereze ku kigo nderabuzima babashe kumufasha.
question_english: I received a fifteen-year-old girl weighing fifty kilograms who has been menstruating heavily for two months. She uses a contraceptive implant, and upon examination, I found her pale in the face and hands. I advised her to eat vegetables and fruits. What should I do for her? Please advise me.

question_kinyarwanda: Umubyeyi yazanye umwana w'imyaka ibiri n'igice w'ibiro icyenda ari gukorora kenshi no kuruka kandi bitari bisanzwe, bitarisanzwe bimubaho. Mufatira tayima nsanga nta kibazo afite ese ni ubuhe butabazi bundi namuha
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze kubaza iki kibazo cy'uyu mubyeyi wazanye umwana w'imyaka ibiri n'igice w'ibiro icyenda, ari gukorora kenshi no kuruka kandi bitari bisanzwe bimubaho, umufatira tayima usanga nta kibazo afite, ukaba ubaza ubutabazi bundi wamuha. Ni byo koko iyo umwana afite inkorora gusa nta kindi kimenyetso afite nk'umuriro, guhumeka vuba cyangwa inshuro nyinshi mu munota n'ibindi, avurishwa umutobe w'indimu cyangwa bakamuha ubuki bufunguye, haba hari ikindi kimenyetso kidasanzwe cyangwa umwana ahumeka inshuro nyinshi bigaragaza ko yaba afite umusonga agahabwa ibinini by'Amoxicillin bagendeye ku myaka afite. Ndetse iyo ubonye ko kuruka kwe kudakabije cyangwa bizanwa nuko akoroye, na bwo umuha umutobe w'indimu cyangwa ubuki bufunguye. Ariko uyu mwana watubwiye we, aramutse afite ikibazo cyo gukorora kenshi no kuruka cyane bikabije, byaba byiza umuhaye taransiferi imujyana ku kigo nderabuzima bakamusuzuma akavurwa neza, ndetse agafatirwa ibindi bizamini agahabwa imiti ijyanye n'uburwayi afite. Uyu mubyeyi wazanye, ubufasha wamuha ni uko wamusobanurira ibi byose byavuzwe haruguru, ubundi mugafata umwanzuro bitewe nuko umwana mu mubona. Murakoze!
question_english: A mother brought her two-and-a-half-year-old child weighing nine kilograms, who was coughing frequently and vomiting unusually, which had never happened before. I took TIMER, and the result proven the child was normal. What other support can I provide?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umugore w'imyaka mirongo itatu n'ibiri, afite ibibyimba mu rubavu afite n'ikindi mu mutwe, arananutse. Namubajije igihe abimaranye, ambwira ko abimaranye ibyumweru bibiri. Namubajije niba nta bundi burwayi yari afite ambwira ko abana n'ubwandu bwa SIDA. Uyu murwayi namufasha iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Urakoze kubaza iki kibazo cy'umugore w'imyaka mirongo itatu n'ibiri waje afite ibibyimba mu rubavu n'ikindi ku mutwe kandi ananutse. Wamubaza igihe abimaranye akakubwira yuko ari ibyumweru bibiri kandi asanzwe abana n'ubwandu bwa virusi itera sida. Nibyo koko uyu mugore kuba yagira ibi bibyimba birashoboka kubera ko abantu bafite ubwandu bwa virusi itera sida baba bashobora kugira izindi ndwara z'ibyuririzi zibafata, kubera yuko virusi itera sida ica imbaraga umubiri abasirikare barinda umubiri bakagabanyuka, ndetse cyane iyo bagabanyutse rero ntago baba bagifite ubushobozi bwo kurinda umubiri w'umuntu, bityo izindi ndwara nyinshi zikaboneraho zigatangira kumufata. Ni yo mpamvu umuntu umenye yuko afite ubwandu bwa virusi itera sida tumusaba kwihutira kujya kwa muganga kugira ngo atangire gukurikiranwa muri porogaramu ikurikirana aba barwayi kandi ahite atangira imiti ako kanya akimara kubimenya. Iyo afashe imiti igabanya ubukana, rwose nta kibazo abasirikare barongera bakagaruka bakaba benshi bakarinda umubiri ntiyongere kurwaragurika. Uyu mudamu rero birashoboka ko yaba atanywa imiti igabanya ubukana cyangwa se akaba ayinywa nabi. Muganirize wumve uko bimeze, hanyuma umwohereze ku kigo nderabuzima kugira ngo ababishinzwe bamugire inama kandi banamuvure ibyo bibyimba byatangiye kumufata. Urakoze!
question_english: I received a 32-year-old woman who has swelling on her side and another on her head, and she has lost weight. When I asked how long she has had this, she said two weeks. When I asked if she had any other illnesses, she told me she is living with HIV. How can I help this patient?

question_kinyarwanda: Umubyeyi yanzaniye umwana w'umuhungu ufite imyaka itatu, afite ibiro cumi na bine muwake cumi na gatanu. Ashyize igiceri mu kanwa arakimira, asanzwe afite ubumuga bwo mu mutwe. Ndamuganirije ndetse ndamuhumuriza muhaye transiferi. Mumfashe ubu hari ubundi bufasha bwisumbuye namuha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'imyaka 3, fite ibiro 14 na MUAC ya 15, akaba asanganywe ubumuga bwo mu mutwe, aje yamize igiceri. Iki kibazo kirihutirwa kuko icyo giceri gishobora gufunga imyanya y'ubuhumekero, akeneye ubutabazi bw'ibanze. Reba niba yatangiye guhumeka nabi arwana no kubona umwuka, hamagara ubutabazi bw'ibanze bumwitisha kugera aho ari buhabwe ubuvuzi bwisumbuyeho, ariko ube ugerageza kuba umufasha nko kumukanda ku nda umufatiye inyuma ngo urebe ko igiceri yakigarura. Ageze ku bitaro bikuru basobora kuba bamunyuza mu cyuma bakareba aho kiri, bakaba bafungura imyanya y'ubuhumekero hakoreshwejwe kubagwa cyangwa ibindi bikoresho byisumbuyeho bikozwe n'inzobere zabihuguriwe.
question_english: A parent brought me a three-year-old boy weighing 14 kilograms. He put a coin in his mouth and is swallowed it. He already has mental disability. I spoke with him and comforted him, and I provided a referral. Can you help me with any additional support I can offer him?

question_kinyarwanda: Mwiriwe! Ndi umujyanama w'ubuzima nakiriye umugabo ufite imyaka mirongo itatu n'umunani; ibiro mirongo itanu na kimwe; afite umuriro;nta bundi burwayi asanganywe. Namukoreye tederi iba negatifu. Muhaye transiferi ntiyabyakira neza. Mwamfasha iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: mwiriwe neza Mujyana, urakoze kubaza iki kibazo cy'umugabo w'imyaka mirongo itatu n'umunani ufite ibiro mirongo itanu na kimwe akaba afite umuriro wamupima na tederi ikaba negatifu kandi ntabundi burwayi asanganywe ariko wamuha taransiferi ntabyakire neza. icyambere wakora kuri uyu mugabo nukumusobanurira neza impamvu umuhaye taransiferi kuko akenshi abantu bagize umuriro bishyiramo ko barwaye malariya kandi bumva bagomba guhabwa imiti ya malariya. uyumugabo rero mubwireko abantu bose bafite umuriro bataba barwaye malariya kuko habaho nizindi ndwara nyinshi zigira ikimenyetso cy'umuriro. harimo nko kuba yagira infegisiyo yo mumaraso cg izindi mikorobe zishobora kwinjira mumubiri w'umuntu zikamutera umuriro kandi ibi bishobora kugaragarira kwamuganga kuko niho honyine bashobora gupima bakabone ibyo bibazo kandi bagatanga imiti yo kubivura. numara kumusobanurira neza uyu mugabo aremera taransiferi ajye kwamuganga kandi baramufasha. Murakoze!
question_english: Good afternoon! I am a community health worker, and I received a man who is thirty-eight years old; weighs fifty-one kilograms; has a fever; and has no other pre-existing conditions. I performed a rapid diagnostic test, and it was negative. I gave him a transfer, but he did not take it well. What can you help me with?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umwana w'umuhungu ufite imyaka makumyabiri, ibiro mirongo itanu nicyenda, afite inkorora, ibicurane n'umuriro mwinshi. Mubajije igihe yafatiwe, abwira ko amaze iminsi itatu arwaye, mubajije niba nta bundi burwayi asanganywe, ambwira ko ntabwo. Mubajije niba nta yinindi miti asanzwe anywa ambwira ko ntayo. Mufashe tederi nsanga ni positif, afite umuriro ufite mirongo itatu n'umunani. Ndikubaza imiti ndamuha n'ikigero cyayo?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umuhungu w'imyaka 20 upima ibiro 59, afite smear ya malaria nziza, umuriro n'inkorora. Ashobora kuba afite malaria ifite pneumonia yisumbuyeho cyangwa indwara z'ubuhumekero bwo hejuru. Niba nta bindi bimenyetso bifitanye isano nko kuruka, impiswi, intege nke z'umubiri, kubura amaraso, umuhondo, cyangwa kugorwa no guhumeka, kuvura byihutirwa harimo gufata imiti igabanya umuriro (Paracetamol po 1 g, brufene 400mg), kumuha imiti ya malaria ako kanya, coartem 4 ku dose ya mbere hanyuma izindi 4 nyuma y'amasaha 8, 24, 36, 48, 60 nyuma ya dose ya mbere (iminsi 3). Ku nkorora na pneumonia, kumuha amoxicillin 50mg TDS mu minsi itanu, kumushishikariza kunywa amazi no kurya. Niba afite ibindi bimenyetso bifitanye isano byavuzwe haruguru, kumuha ubuvuzi bwihutirwa nk'uko byavuzwe haruguru, no kumwohereza kwa muganga kugira ngo akorerwe ibizamini byimbitse no kuvurwa kuko ashobora kuba afite malaria ikomeye.
question_english: I received a 20-year-old boy who weighs 59 kilograms. He has a cough, cold symptoms, and a high fever. When I asked him when the symptoms started, he said he has been ill for three days. I also asked if he has any other health conditions, and he said no. When I asked if he is taking any regular medication, he said no. I performed TDR and the result was positive. He has a fever of 38.°C. I am now asking for the medication to give him and the appropriate dosage.

question_kinyarwanda: Mwiriwe, umukobwa w'imyaka makumyabiri n'umwe ambajije niba gukoresha agakingirizo kamurinda kwandura virusi itera SIDA mu gihe cy'imibonano mpuzabitsina ijana ku ijana. Namusubiza iki? Murakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umukobwa w'imyaka 21 ubaza niba gukoresha agakingirizo bimurinda kwandura virusi itera SIDA 100%. Agakingirizo kagufasha cyane kwirinda kwandura indwara zandurira mu mibonano mpuzabitsina harimo na virusi itera SIDA, ariko ntikakurinda 100%, bityo ugomba kugakoresha witonze: -Mbere yo gukoresha agakingirizo, reba itariki kazarangiriraho. -Koresha agakingirizo gashya kuri buri gikorwa cy'imibonano mpuzabitsina. -Menya uko ugakoresha neza kugira ngo bigire umusaruro mwiza. Byose muri rusange, kwifata ni bwo buryo bwiza bwo kwirinda kwandura indwara zandurira mu mibonano mpuzabitsina harimo na virusi itera SIDA; ariko mu gihe utabishoboye, koresha agakingirizo neza kandi ubifatanye no kwisuzumisha kenshi wowe n'abo muryamana. Menya neza uko ubuzima bw'abo muryamana buhagaze ku bijyanye na virusi itera SIDA.
question_english: Good afternoon, a girl of twenty-one years asked me if using a condom protects her from contracting the virus that causes AIDS during sexual intercourse one hundred percent. What do I answer her? Thank you

question_kinyarwanda: Umugabo w'imyaka mirongo ine n'itatu ufite ibiro mirongo itandatu n'icyenda, afata imiti y'igituntu hashize ukwezi ayifata. Ariko akaba ababara mu gatuza, kandi agifite inkorora ikabije. Naba nabazaga niba yasubira kwa muganga cyangwa yakomeza kwihangana agakomeza kunywa imiti. Mugire iyihe nama?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Nyuma yuko uyu mugabo afite ibimenyetso by'uburibwe mu gatuza n'inkorora ikabije nyuma yo gufata imiti y'igituntu, ni byiza ko asubira kwa muganga.  Nubwo yaba yarafashe imiti, ibimenyetso afite nk'ibi bishobora kugaragaza ko imiti itakiri kumuvura neza kimwe n'uko haba hari ikibazo gikomeye gikwiye gusuzumwa n'amuganga. Rero gukomeza gufata imiti utasuzumwe neza bishobora gutuma ikibazo gikomeza cyangwa kikarushaho kwiyongera. Inama nziza ni ugusubira kwa muganga kugira ngo ahabwe ubuvuzi bwisumbuyeho .
question_english: A forty-three-year-old man weighing sixty-nine kilograms has been taking tuberculosis medication for a month. However, he experiences chest pain and still has a severe cough. I've been wondering if he should go back to the doctor or continue being patient and keep taking the medication. What advice can I give?

question_kinyarwanda: Muraho neza, ndi umugore. Umwana wanjye w'umukobwa afite imyaka ibiri. Afite ibiro cumi na bitatu. Ntabwo agenda keretse afashe ku kintu kandi abo bangana bariruka. Mwangira iyihe nama?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Muraho neza, ndi umugore. Umwana wanjye w'umukobwa afite imyaka ibiri, afite ibiro cumi na bitatu, ntabwo agenda keretse afashe ku kintu. Murakoze, umwana bisa n'aho yatinze kugenda ariko mugaburire indyo yuzuye hanyuma baguhe transfer, uzajye ku bitaro by'Akarere bikwegereye ujye kureba muganga w'abana.
question_english: Hello, I am a woman. My two-year-old daughter weighs thirteen kilograms. She cannot walk unless she holds onto something, while her peers are running. What advice can you give me?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umwana w'umuhungu ufite imyaka itatu, ibiro cumi na kimwe, aje afite impiswi, undi asanzwe akunda kurwara malariya namupimye MIWAKE, muha oresi na zenke ntiyabyakira. Namuhaye amogisi. mwamfasha iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'umuhungu w'imyaka 3 upima 11 kg afite impiswi, akunda kurwara malariya kenshi. Yanze gufata ORS na Zinc. Kuko akunda kurwara malariya, kora TDR urebe niba atongeye kugira malariya ifite ibimenyetso bya GI. Niba ari positive, tangira imiti ya malariya. Reba ibindi bimenyetso bijyana na byo nko kugira umuriro, isesemi no kuruka hanyuma uvure ibimenyetso. Kandi kuko uyu mwana atihanganira imiti inyobwa, mwimurire ku kigo nderabuzima cya hafi kugira ngo ahabwe imiti inyuzwa mu mutsi, hakorwe ibindi bipimo no kumwitaho birushijeho.
question_english: "I received a three-year-old boy weighing eleven kilograms, who came with diarrhea. He usually suffers from malaria. I tested him with MUAC and administer him ORES and zinc, but he didn't recover. I gave him amoxicillin. What can you advise me?"

question_kinyarwanda: Nasuye umugabo w'imyaka mirongo itatu n'itanu, ngo ahora yikanga bikabije umuntu, agahora asa nkaho yiteguye guhunga cyangwa kurwana. Namusabye kugana muganga ushinzwe ihungabana abe yamufasha, ati yewe nzaba njyayo. Yafashwa iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Nasuye umugabo w'imyaka 35 uhora yumva ubwoba bukabije, ahora asa nk'aho yiteguye guhunga cyangwa kurwana. Niba nta yindi mateka y'uburwayi afite, cyangwa amateka y'ibibazo by'ubuzima bwo mu mutwe, inkunga yo mu rwego rw'ubuzima bwo mu mutwe byasabwe ko agisha inama muganga w'inzobere mu by'ihungabana ngo amufashe, kandi yarabyemeye.
question_english: I visited a 35-year-old man who constantly feels intense fear, always appearing as if he is ready to flee or fight. I suggested that he consult a doctor specializing in trauma to help him, and he agreed, saying he would go. What kind of help can he receive?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umukobwa w'imyaka cumi n'irindwi, afite ibiro mirongo itandatu. Aje antakira ko bamufashe ku ngufu mpita muhamagarira kwa muganga ngo bamuhe ubufasha bamupime, ndamwohereza. Ese hari ubundi bufasha naba muhaye mu gihe ngitegereje?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze kubaza iki kibazo cy’umwana w’umukobwa w’imyaka cumi n’irindwi n’ibiro mirongo itandatu, waje agutakira ko bamufashe ku ngufu, ugahita umuhamagarira kwa muganga ngo bamufashe bamupime. Mbashimiye ubufasha n’ubutabazi mwamuhaye, kuko iyo umuntu yafashwe ku ngufu, agomba guhita ajya kwa muganga ibimenyetso bitarazimangatana.  Agomba kandi gupimwa umwandu w’agakoko gatera SIDA/HIV, kugira ngo nibasanga adafite ubwandu bamuhe imiti ituma atandura ako gakoko.  Agahabwa imiti imurinda indwara zandurira mu mibonano mpuzabitsina, kandi akanapimwa inda, kugira ngo nibasanga adatwite bamuhe ibinini bituma adasama, bityo atabyara umwana udateganijwe. Ndetse, agomba koherezwa kuri polisi kugira ngo uwo munyabyaha wamufashe ku ngufu akurikiranywe n’amategeko maze ahanwe. Mwakoze guhita mumwohereza kwa muganga.
question_english: I've received a seventeen-year-old girl, who weighs sixty kilograms. She has come to me saying that she was raped and I've immediately called at the health center to give her help and test her and I've sent her. So is there any other help I can give her while I am waiting?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umugore w'imyaka mirongo itatu n'ibiri, arababara umukiziba cyinda kandi akabara n'umugongo,abimaranye iminsi itatu. Nabajije nimba ntabundi burwayi afite ambwira ko arwaye umuvuduko w'amaraso.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze -uyu mugore mubaze niba afata imiti neza,maze umushishikarize kuyifata neza -uyu mugore mubaze niba aheruka mumihango,mufate ikizamini cy'inda -uyu mugore mubaze niba yarigeze ahura nikibazo cyatuma agira ikibazo cymugongo nka agisida,kwitura hasi,kubagwa harimo no kubagwa abyara,nizimwe mumpamvu maze umubwireko byaba impamvu ashake imiti yububabare akre na siporo zoroheje -harindi mpamvu yatera kubabara mukiziba kinda numugongo,mwegere umubaze niba iyo akoze imibonano mpuza bitsina azana mavangingo,niba bibaho abiheruka ryali?niba ari cyera yaba imwe mumpamvu bimubwire niba afite umugabo babiganireho babikemure niba ntawe muganire uburyo byakemuka hirindwa ibindi bibazo byavukamo mugihe biciye munzira mbi -nibikomeza ajye kwa muganga
question_english: I received a thirty-two-year-old woman who has been experiencing abdominal pain and back pain for three days. When I asked if she has any other health issues, she mentioned that she has hypertension.
