question_kinyarwanda: Nasuye umugore w'imyaka mirongo itatu n'umwe afite ibiro mirongo itanu na bitatu yari afite abana barindwi, nta buryo bwo kuboneza urubyaro afite, nta burwayi asanganwe. Musobanurira gahunda yo kuboneza urubyaro; mubwira ibyiza byo kuboneza urubyaro. Mubajije ko aboneza ambwira ko yumvise bavuga ko iyo uboneje ko ukonja. Namugira iyihe nama?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Uyu ni umugore w'imyaka 31 upima ibiro 53, afite abana barindwi kandi nta buryo bwo kuboneza urubyaro akoresha. Uyu mugore akeneye uburyo bwo kuboneza urubyaro, kandi atekereza ko bushobora kugabanya ubushake bwo gukora imibonano mpuzabitsina, ariko ntibizamufasha kuko atari uburyo bwizewe bwo kubukoresha. Gahunda: -Mwigishe neza uburyo bwo gukoresha uburyo bwo kuboneza urubyaro n'akamaro ko kwita neza ku bana be. -Mubwire ubwoko bwose bw'uburyo bwo kuboneza urubyaro kugira ngo ahitemo uburyo bumukwiriye.
question_english: I visited a 31-year-old woman weighing 53 kilograms who has seven children and no contraceptive methods. She has no known health issues. I explained the family planning options to her and the benefits of family planning. When I asked if she uses contraception, she said she heard that it can reduce one's sexual urge. What advice should I give her?

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'umukobwa w'imyaka cumi'umunani, angezeho avuga ko agize ikibazo cyo gufatwa ku ngufu ,mubaza amasaha amaze ambwira ko amaze iminota mirongo itatu, mwohereje kwa muganga ngo bamufashe. Ese hari umufasha namuha? Murakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Uyu mwana w'umukobwa wafashwe kungufu akeneye ubufasha bwihuse bwo kujya kwa muganga kugira ngo ahabwe service ituma atandura VIH kandi agahabwa imiti imurinda gutwara inda atateganyije, cyane ko ari mu masaha yo kumufasha muri ubwo buryo navuze bwo kwirinda ibyo byago. Rero, ubufasha bwa muganga burakenewe.
question_english: An eighteen-year-old girl has come to me saying she that has been raped. When i asked how long ago it happened, she says it was thirty minutes ago, and I send her to the hospital for help. Is there any support you can provide her? Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Mwaramutse neza umusaza w'imyaka mirongo itandatu n'irindwi afite ibiro mirongo itandatu na bibiri, aje akorora cyane,ababara mu gatuza, ahinda umuriro, ababara umutwe bikabije Mubajije igihe abimaranye ambwiye ko abimaranye iminsi irindwi, muhaye taransiferi(transfeur) ngo ajye ku kigo nderabuzima yanze kujyayo ngakoresha imiti y'ikinyarwanda, ubwo namufasha iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Mufatire tederi urebe, niba nta malariya afite hanyuma unamubwire ko afite ibimenyetso by'igituntu Kandi kitavurwa n'imiti ya kinyarwanda bityo ko agomba kujya Kwa Muganga bakamufasha.
question_english: Good morning. I have received a sixty-seven-year-old man weighing sixty-two kilograms. He is coughing a lot, has chest pain, has a fever, and is experiencing severe headaches. When I asked how long he has been feeling this way, he said it's been seven days. I transferred him to the health center, but he refused to go because he uses traditional medicine. so, what can I do to help him?

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'umuhungu ufite imyaka ine ibiro cumi na bitanu,yaje ari gusagura umwuka arimo guhumeka nabi kandi afite umuriro. Mupima nkoresheje tayima ndetse mufatira na tederi (TDR), tederi(TDR) nsanga ni negatifu (Negatif), ngiye kumuha taransiferi (transfeur) umubyeyi mubaza uburwayi, uburwayi umwana yaba asanganywe, ambwira ko akunda kurwara umutwe uruhande rumwe. Ni iki nakora? Murakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Uwo mwana w'imyaka ine uhumeka nabi, akaba nta malariya afite, ashobora kuba arwaye umusonga. Yajyanwa ku kigo nderabuzima bakamukurikirana.
question_english: A four-year-old boy weighing 15 kilograms comes in showing signs of difficulty breathing and having a fever. I measure his temperature using a thermometer and take a TDR reading, which turns out negative. As I prepare to administer treatment, I ask the parent about the child's medical history. The parent informs me that the child often experiences headaches on one side. What should I do? Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Umubyeyi azanye umwana ufite imyaka itanu, ibiro cumi n'umunani, afite uburwayi bw'umuriro mukoreye tederi nsanga ari negatifu, mbajije umubyeyi ambwira ko arwara igicuri. None namuha iyihe miti?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Urakoze, ariko ibyiza ni ukohereza umurwayi ku bitaro kugira ngo hakorwe isuzuma ryimbitse no anitabweho.
question_english: A mother brought a five-year-old child weighing 18 kg, who has a fever. I performed TDR, and it resulted negative. When I asked the mother, she told me the child has epilepsy. What medication can I give ?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umwana w'umukobwa w'imyaka cumi n’itandatu, afite ibiro mirongo ine, yaje angana ambwira ko afite ikibazo cy'uko amaze iminsi irindwi irenga mu mihango kandi ubusanzwe yarayijyagamo iminsi itatu. Byamubayeho ari ku ishuri abura uko ajya kwa muganga. Nahise mugira inama yo kujya kwa muganga kugira ngo arebe. Ese hari ubundi bufasha yahabwa?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze kubaza iki ikibazo cy, umwana w, umukobwa w, imyaka cumi n,itandatu,ufite ibiro mirongo ine,yaje akugana akubwira ko afite ikibazo cy, uko amaze iminsi irindwi irenga mu mihango Kandi ubusanzwe yarayijyagamo iminsi itatu.Byamubayeho Ari ku ishuri abura uko ajya kwa muganga.Wahise umugira inama yo kujya kwa muganga kugirango arebe impamvu. Ukaba ubaza niba hari ubundi bufasha yahabwa. Mwakoze kuba mwakiriye uyu mwana w, umukobwa ndetse mukamuha taransiferi imujyana kw, ivuriro bitewe n,ikibazo yarafite cyo kujya mu mihango ikarenga iminsi irindwi Kandi yarayijyagamo iminsi itatu. Mubyukuri uyu mwana w, umukobwa afite ikibazo cyumvikana,Kuko ubusanzwe imihango imara hagati y,iminsi ibiri n, irindwi (2-7),none uyu mukobwa ayimazemo iminsi irenga irindwi. Gusa tugomba kumenya ko ukwezi k,umukobwa gushobora kugira impinduka akaba yagira imihango idakama,cyangwa akirenza ukwezi bitewe n,ubuzima arimo cyangwa abayemo,Kuko ubuzima burimo guhangayika cyangwa ibibazo bigoye,abakobwa benshi kubyakira mu ntekerezo zabo birabagora,bikaba byatuma agira impinduka ku minsi y,imihango ye. Birashoboka ko bitewe n,amasomo cyangwa kwitegura ibizamini byamugoye,bigatuma agira iki ikibazo. Kuba wamwohereje kwa muganga nibyiza,Kuko baramusuzuma bakareba niba ntabundi burwayi afite,bakamenya niba ataragize indwara yo kubura amaraso mu mubiri,akagirwa izindi nama,akanaganirizwa nuko agomba kwiyitaho ngo agarure amaraso yatakaje. Murakoze.
question_english: I've received a sixteen-year-old girl, she weighs forty kilograms, has come to me and told me that she has got a problem because she has been menstruating for more than seven days and she has been used to having three days in it. It happened to her at school and missed the way to the doctor. I immediately advised her to go to the doctor to see how. Is there any other help she could get?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umukobwa w'imyaka cumi n'itanu; ibiro mirongo itatu n'umunani; ambwiye ko atwite ariko iyo nda atayishaka kuko yayitewe na se wabo, kandi amufashe ku ngufu. Namubajije igihe imaze ambwira ngo imaze amezi atatu. Namubajije ko nta bundi burwayi ambwira ko ntabwo. Uyu mukobwa namufasha iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umukobwa w'imyaka 15 upima ibiro 38, atwite amezi 3 ariko ashaka gukuramo inda kuko ari iya se wabo. Kubera ko akiri muto, agomba kuza ari kumwe n'umwishingizi wemewe n'amategeko kugira ngo asabe gukurirwamo inda mu buryo butekanye. Ndasobanukiwe ko ashobora kutabibwira ababyeyi ariko kandi ntimushobora kumufasha atari kumwe n'umwishingizi. Ariko afite uburenganzira bwo gukurirwamo inda mu buryo butekanye, bityo umwishingizi naramuka ahageze, mumufashe kugera ku kigo nderabuzima aho ashobora gukorerwa icyo gikorwa. Kandi kuko atari mwe mumukorera serivisi yo gukurirwamo inda mu buryo butekanye, mushobora kumubaza ibyabaye hagati ye na se wabo kugira ngo hamenyekane niba harabayeho ihohoterwa rishingiye ku gitsina kandi akaba atarabonye ubutabera. Igihe cyararenze kugira ngo ibizamini bihagije bikorwe, ariko kwifashisha abahanga mu by'ubuzima bwo mu mutwe bishobora kumufasha kuko bashobora gusuzuma uko ubuzima bwe bwo mu mutwe buhagaze kugira ngo bamenye niba afite ihungabana. Ku kigo nderabuzima, bazanasuzuma uko ahagaze ku bijyanye na virusi itera SIDA, bamuhe imiti n'inama niba asanze ari positifu. Bazamusuzuma Hepatite B na C. Mukomeze kumukurikirana n'igihe byose byaba byarangiye.
question_english: I received a fifteen-year-old girl who weighs thirty-eight kilograms. She told me that she is pregnant but does not want the pregnancy because her uncle impregnated her by raping her. I asked her how long it has been, and she replied that it has been three months. I also inquired if she has any other illnesses, and she said no. How can I help this girl?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umugore ufite imyaka makumyabiri n'itanu, afite ibiro mirongo itanu numunani, afite umuriro wa mirongo itatu ni'cyenda, nta bundi burwayi yari afite. Mukoreye tedele(TDR), nsanga afite malariya y'igikatu. Namuha umuti afite malariya y'igikatu?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Ni byiza kubaza iki kibazo cy’uyu mugore ufite imyaka makumyabiri n’itanu, ufite ibiro mirongo itanu n’umunani, ndetse n’umuriro wa mirongo itatu n’icyenda. Nta bundi burwayi yari afite. Wamukoreye tederi, usanga afite malariya y’igikatu. Ukaba ubaza niba wamuha imiti afite malariya y’igikatu. Nibyo koko, uyu mubyeyi ufite umuriro urenze mirongo itatu n’icyenda n’ibice bitanu, kandi tederi ikaba ari positifu, aba afite malariya y’igikatu. Ni yo mpamvu agomba koherezwa byihutirwa ku kigo nderabuzima kimwegereye, akajyana n’ibisubizo bya tederi yakorewe, kugira ngo avurwe kandi ahabwe imiti igabanya umuriro afite. Nibiba ngombwa, ahabwe antibiyotike. Umujyanama w’ubuzima wamusuzumye, agomba kandi kumufatira amaraso kuri tederi (Rapid Malaria Test) kugira ngo hakorwe isuzuma ryimbitse. Uyu mugore ntabwo yemerewe kuvurwa n’umujyanama w’ubuzima, ahubwo ahabwa taransiferi akajya ku kigo nderabuzima kimwegereye. Murakoze!
question_english: I received a 25-year-old woman weighing 58 kilograms, with a fever of 39°C, and no other underlying illnesses. I performed a rapid diagnostic test (RDT) and found that she has severe malaria. Should I give her medication with sever malaria?

question_kinyarwanda: Nasuye urugo rurimo umwana n'umukobwa afite imyaka umunani. Ababyeyi be bambwiye ko afite ikibazo cyo kwikanga kandi buri gihe. Nabagiriye inama yo kumugeza ku ivuriro kuko bishobora kuba byamuviramo indwara y'umutima. Ise ati ntuzagire aho unjyanira umwana bizikiza hakorwa iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Icyakorwa nukwigisha uwo mugabo cyane ukamwumvisha ko byamuviramo uburwayi bukomeye ataviye kwa muganga ngo aganire nushinzwe ubuzima bwo mu mutwe, kuko bavugana akamenya naho bituruka. Ikindi kwa muganga bamufatira ibipimo by' ubuzima bakamenya ibyo aribyo. Mwigishe cyane nibiba ngobwa umuzane kwa muganga umuherekeje.
question_english: I visited a home with a child, a girl who is eight years old. Her parents told me that she has a problem of being startled all the time. I advised them to take her to the hospital because it could lead to a heart disease. Her father said, "Don't take my child anywhere, it will recover itself, what should be done?"

question_kinyarwanda: Nasuye umugore utwite w'imyaka makumyabiri n'icyenda, nsanga araganira n'umugabo we uburyo azajya kubyarira kwa muganga ko birinda ingorane kurusha kubyarira mu rugo. Nanjye mbagira inama ko ari byo byiza haba kuri we ndetse no kubo azabyara kuko muganga abitaho birenze uko yabyarira mu rugo. Nababazaga niba hari ubundi bufasha nari kumuha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugore utwite w'imyaka 29 uri kuganira n'umugabo we ku byiza byo kubyarira kwa muganga ugereranyije no kubyarira mu rugo. Kubyarira kwa muganga bifite akamaro kenshi nko gukurikirana ubuzima bw'umubyeyi n'ubw'umwana neza. Gukurikirana uko ibise bigenda biza, kandi niba hari ikibazo kidasanzwe bakakibona hakiri kare. Nyuma yo kubyara umwana, umubyeyi ahabwa oxytocin kugira ngo hatabaho kuva amaraso menshi. Umwana ahita ahabwa Vitamine K kugira ngo atava amaraso. Nanone umwana ahita ahabwa tetracycline kugira ngo imurinde indwara ziterwa na bagiteri zibasira amaso. Umwana ashyirwa ku byuma bitanga ubushyuhe kugira ngo atagira ikibazo cyo gukonja cyane. Ku mubyeyi wagize ikibazo cyo gucika mu gitsina, ahita adodwa kandi agahabwa umuti ugabanya ububabare.
question_english: I visited a 29-year-old pregnant woman and found her discussing with her husband about giving birth at the hospital, as it prevents complications compared to giving birth at home. I also advised them that it is the best option for her and the baby because the doctor provides better care than giving birth at home. I was asking if there was any other assistance I could offer her.

question_kinyarwanda: Umugore w'imyaka mirongo itandatu, ibiro ni mirongo irindwi na kimwe aje ababara umutwe, umugongo no mu nda. Mubajije niba nta bundi burwayi asanganywe avuga ko ntabwo. Namuha ubuhe bufasha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: • Ubanza gukora RDT, niba ari negative umubwire ajye ku kigo nderabuzima kugira ngo akorerwe isuzuma ririmo; Igipimo cy'isukari mu maraso kugira ngo harebwe niba atarwaye Diyabete kuko nayo ishobora gutera ibimenyetso byavuzwe, Igipimo cy'umuvuduko w'amaraso ndetse n'ibipimo byuzuye by'amaraso hanyuma avurwe hakurikijwe ibisubizo.
question_english: A 60-year-old woman, weighing 71 kilograms, came in complaining of headaches, back pain, and abdominal pain. When I asked if she had any underlying health conditions, she said no. What assistance can I provide her?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umusore w'imyaka cumi n'umunani. Yaje avuye mu mujyi wa Kigali, aza atameze neza, aza kundeba ngo arebe ko arwaye malariya. Namubajije uko yiyumva, ambwira ko afite umuriro mwinshi cyane utagabanuka, ko yaje yipimishije agira mirongo ine, ni ko kuza atorotse abayobozi batabizi. Ari kuribwa mu mutwe, mu ngingo, mu muhogo, kandi ari gucibwamo. Namubwiye ko ashobora kuba afite ibimenyetso bya marburg. Yambwiye ko yanyweye utunini twa paracetamol ngo umuriro ugabanuke, ariko byanze. Namugiriye inama yo gusubira mu rugo, akiha akato ntagume kugendagenda, kugeza igihe muhamagarije ubufasha. Yambwije ukuri ko atashobora kwicara mu rugo iminota irenze mirongo itatu, mubwira ko ari kubw'inyungu ze n'iz'abo mu rugo n'iz'abaturage muri rusange, kugira ngo ataba ari icyorezo kikarimbura abantu. Mubwira uko gifata n'uko kirindwa, mugira inama yo kunywa amazi menshi mu gihe ategereje ubufasha. Yambwiye ko bitashoboka n'ubundi, arigendera kuko bitamushobokera. Namwumvishije ko kuguma mu rugo, ari inyungu rusange z'abaturage, kandi n'ubuzima bwe bukarushaho kujya mu kangaratete. Yampakaniye ko bitari bushoboke. Muramfasha iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Icyo wafasha uwo muntu ufite ibimenyetso bya mariburu, ariko akaba adashaka kwishira mu kato, wamuhururiza uhamagara ku 114, polisee 112 cyangwa ukiyambaza inzego z'umutekano zikwigereye bakagufasha kumwitaho
question_english: I evaluated an eighteen-year-old young man who came from Kigali city, feeling unwell, to check if he had malaria. I asked him how he was feeling, and he told me he had a persistent high fever and had measured his body temperature at 40°C, therefore escaping from the authorities without their knowledge. He was experiencing a headache, joint pain, throat pain, and diarrhea, to which I told him that he might have signs of Marburg virus disease. He explained that he had taken paracetamol tablets to reduce the fever, but they did not work. I advised him to go back home, isolate himself, and avoid moving around until help was arranged for him; however, he admitted that he could not stay at home for more than thirty minutes. I emphasized it was for his own benefit, for his family's, and for the general public, to protect them from the risk of an epidemic that could wipe out people. I explained how Marburg virus spreads, how to prevent it, and advised him to drink plenty of water while waiting for assistance. He told me it was impossible anyway, and he left because he couldn’t manage it. I explained to him that staying at home was for the general public’s benefit and that his health would deteriorate further. He insisted that it was not possible. How can you help me?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umugabo w'imyaka mirongo ine n'itandatu y'amavuko. Umugabo yaje avuga ko abira ibyuya nijoro, afite inkorora amaranye ibyumweru birenze bine. Mwohereje kwa muganga ngo iyo nkorora bayimusuzume. Murakoze. Hari ikindi mwamfasha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugabo w'imyaka 46, abira ibyuya nijoro, afite inkorora amaranye ibyumweru birenze bine. Amwohereje kwa muganga ngo bamufashe. Ubundi bufasha: 1. Kumuha umuti wa amoxicilline ugabanya inkorora, agahita yoherezwa kwa muganga. 2. Ageze kwa muganga baramupima ibizamini by'igikororwa kuko ashobora kuba arwaye igituntu cyo mu bihaha, basanze ari cyo, agatangira imiti izamara amezi 6 (ari mu byiciro 2): -Amezi abiri yambere :RHZE -Amezi ane ya nyuma : RH 3. Gukorerwa ibizamini bindi bareba ko nta zindi ndwara yaba afite nka VIH, yaba ayifite nayo ikavurwa bakurikije purotokole, 4. Gukomeza kubahiriza imiti, kuyifata neza, ndetse akirinda kuba yayihagarika, kubahiriza imirire (indyo yuzuye), 5. Gukomeza gukurikiranwa kugeza akize neza.
question_english: I received a 46-year-old man. The man came saying he sweats at night and has had a cough for over four weeks. I transferred him to the hospital for the cough to be examined. Thank you. Is there anything else you can help me with?

question_kinyarwanda: Mwaramutse neza, umubyeyi anzaniye umwana w'imyaka ibiri ambwira ko ari guhitwa byoroshye, bitoroshye cyane. Ni umwana w'umukobwa mubajije niba nta burundi burwayi asanzwe afite abwiye ko ari ntabwo. Muhaye muhaye ibinini bya zenke mubwira ko agomba kuza amuha n'amazi, muha na asiro yo kuzashyiramo amazi. Mubwiye ko agomba kuza amuhama amuha amugaburira kenshi. None uwo murwayi namufasha iki? Murakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Uwo mwana mwohereze ku kigo nderabuzima babashe kumufatira ibizami by'umusarane bamenye ikiri gutera iyo diyare.
question_english: Good morning, a mother has brought me a two-year-old and told me that she is suffering from a simple diarrhea, not very simple. She is a baby girl. I've asked if she has had any other illnesses and said no. I've given I've given her zinc tablets and told her to regularly give her water and I've given her suro to put water in. I've told her feed her often. So what can I do for that patient? Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Umugabo w'imyaka mirongo inani amaso aramurya cyane akayakuba. Uburwayi asanganywe ni igituntu. Namugiriye inama ko atongera kuyakuba ko kuko yakuba atari byiza. Namukorera iki? nimumfashe.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: uyu ni umugabo w'imyaka mirongo inani ufite iibazo cyo kuribwa amaso ndetse akayakuba cyane akaba asanzwe afite igituntu . ashobora kuba afite alerigi y'amaso(allergic conjuctivitis). icyo yakorerwa : * Wamubwira ko akomeza kwirinda kuyakuba -Noneho unamwohereze kwa muganga aho ahura n'umuganga w'amaso (opthalmologist) akamuvura. -Ikindi niba afite imiti y'igituntu ayikomeze kugeza amezi agomba kuyifatira arangiye.
question_english: An eighty-year-old man is experiencing severe eye irritation and keeps rubbing them. He has a history of tuberculosis. I advised him to stop rubbing his eyes as it is not helpful. What can I do for him? Please assist.

question_kinyarwanda: Nasuye umugore ufite umwana w'umuhungu ufata shisha kibondo, afite umwaka n'amezi atatu, afite muake ya cumi na kabiri nibice bitanu, afite ibiro icumi. Namubajije ko nta burwayi asanganywe ambwira ko ntabwo, mubajije uko amuha shisha kibondo ambwira ko ayivangamo indi fu kugira ngo itubuke, indi akayigurisha kugirango abone udufaranga two kwifashisha. Mungire inama.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: mwakoze kakira uyu mubyeyi -mubwire ko shisha kibondo itavangirwa -mubwire ko yayihawe kugirango ifashe umwana we kumererwa neza ko nayivangira ntakamaro izaba igifite -mubwire gushaka ukundi yabona amafarango yo kwifashisha adakoresheje shisha kibondo -mubwire ko kandi ko kuyigurisha bitemewe nagato ko nabikomeza hazabamo izindi ngauka mbi -mubwireko nabo ayiha bitemewe kuko itangwa nababihuguriwe bakayiha abana bayikeneye babanje kubapima gusa -mubwire ko agomba kubungabunga uzubzima bwuwo mwana -tanga raporo kunzego zibishinzwe bakore ubukangurambaga
question_english: I visited a woman with a baby boy taking shisha kibondo, one year old and three months old, MUAC of twelve point five, ten kilos. When i asked him if he had not been sick he told me no, when i asked her how she gives him shisha kibondo she told me that she mixes it with another flour so that it would melt, and sells the left to get money to use. Can you advise me?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umwana w'umuhungu ufite imyaka itatu ibiro cumi n'umunani aje afite impiswi. Namupimye miwake muha ORESI na zenke. Mwamfasha iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze! Uwomwana ufite impswi MENYA -Igihe bimaze -Uko bisa,birarenduka,bicitse amazi,birimo amaraso,biranuka,.. -Munda haramurya? -Yaramaze kurya iki mbere yo gutangira gucibwamo -Hari ubundi burwayi afite -Yafashe mebendazole uko bikwiye? IBYO GUKORA BINDI -Numara kumenya ibyo byose, ibisubizo bishobora ku kubwirako akeneye kujya kwa muganga gukorerwa ibizamini (umusarane, amaraso, guca mu cyuma) -Niba yamaze gucika intege, amaso yasubiye mu binogori, akeneye kujya kwa muganga kugira ngo ahabwe ama serumu n'ubundi buvuzi -Ganiriza umuryango we kw'isuku (ibiryo, amazi, imyenda,..),indyo yuzuye,no guha abana ibinini by'inzoka.
question_english: I received a three-year-old boy weighing eighteen kilograms who came with diarrhea. I measured his MUAC and gave him ORS and zinc. What could you help me?

question_kinyarwanda: Mwaramutse neza! umusaza w'imyaka mirongo itanu n’ibiri; afite ibiro mirongo itandatu na bine. afite ikibazo cy'inkorora, arakorora akaruka, akaribwa mu gatuza, akababara mu nda. Mubajije igihe abimaranye, ambwiye ko abimaranye iminsi irindwi. Mwohereje ku kigo nderabuzima yanga kujyayo ngo nta bwisungane mu kwivuza afite. Ubu namufasha iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: #NAME?
question_english: Good morning! A fifty-two-year-old man weighs sixty-four kilograms. He has a cough, is coughing up phlegm, feels pain in his chest, and has abdominal pain. When I asked him how long he has been experiencing this, he told me it has been seven days. I referred him to the health center, but he refused to go because he doesn't have health insurance. How can I help him now?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umudamu w'imyaka makumyabiri n'icyenda ibiro mirongo itandatu na birindwi. Yaje afite umuriro ari kuva cyane, kandi ari kuvira ku nda. Mwohereza kwa muganga. Musuye nyuma y'iminsi itatu, nsanga aracyava. Mungire inama.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugore utwite w'imyaka 29 upima ibiro 67, yaje afite umuriro n'amaraso aturuka mu nda kubera gutwita, yoherejwe ku bitaro ariko hashize iminsi itatu agikomeza kuva amaraso. Uyu murwayi ashobora kuba yaragize malariya mu gihe cyo gutwita ishobora kuba yarakize ariko kandi ashobora kuba ari gukuramo inda. Ugomba kumwohereza byihutirwa ku bitaro by'akarere kugira ngo babashe gusuzuma uko umwana n'umubyeyi bameze. Ku bitaro, umubyeyi arasuzumwa, hakorwa ecographie y'inda, niba basanze ari gukuramo inda bizashyirwa mu byiciro nko gukuramo inda kutarangiye, cyangwa ikuramo inda iteye ubwoba. Uburyo bwo kuyitaho buzaterwa n'ubwoko bwo gukuramo inda basanze afite. Hazatangwa inyigisho ku bijyanye n'amahitamo yo kuboneza urubyaro nyuma yo gukuramo inda kandi amahitamo azaterwa n'icyo umurwayi ashaka.
question_english: I received a twenty-nine-year-old woman weighing sixty-seven kilograms. She came in with a high fever and was experiencing bleeding during her pregnancy. I sent her to the hospital. I visited her three days later, and she was still bleeding. What advice can you give me?

question_kinyarwanda: Umugore w'imyaka makumyabiri n’itandatu ibiro mirongo itanu na bitanu, umuriro wa mirongo itatu nagatandatu n’igice, twagiranye ikiganiro yari abyaye rimwe arambaza ati, mbese ubu kwa muganga bashobora kumfungira urubyaro burundu? Namusobanuriye mubwira yuko ibyo byaterwa n'ikiganiro yagiranye na muganga, n'impamvu ashaka gufungisha burundu, nuko muganga yabirebye akabisuzuma bikaba ngombwa ko abigukorera. Hari ikindi nari kongeraho?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Icyo wakongeraho nuko wamubwira akajya kureba muganga ubishinzwe, akamuha ibisobanuro bihagije bitewe n'impamvu ashaka kwifungisha burundu. Ariko mu bisanzwe wamubwira ko umuntu ushaka kwifungisha burundu agomba kuba ari kumwe ni uwo bashakanye bakabaganiriza bombi.
question_english: A 26-year-old woman weighing 55 kilograms, with a temperature of 36.5°C, asked me if the hospital could permanently sterilize her. I explained that this would depend on her discussion with the doctor, the reasons for her request, and the doctor's evaluation. Is there anything else I should have added?

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'umukobwa w'imyaka makumyabiri n'ibiri; ufite ibiro mirongo itanu na bitatu; yambwiye ko ajya mu mihango akaremba cyane mu minsi ibiri muyindi minsi akaba yoroherwamo gake ariko mubwira ko agomba kujya kwa muganga aranga . Ese hari ubundi bufasha namuha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze kuba iki kibazo cy'uyu mwana w'umukobwa w'imyaka makumyabiri n'ibiri ufite ibiro mirongo itanu na bitatu bakubwiye ko ajya mu mihango akaremba cyane mu minsi ibiri, mu yindi minsi akaba yoroherwamo gake ariko umubwira ko agomba kujya kwa muganga aranga. Ukaba ubaza niba hari ubundi bufasha wamuha. Nibyo,hari abakobwa bamwe, iyo bagiye kujya mu mihango cyangwa bari mu mihango mu minsi ibiri yambere, hari ubwo bagira uburibwe bwinshi bitewe nuko iminsi y'intangangore igomba kumara itegereje intangangabo iba irangiye, maze nyababyeyi agahita ikora akazi ko kubisohora hanze n'ibyari gutunga umwana, mu gihe cyo gusohoka, ibyari guzatunga umwana n'intangangore bikamutera uburibwe bwinshi cyane, aha abakobwa benshi bararibwa cyane, bamwe bakaremba mu minsi nk'ibiri ibanza, gusa si bose ahubwo biterwa n'imiterere yabo cyangwa se imisemburo yabo. Ariko iyo baje kwa muganga babaha imiti ibagabanyiriza uburibwe bukoroha. Uyu mukobwa agomba kugirwa inama y'uko kwa muganga hari imiti igabanya uburibwe, bibaye byiza yajya ayikoresha mu minsi ibiri ye y'uburibwe bigatuma agira ubuzima bwiza. Murakoze
question_english: A twenty-two-year-old girl weighing fifty-three kilograms told me that she experiences severe pain during her menstrual period for two days, while on other days she has mild discomfort. I advised her to go to the hospital, but she refuses. Is there any other help I can provide her?

question_kinyarwanda: Mwiriwe neza! umugabo w'imyaka mirongo itatu n'umunani; afite ibiro mirongo itandatu na bine; afite ikibazo cyo kubabara umutwe; akagira isereri; agacika intege akananuka buri munsi. Mubajije igihe abimaranye avuga ko abimaranye ibyumweru bitatu. Mubajije ko yipimishije agakoko gatera SIDA ambwira ko ntako yipimishije. Mwohereje ku kigo nderabuzima yanze kujyayo ngo atamenya ko arwaye SIDA akiyahura. Ubwo namufasha iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugabo w'imyaka 38 upima ibiro 64 yaje afite umutwe, isereri, yumva adafite imbaraga, kandi yaratakaje ibiro buri munsi mu byumweru 3 bishize, ubwo yoherezwaga ku kigo nderabuzima ngo asuzumwe Virus itera SIDA (HIV) yanze avuga ko ashobora kwiyahura aramutse asanze arwaye. • Mumugire inama neza mumubwire ko nyuma yo gusanga arwaye Virus itera SIDA (HIV/AIDS), agatangira imiti kandi akayikurikiza ubuzima bukomeza nk'ibisanzwe, kandi mumubwire ko ari ingenzi kumenya uko ahagaze. • Bazanasuzuma Diyabete kuko nayo ishobora kugaragara mu buryo nk'ubu ku barwayi bashya, kandi aramutse asanze arwaye yahita atangira gufata imiti ya Diyabete ako kanya. • Bazakora n'ibindi bisuzuma bijyanye n'ibimenyetso afite kandi bamuvure uko bikwiye.
question_english: Good evening! A thirty-eight-year-old man; weighing sixty-four kilograms; has a problem of headache; experiences dizziness; feels weak and loses weight every day. When asked how long he has had these symptoms, he says three weeks. When asked if he has been tested for HIV, he says he has not been tested. When I referred him to the health center, he refused to go, saying that if he finds out he has HIV, he might commit suicide. What help should I give for him?

question_kinyarwanda: Umugore w'imyaka makumyabiri n'itatu, ibiro mirongo itanu na kimwe, umuriro wa mirongo itatu na gatandatu n’igice. Twagiranye ikiganiro ku ndwara y'igituntu, arambaza ati kuki bakingira umwana igituntu akivuka cyangwa mbere y’iminsi makumyabiri n'umunani. Namusobanuriye mubwira ko ari ukugira ngo barinde umwana kwandura iriya ndwara hakiri kare, kuko ari indwara ikomeye kandi yica mu gihe gitoya. Hari ikindi nari kongeraho.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Urakoze, wabikoze neza, gukingirwa ni ukwirinda.
question_english: A 23-year-old woman, weighing 51 kilograms, had a fever of 36.6°C. We had a conversation about tuberculosis, and she asked why children are vaccinated against tuberculosis at birth or before 28 days. I explained to her that it is to prevent the child from contracting the disease early, as it is a serious and potentially fatal illness. Is there anything else I should have added?

question_kinyarwanda: Umubyeyi anzaniye umwana w'umuhungu, amezi icyenda, mupimye nsanga afite ibiro birindwi na muwake cumi na gatutu. Mupimye uburebure nsanga ari mu ibara ry'umuhondo, mubaza niba nta bundi burwayi afite ambwira ko ntabwo, mugira inama yo kujya amwonsa kenshi no kumugabura indyo yuzuye kuburyo buhagije. None ndibaza, ese hari ubundi bufasha namuha? Murakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze kubaza iki kibazo cy'uyu mubyeyi wakuzaniye umwana w'umuhungu w'amezi icyenda, umupimye usanga afite ibiro birindwi na muwake cumi na gatatu, umupimye uburebure usanga ari mu ibara ry'umuhondo, umubaza niba nta bundi burwayi afite, akubwira ko ntabwo. Umugira inama yo kujya amwonsa kenshi no kumugaburira indyo yuzuye, ku buryo buhagije ukaba ubaza niba hari ubundi bufasha wamuha. Nibyo koko umwana ufite amezi icyenda aba agomba konka agafata n'ifashabere ifite intungamubiri zihagije, akarya indyo yuzuye, irimo ibitera imbaraga, ibyubaka umubiri, n'ibirinda indwara, kandi nyina akamwonsa cyane kuko mu gihe aba atarageza amezi cumi n'abiri aba agikeneye intungamubiri zituruka mu mashereka, niyo mpamvu kuba wamukanguriye kumwonsa nibyo. Uyu mubyeyi ufite uyu mwana uri mu muhondo, aba agomba kugana ivuriro akaganira na muganga ushinzwe imirire akamusuzumira umwana bakareba impamvu afite iki kibazo cy'igwingira, bakareba impamvu ibitera, niba umwana atonka neza Kandi ku gihe, k'ubushobozi bw'ababyeyi, cyangwa niba atari uburwayi umwana afite. Uyu mubyeyi agomba guhabwa taransiferi, imujyana kwa muganga, umwana agasuzumwa, ndetse agahabwa n'ibigomba guhabwa abana bari mu mirire mibi. Murakoze.
question_english: A parent has brought me a nine-month-old baby boy, I've weighed him and found he has seven kilograms and thirteen MUAC. I've measured his height and found he is in the yellow category, I've asked if he has any other illness, and told me no. I've advised to breastfeed him often and provide him with a balanced diet adequately. Now I am wondering, is there any other assistance I can offer? Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umugabo ufite imyaka mirongo ine n'itanu, ufite ibiro mirongo itandatu n'icyenda yigeze kurwara covid ngo ajya ababara mu gatuza cyane, iyo arwaye inkorora. Ubundi abimaranye iminsi cumi n'itanu ababara cyane mu gatuza kandi asanganywe indwara y'umutima afata n'imiti ya SIDA. Nabazaga uyu umurwayi yahabwa ubuhe buvuzi cyangwa yahabwa ubuhe bufasha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugabo upima ibiro mirongo itandatu n’icyenda wari warigeze kurwara COVID-19 kandi ubu agira ububabare bukabije mu gituza iyo akorora. Amaranye iminsi cumi n’itanu ububabare bukabije mu gituza kandi afite indwara y’umutima yari asanzwe afite ndetse afata imiti ya SIDA. Ugomba kumubaza ibindi bimenyetso nko gukorora, kubura appetit, kugabanuka k'ibiro cyangwa kugira umuriro. Hanyuma ufate igihe cyo gupima pneumonia. Umubaze niba afite imiti y'ubwirinzi bw'udusimba tw'uburwayi. Nyuma ushobora kumwohereza gupimisha ibipimo by'amatembabuzi yo mu bihaha.
question_english: I received a forty-five-year-old man weighing sixty-nine kilograms who had previously suffered from COVID-19 and now experiences severe chest pain when he coughs. He has been suffering from intense chest pain for the past fifteen days and has a pre-existing heart condition while also taking HIV medication. I was asking what treatment or help could be provided to this patient.

question_kinyarwanda: Hello! Narimo ngenda mu nzira; imodoka nini incaho ipakiye ibintu byinshi, ngeze imbere nsanga ibyo yari ipakiye byagiye binyanyagira mu muhanda; harimo imiti yarangije igihe, harimo buwate de sekirite akoresheje, harimo udupfukamunwa n'uturindantoki yakoreshejwe. Abana bavaga ku ishuri bagiye babitoragura, nambaye uturindantoki ndabibaka, ariko menye amakuru ko bamwe babigejeje no mu ngo hirya no hino iyo bataha. Ndikubaza icyo nakora ngo iyo myanda itangiza cyangwa se ikagira ingaruka mu baturage b'igihugu cyacu. Murakoze!
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Nibyiza kubaza iki ikibazo kibazo k,imodoka nini yataye imyanda mu muhanda ,harimo imiti yarangije igihe,harimo buwate de sekirite zakoreshejwe,harimo udupfukamunwa n,uturindantoki byakoreshejwe. Abana bavaga kw,ishuri bagiye babitoragura,wambaye uturindantoki urabibaka ,ariko umenya amakuru Yuko bamwe babigejeje no mu ngo hirya no hino iyo bataha. Ukaba urikubaza icyo wakora kugirango iyo myanda itagira uwo yangiza cyangwa ikagira ingaruka mbi kubaturage. Mbere ya byose ngushimiye uburyo wabashije kugira abana waka iyo myanda Kandi ukagira nindi ubasha gukusanya. Bitewe nuko abana aba Ari benshi,nibyiza kubimenyesha abayobozi b,ikigo bigaho,bagahabwa ikiganiro Bose hamwe kubyerekeye ingaruka mbi zo gukoresha imyanda cyane cyane iyavuye kwa muganga Kuko haba harimo inshinge ,uturindantoki,Kandi biba byarakoreshejwe kubantu benshi bafite ibibazo bitandukanye. Urugero harimo abafite ubwandu bw,agakoko gatera SIDA, abafite ubwandu bw, umwijima wo mubwoko bwa B, tetanusi,igikomere nibindi. Ubundi bagafata abana bataha mugace imodoka yajugunyemo imyanda,bakaganirizwa by,umwihariko,kugirango babone amakuru ahagije yabana bafashe imyanda. Ikindi gishoboka,ni uguha amakuru,ubuyobozi n,abaturage Bose batuye aho iyo modoka yaciye,bagakoreshwa inama,bakigishwa ububi bw,ibyo bikoresho byanduye kubuzima bwabo n,abana babo. Murakoze.
question_english: Hello! I was walking on the road; a big truck passed by loaded with many things, and when I got ahead, I found that what it was carrying had scattered on the road; there were expired medicines, used security gloves, used face masks, and gloves. Children coming from school were picking them up, and wearing gloves, I have worn the glove and took them from the children, but I learned that some had even taken them to their homes in different areas where they come from. I am asking what I can do to prevent that waste from causing harm or having an impact on the citizens of our country. Thank you!

question_kinyarwanda: Mwiriwe neza! Umwana w'umuhungu w'amezi umunani afite muwake ya cumi na kane, ibiro icyenda. Umubyeyi we amuzanye ambwira ko afite umusonga. Mupimye nkoresheje tayima nsanga ahumeka inshuro mirongo ine n'umunani ku munota. Nsanze nta musonga afite, none uyu mwana mukorere iki? Murakoze
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Mwohereze ku kigo nderabuzima bamukurikirane barebe ikibazo afite.
question_english: Hello! An eight-month-old baby boy has a MUAC of 14 cm and weighs 9 kilograms. His mother brought him and told me he has pneumonia. I tested him using a timer and found that he is breathing forty-eight times per minute. I found that he has no pneumonia, so what can I do for this child? Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Umubyeyi ufite umwana w'umukobwa w'imyaka ine, yangeze imbere avuga ko akeka ko umwana we yahawe ibyo kunywa bihumanye mu masaha abiri ashize. Agaragaza ububabare bukabije mu nda, kandi arimo kuruka no gucibwamo yacitse intege cyane, mugira inama yo kujya kwa muganga. Ndabaza nimba hari ubufasha bwihuse bwahabwa uwo mwana?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Iyo umwana agaragaje ibimenyetso nk'ibi nyuma yo kunywa ibintu bihumanye, ni ngombwa gufata ingamba zihuse. Hari iby'ingenzi wakora mbere yo kugera kwa muganga,kumufasha kunywa amazi menshi gushaka ubufasha bw'ubuvuzi Utibagiwe kumushyikiriza muganga kugirango asuzumwe kuko akenshi guhumanywa bishobora kushyira ubuzima mukaga tutibagiwe nurupfu. Kwirinda kumuha indi miti ibonetse yose mugihe utazi iyo yanyoye.
question_english: A mother with a four-year-old daughter has come forward and said she has been suspecting her child to be given contaminated drinks in the last two hours. He shows severe abdominal pain, vomiting and diarrhea and she is very weak. I've advised her to go to the doctor. I would like to ask if there is any immediate help for the child.

question_kinyarwanda: Mwaramutse, umuntu w'umugabo aje kwivuza malariya, ambwira ko afite malariya, mushyizemo igipimo nsanga afite mirongo ine, nsanze ari positifu, muhaye sisi fuwa katere, ambwiye ko asanzwe arwara nigicuri. None uwo murwayi namufasha iki? Murakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugabo aje kwivuza malariya bamupimye basanga koko arayirwaye, avuzeko asanzwe arwara igicuri. Mubaze niba afata imiti yijyicuri neza, mubazwe ubwoko bwimiti afata, ubusanzwe kuko malaria nayo ubwayo ishobora gutuma umuntu agagara usanzwe arwara igicuri we aba afite ibyago byinshi byo kugagara kurusha abandi ..niyo mpamvu ugomba guhita uvura malariya akokanya hita umutanjyiza kowaritemu . Mubaze niba ntabindi bemenyetso afite, nko kuruka, impiswi umwuma, cyangwa kwereruka niba harikimwe mubimenyetso afitemo hita umwohereza kwamuganga barusheho kumukurikirana bamufashe byahafi niba ntabyo mujyire inama yokunywa coartem neza ,kunywa amazi ahajyije no kuruhuka bihajyije, kurya inryo yuzuye no gukomeza imiti yigicuri neza menyesha abo babana kumuba hafi n kumwitaho nawe umusure ukurikirane umenyeko yorohewe cyangwa yarembye umujyane kwa muganga.
question_english: Good morning, A male patient came for malaria treatment, telling me he has malaria. After testing, I found he has 40 degree Celsius, and the TDR was positive. I gave him 6*4 Coartem (AL). He also informed me that he has epilepsy. How can I assist this patient? Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Umurwayi w'umukobwa w'imyaka makumyabiri, ibiro mirongo itandatu. Yaje ahumeka insigane kandi yabyimbye ibirenge mukorera ibizamini nsanga afite indwara zidakira. Ese ni izihe nama nari kumugira zindi?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Uwo mukobwa w'imyaka makumyabiri, ibiro 60. Uhumeka insigane kandi yabyimbye ibirenge. Nibyo koko afite indwara zidakira. Uramupima umuvuduko, umugire n'inama yo kugabanya stress. Kugabanya umunyu, gukora sport. Noneho akeneye transfer yo kwa muganga ngo barebe neza niba atarwaye umutima, babe bamutangiza imiti.
question_english: A twenty-year-old female patient weighing sixty kilograms came in with dyspnea and swollen feet. After conducting tests, I found out that she has a chronic disease. What other advice should I give her?

question_kinyarwanda: Umugore w'imyaka mirongo itatu n'ibiri afite cyane yewe ananywa itabi mugira inama yo kureka itabi no kureka inzoga akananira. Mwamfasha iki ngo uyu mugore yo gukomeza gushyira ubuzima bwe mu kaga?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Uyu ni umugore w'imyaka 32 waje akorora asanzwe anywa itabi n'inzoga. Uyu mugore ashobora kuba afite igituntu cyo mu bihaha. Uyu mugore akwiye koherezwa ku bitaro kugira ngo hakorwe ibindi bizamini birimo kumucisha mu cyuma mu gatuza, ndetse no kugira ngo yitabwaho.
question_english: A 32-year-old woman coughs a lot and also smokes. I advised her to quit smoking and drinking alcohol, but she refused. How can you help me stop this woman from continuing to put her health at risk?

question_kinyarwanda: Umugabo w'imyaka mirongo ine n'umunani, yaje ansanga, ambwira ko atajya agira ubushake bwo gukora imibonano. Mubajije niba nta kibazo afite mu buzima, ambwira ko atabanye neza n'umufasha we, iyo bavuganye nabi nta bushake akigira. Mubwira rero ko agomba kwishakamo ibyishimo, akagerageza kwiyunga n'umufasha we, ko igihe nikigera bizagera aho bikaza. Ese hari ubundi nkaba mbaza niba hari ubundi bufasha namukorera? Murakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Ni iby'igiciro kandi ni ingenzi ko wita ku gusigasira ubuzima bw'imyororokere ku mubano. Nk’uko ubivuga, kuba umugabo afite ikibazo cy’ubushake buke bwo gutera akabariro cgangwa gukora imibonano mpuzabitsina bitewe n'imibanire itari ku rugero rwiza hagati yabo bombi nk'umugabo n'umugore, ni ikibazo gikunze kugaragara. Mu gihe nta bushake afite birashobora kuba biterwa n’imibanire mibi, comfrit, impaka cyangwa umwuka mubi mu rugo. Rero hari byinshi wamufasha nko gukomeza kuganira ku mpande zombi, ubagenera inama, kwigisha ku kuganira neza n'umufasha we no gushaka uburyo bwo kugarura umubano mwiza mu rugo rwabo. Ni ingenzi gukemura bimwe mu bibazo afite by'ubushake bwo kutabasha gutera akabariro n'ibindi, gusa ibi biramutse byanze bagana impuguke bakabagira inama. Ariko kandi ni byiza ko agisha inama ku bantu babifitiye ubumenyi bwimbitse muri icyo kibazo.
question_english: A forty-eight-year-old man has come to me and told me that he never has the desire to have sexual intercourse. When I have asked him if he has any health issues, he has told me that he does not have a good relationship with his spouse, and whenever they have a disagreement, he loses the desire. I have told him that he needs to find happiness within himself, try to reconcile with his spouse, and that in time things will improve. Is there any other help I can offer him? Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umwana w'umukobwa w'imyaka cumi n'umunani, afite ibiro mirongo itanu na bitandatu, afite umuriro wa mirongo itatu n'umunani, amaze iminsi ibiri afashwe. Nta bundi burwayi afite ariko aratwite. Namukoreye tederi (TDR) nsanga afite malariya. Namuha imiti ya malariya kandi atwite?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze ku kibazo kiza. -Mubaze igihe aherukira mu mihango, umenye igihe inda ye ifite, niba anikurikirana kwa muganga. -Ntabwo COARTEM itangwa ku mugore utwite mu gihembwe cya mbere n'icya 2. -Mwohereze kwa muganga bamwiteho kuko muri icyo gihe ahabwa quinine.
question_english: I received an 18-year-old girl, weighing 56 kilograms, who had a fever of 38 Celsius degrees, who has been sick for two days. Has no other illness but she is now pregnant. I performed a rapid diagnostic test (RDT) and found she has malaria. Should I give her malaria medication while she is pregnant?

question_kinyarwanda: Muraho, umubyeyi yanzaniye umwana w'umukobwa w'imyaka cumi n'itandatu, ibiro mirongo itatu na bine. Ambwira ko afite umuriro ari kubabara mu nda. Mushyizemo igipimo thermometre, musangamo umuriro wa mirongo itatu n'icyenda. Mukorera tederi musanzemo malariya, mubajije niba nta bundi burwayi asanganywe. Ambwiye ko ari ntabwo. Mubwiye ko yihangana ari bumere neza. Muhaye six fois quatre. Nabazaga nti hari ubundi bufasha naha uyu mwana?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Uwo mukobwa w'imyaka 16, ufite umuriro,uribwa mu nda,na malaria, turamuha kowariteme, tumwohereze ku ivuriro nyuma afatirwe ibizamini, ashobora kuba afite enfegisiyo mu myanya y'ibanga itazwi.
question_english: Hello, a parent has brought me a 16-year-old girl weighing 34 kilograms. They have told me she has a fever and abdominal pain. I have taken her temperature with a thermometer and found a fever of 39 degrees. I have performed a rapid test and found malaria. I have asked if she has any other pre-existing conditions, and they have told me no. I have told them to be patient; she will get better. I have given her six times four. I am asking if there is any other help I can give this child?

question_kinyarwanda: Umusore w'imyaka makumyabiri nitatu ufite ibiro mirongo itanu na bitanu yakoze impanuka akubita umutwe hasi ava amaraso ariko araribwa umutwe bikabije. None uyu muntu ndamukorera iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze kubaza iki kibazo cy'uyu musore w'imyaka makumyabiri n'itatu, ufite ibiro mirongo itanu na bitanu, wakoze impanuka agakubita umutwe hasi akava amaraso akaba aribwa umutwe bikabije. Kuba uyu musore yagize impanuka agakubita umutwe hasi akava amaraso, none akaba ari kuribwa bikabije, biragaragara ko uyu musore ashobora kuba yangiritse umutwe, udutsi tujyana amaraso mu mutwe tukaba twacitse akaba ari kuviramo imbere, bigateza ikibazo cyo kuribwa umutwe cyane, kandi aba ashobora kugwa muri shoke cyangwa akaba yahaburira ubuzima.Uyu musore agomba kwitabwaho cyane Kandi agahita yoherezwa kwa muganga, Kuko iyo umuntu yagize ikibazo nk'iki, biba bisaba ko ahita ajyanwa kw'ivuriro, akirinda kugira ikintu cyose anywa cyaba igishyushye cyangwa igikonje. Uyu musore mumwihutane, mu mujyane kwa muganga. Murakoze!
question_english: A twenty-three-year-old man with fifty-five kilograms made an accident and hit his head on the ground. He is now bleeding but severely suffering from a severe headache. So what do i do for this person?

question_kinyarwanda: Muraho, umubyeyi anzaniye umwana w'umuhungu, imyaka cumi n'itanu, ibiro mirongo itatu na bitanu, ambwira ko afite umuriro ari kubabara munda. Mumushyizemo igipimo thermometre, musangamo umuriro mirongo itatu n’icyenda, mukorera tederi (TDR) musangamo Malariya. mubajije niba nta bundi burwayi asanganwe, ambwira ko ari ntabwo. Mubwiye ko yihangana ari bumere neza. Muhaye sisi fuwa katere(six fois quatre). Nabazaga nti hari ubundi bufasha naha uwo mwana?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umuhungu w'imyaka 15 ufite ibiro 35, uvuga ko afite ububabare mu nda n'umuriro wa 39°C kandi TDR yerekanye ko arwaye malaria, yahawe 6\*4. Uyu murwayi afite malaria kuko TDR yerekanye ko ari nziza. Byiza cyane kumuha coartem. Mugire inama yo gufata imiti neza, ahite avurwa umuriro n'ububabare akoresheje paracetamol. Mwigishe ku ngamba zose zo kwirinda malaria. Mugire inama yo kuruhuka bihagije no kunywa amazi menshi. Niba hari ibimenyetso bya malaria ikomeye nko kugagara, ibimenyetso by'ubukonje bw'amaraso cyangwa umwuka mubi mu bihaha, mumwohereze kwa muganga ngo avurwe.
question_english: Hello, a parent brought me a 15-year-old boy, weighing 35 kilograms, and told me that he has a fever and abdominal pain. I used a thermometer to measure his temperature and found it to be 39°C. I performed an RDT (Rapid Diagnostic Test) and found that he has malaria. I asked if he has any other underlying conditions, and the parent said no. I reassured them that he will get better soon. I gave him six times four. I am asking if there is any other assistance I can provide to this child?

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'umuhungu ufite imyaka ibiri nigice, ufite ibiro cumi na bitatu, afite ubumuga bwo kutumva. bamuha imiti kwa muganga. namwakiriye amaze icyumweru ahitwa. namuhaye zenke ibinini bibiri ku munsi muminsi icumi byanze gukira. Niki nakora kugira ngo mufashe mbere yo kumwohereza?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'imyaka 2.5 ufite ibiro 13 afite ikibazo cyo kutumva kandi ahabwa imiti ku kigonderabuzima. Namwakiriye afite impiswi imaze icyumweru. Namuhaye ibinini bibiri bya zenke ku munsi mu minsi icumi, ariko ntabwo akira neza. Impiswi ishobora kuba iterwa n'inzoka zo mu nda, isuku nke y'ibiryo cyangwa ingaruka mbi z'imiti. Umurwayi akeneye inyigisho zijyanye n'isuku, agashishikarizwa kunywa oresi, ahabwa ibinini bya oresi 130ml kuri buri musemburo mwinshi hanyuma akoherezwa ku bitaro, baza niba impiswi yaje nyuma yo gutangira imiti, niba ari yego bahagarike imiti kandi bafate n'ibindi, hagati aho usuzume urugero rw'umwuma hanyuma umuhe iv ibinyobwa bisanzwe birimo umunyu/ indwara ya lactate uko bikwiye, niba byoroheje utange ibinini bya oresi 130ml kuri buri uko agiye kubwiherero nyuma yo gupima umusarane.
question_english: A 2.5-year-old boy weighing 13 kilograms has a hearing impairment and is receiving medication at the hospital. I received him when he had diarrhea for a week. I gave him two Zenke tablets per day for ten days, but there was no improvement. What can I do to help him before referring him?

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'imyaka makumyabiri n‘irindwi ibiro mirongo itandatu ni umuhungu, ari kuruka asa n'uwataye ubwenge, nta burwayi yari asanganwe. Namubajije icyamuteye kuruka ambwira ko yanyweye inzoga nyinshi n'itabi, mubajije icyabimuteye ambwira ko ababyeyi be bamubujije kubana n'umukobwa bakundana, ngo iwabo w'umukobwa ni abakene. Nagiriye inama ababyeyi b'umuhungu ko bagomba kurekera abana uburenganzira bwabo barabyanga,mungire inama y'icyo nabakorera.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Uyu ni umugabo w’imyaka 27 upima **60 kg**, wari usanzwe ari muzima, ariko ubu araruka kandi atakaza ubwenge nyuma yo gusinda kubera amakimbirane yo mu muryango. Uyu murwayi **yasindishijwe n’inzoga** kandi akeneye ubuvuzi bwihuse. **Mujyane kwa muganga ako kanya.** Kwa muganga, azakirirwa, asuzumwe, ahabwe **serumu, thiamine IV cyangwa mu kanwa (PO)**. Umuganga w’indwara zo mu mutwe azagirana ibiganiro n’umuryango ndetse n’umurwayi ubwe kugira ngo bamufashe mu buryo bw’imitekerereze.
question_english: A 27-year-old young man weighing 60 kg, who had no pre-existing conditions, started vomiting and appeared to be losing consciousness. When I asked him what caused the vomiting, he told me he had consumed a lot of alcohol and smoked cigarettes. Upon further inquiry, he said it was because his parents forbade him from marrying the girl he loves, claiming her family is poor. I advised the boy's parents to allow their son to make his own choices, but they refused. Please advise me on what I should do next.

question_kinyarwanda: Nasuye umwana w'umuhungu, afite amezi cumi n'atandatu, afite ibiro cumi na bibiri, yaracikanwe urukingo rw'amezi cumi n'atanu, nganira n'umubyeyi we mubaza niba umwana yararwaye, ambwira ko umwana ari muzima ko atarwaye muri uku kwezi. Mubaza impamvu atakingije umwana urukingo rw'amezi cumi n'atanu, ansubiza ko izindi zose yazibonye, urwa cumi n'atanu ntacyo rumaze. Namuya iyihe nama?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze cyane. -Ese umubyeyi yabonye inyigisho kugukingiza? Niba ntazo mwicare umugire inama, umwigishe, nibiba byiza uhamagare na papa w'umwana. -Musobanurire ko n'ubwo atarwaye bitaba impamvu yo kutamukingiza. -Mubwire n'izinzi ngamba zose umuryango ugomba gukurikiza mugihe bari kurera umwana mu minsi 1000 ya mbere harimo uko kumukingiza ,kumwonsa amezi 6 yambere ntamfashaberei bagatangira kuyimuha amezi atandatu aramgiye. -Kwirinda indwara zose. -Kugira isuku, gutegura ifunguro neza no kugira akarima k'igikoni no kwirinda malaria, umwana agomba kuryamba munzitiramibu ikoranye umuti.
question_english: I've visited a baby boy, he is sixteen months old, weighs twelve kilograms, and has missed the fifteen-month vaccine. I've talked to his parent and asked if the child has been sick, and they told me the child is healthy and has not been sick this month. I've asked why they did not vaccinate the child with the fifteen-month vaccine, and they've replied that he has received all the other vaccines, but the fifteen-month one is not important. What advice should I give them?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umwana w'umukobwa;ufite imyaka itatu; ibiro cumi na bitatu; muwaka(MUAC) cumi na kane. Afite inkorora n'ibicurane ,ari guhumeka vuba vuba nta bundi burwayi yari afite, namusuzumye nsanga arwaye umusonga. Namuha iyihe miti?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Amoxy,then transfer
question_english: I received a three-year-old girl; she weighs thirteen kilograms, and her mid-upper arm circumference (MUAC) is fourteen. She has a cough and common cold, and she is breathing rapidly; she had no other health issues. After examining her, I found she has pneumonia. What medication should I give her?

question_kinyarwanda: Umuhungu imyaka ine, ibiro cumi na bitatu, umuriro wa mirongo itatu n'umunani aje afite umuriro. Mupimye malariya ntayo. Abimaranye iminsi itatu , umubiri wose washeshe ibihara, umuriro uri kwiyongera. Ni ki nakora ngo mufashe mbere yo kumwohereza?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umuhungu imyaka ine, ibiro cumi na bitatu, umuriro wa mirongo itatu n'umunani aje afite umuriro. Mupimye malariya ntayo. Abimaranye iminsi itatu , umubiri wose washeshe ibihara, umuriro uri kwiyongera. Uyumuriro ushobora kuba uva kubihara akenshi Muhe ibinini by'umuriro umukorere isuku urushijeho kwirinda Ubundi umuhe transfer ajye kwa muganga bamufashe
question_english: A boy, four years old, thirteen kilograms, with a fever of thirty-eight, comes in with a fever. Tested for malaria, none found. He has had it for three days, the whole body has developed a rash, the fever is increasing. What can I do to help before referring him?

question_kinyarwanda: Mwiriwe neza, umugabo w'imyaka mirongo itatu nibiri, afite ibiro mirongo itandatu na kimwe, afite ikibazo cyo kwitura hasi agacira urufuzi. Namwohereje ku kigo nderabuzima bamuha imiti, bamuhaye imiti nyuma yo gutaha iwabo mu rugo ndamusura, nsanga imiti ntayinywa. Ubwo namufasha iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Mwiriwe neza! Bishoboka ko umugabo afite impungenge cyangwa se icyo kibazo afite impamvu zitandukanye zituma atajya afata imiti. Hari ibintu byinshi bishobora gutera umuntu kwanga gufata imiti, nk'ubwoba, kutumva neza uko imiti ikora, cyangwa kuba yumva ko imiti ntacyo yamumarira rimwe narimwe ko atayikenera. Muri icyo gihe, ushobora kumufasha mu buryo bukurikira: Kumufasha no kumwereka akamaro k’imiti Kureberahamwe uburyo bwo kumufasha gufata imiti Kumugeza kwa muganga Birakenewe ko atangira gufata imiti, kuko ikibazo afite (kwitura hasi agacira urufuzi) gishobora gutera ibibazo bikomeye mu buzima bwe. Niba atabyemeye ku giti cye, mu kwitaho no kumuba hafi, bizamufasha kugera ku cyemezo cyo gufata imiti.
question_english: Good evening, a 32-year-old man weighing 61 kg is having trouble falling to the ground and is experiencing fainting spells. I referred him to a health center where they gave him medication. After he returned home, I visited him and found that he was not taking the medication. How can I assist him?

question_kinyarwanda: Muraho, umwana w'umuhungu w'imyaka icyenda ibiro cumi n'umunani azanywe n'umubyeyi we avuga ko afite ikibazo cy'inkorora akaba arimo no guhitwa. Mubajije ko niba nta bundi burwayi asanganywe ambwira ko ari ntabwo, mubajije igihe yafatiwe ambwira ko amaze iminsi itatu. Mubwiye ko yihangana ari bumere neza, muhaye transiferi. Nabazaga niba hari ubundi bufasha namuha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'umuhungu ufite imyaka 9, ibiro 18, azanwe n'ababyeyi be afite inkorora, guhitwa, nta bundi burwayi asanganwe, amaze iminsi 3 afashwe mbere yo kumuha transiferi, ndabanza muhe serumu yo mu kanwa (ors) 100ml kugira adakama amazi mu mubiri, nkabona kumuha transiferi akagana kwa muganga, ageze kwa muganga hararebwa icyo yaba arwaye, nyuma yuko musuzumye ashobora kuba afite: 1. Impiswi iterwa na virusi. 2. Ashobora kuba afite gripe iterwa na virusi, cyangwa akaba afite umusonga. Ubufasha bw'ibanze: 1. oresi. 2. zenke 10mg od. 3. Gukora ibizamini tukamenya icyo arwaye koko. 4. Ibizamini bisohotse tugasanza afite umusonga, turongeramo amoxicilline, syrup 7.5ml bid 7/7. 5. Paidoterin syrup 10ml tds 5/7.
question_english: Hello, a nine-year-old boy weighing eighteen kilograms was brought in by his parent, who mentioned that he has a cough and is also vomiting. When I asked if he had any other underlying conditions, they said no. He mentioned that his symptoms started three days ago. I advised that he be patient as he will recover, and I provided a referral. Is there any additional assistance I can offer him?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umukobwa w'imyaka makumyabiri, afite ibiro mirongo itandatu, ari kuva cyane, amaze iminsi cumi n'ine akoresha uburyo bwo kuboneza urubyaro bwa depo. Nta bundi burwayi yari afite, namusuzumye nsanga arikweruruka mu biganza no mu maso mugira inama yo kurya imboga n'imbuto. Nemerewe kumutera depo? Nimungire inama.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: murakoze -Oya wimutera ahubwo muhamagarire imbangukiragutabara wasanga amaraso yabaye macye barabanza bamupime banamwongerere amaraso nibiba ngombwa -Nbasanga ari ingaruka za depo baramuhindurira
question_english: A 20-year-old girl, weighing 60 kilograms, is experiencing heavy vaginal bleeding. She has been using the Depo contraceptive method for 14 days. She had no other health issues, but upon examination, I found she was pale in her hands and face. I advised her to eat vegetables and fruits. Am I allowed to administer Depo again? Please advise.

question_kinyarwanda: Haje umwana w’imyaka itatu n’amezi icyenda, uwo mwana afite ibiro icumi na garama ijana. Yar’afite ikibazo cyo kuruka, ntabwo abasha kurya. Namurebye mbona yabyimbye ibirenge,n'umusatsi ucuramye. Namugiriye inama yo kurya indyo yuzuye, mwigisha nuko bayitegura. Mwohereza kwa muganga. Murakoze. Har’ikindi namufashisha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umwana w’imyaka 3 n’amezi 9 yaje yabyimbye ikirenge n’umusatsi ucuramye. Uyu mwana yari afite imirire mibi ikabije. **Gahunda yo kumuvura:** * Kumwohereza ku kigo nderabuzima kugira ngo abone ubuvuzi bwimbitse. * Kugira inama nyina yo kumuha indyo yuzuye.
question_english: A three-year and nine-month-old child came, that child weighs ten kilograms and one hundred grams. They had a problem of vomiting and could not eat. I observed that their feet were swollen, and their hair was thinning. I advised them to eat a balanced diet and taught them how to prepare it. I referred them to the hospital. Thank you. Is there anything else I can assist them with?

question_kinyarwanda: Muraho. Umugabo w'imyaka mirongo itanu, ibiro mirongo icyenda. Ambwiye ko afite ikibazo cy'ubuhumekero, arahumeka akababara mu rubavu cyane ndetse akumva akantu gaturika mu gatuza. Mubajije igihe yafatiwe, ambwira ko amaze amezi atanu. Mubajije ko yigeze ajya kwipimisha indwara zitandura, ambwira ko atarajyayo, muhaye taransiferi. Ese hari ubundi bufasha naha uyu mugabo?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Muraho! Ni byiza kubaza iki kibazo cy'uyu mugabo w'imyaka mirongo itanu, ibiro mirongo icyenda. Yakubwiye ko afite ikibazo cy’ubuhumekero, ahumeka anababara mu rubavu cyane ndetse akumva akantu gaturika mu gituza.  Umubajije igihe yafatiwe, akubwira ko amaze amezi atanu. Umubajije ko yigeze ajya kwipimisha indwara zitandura, akubwira ko atarajyayo. Umuhaye taransiferi, ukaba ubaza niba ntabundi bufasha mwaha uwo mugabo. Mbashimiye uburyo mwakiriyemo uwo mugabo, kuko ikibazo yaje afite cyo guhumeka, akababara mu mbavu ndetse no kumva akantu gaturika mu gatuza, kandi akaba anabimaranye igihe kingana nk'amezi atatu. Biragaragara ko uyu mugabo ashobora kuba afite zimwe mu ndwara zitandura. Urugero: kuba afite indwara y’umuvuduko mwinshi w’amaraso, kuba afite indwara y’umutima, kuba afite indwara ya asthma, n’izindi. Rero izi ndwara zitandura, ni byiza kuzisuzumisha kare, kuko iyo bagupimye bagasanga ufite imwe muri izi ndwara zitandura zavuzwe haruguru, baguha inama y'uko witwara bitewe n’uburwayi ufite, ndetse bakamuha imiti hakiri kare, uburwayi butarakomera. Ibi bituma ugira ubuzima bwiza kandi uka muri ubwo buzima igihe kinini cyo kurama nk'uko wakagombye kubaho. Ariko iyo utisuzumishije kare, ubaho mu buzima bubi ndetse bikaba byanamuviramo urupfu mu gihe udafashe imiti kare kandi ku gihe. Rero uyu mugabo agomba guhabwa taransiferi imujyana ku kigo nderabuzima kimwegereye, bakamusuzuma. Basanga afite imwe muri izi ndwara zitandura, agatangira gufata imiti kandi akigishwa uko agomba kwitwara bitewe n’uburwayi afite. Urugero: Basanze arwaye eperitansiyo, agomba gufata imiti ku gihe kandi buri munsi.  Ariko uyirwaye agomba kwirinda kurya umunyu mwinshi cyangwa akarya uwabigenewe, kwirinda kurya indyo irimo amavuta menshi, kunywa amazi menshi ku munsi mu buryo bwo gufasha impyiko ze no gutembera kw’amaraso, kugabanya kunywa inzoga (byaba na ngombwa akazireka), gukora siporo uko ashoboye, kuruhuka bishoboka, kwirinda stress no kwirinda kwibuza amahoro no kwihangayikisha, n’ibindi. Rero uyu mugabo muhe taransiferi. Murakoze.
question_english: Hello. A fifty-year-old man has come to me, weighing ninety kilograms. He tells me that he has a respiratory problem; he breathes with pain in his side and feels something popping in his chest. When I have asked him how long he has had these symptoms, he has told me it has been five months. When I have asked if he has ever gone for a check-up for non-communicable diseases, he has said he has not, so I have given him a referral. Is there any other assistance I can provide to this man?

question_kinyarwanda: Umugabo ufite imyaka mirongo ine n'ibiro mirongo itandatu na bitatu aje ambwira ko amaze amezi atatu ajya kunyara buri kanya ko nta kintu ajya anywa ngo gitinde mu nda. Mubajije ko nta bundi burwayi afite mu ndwara zitandura, ambwira ko ntabwo. Namugiriye inama yo kujya kwisuzumisha ku kigo nderabuzima. Muhaye taransiferi. Mungire inama, hari ikindi mwambwira namukorera mbere yuko ajya ku kigo nderabuzima?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze kubaza iki kibazo. Uyu mugabo w’imyaka mirongo ine ufite ibiro mirongo itandatu na bitatu yaje akubwira ko amaze amezi atatu ajya kunyara buri kanya kandi nta kintu anywa ngo gitinde mu nda. Umubajije niba afite ubundi burwayi mu ndwara zitandura, akubwiye ko ntazo afite. Wamugiriye inama yo kujya kwisuzumisha ku kigo nderabuzima ukamuha taransiferi, ariko ukaba ushaka kumenya indi nama wamugira cyangwa icyo wamukorera mbere y’uko agenda. Ni byiza kumuganiriza ku ndwara zitandura zishobora gutera iki kibazo, nk’indwara ya diyabete iterwa no kugira isukari nyinshi mu mubiri, indwara z’impyiko zangiritse, indwara zandurira mu mibonano mpuzabitsina idakingiye, n’izindi. Kunyara buri kanya bishobora kuba ikimenyetso cy’uko umubiri we uri gutakaza amazi menshi ku buryo budasanzwe. Mu busanzwe, amazi agize 75% by’umubiri wacu, kandi gutakaza amazi menshi bishobora gutera ingaruka zikomeye, zirimo indwara y’umwuma, kwangirika kw’impyiko, umwijima, ndetse n'ikibazo ku mutima ukwirakwiza amazi mu mubiri. Uyu mugabo agomba kugirwa inama yo kunywa amazi menshi kugira ngo asimbure ayo atakaza, bityo arinde umubiri we ibibazo bishobora guterwa no kubura amazi. Hanyuma, agomba guhita ajya ku kigo nderabuzima byihutirwa kugira ngo asuzumwe neza hamenyekane impamvu nyayo y’iki kibazo. **Murakoze.**
question_english: A 40-year-old man weighing 63 kilograms came to me saying that for three months he has been urinating frequently and that nothing he drinks stays in his abdomen for long. I asked him if he has any other non-communicable diseases, and he said no. I advised him to go for a check-up at the health center. I gave him a referral. Please advise me, is there anything else you would suggest I do for him before he goes to the health center?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiye umudamu w'imyaka makumyabiri n'icyenda, afite ibiro mirongo ine na bine, aje ambwira ko afite inkorora amaranye ibyumweru bibiri n'iminsi itatu, ambwira ko agira umuriro cyane n'ijoro, akabira ibyuya ibyo aryamiye byose bigatoha yumva yaracitse intege ntacyo ashaka gukora, ngo akababara mu gatuza, kubera guhora akorora cyane. Murebye mbona yarananutse bitewe n'uko nari muzi. Mufatira igipimo cy'umuriro kuko yambwira ko agira umuriro ngo ndebeho ikibazo afite nsanga mirongo itatu na karindwi n'ibice bitanu. Mufatiye tederi nsanga ari negatifu, mubaza niba hari ubundi burwayi afite ambwira ko ari ntabwo, mubwira yuko kuva nta bundi burwayi afite n'ibizamini binyeretse ko nta malariya afite, ejo tugomba kujyana ku kigo nderabuzima agatanga ibizami tukareba niba nta bundi burwayi afite. Hari ubundi bufasha namuha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugore w'imyaka 29 ufite ibiro 44, afite inkorora imaze ibyumweru 2 n'iminsi 3, afite umuriro mwinshi cyane cyane nijoro, abira ibyuya byinshi,yumva yacitse intege cyane, ababara mu gatuza, kandi yatakaje ibiro. Ubushyuhe bwe bwari 37°C kandi RDT yabaye negatifu, nta bindi bibazo by’ubuzima afite. • Ni byiza, kumujyana ku Kigo Nderabuzima kugira ngo asuzumwe igituntu, kuko ibyo ni ibimenyetso by’igituntu (ibyo twita ibimenyetso bya B) kandi birashoboka cyane ko ari igituntu cyo mu bihaha, bityo atangire imiti y’igituntu vuba bishoboka.
question_english: I received a 29-year-old woman weighing 44 kilograms. She came to me reporting a cough that she has had for two weeks and three days. She said that she experiences high fever, especially at night, sweats a lot while lying down, feels very weak, and has no desire to do anything. She also complains of chest pain due to the constant coughing. Upon examination, I noticed that she had lost weight compared to when I had previously seen her. I took her temperature, which was 37.5°C. I also conducted a malaria test, and the results were negative. When I asked if she had any other health issues, she said no. I explained that since the test results show she does not have malaria, we need to visit a health center tomorrow for further tests to rule out any other potential issues. Is there any other assistance I should provide to her?

question_kinyarwanda: Mwiriwe ndi umujyanama w'ubuzima, nakiriye umugabo ufite imyaka mirongo itatu n'itanu ibiro mirongo ine n'icyenda afite muriro nta bundi burwayi asanganywe na mukoreye tederi iba negatifu namuhaye transiferi ntiyabyakira neza. Mwamfasha iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Uyu ni umugabo w'imyaka 35 ufite ibiro 49 wageze afite umuriro, tederi ye yari negative. Ashobora kuba afite igituntu cy'inda, umusonga cyangwa izindi ndwara z'ubwandu. Mukomeze kumwigisha kujya ku kigo nderabuzima kugira ngo bamupime bamenye icyateye uwo muriro ndetse banamenye uburyo bwo kumuvura hakurikijwe ibisubizo by'ibipimo. Agomba kumenya ingaruka zo kwanga kujya kwivuza harimo no gukomeza gukomera kw'indwara.
question_english: Good evening, I am a community health worker. I received a 35-year-old man weighing 49 kilograms who has a fever but no other underlying illness. I tested him for malaria, and the result was negative. I gave him tranafer, but he did not respond well to it. How can you help me?

question_kinyarwanda: Umusore w'imyaka makumyabiri n'umunani,ibiro ni mirongo itanu na bitandatu aje afite umuriro, inkorora n'umutwe. Mfahse igipimo cy'umuriro nsanga ni mirongo itatu n'umunani n'ibice bitanu. Mupimye malariya nsanga ntayo afite. Mubajije niba nta bundi burwayi asanganywe ambwira ko ntabwo. Namuha ubuhe bufasha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Mwohereze Kwa Muganga bamufatire ibizami bindi barebe ikibazo yaba afite, hanyuma anoge n'amazi akonje abashe kugabanya umuriro.
question_english: A 28-year-old young man weighing 56 kg came in with a fever, cough, and headache. I took his temperature, and it was 38.5°C. I tested him for malaria, and the results were negative. I asked if he had any other pre-existing conditions, and he said no. What assistance should I provide him?

question_kinyarwanda: Umubyeyi ufite umwana w'umukobwa ufite imyaka cumi n'umunani yaje angana, ambwira ko uwo mukobwa we atamwiyumvamo, mugira inama yo kumugira inshuti. Nabazaga ko hari ubundi bufasha namufasha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Mu gihe umubyeyi avuga ko umwana w’umukobwa ufite imyaka 18 atamwiyumvamo, birashoboka ko atarumva neza uburyo bwo gukemura ibibazo by’ubucuti, cyangwa se ashobora kuba afite impungenge cyangwa ahangayitse bijyanye n’icyo kibazo. None, mu gihe uwo mwana adashaka kugirana imigenderanire myiza n’umubyeyi we, nyamara umubyeyi ashaka kumufasha, hari inzira zimwe na zimwe zafatwa: Gufata umwanya wo kuganira neza n’umwana: Umubyeyi agomba kumva umwana, hanyuma n’umwana akamwiyumvamo mu buryo bworoshye. Kumwumva no kumutega amatwi ku kibazo afite cyose. Kumubaza uko yifuza ko ikibazo cye cyakemuka, kugira ngo yumve neza ibitekerezo n’amarangamutima y’umwana. Ibi byose nibifatwa mu murongo mwiza, bizafasha umubyeyi kumva neza ibitekerezo n’amarangamutima y’umwana, kandi bigafasha kugera ku gisubizo cyiza kandi kirambye. Murakoze.
question_english: A mother with an eighteen-year-old daughter came to me and told me that her daughter did not feel like her, and I advised her to be friend to her daughter. I was asking if there is any other help I could give her.

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'umukobwa w'imyaka itatu, afite ibiro cumi na bibiri. Aje angana afite ikibazo cy'uko amaze iminsi itatu ahawe umuti wa malariya yoroheje, none akaba adakira, umuriro ugikomeje kuba mwinshi afite igipimo cya mirongo itatu n'umunani, kandi anakorora. Nongeye gupima tederi iba negatifu. Ese uyu mwana yahabwa ubuhe bufasha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Ku mwana uyu, ashobora kuba afite malariya n’umusonga icyarimwe. Ni yo mpamvu atoroherwa neza. Rero muhe amoxicillin na paracetamol. Niba nta mpinduka nyuma y’iminsi 2, ohereza umurwayi ku kigo nderabuzima.
question_english: A three-year-old girl weighs twelve kilograms. She has come in with a concern that she has been undergoing treatment for mild malaria for three days but is not recovering. She has a persistent high fever of thirty-eight degrees Celsius and is also coughing. I have performed a rapid diagnostic test again, and it has come back negative. What kind of assistance can be given to this child?

question_kinyarwanda: Umukobwa ufite imyaka cumi n'itatu, afite ibiro mirongo ine. Atangiye kujya mu mihango ayimaranye iminsi itandatu ariko arababara mu nda yo hasi, nta bundi burwayi asanzwe afite. None uyu mukobwa namufasha nte?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umukobwa ufite imyaka 13, ibiro 40, atangiye kujya mumihango, ayimaranye iminsi 6, ababara munda yo hasi, ntabundi burwayi asanganwe. Uyu mukobwa nukumwohereza kwa muganga, agahabwa imiti igabanya uburibwe (brufen 400mg tds 5/7, spasfon 10mg bid 5/7. Ndetse agakorwa n'ibizamini by'amaraso bakareba ko atamanutse kukigero cyo hasi (FBC, BG rh...), basanga afite amaraso make akaba yahabwa na fefol 1 tab od 30/7. Ndetse akaganirizwa ko ibi bimenyetso afite atari uburwayi ahubwo biterwa niyo mihango.
question_english: A 13-year-old girl, weighing 40 kilograms, has started menstruating and has had her period for six days, but she is experiencing lower abdominal pain. She has no other underlying conditions. How can I help this girl?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umugabo ufite imyaka mirongo itandatu, afite ibiro mirongo itanu na birindwi. Yaje ataka umutwe, agira igihu ku maso ntabashe kureba, kandi akumva nta rutege afite abimaranye iminsi cumi n'itanu. Namubajije niba hari ubundi burwayi asanganywe arampakanira. Namugiriye inama rero yuko yafata imbuto n'imboga. Mubwira ko yajya no kwa muganga bakamufasha. Nabazaga ngo ese nta bindi bipimo yakorerwa?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Wakoze kumwohereza Kwa muganga kuko afite ibimenyetso by'umuvuduko w'amaraso. Ni byiza kujya kwa muganga bakareba niba nta kibazo afite.
question_english: I received a sixty-year-old man, weighing fifty-seven kilograms. He came complaining of a headache, experiencing blurred vision, and feeling weak, which he had been dealing with for fifteen days. I asked him if he had any pre-existing conditions, and he denied it. I advised him to eat fruits and vegetables. I also told him to go to the hospital for assistance. I was wondering if there were any other tests that could be done?

question_kinyarwanda: Mwaramutse! Ngeze ahantu nsanga abantu bari kurwana umwe akomeretsa undi amuca akaboko, mubajije imyaka ye ambwira ko afite imyaka mirongo itatu n'itanu. Mpamagaye ambulance kugira imujyane kwa muganga ambwira ko atarajyayo. None uyu murwayi namufasha iki ? Murarakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Abantu bari kurwana, umwe akomeretsa undi amuca akaboko, ufite imyaka mirongo itatu n'itanu. Pfuka akaboko ugakomeje neza n'isuku nyinshi. Umuhe imiti y'ububabare. Noneho urinde itakazwa ry'amaraso. Umwigishe cyane ko agomba kujya kwa muganga bakamufasha, kugira ngo hatagira ubukoko cyangwa infections zinjira.
question_english: Good morning! I arrived at a place and found people fighting, one injuring the other by cutting off his arm. When I asked his age, he told me he is thirty-five years old. I called an ambulance to take him to the hospital, but he told me he doesn't want to go there. So, how can I help this patient? Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'umukobwa ufite imyaka cumi n'ibiri afite ibiro mirongo itatu na bitanu ikibazo afite, afite ikibazo cy'uko ari kuribwa munda cyane. Mubajije ubundi burwayi asanganywe ambwira ko ntabwo, usibye ko mu mezi ya mbere ashize yagiye mu mihango ihita igenda ukundi kwezi gukurikiyeho, ubundi ukundi gukurikiyeho ntiyaza. Nafasha iki kuburwayi bwuyu mwana?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: **UMUKOBWA W’IMYAKA 12** **UPIMA IBIRO 35 KG** Araribwa mu nda cyane. Yagiye mu mihango ukwezi kumwe, ukundi ntiyaza. * Banza umuganirize atuze, umenye niba ataba yaragize umuntu baryamana. * Niba ahari, umwana yoherezwe kwa muganga apimwe inda. * Niba nta wuhari, nabwo azoherezwa kwa muganga kugira ngo agabanirizwe ubwo bubabare, akorerwe ibizamini bitandukanye: * Ibizamini by’inkari. * Acishwe mu cyuma kugira ngo harebwe niba imihango itaba iza ikaguma muri nyababyeyi kubera kubura inzira mu myanya ndangagitsina, ishobora kuba idafunguye cyangwa inzira ari nto cyane.
question_english: A 12-year-old girl who weighs 35 kilograms is experiencing severe stomach pains. When I asked if she has any other medical issues, she says she doesn't, except that in the previous months her menstrual cycle was irregular. She had her period, but it stopped, and in the following month, it didn't come at all. What can I do to help with this child's condition?

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'umusore w'imyaka cumi n'itandatu, yaje kwivuza ibisebe mu maso, mubaza ko nta bundi burwayi afite, ambwira yuko afite ubwandu bw'agakoko gatera SIDA, ariko kata ko atajya gufata imiti, mugira inama are ageze aho aremera. Namufasha iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Uyu muhungu w’imyaka 16 yagaragaye afite igikomere mu maso kandi asanganwe virusi itera SIDA (VIH). Uyu mwana ashobora kuba afite igikomere ku bwonko cyangwa ibikomere ku mubiri (Physical Trauma). Tangira umwiteho wita ku gikomere cye, ugisukure kandi ugipfuke ukoresheje ibikoresho by’isuku . Hanyuma umwohereze kwa muganga kugira ngo hakorwe ibindi bizamini anavurwe bihagije. Ubuvuzi bukubiyemo kumuha imiti igabanya ububabare nka paracetamol 1g buri masaha 8 hamwe na cloxacillin 500 mg buri masaha 8 mu kanwa.
question_english: A sixteen-year-old boy has come to seek treatment for wounds on his face. When I've asked if he has had any other illness, he has told me that he is infected with the HIV virus but does not take medication. I've advised him, and eventually, he agreed. How can I help him?

question_kinyarwanda: Umurwayi afite imyaka mirongo itatu n'ibiri ibiro mirongo itandatu ni umugore. Afite umuriro wa mirongo itatu n'icyenda, akababara umutwe, akaba yari afite ibyishimo byo gutwita. Mufatiye tederi (TDR) nsanga ni positif. Nari mfite six fois quatre, nayimuha atwite?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Urkoze kuri iki kibazo cy'umurwayi w'umugore ufite imyaka mirongo itatu n'ibiri n'ibiro mirongo itandatu akaba afite umuriro wa mirongo itatu n'icyenda, ababara umutwe. kandi yari yishimiye ko atwite ariko wamufatira tederi ugasanga arwaye malariya. wakoze kumufasha ukamuha umuti wa m​lariya kwariteme sisi fuwa katere kandi nibyo ariko buriya umubyeyi utwite bisaba kumufasha cyane byisumbuyeho kuko kubera uwo muriro wa mirongo itatu n'icyenda akeneye guhabwa ibindi binini bya paracetamolo kugirango uwo muriro ugabanuke. ikindi nukumwigisha cyane kuburyo bwo kwirinda malariya kandi ukamubwirako umubyeyi utwite agomba kuryama munzitiramibi kuko nutayifite iyo agiye kwipimisha bwambere barayimuha ubwo rero agomba kubyitaho kugirango malariya itazamuzahaza kandi atwite. Murakoze!
question_english: A 32-year-old woman weighing 60 kilograms came to me with a temperature of 39°C and a headache. She had recently been excited about her pregnancy. I performed a rapid diagnostic test (RDT) for malaria, which came out positive. I have 6×4 Coartem tablets. Is it safe to give her the medication while pregnant?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umurwayi w'igitsina gore afite imyaka ibiri n'amezi atatu, yaturutse mu mudugudu w'Umukamba. Ibimenyetso afite, yafashwe aruka agira umuriro, igice kimwe cyo hejuru aragagara, arashitagurika. Isuzuma nakoze imitsi y'umutwe iratera cyane amaso yatukuye ibirenge n'ibiganza byahindutse umweru, umuriro rero terimometero yanyeretse mirongo ine n'igice kimwe, malariya amaraso test rapid igisubizo ni negatifu. Imiti n'ibipimo birenzeho yahabwa ni ibihe?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Uwo mwana nukumujyana Kwa Muganga byihuse kuko afite ibimenyetso mpuruza. Wamufasha kugabana umuriro umushyiraho agatambaro gatose ubundi bakihutira kumujyana kwa muganga.
question_english: I received a female patient who is two years and three months old, from Umukamba village. Her symptoms include vomiting, fever, partial upper body stiffness, and convulsions. Upon examination, I found a rapid pulse, red eyes, pale hands and feet, and a temperature of 40.1°C. A rapid malaria test came back negative. What additional medication and tests should she be given?

question_kinyarwanda: Mwiriwe we neza, umugore w'imyaka mirongo itatu n'irindwi, afite ibiro mirongo itaratu na bine. Aje kuboneza urubyaro akoresha uburyo bw'ibinini. Mubajije indi miti y'ubushize ko yayinyweye, ambwira ko ayinywa rimwe na rimwe. Muhaye transiferi ngo ajye ku kigo nderabuzima yanze kujyayo. Ubwo namufasha iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugore w'imyaka 37 afite ibiro 64kg akoresha ibinini mu kuboneza urubyaro, gusa ntabwo ayifata neza. wamusabye ko yajya kwa muganga aranga. Musobanurire ko ashobora gusama mu gihe atanywa neza imiti yo kuboneza urubyaro. Musobanurire ubundi buryo bwo kuboneza urubyaro nk'urushinge niba kunywa imiti y'ibinini bimugora.
question_english: Good evening, a thirty-seven-year-old woman, weighing sixty-four kilograms. She has come for family planning using pills. When I've asked her about other medications she has taken in the past, she's told me she takes them occasionally. I've given her a referral to go to the health center, but she's refused to go. How can I assist her?

question_kinyarwanda: Nasuye uruhinja ku munsi wa karindwi. ni umuhungu. Afite iminsi irindwi, afite ibiro bitatu magana atanu. Nsanga atari yonka kuva mu gitondo saa mbiri kugeza saa saba z'amanywa, ariko rwari rusanzwe rwonka buri saha. Mugira inama yo kujya kwa muganga bakareba impamvu, ambwira ko ari ubunebwe bwo konka bw’uruhinja yanga kujya kwa muganga. ni iki nakora?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze -Banza umubaze niba byibuze azi ibyiza byo kwonsa niba barabimubwiye. -Mubwire ibyiza byo konsa kuriwe no kumwana. -Musobanurire ibibi byo kutonsa ko uretse no guhemukira umwana ko nawe yarwara amabere kubera amashereka menshi ikindi akomeje kutonsa amashereka yagenda agabanuka. -Ganiriza abandi babana nabo bagufashe kumwumvisha kandi mumwigishe kwonsa neza.
question_english: I have visited a newborn on the seventh day. It is a boy. He is seven days old and weighs three and a half kilograms. I have found that he has not suckled from 8 a.m. to 1 p.m., but he used to suckle every hour. I have advised them to go to the doctor to check the reason, but they have told me it is the baby's laziness to suckle and have refused to go to the doctor. What should I do?
