question_kinyarwanda: Muraho! Hari impanuka yabereye mu muhanda w'imodoka; hakomeretsa umugabo w'imyaka mirongo ine ufite ibiro mirongo inani; nta burwayi yarasanganywe. Mushyira ahantu hatuje mukozeho nsanga ntabwo ari guhumeka;; nahise nshyiraho ikimenyetso kigaragaza ko habaye impanuka; ntangira kumuha umwuka. Mpamagara ambilance ariko ntabwo irahagera. Nibazaga niba hari ubundi bufashe naha uwo mugabo.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Uyu ni umugabo w'imyaka 40 wari usanzwe ari muzima, wagize impanuka y’imodoka (RTA), ubu ntiyashobora guhumeka kandi yakomeretse, yatangiye guhabwa umwuka wo gutabara mu gihe hategerejwe imbangukiragutabara. Uyu murwayi ashobora kuba yaragize imvune ikomeye mu bwonko ndetse n’amaraso menshi yamenetse bishobora kuba byaratumye agira hypovolemike shock hanyuma bigakurikirwa no guhagarara k’umutima n’ubuhumekero. Banza urebe inzira z’umwuka, ese zirakinguye, nta kintu kibangamiye? Niba zitakinguye, fata umutwe uwunamure inyuma kandi uzamure urwasaya kugira ngo ufungure inzira z’umwuka, ukomeze guha umwuka wo gutabara, urebe n’umutsi, ese uratera?  Uratera buhoro, uratera cyane cyangwa ntuterwa? Niba nta mutsi, tangira gukanda igituza uherekeza no guha umwuka wo gutabara nyuma yo gukanda, urebe umutsi buri minota 2. Ese hari amaraso akomeza kuva? Niba ahari, gerageza guhagarika amaraso ukoresheje igitambaro gisukuye ugashyiraho igitambaro gikanda. Mujyane kwa muganga. Kwa muganga, hakurikijwe amabwiriza ya ATLS, inzira z’umwuka zizongera gusuzumwa kimwe n’umugongo, x-collar izashyirwaho kugeza igihe imvune y’umugongo ivuyeho. Niba inzira z’umwuka zitakinguye, zizakingurwa, unamura umutwe inyuma kandi uzamure urwasaya, guhumeka n’amaraso bizongera gusuzumwa, niba adahumeka kandi nta mutsi, hazatangizwa ibikorwa byo kumuzanzamura (resuscitation) hakoreshejwe CPR inshuro 30 ku mwuka 2 ukoresheje agapfukamunwa, adrenaline izahabwa buri minota 2 nk’uko bikenewe, binyuze mu miyoboro ibiri minini ya serumu (IV lines), serumu (IVFs) izatangizwa kimwe no kongerera amaraso nk’uko bikenewe, 1L ya NS izatangwa mu buryo bwa bolus hanyuma hakurikizwe uburyo bwo kubungabunga amaraso hakurikijwe ibiro. Niba guhumeka n’umutsi byagarutse, hazakorwa isuzuma ry’umufuka w’umwuka (ventilator), niba GCS iri munsi ya 8 kandi adashobora kugenzura inzira z’umwuka, azashyirwaho umuyoboro wo guhumeka (intubation) kandi ashyirwe ku mashini imufasha guhumeka (mechanical ventilation). Amaraso akomeza kuva azahagarikwa hakoreshejwe kudoda no gushyiraho igitambaro gikanda, azamburwe ariko hakirindwa hypothermia kugira ngo harebwe niba nta bindi bikomere biteye inkeke. Hazakorwa CT scan y’ubwonko byihutirwa kugira ngo harebwe niba nta maraso yamenetse mu bwonko nka subdural cyangwa epidural hematoma bishobora gusaba gukurwamo byihutirwa. Umusego uzazamurwa kugira ngo hagabanuke ICP. Imiti igabanya ububabare izatangizwa hakurikijwe urwego rw’ububabare. Hazanatangwa imiti yo kurinda ibisebe by’inda ku murwayi uri mu cyumba cy’indembe (ICU). Nyuma yo gukira no gutera imbere, umurwayi azasezererwa.
question_english: Hello! There was an accident on the road; a forty-year-old man weighing eighty kilograms was injured; he had no pre-existing health issues. When I placed him in a safe area, I found that he was not breathing. I immediately put up a sign indicating that an accident had occurred and began to provide him with rescue breaths. I called for an ambulance, but it hasn't arrived yet. I was asking if there is any other help can provide to this man.

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umugore w'imyaka mirongo ine n'itanu ibiro mirongo itanu n'icyenda, ari kuva cyane. Amaze iminsi cumi n'ine akoresha ubu buryo bwo kuboneza urubyaro bwa sayana nta bundi burwayi afite. Namusuzumye nsanga arikwereruka mu biganza no mu maso. Nemerewe kumutera sayana?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: -Murakoze kumwakira. -Oya wimutera sayana ahubwo najye kwa muganga babanze barebe ibibazo afite banamufashe. -Mumwigishe ubundi buryo bwo kuboneza urubyaro amaze gufashwa no gukemurirwa ikibazo cyo kuva. -Mu gihe atarahitamo ubundi buryo abe akoresha uburyo bwo kubara cyangwa agakingirizo unamufashe kutubona. -Mwigishe we n'umugabo we barikumwe.
question_english: I have received a 45-year-old woman weighing 59 kilograms, experiencing heavy bleeding. She has been using the Sayana contraceptive method for 14 days without any other illness. Upon examination, I have found she is pale in her hands and face. Am I allowed to give her Sayana?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umwana w'umuhungu umaze iminsi ine avutse, afite ibiro bibiri gusa Yavukanye ibiro bikeya nta bundi burwayi yari afite. Namusize ku munzani nsanga afite ibiro bibiri, nagiriye inama nyina yo kuza aramuheka kangaro akanamushuhisha kandi akamwonsa kenshi. Mwangira iyihe nama nta kindi kintu namukorera kitari icyo? Mungire inama?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umwana umaze iminsi ine avutse yavukanye ibiro bicye afite ibiro 2kg. Nta bundi burwayi yavukanye. Igisha mama we kuzajya ahora amwitaho kandi amureberera, kumurinda ubukonje kuko nabwo butuma asubira inyuma mu biro, kumuheka kuri kangaru kuko bimufasha kongera ibiro no kurushaho kubaka umubano w'umwana na mama we, kureba ko ataruka, kureba ko nta muriro, kujya amupimisha ibiro burigihe kugira ngo amenye niba byiyongera cyangwa bigabanuka. Mushishikarize kugira isuku ihagije kugira ngo atazarwara bikamutera gusubira inyuma. Mwigishe ko agomba kumwonsa kenshi kandi neza, atagize ibindi avangamo atabwiwe na muganga kuko amashereka ubwayo yonyine arimo intungamubiri ihagije. Jya ukomeza umube hafi ukurikirane ko inama wamugiriye azikurikiza. Mwigishe ko iyo abonye ibimenyetso bidasanzwe kumwana cyangwa akomeje kutiyongera ibiro aba agomba kujya kwa muganga kugira ngo barusheho kumugira inama abe yafashwa mu bundi buryo.
question_english: I attended to a four-day-old baby boy weighing only two kilograms. He was born with a low birth weight but had no other health issues. I advised his mother to practice kangaroo care, keep him warm, and breastfeed him frequently. What additional advice should I give, and is there anything else I can do for the baby? Please advise.

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'imyaka cumi nirindwi, ibiro mirongo ine numunani, ni umuhungu. Afite inturugunyu afite ibiheri afite numuriro wa mirongo itatu nikenda, ntaburwayi yari asanganywe. Namugiriye inama yo kwiha akato, mugira n'inama yo kwirinda gukora ingendo, mugira ninama yo gusiga intera metero ebyiri hagati ye n'abandi arabyanga. Nabazaga ngo mungire inama y' icyo nakora.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Urakoze ku kibazo cy'umwana w'umuhungu w'imyaka cumi n'rindwi, ufite ibiturugunyu bine ku mubiri, n'ibiheri umunani kandi akaba afite umuriro wa mirongo itatu n'icyenda yakubwiye ko nta bundi burwayi asanzwe agira none wamugiriye inama yo kwiha akato no gushyira intera hagati ye n'abandi kandi ntakore ingendo. Uyu icyo wamukorera cya mbere nubwo afite izo nturugunyu n'ibiheri ariko afite n'umuriro wa mirongo itatu n'icyenda mu watekereza no kumupima indwara ya malariya ibyo biheri n'ibiturugunyu afite twamenya ibyo ari bishobora kuba ari ibihara cyangwa ari n'ubushita bw'inkende rero mwohereze ajye ku kigo nderabuzima niho bari bubashe kumufataho umwanzuro no kumufasha ku buryo bukwiriye urakoze.
question_english: A 17-year-old boy weighing 48 kilograms came to me with chickenpox, having pimples and a fever of 39°C. He had no pre-existing health conditions. I advised him to self-isolate, avoid traveling, and maintain a two-meter distance from others, but he refused to follow these instructions. I was asking for advice on what else I can do.

question_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'imyaka cumi nitandatu ibiro mirongo itanu na bibiri. Ni umukobwa, afite agahinda kandi yihebye. Nta burwayi yari asanganywe. Namubajije icyamuteye kwiheba, ambwira ko yasambanyijwe n'umugabo atazi amufashe ku ngufu, akaba akeka ko atwite. Mubwiye ngo musuzume nkoresheje agapimisho k'inkari, arabyanga. Namugiriye inama yo kujya kwa muganga ko hari icyumba gifasha abahohotewe arabyanga. Mungire inama y'icyo namukorera?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umwana w'imyaka cumi n'itandatu ibiro mirongo itanu na bibiri. Ni umukobwa, afite agahinda kandi yihebye. Nta burwayi yari asanganywe. Namubajije icyamuteye kwiheba, ambwira ko yasambanyijwe n'umugabo atazi amufashe ku ngufu, akaba akeka ko atwite Uyu mwari wafashwe kungfu uramwicaza umwigishe umupime inda Nakomeza kwinangira uravugisha isange ube wamujyana bamwiteho kuko nicyo bashinzwe
question_english: A sixteen-year-old girl weighing fifty-two kilograms has been feeling sad and depressed. She has had no prior illnesses. When I asked her what caused her depression, she told me that she has been raped by an unknown man and suspects she might be pregnant. I have suggested testing her using a urine test, but she has refused. I have advised her to go to the hospital where there is a unit that helps victims of abuse, but she has also refused. Please advise me on what I can do for her?

question_kinyarwanda: Umukobwa wimyaka makumyabiri afite ibiro mirongo itandatu , yaje angana angisha inama. Ambwirako amaze imyaka makumyabiri ngo ariko nta mihango arabona. mwamfasha iki kubujyanama nagira uyu mukobwa?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umukobwa w'imyaka 20 ufite ibiro 60 yaje afite ikibazo cyo kutajya mu mihango, ushobora kubanza kumubaza igihe nyina yatangiriye kujya mu mihango, cyangwa niba ajya agira ububabare mu nda yo hasi buri kwezi, ukamubaza ku bimenyetso by'uburumbuke bw'inyongera. niba nyina yaratangiye kujya mu mihango atinze, bishobora kuba ari imiterere y'ubuzima bw'umuryango kandi bishobora kumera kimwe kuri we. niba agira ububabare mu nda yo hasi buri kwezi, ashobora kuba afite indeshyo y'imbere itari ifunguye neza ituma imihango itabasha gusohoka. niba nta mpinduka mu bimenyetso by'uburumbuke bw'inyongera cyangwa afite ibimenyetso bisa n'iby'abahungu, bishobora kuba ari imiterere y'ubuzima bw'umuryango, bityo ashobora kujya kwa muganga kugira ngo hakorwe iperereza ryimbitse ku bijyanye n'ubuzima bw'umuryango.
question_english: A twenty-year-old girl weighing sixty kilograms came to me seeking advice. She told me she has never experienced menstruation despite being twenty years old. What can you help me regarding advice can I provide to this girl?

question_kinyarwanda: Umubyeyi ufite imyaka mirongo itatu yaje afite ikibazo cy'umwana we ufite amezi cumi na kumwe ari kw’ibere. Ahitwa cyane kandi akanaruka kubera ko mama we atwite, uko amwonkeje akamererwa nabi cyane. Mugira inama yo kumukura kw’ibere. Ndabaza, ese n’ubuhe bundi bufasha bwakorerwa uwo mwana?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze cyane kuri iki kibazo mubajije cy'uyu mubyeyi ufite imyaka mirongo itatu, waje afite umwana w'amezi cumi na kumwe uri kw'ibere ahitwa cyane kandi akanaruka kubera ko mama we atwite, kandi uko amwonkeje akamererwa nabi cyane. Iyi nama wamugiriye yo kumukura kw'ibere, wabanza ukamubaza igihe iyonda ifite (amezi y'inda), kuko umubyeyi utwite akomeza konsa umwana akiyitaho cyane afata inryo yuzuye kugirango abashe gufasha umwana uri munda kandi anonse kugeza byibuze inda atwite igeze amezi arindwi. Ni byiza rero ko umenya igihe inda atwite ifite, ukabona kumugira inama. Naho kuba umwana ahitwa akanaruka, wamugira inama yo kumujyanama kwa muganga, ugahita umuha taransiferi kugirango bamusuzume bamuhe imiti ivura impiswi nka zinke na oresi kuruta kuba yamukura kw'ibere.  Koko, ashobora kuba arwaye indwara ziterwa n'umwanda, cyane ko umwana ugeze mu mezi cumi na kumwe aba atangiye kugenda afata ibintu byose ashyira mu kanwa, bikaba byamutera kurwara impiswi no kuruka. Murakoze!
question_english: A 30-year-old mother came with concerns about her 11-month-old breastfeeding child. The child has frequent diarrhea and vomiting, as the mother is pregnant and the child reacts poorly to breastfeeding. I advised her to wean the child off breastfeeding. I am asking, what other support can be provided for this child?

question_kinyarwanda: Umusore w'imyaka makumyabiri n'ine afite ibiro mirongo ine n'umunani arababara umugongo yabyimbye ibirenge iyo ukanze ntabwo umubiri ugaruka abimaranye iminsi cumi n'itanu namubajije niba nta bundi burwayi yarasanganywe ambwira ko ari ntabwo namugiriye inama yo kuruhuka kandi yo gukomeza gusa no gukora siporo. Ese hari indi nama nagira uyu muntu kugira ngo akomeze agire ubuzima bwiza?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze kutubaza iki ikibazo cy, uyu musore w,imyaka makumyabiri n,ine,ufite ibiro mirongo ine n, umunani waje ababara umugongo,yabyimbye ibirenge,iyo ukanze ntabwo umubiri kugaruka,abimaranye iminsi cumi n,itanu,umubajije niba nta bundi burwayi yarasanganywe akubwira ko Ari ntabwo.Wamugiriye inama yo kuruhuka no gukomeza gukora siporo.Ukaba ubaza niba hari Indi nama wagira uwo muntu kugirango akomeze agire ubuzima bwiza. Mubyukuri,uyu musore,inama wamugiriye nayo ni nziza,Kuko kuruhuka no gukora siporo,bifasha umubiri kumera neza,gukora neza,Kandi n,ubwonko bukaruhuka.Ariko kuba uyu musore yarabyimbye ibirenge atazi icyabimuteye,nabyo ni ikibazo,Kuko ushobora gusanga arwaye indwara y,impyiko,umwijima,umutima nizindi.Kandi izi ndwara nimbi cyane,iyo utisuzimishije kare,nguvurwe kare zitera ikibazo gikomeye k,ubuzima bw,uyirwaye. Rero uyu musore agomba guhabwa taransiferi akoherezwa ku kigo Nderabuzima kimwegereye bakamusuzuma kugirango harebwe icyateye uko kubyimba ibirenge,ndetse agahabwa n, izindi nama zirebana n,ikibazo afite. Murakoze!
question_english: A 24-year-old man weighs 48 kilograms and is experiencing back pain, swollen feet, and a lack of elasticity in his body when pressed. He has had these symptoms for 15 days. When I asked if he had any pre-existing medical conditions, he said no. I advised him to rest and continue engaging in light physical exercise. Are there any other suggestions I can give him to help him maintain good health?

question_kinyarwanda: Umubyeyi ufite imyaka mirongo itatu, ibiro afite mirongo itanu n'icyenda. Aje afite ikibazo cyo kuvira ku nda. Ambajije ko nta tunini namuha, mubwira ko ibinini bitemewe ahubwo agomba kujya kwa muganga. Ambwira ko afite ikibazo yuko ari mu rugo wenyine. None namuha ubuhe bufasha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Murakoze kwakira uyu mubyeyi ufite imyaka mirongo itatu waje afite ikibazo cyo kuvira ku nda akakubaza niba nta tunini wamuha, nawe ukamubwira ko ntatwo ahubwo akwiriye kujya kwa muganga akaba ariho bamufasha. Mu by'ukuri umubyeyi utwite akenera kwitabwaho na we akiyitaho, cyane cyane iyo inda ikiri mu mezi yo hasi, kuko iyo atitonze ngo atuze agakora imirimo nk'ibyari bisanzwe, hari igihe bituma inda ishobora kugira ibibazo ku buryo yanavamo. Ni yo mpamvu rero uyu mubyeyi urimo kuvira ku nda akwiriye kujya kwa muganga agafashwa, kuko bo bashobora kumucisha mu cyuma bakareba mu nda impamvu arimo kuva n'ikibazo yaba afite, kandi bakanamenya neza amezi inda ifite hanyuma bakamuha ubufasha bijyanye n'uko ikibazo giteye. Uyu mubyeyi rero nta tunini uri bumuhe ahubwo muhe taransiferi umubwire yihutire kujya kwa muganga.
question_english: A thirty-year-old mother weighing fifty-nine pounds presented with a complaint of vaginal bleeding during her pregnancy. She asked if I could provide her with any pills; however, I informed her that pills are not permitted and advised her to see a doctor instead, where she mentioned that she has an issue of being home alone. What assistance can I offer her?

question_kinyarwanda: Mwiriwe neza. Nakiriye umugore w'imyaka makumyabiri n'icyenda, ambaza niba agapira ko ku nkondo y'umuraka katamutera kanseri. Namusubiza gute? Murakoze.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Musobanurire ko kugeza ubu ubushakashatsi butarabyerekana ko katera kanseri, bityo rero ko adakwiye kugira impungenge, yagakoresha mu kuboneza urubyaro nka bumwe mu buryo buhari kandi bukoreshwa.
question_english: Good evening. I have received a 29-year-old woman asking me if the implant in the uterus could cause her cancer. How should I respond to her? Thank you.

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umugore w'imyaka mirongo itandatu afite ibiro mirongo itandatu na bitanu. Afite umuriro wa mirongo itatu na karindwi. Ubundi abana n'ubwandu bwa virusi itera SIDA. Afata imiti neza, akayinwera ku gihe. None amaze iminsi icumi ababara mu nda n'umutwe. Nkore iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugore w'imyaka mirongo itandatu afite ibiro mirongo itandatu na bitanu. Afite umuriro wa mirongo itatu na karindwi kandi abana n'ubwandu bwa virusi itera SIDA. Afata imiti neza akayinywera ku gihe, none amaze iminsi icumi ababara mu nda n'umutwe. Mufatire TDR urebe ko nta maraliya afite, nusanga ayifite ahite atangira coartem. Mushishikarize kunywa amazi ahagije. Niba ufite imiti y'umuriro nka paracetamol, umuhe kugira ngo umworohereze umutwe n'umuriro. Mubaze niba hari ibindi bimenyetso afite nko kuruka, impiswi n'umwuma. Mushishikarize gukomeza gufata imiti y'ubwandu neza nkuko bisanzwe. Mwohereze kwa muganga bafate ibindi bizamini bamufashe bakurikije ibisubizo babonye.
question_english: I received a sixty-year-old woman who weighs sixty-five pounds. She has a fever of thirty-seven degrees Celsius. She has children with HIV infection, takes her medication well, and takes it on time. For the past ten days, she has been suffering from abdominal and head pain. What should I do?

question_kinyarwanda: Muraho, umubyeyi anzaniye umwana w'umuhungu, w'imyaka cumi n'itanu, ibiro mirongo itatu na bitanu. Ambwira ko afite umuriro ari kubabara mu nda. Mushizemo igipimo terimometere musangamo umuriro wa mirongo itatu n'icyenda. Mukorera tederi musanzemo malariya. Mubajije niba nta bundi burwayi asanganwe, ambwira ko ari ntabwo. Mubwira ko yihangana ari buze kumera neza, muhaye sisi fuwa katere. Nabazaga nti, hari ubundi bufasha naha uyu mwana?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Mwakoze kwakira utyu mwana no kumuvura IBINDI WAKONGERAHO -kumwigisha we numuryango we kuri gahund ayo kwirinda malaria birinda ibihuru,ibizinga nibizenga kandi baryama munzitiramibu ziteye umuti kandi banagira isuku muri byose -kunywa imiti neza -gushaka umuti wumuriro nka paracetamol 25omg azajya afata buri masaha 8 muminsi 3 -kumugaburira akarya akananywa bihagije
question_english: Hello, a parent has brought me a 15-year-old boy weighing 35 kilograms. They've told me he has a fever and is experiencing abdominal pain. I've taken his temperature with a thermometer and found a fever of 39 degrees. I've conducted a rapid test and found malaria. When I've asked if he has had any other pre-existing conditions, They've said no. I've told them to be patient as he would get better, and I've given him six times four (six fois quatre). I would like to ask, is there any other assistance I can provide to this child?

question_kinyarwanda: Umudamu yambwiye ko nubwo aboneza urubyaro, ariko umugabo atabishaka. Ngerageza kubimuganiriza umugabo, ntiyabyumva. Uwo mudamu afite imyaka mirongo ine n'umwe. Bafite abana batatu. umugabo ni umusinzi, n'abandi bana ntibitabwaho uko bikwiye. Ambwira ko nabona agafishi azahita agaca. Mugira inama yo kukamubikira, muha agapapuro kanditseho randevu azagarukiraho,none bigenda neza. None nari bwongereho iki ubwo?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Bisaba guhamagara umugabo nawe akigishwa.
question_english: The woman told me that even though she was planning the birth, but the man did not want to. I tried to talk to her husband, he didn't understand. The woman is forty-one years old. They have three children. The man is an alcoholic, and the other children are not properly cared for. She tells me that if he get the form he will immediately cut it. I advised her to keep that form for her, i give her a piece of paper with the date she will return, and now it is going well. So what else was i supposed to add then?

question_kinyarwanda: Umubyeyi w'imyaka mirongo itatu n'itandatu w'umudugudu wa gahondo, apima ibironi itanu numunani. Aje ambwira ko afite ikibazo amaze igihe yumvamo umubiri hakonje, ndetse akumva umugabo we atamushaka. Mufashe umuriro rero agera munsi ya mirongo itatu na karindwi nibice bitanu, yagize mirongo itatu na gatanu. Mubajije ko ntabundi burwayi amaranye iminsi asanganywe, ambwira ko ari nta bwo usibye ko agira isereri, muhaye transiferi. Mumfashe, uyu mubyeyi hari ikindi nari ndamufasha?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umubyeyi w'imyaka 36 upima ibiro 58 yaje avuga ko amaze igihe yumva umubiri we ukonje kandi ko umugabo we atakimwifuza. • Ugomba kumugira inama yo kujya kwa muganga kugira ngo akorerwe isuzuma ryimbitse harimo no gupimwa isukari yo mu maraso (Random blood sugar) kugira ngo harebwe niba atarwaye diyabete kuko nayo ishobora kubitera, ndetse no guhura n'umuganga w'inzobere mu by'ubwonko n'imisemburo (endocrinologist) kugira ngo asuzume urwego rw'imisemburo ye n'uko ikora, hanyuma amugire inama.
question_english: A thirty-six-year-old parent from Gahondo village weighs fifty-eight kilograms. She came to me saying she has been feeling cold in her body for some time and that her husband does not desire her. I took her temperature, and it was below thirty-seven point five, reaching thirty-five. When I asked if she had any other illnesses she had been experiencing, she told me there were none except occasional dizziness. I gave her transfer. Please help me, is there anything else I could have done for this parent?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umugabo w'imyaka mirongo itatu, ibiro mirongo irindwi na bibiri. Yaje yarumwe n'inzoka, namwohereje kwa muganga. Musuye nyuma y'iminsi itatu nsanga aracyarwaye. Mungire inama.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Nibyiza kubaza iki ikibazo cy, uyu Mugabo w'imyaka mirongo itatu, ibiro mirongo irindwi na bibiri.yaje yarumwe n,inzoka umwohereza kwa muganga ,umusuye nyuma y,iminsi itatu usanga aracyarwaye.Ukaba ushaka inama. Nibyo koko kuba wari wamuhaye taransiferi imujyana kwa muganga nyuma yo kumwa n,inzoka,Kuko inzoka yikurumye,igushyiramo ubumara Kandi iyo udahise wivuza,buragenda bugatuma amaraso avura ntabashe gutembera neza mu mubiri,bigatuma n,imyanya y,ubuhumekero ibyimba ikifunga,niyo mpamvu iyo umuntu arumwe n,inzoka agomba guhita ajya kwa muganga bakamuha imiti itesha imbaraga ubumara bw,inzoka. Rero kuba wasubiye gusura uyu Mugabo ugasanga aracyarembye. Uyu Mugabo muhe Indi taransiferi imujyana ku kigo Nderabuzima byihutirwa,bongere bamukurikirane ahabwe Indi miti Kuko birashoboka ko Yaba yarabonye mike ugereranyije n,ubumara bw,inzoka bwamwinjiyemo. Murakoze.
question_english: I received a thirty-year-old man who weighs seventy-two kilograms. He came in after being bitten by a snake, and I referred him to the hospital. When I visited him three days later, I found that he was still unwell. Please advise me.

question_kinyarwanda: Umurwayi afite imyaka mirongo itatu n'umwe w'umukobwa wo mu mudugudu wa Gahodo, apima ibiro mirongo itanu na bitatu, amaze amezi ane ajya mu mihango akamara iminsi makumyabiri n'umwe akiyirimo buri kwezi, kandi mbere yamaraga iminsi itatu cyangwa ine. Mfashe umuriro agira mirongo itatu n'umunani, mfashe tederi iba negatifu. Muhaye taransiferi ngo ajye ku kigo nderabuzima bamurebere ikibazo afite. Mumfashe hari ubundi bufasha nari ndamuha bwisumbuye kubwo muhaye?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Ndumva ntacyo agomba kuza ku kigonderabuzima, nacyo kimwohereza mu bitaro bikuru ngo barebe ikibazo afite gituma amera gutyo. Icyo wamubwira nuko ari bunywe ibintu byinshi akongeraho birimo ibyongera amaraso kugira ngo abashe kugera kwa muganga.
question_english: The patient is a thirty-one-year-old girl from the village of Gahodo, weighing fifty-three kilograms, she has been menstruating for four months and spends twenty-one days every month, and before she spent three or four days. I get a fever that's thirty-eight, i get a TDR that's negative. I Give her a transfer to the health center to see what problem she is having. Help me is there any other help i would have given her higher than that i gave her?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umugabo w'imyaka mirongo ine ibiro mirongo itandatu na bitandatu. Yaje afite umuriro, mupimye nsanga afite mirongo itatu na gatandatu n'ibice bitanu ambwira ko ababara mu nda cyane, akanyara amaraso rimwe na rimwe, akarwara umutwe kenshi, nijoro agira icyokere cyinshi. Namugiriye inama yo kujya kwa muganga, none uyu murwayi nta bundi bufasha yahabwa?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugabo w'imyaka mirongo ine upima ibiro mirongo itandatu na bitandatu. Yaje afite umuriro, maze ubwo nawupimaga nsanga ari mirongo itatu na gatandatu n'ibice bitanu.  Yambwiye ko afite ububabare bukabije mu nda, rimwe na rimwe akabona amaraso mu nkari ze, akunda kugira umutwe, kandi akagira ibyuya byinshi nijoro. Baza amakuru y'amateka y'imibonano mpuzabitsina idakingiye. Tekereza ku ndwara y'ubwandu bw'umuyoboro w'inkari kugira ngo ukureho igituntu cy'uruhago. Nuko muhe imiti igabanya umuriro, umuhe imiti igabanya ububabare. Hanyuma mukore ikizamini cya VIH. Kugira amaraso mu nkari ni ikimenyetso gikomeye giteye impungenge. Mumwohereze ku bitaro kugira ngo akurikiranwe neza.
question_english: I received a forty-year-old man weighing sixty-six kilograms. He came with a fever, and when I measured it, I found it to be thirty-six point five. He told me he has severe abdominal pain, sometimes passes blood in his urine, frequently has headaches, and experiences excessive sweating at night. I advised him to go to the hospital, so is there any other help this patient could be given?

question_kinyarwanda: Nakiriye umudamu w'imyaka mirongo itandatu n'ibiri, ibiro mirongo irindwi yaje ababara umutwe, afite n'umuriro. Mubajije ko nta bundi burwayi afite ambwira ko arwaye umutima, mwohereza kwa muganga musuye nyuma y'iminsi ine nsanga aracyarembye. Mungire inama.
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Ugomba gukomeza kumukurikirana no kwemeza ko ahabwa ubufasha buhagije bw’imibereho.
question_english: I received a 62-year-old woman weighing 70 kg, who came in complaining of a headache and fever. When I asked if she had any other health conditions, she mentioned she has a heart condition. I referred her to the hospital, and after four days, I found that she was still in poor condition. What advice should I follow?

question_kinyarwanda: Mwaramutse neza, umugore w'imyaka mirongo ine, afite ibiro mirongo itandatu na kimwe, afite ikibazo; ahora akorora, akananuka cyane, akabura apeti yo kurya. Mbajije igihe abimaranye, ambwiye ko abimaranye amezi atatu. Mwohereje ku kigo nderabuzima ngo ajye kwivuza, yanze kujyayo ngo arajya kwivuza mu kinyarwanda. Namufasha iki?
answer_clinician_kinyarwanda: Umugore w'imyaka mirongo ine, afite ibiro mirongo itandatu na kimwe, afite ikibazo; ahora akorora akananuka cyane, akabura apeti yo kurya amezi atatu yose. Uramubaza niba yarahuye n'urwaye igituntu umufate timer, umupime umuriro hanyuma unamufate ikizami cy'umusonga ariko wambaye agapfukamunwa. Noneho ube wamuha amogisi ariko umwohereze bajye kumufatira igikororwa kwa muganga.
question_english: Good morning, a 40-year-old woman weighing 61 kilograms has a problem; she is constantly coughing, losing weight significantly, and has no appetite. When I asked how long she has been experiencing these symptoms, she told me it has been three months. I referred her to a health center for treatment, but she refused, saying she would seek traditional medicine instead. How can I help her?
